title: Senior adviseur geotechniek
description: Jouw impact bij Movares Jouw geotechnisch advies bepaalt of civiele projecten veilig, uitvoerbaar en toekomstbestendig gerealiseerd kunnen worden. Dit ga je doen bij Movares Je werkt aan geotechnische analyses, adviezen en ontwerpen voor civiele en infrastructurele projecten; je pakt, afhankelijk van je ervaring, projecten zelfstandig op, van vraagstelling tot advies en ontwerp; je bent sparringpartner voor collega’s en opdrachtgevers bij complexe geotechnische vraagstukken. Geotechniek bij Movares is breed en adviserend. Je werkt voor verschillende opdrachtgevers aan uiteenlopende projecten, zoals spoor- en railinfrastructuur, civiele constructies en waterbouwkundige werken. Je combineert technische analyse met advies en denkt mee over oplossingen die veilig, uitvoerbaar en duurzaam zijn. Binnen het team deel je actief je kennis en draag je bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van Geotechniek. Heb je meer ervaring, dan begeleid je ook junior-adviseurs inhoudelijk. Dit ben jij bij Movares Je bent een ervaren geotechnisch adviseur die verder kijkt dan zijn eigen berekening. Je overziet het geheel, maakt inhoudelijke keuzes en weet collega’s daarin mee te nemen. Je vindt het leuk om kennis te delen en bij te dragen aan de ontwikkeling van collega’s en het team. Werk je nu bij een gespecialiseerd bureau en mis je de breedte van projecten, de invloed op inhoudelijke keuzes of de ruimte om collega’s te begeleiden? Of wil je jouw geotechnische expertise inzetten in projecten met grote maatschappelijke impact? Dan past deze rol goed bij jou. Dit breng je ook mee: meerdere jaren ervaring binnen de geotechniek, passend bij een medior-of senior rol; ervaring met Deltares-software (D-serie); ervaring met Plaxis is een pre, net zoals affiniteit met lijninfrastructuur; sterke schriftelijke en mondelinge vaardigheden in zowel het Nederlands als Engels. Dit krijg je bij Movares Bij Movares werk je aan opgaven die Nederland verder helpen. Tegelijk krijg je de ruimte om je werk en loopbaan in te richten op een manier die bij jou past. Privé profiteer je met de kaart van de dalurenkorting. Maximaal flexibel Vorm een manier van werken die aansluit bij jouw leven én jouw ambities. Veel ontwikkelmogelijkheden Ontwikkel een loopbaan die past bij jouw talenten en ambities. Kies jouw eigen pad: ruimte om je expertise, ambitie en loopbaan verder te ontwikkelen; leren door te doen, samen met ervaren collega's en met gebruik van een breed aanbod aan ontwikkelmogelijkheden; de kans om actief kennis te delen en mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van ons vakgebied. Samen groeien Deel mee in de waarde die we samen creëren en de groei van onze organisatie. Samen voor succes: je flexibele pot groeit mee met de resultaten van Movares; een winstdeling met een doelbedrag van 5% van je brutojaarsalaris, afhankelijk van de resultaten; en de mogelijkheid tot participeren in de waardeontwikkeling van Movares door middel van aankoop van phantom-aandelen. Er is altijd iemand aanwezig en de lijnen zijn kort. De sfeer in het team is open en gelijkwaardig. Er is weinig hiërarchie: senioriteit gaat hier niet over ‘boven iemand staan’, maar over kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Collega’s kunnen goed met elkaar opschieten, schakelen snel en staan voor elkaar klaar. Samenwerken doen we bewust, omdat we geloven dat je daar betere oplossingen van maakt. title: Meewerkstage Architectuur

title: Internship: Explainable AI for the qualification of aerospace algorithms
description: Background Machine learning is increasingly used in aerospace for tasks that have traditionally relied on human experts or on fixed rule-based procedures. For such tasks, data-driven algorithms promise gains in speed, consistency and sensitivity. Before they can be used in practice however, they must be qualified, which means it has to be demonstrated with sufficient substantiation that the algorithm performs its intended function reliably within a defined set of conditions. The qualification approaches used in the sector today were developed for human operators and for conventional systems whose behaviour can be traced back to explicit requirements. They do not translate directly to algorithms whose behaviour is learned from data, and emerging guidance from aviation authorities names explainability as a key ingredient of trustworthy AI, while leaving open how it should be demonstrated in practice. Performance figures on a test set do not show why an algorithm reaches a decision, whether it relies on physically meaningful information, or how it behaves outside the data it was trained on. Explainable machine learning offers a wide range of methods to address this, from feature attribution and saliency methods, to example-based and concept-based explanations, but it is still an open question which of these can provide evidence that is strong enough to support qualification. This project therefore investigates how explainability methods can contribute to the qualification of machine learning algorithms for aerospace, starting from an use case, and provides a comparative assessment of several methods. Assignment The assignment will include the following tasks: A literature study on the qualification of machine learning algorithms in safety-critical sectors and on explainability methods for machine learning (e.g., attribution and saliency methods, example-based and concept-based explanations, interpretable models, uncertainty quantification), including the ways in which explanations themselves are evaluated. A use case provided by NLR, for instance automated defect detection, and identification of the substantiation needed to qualify the algorithm, translated into criteria that explanations should meet. Implementing several explainability methods for the use case and analysing them against these criteria, for example their faithfulness to the model, their robustness and their usefulness to domain experts. Assessing how the resulting explanations can serve as evidence in the qualification of the algorithm, and formulating recommendations for the use of explainability in qualification. Results The final outcomes of this assignment will be: § A structured assessment, as part of a literature study, of explainability methods for machine learning and their suitability for qualification in aerospace, together with a justified selection of the use case. § An implementation and comparative evaluation of several explainability methods on the selected use case, with recommendations on how explainability can support the qualification of the algorithm. § A technical report, either an MSc thesis following the guidelines of your faculty or an internship report, describing the approach, results, and conclusions of the work. Duration For an MSc thesis, the standard duration of a thesis at your faculty applies (typically 9 months). For an internship, the duration is 6 months. Profile You are an MSc student in Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics or a similar master. You have a strong background in machine learning, preferably deep learning. Knowledge of explainable AI is a plus. You have experience with programming in Python and with machine learning libraries, for instance PyTorch or scikit-learn. You have an affinity with aerospace, inspection or certification, and are motivated to bring machine learning closer to qualified use in practice. What we offer A challenging graduation project/internship in a high-tech result orientated work environment Weekly supervision and availability of the technical staff for support An internship allowance Working in an actual R&D project as part of the team Internship results to be used in the current and future projects About NLR Royal NLR has been the ambitious research organisation with the will to keep innovating for over 100 years. title: Senior HR Medewerker (m/v/x)
description: Een ervaren HR-professional die graag complexe HR-vraagstukken oppakt, kennis deelt, overzicht houdt en bijdraagt aan een goede HR-dienstverlening. Daarnaast deel je actief je kennis met collega's, denk je mee over een slimme verdeling van het werk en draag je bij aan de kwaliteit van onze dienstverlening. Jouw werkzaamheden in het kort: Vraagbaak voor het HR-team : je behandelt tweedelijns HR-vraagstukken over bijvoorbeeld arbeidsvoorwaarden, personeelsregelingen en HR processen, detachering, inleen en deelt je kennis en ondersteunt collega’s. Ondersteunen van de HR Adviseurs en managers : je helpt bij operationele HR-vraagstukken en zorgt voor een goede aansluiting tussen HR-processen en de praktijk. Zorgen voor goede HR-dienstverlening : je bewaakt de kwaliteit van de HR-administratie en hebt contact met medewerkers. Je draagt bij aan een juiste en tijdige verwerking van personeelsgegevens en ondersteunt waar nodig bij eerstelijnsvragen. Bouwen aan de HR-afdeling : je signaleert knelpunten, denkt mee over praktische verbeteringen, helpt werkprocessen te uniformeren en deelt je kennis met collega's. Wat breng je mee? We zoeken iemand die senioriteit laat zien in zowel gedrag als HR-kennis. Je hoeft niet alles te weten, maar je hebt een stevige basis, durft verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en weet wanneer je zelfstandig kunt handelen en wanneer afstemming nodig is. First time right is het devies, kwalitatieve en zorgvuldige HR administratie en dienstverlening vinden wij belangrijk. Afgeronde opleiding in HRM of een vergelijkbare richting met minimaal vijf jaar relevante ervaring binnen HR, bij voorkeur in een brede HR-administratieve functie en kennis van AFAS. Je hebt gedegen kennis van HR-processen en ervaring met het zelfstandig behandelen van HR-vraagstukken over arbeidsvoorwaarden, personeelsregelingen en HR administratie. Je bent communicatief sterk, toegankelijk en klantgericht. Je maakt gemakkelijk contact met medewerkers en collega’s op verschillende niveaus. Je werkt graag samen, durft je eigen perspectief in te brengen en staat open voor feedback en andere inzichten. Je werkt nauwkeurig, hebt oog voor details en houdt overzicht en helpt collega’s om werkzaamheden goed en tijdig af te ronden. Je bent gewend en krijgt er energie van om in een snel groeiende en veranderende organisatie te werken. Je beheerst het Nederlands en Engels goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk op C1 niveau. Wat bieden wij jou? Bij NLR krijg je de ruimte om impact te maken én jezelf te ontwikkelen. Je werkt in een innovatieve nationale en internationale hightechomgeving waar nieuwsgierigheid, samenwerking en vakmanschap centraal staan. We geloven dat mensen het beste presteren als ze de vrijheid krijgen om initiatief te nemen, zich te blijven ontwikkelen en een gezonde balans te vinden tussen werk en privé. Verder bieden we je onder andere: Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 4400,- en € 5000 (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek) , afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring; 45 verlofdagen (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek); 8% vakantiegeld én een vaste eindejaarsuitkering van 8%; De kosten voor reizen met het openbaar vervoer worden volledig vergoed. Reis je met eigen vervoer? Dan ontvang je een kilometervergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer. Een zorgtoelage van €145,- bruto (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek) via onze collectieve zorgverzekering bij OHRA als extra ondersteuning voor jouw zorgkosten; Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof; Volop kansen om te blijven leren met opleidingen, trainingen, coaching en andere ontwikkelmogelijkheden; De mogelijkheid om 32-40 uur per week te werken inclusief thuiswerken. Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving Je wordt onderdeel van een breed HR-team met verschillende expertises, van HR-advies en beleid tot recruitment en Learning & Development. We sparren graag met elkaar, houden elkaar scherp en inspireren elkaar om verder te komen. Er is volop ruimte voor jouw ideeën, kennis en initiatief, met oog voor elkaar en het gezamenlijke resultaat. Samen werken we aan HR-dienstverlening die aansluit bij de behoeften van de organisatie en bijdraagt aan onze strategische ambities. Onze HR-afdeling is volop in ontwikkeling en werkt aan verdere professionalisering en verbetering van processen en samenwerking. Dat biedt kansen, maar vraagt ook iets van jou. Je komt terecht in een HR-afdeling waar we volop werken aan het verbeteren van onze dienstverlening. We brengen meer structuur aan, maken onze processen eenvoudiger en werken steeds nauwer samen. Dat betekent dat niet alles al vastligt en dat er ruimte is om mee te denken en dingen slimmer te organiseren. Je standplaats is Amsterdam of Marknesse , maar je bent ook regelmatig op onze andere locatie voor overleg en samenwerking met collega’s. Wat betekent werken bij NLR? Koninklijke NLR is al meer dan 100 jaar een toonaangevende kennisinstelling voor toegepast onderzoek in de lucht- en ruimtevaart. Samen met meer dan 1000 professionals werken we aan innovatieve oplossingen voor een duurzamere, veiligere en efficiëntere lucht- en ruimtevaart. We willen dat iedereen bij NLR de ruimte krijgt om zichzelf te zijn, talenten te ontwikkelen en ideeën in te brengen. title: Customer Service and Sales administaror
description: About Us Cloverleaf Plumbing, Heating & Renewables is a well-established and growing business, proudly serving customers since 1994. We specialise in plumbing, heating, air conditioning and renewable energy solutions, helping homeowners and businesses improve their comfort and energy efficiency. As our business continues to grow, we're looking for an enthusiastic, organised and confident individual to join our friendly office team. About the Role This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys working with people, thrives in a busy office environment, and wants to develop their career in customer relationship and sales. Initially, the role will focus primarily on general office administration, customer service and supporting the smooth day-to-day running of the business. However, we're looking for more than someone who simply processes paperwork. You'll also play an important role in how we welcome new customers, manage incoming enquiries and guide prospective clients through the early stages of their journey with Cloverleaf. As you become familiar with our services, systems and customers, there will be opportunities to take on greater sales responsibilities, develop your commercial skills and earn additional income through a commission structure. You don't need to be a heating or renewable energy expert. We're much more interested in finding someone with the right personality, communication skills and willingness to learn. Key Responsibilities Office Administration & Operations Manage and coordinate boiler and air source heat pump servicing, including customer reminders, bookings and follow-up communications. Complete manufacturer product and warranty registrations, ensuring accurate records are maintained. Assist with the administration of our company vehicle fleet, including servicing, MOTs, insurance and general vehicle records. Maintain accurate customer information, job records and documentation within our Simpro management system. Support the scheduling and coordination of engineers and customer appointments. Liaise with customers, engineers, suppliers and other members of the team to ensure jobs progress smoothly. Assist with general office administration and other operational tasks as required. Customer Enquiries & Relationship Management Act as a friendly, professional and confident first point of contact for customers contacting Cloverleaf by telephone, email or through our website. Handle new sales enquiries, asking relevant questions to understand customers' requirements and identify the most appropriate next step. Qualify and organise incoming enquiries, ensuring customers are directed towards the correct service, appointment or member of the team. Build rapport with prospective customers and maintain communication throughout the early stages of their enquiry. Arrange initial consultations, surveys and follow-up appointments with the appropriate team members. Proactively follow up with prospective customers, keeping conversations moving forward and ensuring opportunities are not overlooked. Maintain accurate customer notes and enquiry records to support a structured and professional sales process. Sales Development & Career Progression As you gain experience and confidence, we would like you to become increasingly involved in the commercial side of the business. This could include: Following up on quotations and helping customers make informed purchasing decisions. Developing the confidence to discuss our services, explain their benefits and address common customer objections. Managing your own customer enquiries and progressing opportunities through the sales process. Helping convert enquiries into confirmed appointments and accepted quotations. Working towards agreed sales targets with the opportunity to earn commission. Full training and ongoing support will be provided as your responsibilities develop. What We're Looking For We're looking for someone who combines excellent organisational skills with a natural ability to communicate and build relationships. Essential Skills & Qualities Previous experience in office administration, customer service or a similar role. Confident, friendly and professional telephone manner. Comfortable starting conversations with new customers and asking questions to understand their needs. Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage several tasks and priorities. Excellent attention to detail and a reliable approach to completing administrative work. Good written communication and computer skills. A proactive attitude, with the confidence to take ownership of tasks and follow them through. Willingness to learn new systems, processes and technical information. A positive, enthusiastic personality and the ability to work well within a small team. An interest in developing customer relationship and sales skills. Desirable Experience Experience working in plumbing, heating, air conditioning, renewables, construction or a related industry. Previous experience in a customer-facing sales or sales support role. Experience using CRM or job management software such as Simpro. Experience managing service schedules, customer appointments or maintenance contracts. Previous involvement in following up on quotations or converting customer enquiries into sales. Industry experience is an advantage but is not essential. We believe that the right attitude, personality and communication skills are just as important as previous technical knowledge. What We Offer Competitive basic salary of £26,000–£29,000 per annum, depending on experience. Opportunity to earn additional sales commission as your role develops. 20 days' annual leave plus 8 bank holidays. An additional 3 days' paid holiday gifted by the company during our Christmas shutdown. Workplace pension scheme. Friendly, supportive and established team environment. Training on our products, services and business systems. Genuine opportunities for professional development as the company continues to grow. The opportunity to play an important role in a growing business within the renewable energy sector. How to Apply If you're organised, enjoy speaking with people and would like a role that offers both variety and the opportunity to develop your career, we'd love to hear from you. We're particularly interested in hearing from candidates who are confident on the telephone, enjoy building customer relationships and are motivated to take on more responsibility over time. Please apply with your up-to-date CV and a brief introduction explaining why you feel you'd be a good fit for our team. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Knowledge of best practices in resilience management, risk and security strategy, crisis preparedness, business continuity, organisational structures and executive decision-making under pressure. Demonstrated expertise in resilience management, including risk and resilience programme development, security and crisis management, business continuity and organisational resilience optimisation. Strong understanding of cyber and digital risks and how they intersect with resilience management, crisis preparedness, business continuity and senior-level risk decision-making. Knowledge of data-driven approaches and understanding the impact of AI on resilience Experience advising boards, executive committees and senior executives, including presenting complex recommendations in a compelling and commercially relevant way. Strong presentation skills, with the ability to structure, visualise and communicate strategic thinking clearly and persuasively. Business-level proficiency in German and English language. Preferred Experience in multiple industries and client operating environments Ability to travel 50+% of the time and on short notice Exceptional written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills, including strong social skills and the ability to build trust quickly with senior clients and internal stakeholders. Ownership, accountability and commercial resilience to drive success both within the team and across Control Risks. The ability to multi-task and balance competing requirements, including client-facing, business development related, and internal matters Committed, enthusiastic and commercially driven, with a “refuse to lose” attitude and a proactive approach to winning client confidence and new work. A high level of integrity, loyalty and discretion Willingness to learn and develop new skills Executive presence, board-level confidence and the ability to present ideas and recommendations in a compelling, visually clear and persuasive way. title: Operations Manager (m/f/d)

Our portfolio includes industrial pumps, tanks, filtration systems and related equipment used in demanding industrial applications. To support our continued growth, we are looking for an Operations Manager to strengthen our operations team at our Roosendaal location. Working closely with the Team Lead Operations, you will play a key role in ensuring smooth and efficient day-to-day operations. Ensure efficient planning and execution of equipment preparation, dispatching, deliveries and returns. Coordinate operational priorities and ensure resources are allocated efficiently. Monitor ongoing activities and proactively address operational bottlenecks. Ensure smooth coordination between workshop, yard, logistics and field service activities. Equipment & Fleet Management Monitor equipment availability, utilization and operational readiness. Coordinate maintenance, inspections, repairs and servicing of rental equipment. Ensure equipment is prepared, tested and ready for customer deployment. Maintain accurate equipment records and ensure proper documentation. Identify opportunities to improve equipment utilization, reliability and lifecycle management. Process Management & Optimization Ensure operational processes are consistently applied and executed. Identify inefficiencies and develop practical solutions to improve workflows. Drive continuous improvement initiatives across operational activities. Support the implementation and standardization of operational procedures. Ensure accurate use of operational systems and documentation. Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with the Team Lead Operations to ensure operational priorities are achieved. Coordinate with Sales to ensure customer requirements and delivery schedules are met. Collaborate with technical teams to resolve equipment-related issues. Support communication between operations, logistics, workshop and administration. Act as a central coordination point for operational matters at the location. Health, Safety & Compliance Ensure compliance with applicable health, safety and environmental requirements. Promote safe working practices throughout all operational activities. Ensure equipment handling, storage, inspections and maintenance comply with internal procedures and applicable regulations. Report safety concerns and support the implementation of corrective actions. Your Profile Several years of experience in operations, industrial services, equipment rental, logistics or a comparable technical environment. Strong technical understanding of industrial equipment, ideally pumps, tanks, filtration systems or fluid management solutions. Experience in operational planning, equipment coordination, maintenance or fleet management. Good understanding of workshop, yard and logistics processes. Strong organizational and coordination skills. Analytical mindset with the ability to identify process inefficiencies and implement improvements. Experience working with operational KPIs and ERP systems. Structured, proactive and solution-oriented working approach. Ability to work independently and coordinate effectively across different departments. Fluent Dutch and good working proficiency in English. Valid driving licence. What We Offer An important operational role within an international and growing organization. The opportunity to contribute directly to operational efficiency and service quality. A varied technical working environment involving pumps, tanks and filtration equipment. Close collaboration with colleagues across different European locations. title: Intermediate Backend Engineer, Authorization
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As a Software Engineer on GitLab's Authorization team, you'll help build and maintain the system that decides what every user, token, and automated agent can access on GitLab.com, Self-Managed, and Dedicated. You'll work alongside experienced engineers who guide the larger design decisions, delivering well-scoped changes and growing into ownership of larger parts of the system.</p> <p>Today, that work is Ruby on Rails. Roughly 400 policy classes and a catalog of about 1,900 permissions sit behind every application programming interface (API) request. You'll work on fine-grained token permissions, custom roles, and the GraphQL and representational state transfer (REST) APIs that enforce them. A single request can trigger hundreds of permission checks, so correctness and performance both matter.</p> <p>You'll also contribute to moving the permission model to a new authorization stack that pairs the Rails monolith with a Rust policy engine. The engine represents access relationships and evaluates permission rules, and can run within the monolith's process or be reached through remote procedure calls using gRPC. You don't need prior Rust experience: several engineers on the team learned it for this work, and we'll support you doing the same.</p> <p>Some examples of our projects:</p> <ul> <li value="1">Refactoring GitLab's policy layer so the same permission definitions can be evaluated by the monolith and the new authorization service</li> <li value="2">Extending fine-grained token permissions to more resources, with guidance from senior engineers on the design</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Implement authorization changes in GitLab's Ruby on Rails monolith so permission checks allow intended access and deny unauthorized access.</li> <li value="2">Deliver well-scoped workstreams from feature-flagged rollout through verifying that the old and new systems produce the same results, with review and guidance from senior engineers.</li> <li value="3">Build and extend fine-grained permissions for tokens and roles so additional resources have permission coverage consistent with the established catalog.</li> <li value="4">Extend and fix authorization enforcement so GraphQL and the REST API enforce the intended permissions consistently.</li> <li value="5">Make incremental refactors to long-lived policy code without changing behavior for existing customers.</li> <li value="6">Investigate and fix reliability, performance, and security issues so affected permission checks return the expected results without regressions.</li> <li value="7">Work with the authentication, platform, and artificial intelligence (AI) teams to document interface contracts that keep permission checks consistent as authorization moves toward a shared service.</li> <li value="8">Contribute to design documents, merge requests, and code reviews so proposed changes have a documented rationale and review feedback is addressed asynchronously.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Solid experience building and maintaining production Ruby on Rails applications, typically gained over 2 to 4 years or more.</li> <li value="2">Hands-on experience with authorization concepts, such as role-based access control or fine-grained permissions, from work or projects.</li> <li value="3">A security mindset: you treat a permission bug as a security bug and consider who a change could affect before choosing an implementation.</li> <li value="4">Experience making careful changes to existing codebases, including incremental refactors and feature-flagged rollouts that preserve existing behavior.</li> <li value="5">Familiarity with GraphQL or API authorization patterns.</li> <li value="6">Awareness of performance, including how repeated permission checks can add up on every request.</li> <li value="7">Strong written communication and the ability to work effectively when most decisions happen in a document or merge request rather than a meeting.</li> <li value="8">Helpful, but not required: hands-on PostgreSQL experience, or experience with Rust, gRPC or Protocol Buffers, Cedar or other policy languages, Zanzibar-style authorization systems, Go, or service-oriented architecture.</li> </ul> <p>We welcome transferable experience from adjacent domains such as identity, policy engines, and platform security.</p> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>We work in a fully asynchronous organization, with most decisions made in documents or merge requests rather than meetings.</p> <p>GitLab's mission is to enable everyone to contribute to and co-create the software that powers our world. Our values include collaboration, results, efficiency, diversity, inclusion and belonging, iteration, and transparency. We expect all GitLab team members to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. title: Credit Risk Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">📍Dublin | 💶 €93,500 - €114,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + benefits | <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U62l09nB0M4">Hear from the team</a> ✨</span></p> <p><strong>⭐ About the team:</strong></p> <p>Our Borrowing (lending) business is growing rapidly across both existing products and the planned launch of new initiatives. We aim to create a genuine feel-good factor when it comes to personal credit, and are looking for driven, analytical and creative individuals to help us achieve this goal.</p> <p>We’re looking for a Credit Risk Manager to help drive the credit and growth strategy for our consumer lending products as we grow our business in Ireland. Our credit teams are part of our Credit Discipline which drives a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. We’re great believers in powerful, real-time analytics and empowerment of the wider business. risk committees and senior management.</li> </ul> <p> <strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have 8+ years’ experience in operational risk, technology risk or related roles title: Territory Account Executive, UAE - Startups
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Dubai, UAE</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>We are seeking a highly accomplished and strategic Account Executive to join our <strong>Digital Natives</strong> team in Dubai. In this advanced role, you will be pivotal in driving significant growth by leading comprehensive sales cycles within a portfolio of assigned enterprise-level clients, and strategically acquiring new logos. The ideal candidate possesses a deep blend of advanced sales acumen and sophisticated technical understanding, enabling them to lead engagements at all levels, from the C-suite to technical leaders (e.g., Head of/VP of Networking or Security).</p> <p>As an Account Executive, you will consistently demonstrate advanced proficiency in all sales activities, ensuring highly accurate forecasting, proactive and strategic pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets. You will be a subject matter expert, speaking fluently about Cloudflare's products, features, benefits, and use cases across diverse customer segments. This role demands the ability to deeply understand complex customer IT Architectures, match them with relevant Cloudflare Reference Architectures, and orchestrate successful, large-scale platform sales. You will be a key driver of digital transformation for our customers, understanding their broader market trends and how Cloudflare uniquely enables their strategic initiatives.</p> <p><strong>Regional Focus: UAE - Startups</strong></p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Strategic Revenue Generation:</strong> Architect and execute advanced territory and account plans to consistently exceed multi-million dollar sales targets and annual quotas, with a strong focus on new business acquisition and expansion within complex enterprise environments.</li> <li><strong>Expert Pipeline & Forecasting:</strong> Lead proactive and strategic pipeline management efforts, demonstrating a sophisticated understanding of sales cycles and customer buying processes. Deliver highly accurate forecasts, providing clear insights and strategic guidance to sales leadership.</li> <li><strong>Deep Customer & IT Architecture Understanding:</strong> Develop a profound understanding of customers' IT architectures, including applications and third-party technologies. Architect and align Cloudflare Reference Architectures to customer environments, driving comprehensive platform solutions.</li> <li><strong>Multi-Engagement Leadership:</strong> Orchestrate and manage multiple complex customer engagements simultaneously across various business units within an organization. Strategically connect disparate needs to strengthen Cloudflare's platform sale, actively involving and influencing technical C-level minus one executives.</li> <li><strong>Virtual Team Leadership:</strong> Set clear direction and lead a virtual team of in-GEO specialists, Product Managers, Deal Desk, and Legal to collaboratively manage and close complex customer opportunities. Proactively identify and navigate through situations to address colleague and customer needs, escalating as appropriate to drive urgency and efficient delivery.</li> <li><strong>Digital Transformation Authority:</strong> Act as an authority on digital transformation, understanding key drivers (e.g., new offering development, enhanced customer capabilities) and the broader market trends influencing these decisions. Position Cloudflare as a critical enabler of these transformations.</li> <li><strong>Compelling Value Creation:</strong> Articulate highly compelling, strategic value propositions for Cloudflare's services, directly linking them to customer business outcomes and strategic objectives. Lead with a strong focus on the "why," communicating the whole picture to both internal and external stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Advanced Negotiation & Closure:</strong> Expertly lead and navigate complex contract negotiations, driving win-win scenarios for all parties. Demonstrate advanced closing skills across new business and expansion opportunities.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisor & Coach:</strong> Build long-term, executive-level strategic relationships, ensuring deep customer adoption, retention, and expansion. Consistently provide clear, direct, and constructive feedback to team members, coaching them to improve communication, learn from mistakes, and enhance the quality of work. title: Directeur des opérations Datacenter (H/F)
description: Head of DC Operations (H/F) Région parisienne Votre mission Dans un environnement où la disponibilité et la fiabilité des infrastructures sont essentielles, Isatalent recherche un(e) Head of DC Operations pour piloter les opérations de ses data centers en région parisienne. Rattaché(e) à la direction, vous êtes garant(e) de la performance opérationnelle, de la continuité de service et de la fiabilité des infrastructures. Vous encadrez les responsables de site et travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d'expertise centrales, les clients et les partenaires de maintenance. Dans un contexte de croissance de l'entreprise et d'exigences opérationnelles, vous jouez un rôle clé dans l'harmonisation des pratiques, la structuration du pilotage des activités et l'accompagnement du changement auprès des équipes. Votre objectif : construire une vision opérationnelle consolidée, maîtriser les risques et fédérer les équipes autour d'exigences communes de performance, de sécurité et de qualité de service. Vos responsabilités Piloter la stratégie et la performance des opérations multisites Élaborer une feuille de route opérationnelle à court et moyen terme, en définissant les priorités, les plans d'action et les ressources humaines et financières nécessaires. Définir et harmoniser les méthodes de pilotage des activités opérationnelles sur l'ensemble des sites. Consolider et faire évoluer les KPI et tableaux de bord portant notamment sur la disponibilité des infrastructures, la maintenance, la communication client et le respect des procédures. Analyser les résultats, identifier les écarts de performance et piloter les actions correctives. Produire un reporting structuré à destination de la direction et éclairer les décisions stratégiques. Manager les responsables de site et accompagner la transformation Encadrer et accompagner les responsables de site dans le pilotage de leurs activités et le développement de leurs compétences. Apporter une expertise opérationnelle et technique permettant de challenger les choix, les priorités et les plans d'action. Favoriser l'autonomie, la responsabilisation et la coopération des équipes. Organiser l'allocation des ressources et le suivi des plans de charge. Accompagner la réorganisation du périmètre, harmoniser les pratiques et contribuer à l'intégration de nouveaux sites. Travailler en transversalité avec le responsable du pôle Expertise et les autres fonctions de l'entreprise. Garantir la fiabilité des infrastructures et maîtriser les risques Garantir la disponibilité, la résilience et la continuité d'exploitation des infrastructures critiques. Superviser la maintenance préventive, corrective et réglementaire, ainsi que les travaux, extensions, rétrofits et changements réalisés en environnement exploité. Reprendre et consolider la cartographie des risques opérationnels et techniques, notamment les points uniques de défaillance (SPOF) et les obsolescences critiques. Hiérarchiser les risques, définir les plans de traitement, en évaluer les impacts financiers et humains et identifier les investissements nécessaires. Piloter les incidents majeurs, les escalades, les analyses de causes et le suivi des actions correctives et préventives. Garantir le respect des exigences de sécurité, de conformité et de continuité de service. Développer la relation client et le partenariat avec les mainteneurs Garantir le respect des engagements contractuels, des SLA et des standards de qualité attendus par les clients. Renforcer la qualité de la communication opérationnelle et la confiance avec les interlocuteurs clients. Développer une relation constructive et partenariale avec les mainteneurs et les prestataires. Améliorer la coordination des interventions, le suivi des engagements et la qualité des prestations. Identifier les axes de progrès et piloter les actions d'amélioration de la performance des partenaires. Piloter les budgets et l'amélioration continue Élaborer et suivre les budgets OPEX et CAPEX du périmètre. Arbitrer les priorités de maintenance, de renouvellement et d'investissement en fonction des risques, des capacités et des engagements clients. Garantir le respect des exigences réglementaires, environnementales, HSE, ICPE et des référentiels ISO applicables. Déployer des standards, procédures et méthodes de travail homogènes. Contribuer à l'amélioration de la performance énergétique des installations, notamment du PUE, et à la maîtrise des coûts d'exploitation. Votre profil Formation et expérience Formation supérieure, idéalement Bac +5, de type ingénieur ou master spécialisé en génie électrique, énergétique, climatique, maintenance industrielle ou management des opérations. Un Bac +3 technique pourra être étudié au regard d'une expérience particulièrement solide. Expérience significative dans l'exploitation, la maintenance ou la direction technique d'infrastructures critiques. Expérience significative en management de managers, en pilotage multisite ou dans une fonction de responsabilité opérationnelle comparable. Expérience confirmée dans un environnement critique fonctionnant 24h/24 et 7j/7, avec de fortes exigences de disponibilité, de sécurité et de conformité. Expérience en gestion d'incidents majeurs, pilotage de budgets, gestion des risques et conduite de transformations opérationnelles. You'll investigate new attack surfaces, including AI coding agents, agent plugins, and package ecosystems, and build systems that help detect threats and improve vulnerability advisories.<br>This is a full-stack role: you'll take an idea from the first research question to a working proof of concept, deploy it, and analyze the results yourself. Artificial intelligence (AI) is central to how we work. You'll use AI tools daily and build agentic workflows for research, analysis, and detection.<br><br>What you'll do</div> <ul> <li>Research new attack surfaces and threat vectors, including AI coding agents, agent plugins, and package ecosystems.</li> <li>Find and responsibly disclose vulnerabilities in open source projects and developer tools.</li> <li>Analyze software supply chain incidents and events.</li> <li>Build AI-powered workflows and agents that automate research, analysis, and detection.</li> <li>Build and maintain the cloud-based systems behind our detection and advisory work.</li> <li>Improve the quality and coverage of our vulnerability and malware advisories.</li> <li>Write up your findings as blog posts and present them at conferences.</li> </ul> <div>What you'll bring</div> <ul> <li>Hands-on security experience in research, malware analysis, penetration testing, or security tooling, with an understanding of package ecosystems and software supply chain attacks.</li> <li>Both a developer mindset and an adversarial mindset: you can build systems and think about how to break them.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience using AI in real work, such as building with large language model (LLM) application programming interfaces (APIs) or agent frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, or agent software development kits (SDKs).</li> <li>Strong programming skills in Go or Python, with good software engineering practices, including testing, code review, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), and writing maintainable code.</li> <li>Experience deploying and running production services on a public cloud.</li> <li>The ability to map attack vectors, explain trade-offs, and use data to move experiments forward, balancing quality, speed, and customer outcomes.</li> <li>Clear writing for engineers and a general audience, and keeping up with security and AI industry trends.</li> <li>Helpful, but not required: Google Cloud Platform (GCP); Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) entries or published findings; research on AI agents, LLM applications, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers; blogs, talks, or open source security tools; Terraform or OpenTofu; databases or data pipelines at scale; reverse engineering.</li> <li>You don't need deep knowledge of compilers or static application security testing (SAST) engines. A high-level understanding is enough.</li> </ul> <div>About the team<br>We're the Threat Research group. We maintain the GitLab Advisory Database, which powers GitLab's dependency scanning, and publish our findings on the Security Labs blog.<br>Our work includes research on the Shai-Hulud npm worm and a critical remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability in Serena, a popular MCP coding agent.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <div> <div id="message-list_1791138600000.D0C5GUG3LB0"></div> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. title: Regional Field CTO
location: EMEA, Germany, Netherlands, France, Italy, Ireland, Finland, Sweden)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Black Duck Software, Inc. helps organizations build secure, high-quality software, minimizing risks while maximizing speed and productivity. Black Duck, a recognized pioneer in application security, provides SAST, SCA, and DAST solutions that enable teams to quickly find and fix vulnerabilities and defects in proprietary code, open source components, and application behavior. With a combination of industry-leading tools, services, and expertise, only Black Duck helps organizations maximize security and quality in DevSecOps and throughout the software development life cycle.</p></div><p><strong>Regional Field Chief Technology Officer</strong></p> <p><strong>Location: EMEA, Remote (Black Duck has entities in UK, Germany, Netherlands, France, Italy, Ireland, Finland, Sweden)</strong></p> <p> </p> <p>Black Duck® meets the board-level risks of modern software with True Scale Application Security, ensuring uncompromised trust in software for the regulated, AI-powered world. Only Black Duck solutions free organizations from tradeoffs between speed, accuracy, and compliance at scale while eliminating security, regulatory, and licensing risks. Whether in the cloud or on premises, Black Duck is the only choice for securing mission-critical software everywhere code happens. With Black Duck, security leaders can make smarter decisions and unleash business innovation with confidence.</p> <p> </p> <p>We are looking for a Regional Field Chief Technology Officer to serve as a senior technical executive, trusted advisor, and public voice of our technology strategy in the market. In this role, the Regional Field CTO will operate at the intersection of technology, sales, and the customer — engaging directly with C-level and technical leaders at our most strategic customer accounts, translating our AI-driven platform capabilities into credible technical narratives, and representing the company as a thought leader across the industry. This is a customer-facing, pre-sales technical leadership role reporting to the VP of Sales Engineering, with a dotted line to Product & Technology.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong>:</p> <ul> <li>Serve as trusted technical advisor and recurring executive sponsor for C-level and senior technical stakeholders at strategic, enterprise, federal and other key accounts — pivoting fluidly between business strategy conversations, risk, compliance, and deep technical architecture reviews.</li> <li>Lead highly visible, multidisciplinary technical engagements of strategic importance across the region, including executive briefings, architecture reviews, whiteboard sessions, customer advisory feedback loops, and partner or analyst-facing discussions.</li> <li>Represent Black Duck as a technical evangelist for the platform and roadmap within a region, delivering keynotes, webinars, whitepapers, and thought leadership content at industry events, and representing the company externally with press, analysts, and partners.</li> <li>Translate Black Duck platform AI/ML, detection engine, and platform architecture capabilities into clear, credible narratives for both technical and executive audiences, speaking candidly to responsible AI practices such as data privacy, model governance, and human-in-the-loop controls.</li> <li>Partner with Sales and Presales leadership on the region’s most strategic and enterprise opportunities, leading technical deep-dives, architecture reviews, whiteboard sessions, and executive briefings, and advising on the technical implications of new product launches, roadmap changes, and competitive positioning.</li> <li>Support RFPs and security questionnaires with authoritative technical input, and articulate competitive and technical differentiation, including nuanced comparisons of AI/ML capabilities against alternatives in the market.</li> <li>Proactively engage strategic accounts to strengthen technical trust, identify expansion opportunities, mitigate renewal risk, and guide customers toward secure software development and application security maturity.</li> <li>Identify and solve problems of strategic or industry scope, using innovative approaches to remove technical barriers, strengthen customer confidence, and improve business outcomes.</li> <li>Provide field-informed guidance on emerging AI-assisted software development, agentic workflows, application security trends, and competitive market dynamics that may influence Black Duck strategy or customer adoption.</li> <li>Capture, synthesize, and escalate regional customer, partner, and market feedback into actionable input for Product, Engineering, and Sales systematically capturing technical objections and influencing the roadmap, packaging, launch readiness, and go-to-market strategy.</li> <li>Coach, enable, and review technical storytelling by sales engineers and account executives, including how to explain AI features accurately without overclaiming.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications and Experience Required</strong>:</p> <ul> <li>15+ years in a senior technical leadership role (CTO, Sales Engineering leader, Principal Architect, or equivalent), including several years in a customer-facing or field/pre-sales capacity.</li> <li>Proven track record engaging and influencing C-level and senior technical audiences at enterprise organizations, with demonstrated success across complex enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Domain expertise in application security (SAST, SCA, DAST), enterprise architecture, cloud/SaaS platforms, APIs and integrations, and security best practices.</li> <li>Deep, practical understanding of AI/ML concepts as applied to security (e.g., anomaly detection, large language models, behavioral analytics, AI-assisted software development, agentic workflows), along with a candid grasp of their limitations and the practical limitations and controls needed for responsible adoption.</li> <li>Demonstrated success negotiating with and influencing executive leadership, significant customers, partners, analysts, or vendors to shape technical decisions and business outcomes.</li> <li>Ability to exercise wide latitude in determining objectives and approaches for complex, critical assignments with material regional, functional, or market impact.</li> <li>Experience shaping standards, methods, practices, or market-facing technical narratives within an industry or discipline.</li> <li>Proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear stories for both executive and highly technical audiences, including customers, partners, press, analysts, and internal stakeholders.</li> <li>Demonstrated industry presence — conference speaking, published thought leadership, active contribution to industry/analyst communities, customer advisory leadership, or comparable external technical influence.</li> <li>Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, able to translate complex technical concepts for both technical and executive audiences.</li> <li>Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% to customer sites and industry events.</li> <li>Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>MBA or other advanced degree.</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>Black Duck is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, age, disability, sexual orientation, veteran or military service status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Black Duck complies with all applicable laws prohibiting employment discrimination in every jurisdiction where it operates and provides reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable law.</em></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Alternant(e) Data Analyst H/F
description: L'école et le contexte Kaischool est une école supérieure spécialisée dans les domaines de l'intelligence artificielle, du Big Data et de l'ingénierie d'affaires, proposant des formations certifiantes en mode hybride à Fontenay-sous-Bois. Pour accompagner notre développement, nous accueillons deux alternant(e)s Data Analyst en contrat d'apprentissage de 24 mois. Vos missions Vous analyserez les données internes et celles liées à nos programmes de formation pour optimiser nos processus pédagogiques et commerciaux. Vous concevrez des tableaux de bord et des rapports exploitables pour l'équipe pédagogique et la direction. Vous participerez également à la structuration des bases de données de l'école et à la mise en place d'indicateurs de performance clés. Ce que nous recherchons Vous maîtrisez les outils de visualisation de données et possédez de bonnes compétences en SQL et en manipulation de données. Vous êtes rigoureux(se), doté(e) d'un bon esprit synthétique et capable de travailler dans un environnement dynamique. Si vous ne cochez pas l'ensemble des cases mais que vous apprenez vite, candidatez tout de même. Vos premiers mois Dès votre arrivée, vous prendrez en main les outils de reporting existants et collaborerez avec l'équipe sur les analyses en cours. Vous aurez rapidement l'opportunité de concevoir vos propres tableaux de bord pour suivre les performances des programmes de formation. Rémunération La rémunération proposée pour ce poste est de EUR 20,000–45,000 par an. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: AI Native - Project Delivery Lead
description: Quick answer: what is this job? PALO IT is hiring an AI Native Project Delivery Lead in Paris, France (hybrid) to own end-to-end project delivery from pre-sales engagement to final handover. The role requires at least 8 years of experience leading software delivery in agile, iterative contexts, strong client-facing leadership, and comfort embedding PALO IT's Gen-e²™ AI-first delivery practices into everyday project governance. About PALO IT At PALO IT , we don’t just build software, we invent the AI-first future of enterprises. As a global technology consultancy, our patented Gen-e²™ methodology puts AI at the core of everything we do, transforming how businesses design, deliver, and evolve digital solutions. We are a diverse collective of 450+ AI-native professionals across 11 offices , united by our commitment to excellence, integrity, and positive impact. Proudly independent since 2009, we combine agility and global reach, pioneering the “agentic organization” model we implement for our clients. What does an AI Native Project Delivery Lead do at PALO IT? As an AI Native Project Delivery Lead within PALO IT in Paris, you own end-to-end project delivery, from pre-sales engagement through to final handover, driving AI-augmented innovation and seamless execution at every phase. Your responsibilities include: Ensure project transparency. Share clear KPIs with teams and clients to track progress and anticipate risks. Lead project advancement. Maintain a clear view on requirements and milestones; unblock teams proactively. Guarantee service quality. Support PALO IT Labs teams, relay client feedback, and facilitate resolution of blockers. Be a trusted advisor for clients. Build strong, strategic partnerships aligned with their business goals. Partner with account management. Oversee financial performance (P&L) to secure sustainable project success. Facilitate cross-stakeholder communication. Serve as the central contact for senior client stakeholders, internal teams, and commercial leadership. Drive key reporting and governance. Document and share progress, risks, and decisions effectively. Host collaborative workshops. Create alignment on objectives and working methods anchored in Gen-e²™. Coach and uplift your Gen-e²™ delivery team. Promote continuous improvement, embed Gen-e²™ practices, and lead ceremonies (plannings, reviews, retrospectives). Advise clients on product management. Help define vision, optimize backlogs, and maximize delivered value. What experience do you need for this role? You're a strong fit for this AI Native Project Delivery Lead role if you have: At least 8 years of experience driving software delivery in agile and iterative contexts from discovery to maintenance as a natural leader. Excellent direction-setting and communication skills organizing teams and aligning objectives to boost efficiency and project outcomes. A deep understanding of clients' strategic and business context , enabling you to anticipate needs and adopt their point of view. Strong facilitation and dialogue skills , confidently engaging senior decision-makers and fostering smooth interaction across all stakeholders. Servant leadership practice situational awareness, conflict resolution, empowerment, and transparency in team dynamics. Comfort stepping into Scrum Master and/or Product Owner roles when needed. Ideally, a passion for Tech for Good (B Corp values) , including accessibility, sustainability, and ethical AI. Fluency in French and English ; additional languages are a plus. PALO IT values diverse profiles and encourages you to apply even if you don't check every box, especially if you: Share your expertise at conferences or in Software Craftsmanship communities. Contribute to open source projects. Are passionate about eco-design, social challenges, and sustainable innovation. Engage in associations or meetups focused on humanity and the environment. What we offer A playground matching your expertise missions chosen for their complexity, engineering excellence, and meaningful business and societal impact. Dedicated career coaching regular development check-ins and goal support. A demanding yet supportive technical community code reviews, pair programming, mentoring to raise development craft daily. Gen-e²™ skill ramp-up from week 1, fully integrated onboarding. Funded Microsoft, Anthropic and GitHub certifications. From idea to impact internal R&D labs, default open source culture, tech conferences, and innovation dojos to experiment and share. …Plus: 🌍 Global career opportunities with cross-sector and multi-country missions, connecting 11 offices worldwide. 🏠 Remote-friendly arrangements depending on project needs, alternating client sites and the Paris République office for team collaboration. 🌱 Impact Academy — training on climate, digital responsibility, and accessibility embedded in everyday practices. 🤝 Solidarity engagements — team volunteering, skills sponsorship, and more. 🥗🩺 Benefits including Swile meal vouchers and Alan health insurance. Frequently asked questions about this role Is the AI Native Project Delivery Lead role remote or on-site? The role is hybrid, based in Paris, France, alternating between client sites and PALO IT's Wagram office depending on project needs. How many years of experience are required for this role? At least 8 years of experience driving software delivery in agile and iterative contexts, from discovery through maintenance. What does an AI Native Project Delivery Lead own at PALO IT? End-to-end project delivery from pre-sales engagement to final handover including client relationship management, P&L oversight with account management, governance and reporting, and coaching the Gen-e²™ delivery team. Do I need to be a Scrum Master or Product Owner to apply? Not necessarily, but you should be comfortable stepping into either role when a project needs it. What is Gen-e²™? Gen-e²™ is PALO IT's patented AI-first methodology, which puts AI at the core of how the company designs, delivers, and evolves digital solutions for clients. What makes PALO IT different from other technology consultancies? PALO IT has been independent since 2009, employs 450+ AI-native professionals across 10 countries and 11 offices, is a certified B Corporation, and is pioneering the "agentic organization" model, the same model it implements for its clients. What benefits come with this role? Dedicated career coaching, funded Microsoft and GitHub certifications, a Gen-e²™ skill ramp-up from week one, global mobility across 11 offices, remote-friendly arrangements, the Impact Academy, skills-based volunteering, plus Swile meal vouchers and Alan health insurance. Diversity, equity and inclusion At PALO IT, diversity isn't just a value, it's our innovation engine. As a certified B Corp, PALO IT ensures equal opportunity and assesses candidates solely on skills, potential, and motivation. PALO IT welcomes and celebrates all identities and backgrounds without discrimination. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Founding Full-stack Software Engineer
description: Who we are Lemrock builds the infrastructure of agentic commerce. Tomorrow, consumers won't just buy on e-commerce websites. They will discover, compare and purchase directly inside conversational AI interfaces like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and a growing long tail of specialized AI assistants. For brands, this is a major shift: if they are not present in these environments, they become invisible. Our mission: enable any brand to exist, sell and distribute in this new channel. We raised a €7M seed round (the first in Europe on this market), with Jean-Baptiste Rudelle, founder of Criteo, on our board, and the Bpifrance DeepTech label. Today, Lemrock is already: 100M+ conversations per month 150+ brand clients a $100B market structuring at high speed Context You'll join a small, high-ownership engineering team building production systems that serve millions of users. We care deeply about code quality and clean architecture — and we intend to keep it that way as we scale. Your Mission Your goal is to build and ship the product that powers Lemrock's commerce infrastructure — with full ownership, from design to production. Concretely, you will: Ship features end-to-end that reach millions of users — from data model and API design to the interface they interact with. Scale and harden our backend as traffic, integrations, and product complexity grow. Shape the architecture of the codebase — enforce clean boundaries, maintain modularity, and make decisions that compound as the team scales. Move fast across the stack — backend, frontend, infra, data — wherever the highest-impact work is on any given week. Candidate Profile Strong academic background, proven professional track record, or hands-on entrepreneurial experience 4+ years of hands-on software engineering experience Deep proficiency in TypeScript Experience with structured backend architectures (DDD, hexagonal, or similar) Has owned features end-to-end: data model → API → frontend → deployment Comfortable with AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code) Thrives in ambiguity and 0-to-1 environments — ex-founders or entrepreneurial mindsets are a strong fit Professional proficiency in French & English Tech Stack Core (required) TypeScript, NestJS, React PostgreSQL, Redis Docker Clean architecture patterns (hexagonal, ports & adapters) Bonus (appreciated but not required) GCP (Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, BigQuery), Terraform Vector databases, embeddings, LLM integrations Domain-Driven Design (DDD), CQRS TanStack (Router, Query, Table), shadcn/ui, Tailwind, Vite Durable workflows (Inngest, Temporal) Why Join Us Join a company in early breakout mode , already generating revenue, with a clear technological edge and strong financial backing to fuel its growth Work directly with an experienced team : two repeat YC founders who've scaled product & tech before, a former strategy/innovation director (10 years in the sector), and ex-strategy consultants (McKinsey QuantumBlack, BCG) Be part of the next structural shift of the web — agentic interfaces Own mission-critical topics , grow fast, and shape the company's future trajectory Package Competitive salary + equity, disclosed during the interview process. title: Manager Design Engineer - Facilities (f/m/d)
description: About us We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects About our technology The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution The Role We are seeking an experienced Manager Design Engineer - Facilities (f/m/d) at Black Semiconductor to provide senior-level technical leadership in the design, modification, and commissioning of semiconductor manufacturing facility infrastructure. You will play a key role in bridging front-end design intent with construction execution, commissioning, and operational readiness, ensuring that facility infrastructure meets the requirements of our semiconductor manufacturing operations. To join our team, you should be excited to Lead the design, review, and validation of mechanical, electrical, and civil/structural systems for semiconductor manufacturing facilities. Develop utility matrices, P&IDs, and single-line diagrams for equipment installations and tool hookups. Coordinate with EPC contractors, A/E firms, and equipment OEMs to ensure design intent is met. Support technology migrations, new tool installations, and brownfield modifications. Develop detailed cost models and capital expenditure estimates for facility projects. Provide technical direction and mentorship to junior and senior engineers. Your Qualifications At least 10 years of experience in semiconductor, advanced manufacturing, or mission-critical facility design, including a minimum of 5 years in a principal or senior technical leadership role. Strong knowledge of mechanical and electrical plant systems, including low- and medium-voltage (LV/MV) systems, transformers, HVAC, exhaust systems, scrubbers, compressors, and cleanrooms. Strong leadership skills, with the ability to provide technical direction and mentorship to engineers. Fluent in both English and German , with excellent communication skills. Basic knowledge of AutoCAD and Navisworks. Proficiency in reading and preparing technical schematics, performing engineering calculations, interpreting blueprints, and understanding BMS software. Experience in engineering project budget preparation, budget control, and energy cost evaluation and control. Experience with FMEA and resilient design. Professional registration with a recognized engineering body will be considered a plus. Our work culture People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. title: Key Account Manager 🇫🇷
description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. ⭐️ The Key Account Management Team Our Account Management team’s purpose is to make our key accounts stay and grow with Alan. We created the team in 2020 and we are now 30+. We are looking for amazing people to help us take care of our growing pipe, especially with our medium-touch segment and large accounts. title: Business Development & Tender Manager (Netherlands) - all genders
