You will be instrumental in developing and improving our product and service offering. You will be accountable in particular for network size and securing new contracts. We are looking for highly-motivated individuals with a commercial background, clear business acumen and strong communication skills, who can successfully drive major tenders and develop the Dutch market in line with ubitricity goals and ambition. Based in our Amsterdam office on Keizersgracht 452, you'll be part of an international, collaborative team that values trust, ownership and open communication. We work in a hybrid setup with three days per week in the office, balancing flexibility with meaningful in-person collaboration. Regular travel within the Netherlands will allow you to build strong relationships with partners and municipalities and make a tangible impact on the country's transition to sustainable mobility. Responsibilities Owning and leading major public tenders from end to end, bringing together cross-functional teams, coordinating key stakeholders and driving competitive, high-quality bids through to contract award and signature. Identifying and securing new business opportunities with public authorities and strategic partners across the Netherlands. Building and maintaining strong relationships with decision-makers at national, regional and local government level. Shaping and executing ubitricity's commercial strategy and value proposition in the Dutch market. Representing ubitricity at industry events, conferences, trade fairs and market consultations, strengthening our visibility and influence across the sector. Acting as a trusted ambassador for ubitricity within key industry organisations such as NAL, NKL and Elaad. Leading commercial negotiations with public authorities, grid operators and other strategic stakeholders. Building and expanding a strong network across the Dutch energy and e-mobility ecosystem. Monitoring market developments, regulatory trends and competitive dynamics to identify new growth opportunities. Contributing to industry working groups and helping shape the future of smart and grid-aware charging solutions. Strong track record of managing complex stakeholder environments and driving projects to successful outcomes. Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills. Ability to influence decision-makers and build long-term partnerships. Entrepreneurial mindset with a strong sense of ownership and accountability. Experience in the e-mobility, energy or infrastructure sector is advantageous. Experience with public procurement, B2G sales or tender processes is advantageous. Full professional proficiency in Dutch and English, with the ability to engage confidently with public authorities and senior stakeholders. Our Offer Why Join ubitricity? Help accelerate the transition to cleaner and more sustainable transportation. Work in an international and purpose-driven company with ambitious growth plans. Take ownership of meaningful projects with visible impact. Collaborate with passionate colleagues across Europe. Enjoy a hybrid working environment that combines flexibility with teamwork and connection. Grow professionally while helping shape the future of public EV charging. Diversity & Inclusion At ubitricity, we believe that diverse teams build better solutions. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences and identities. Even if your experience doesn't match every qualification listed, we encourage you to apply. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we're looking for. title: Senior Imaging Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of the <a href="https://www.hudl.com/blog/hudl-2026-top-100-inspiring-workplaces?utm_medium=internal&utm_source=job-ad&utm_campaign=26_NA_talent_job-ad&utm_content=1org_learn-more_blog-link_learn-more_2blog_organic_3ctw">Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces</a>.<br><br>We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.<br><br>Ready to join us?</p> <div style="padding: 56.25% 0 0 0; position: relative;"><iframe style="position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; border: 0;" src="https://player.vimeo.com/video/1095624224?h=9e8cdc9dbe&badge=0&autopause=0&player_id=0&app_id=58479" width="" height=""></iframe></div> <p> </p></div><h2>Your Role</h2> <p>We’re hiring a Senior Imaging Engineer to join our optics and imaging team. You’ll own key parts of the image quality across our multi-camera systems, ensuring our cameras automatically capture high-performance footage that powers computer vision, tracking and insights for teams around the world.</p> <p>As a Senior Imaging Engineer, you’ll:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Evaluate and improve camera systems.</strong> You’ll measure, analyze and improve how optics, sensors and image signal processing (ISP) perform across our computer vision applications.</li> <li><strong>Test and qualify hardware.</strong> You’ll evaluate lenses and camera modules against optical and environmental specifications, run qualification tests and partner closely with external suppliers on technical follow-up, and refine optical test methods for both lab environments and production lines</li> <li><strong>Support ISP tuning.</strong> You’ll tune exposure, white balance, tone mapping and dynamic range, while contributing to camera control and 3A algorithms to enhance downstream computer vision.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate and lead.</strong> You’ll contribute to imaging requirements and trade-offs alongside product managers and our optics lead, own projects end-to-end and share knowledge to mentor fellow engineers.</li> </ul> <h2>Location</h2> <p>Time spent collaborating with your teammates in-office will be a regular part of how you work. We’re currently considering applicants within commuting distance of Den Bosch. You’ll be expected to work more days in-office than remote, but will have the freedom to coordinate your specific in-office schedule with your team.</p> <h2>Must-Haves</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Proven imaging experience.</strong> You have deep experience in imaging, camera systems or optical engineering, ideally working on shipped hardware products, bringing a strong understanding of optics, image sensors and ISP pipelines.</li> <li><strong>Hands-on lab expertise.</strong> You bring practical experience measuring image quality - including MTF/SFR, noise, color and distortion - using lab equipment like collimators, test charts and climate chambers.</li> <li><strong>Proficient programmer.</strong> You’re comfortable using Python for analysis and tooling, as well as C/C++ on embedded Linux.</li> <li><strong>A clear communicator.</strong> You explain technical trade-offs to non-specialists with ease and make sound decisions even when working with incomplete data</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Nice-to-Haves</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Control algorithm development.</strong> Experience developing camera control algorithms such as auto exposure and auto white balance.</li> <li><strong>Calibration knowledge.</strong> Experience with camera calibration (intrinsics, extrinsics and distortion models) and multi-camera or stitched systems.</li> <li><strong>Supplier collaboration.</strong> Experience partnering with suppliers and manufacturing partners on specifications, sample evaluations and issue resolution.</li> <li><strong>Embedded platform experience.</strong> Familiarity with embedded camera platforms and ISP tuning tools.</li> </ul> <h2>Our Role</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Champion work-life harmony</strong>. We’ll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time above any required statutory leave, company-wide holidays, remote work options and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too.  Plus, every five years, we give you a paid sabbatical to unplug and recharge.  </li> <li><strong>Guarantee autonomy</strong>. We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you’ll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.</li> <li><strong>Encourage career growth. </strong>We’re lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We’ll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.</li> <li><strong>Provide an environment to help you succeed</strong>. We've invested in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you’re at the office or working remotely, we’ll provide you the tech you need to do your best work.</li> <li><strong>Support your wellbeing. </strong>Depending on location, we offer medical and retirement benefits for employees—but no matter where you’re located, we have resources like our Employee Assistance Program and employee resource groups to support your mental health.</li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>The base salary range for this role is displayed below—<strong>starting salaries will typically fall near the middle of this range.</strong></p> <p>We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices. </p> <p>This role will also be eligible for a long-term incentive (LTI) award. Any bonuses awarded are based on individual and company performance paid at Hudl's discretion. </p></div><div class="title">Base Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€60.000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€101.000 EUR</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Privacy Policy</strong></h2> <p><strong><a href="https://www.hudl.com/jobs/hudl-applicant-and-candidate-privacy-policy"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Hudl Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy</span></a><br><br></strong></p></div> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: (Senior) Team Lead Sales B2C (w/m/d)
description: Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One +, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert. Jetzt bauen wir unser nächstes Kernprodukt auf: Klimaanlagen . Greenfield . Enpals nächste Marktführerschaft. Dafür suchen wir die Person, die unseren Inside-Sales-Vertrieb from scratch aufbaut und führt. Deine Aufgaben Aufbau statt Verwaltung: Du bist die erste Sales-Führungskraft der neuen Unit. Du startest mit 3 bis 5 Sales Managern und skalierst das Team auf 8 bis 12 und prägst es dabei mit deinen Prozessen, deinem Leitfaden und deiner Handschrift. Das Recruiting verantwortest du gemeinsam mit Talent Acquisition, vom Anforderungsprofil bis zur Einstellungsentscheidung. Sales Playbook: Du entwickelst unseren Sales-Leitfaden für Klimaanlagen, von der Bedarfsanalyse über die Einwandbehandlung bis zum Closing, und optimierst ihn kontinuierlich auf Basis von Daten und Gesprächsanalysen. Prozesse, Tools & Markt: Du führst skalierbare Sales-Prozesse ein und entwickelst gemeinsam mit Marketing, Produkt und Operations CRM, Tools, Lead-Qualität und die Übergabe an Planung und Installation weiter. Dabei beobachtest du Markttrends und Wettbewerbsaktivitäten und übersetzt Kundenfeedback in Impulse für Angebot, Pricing und Verkaufsstrategie. Ramp-up & Coaching: Du onboardest neue Sales Manager strukturiert und bringst sie schnell auf Ziel-Performance. Dafür nutzt du einen klaren Einarbeitungsplan, Shadowing, Zertifizierung und definierte Ramp-up-KPIs. Anschließend entwickelst du jedes Teammitglied durch regelmäßige 1:1s, Call-Reviews und Side-by-Side-Coaching individuell weiter und gibst dabei klares, konstruktives Feedback. Performance-Steuerung: Du etablierst ein transparentes KPI-System (z. B. Erreichbarkeit, Termine, Conversion, Umsatz pro Kopf) und steuerst damit Kapazitäten und Performance des gesamten Teams: von Lead-Verteilung und Schichtplanung inkl. saisonaler Peaks bis zu Conversion Rates entlang des gesamten Funnels. Du erstellst Forecasts, leitest Maßnahmen ab, setzt sie konsequent um und berichtest an die Geschäftsführung. Leading by Example: Du bist nah am Kunden, führst insbesondere in der Pilotphase selbst Verkaufsgespräche und prägst eine leistungsorientierte, wertschätzende Teamkultur. Dein Profil Du bringst mindestens 5 Jahre Vertriebserfahrung im B2C mit, idealerweise im Inside Sales (Telefon/Video) mit erklärungsbedürftigen Produkten, z. B. in Energie, PV, Wärmepumpe oder Haustechnik. Außerdem hast du eine Affinität zu Energie, Gebäuden und Haustechnik. Du hast mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung in der disziplinarischen Führung eines Sales-Teams. Für das Senior-Level sind es 4+ Jahre bzw. die Führung von 8+ Personen. Nachweisbarer Track Record: Du hast selbst überdurchschnittlich verkauft und Teams messbar zur Zielerreichung geführt. Du hast Erfahrung im Onboarding und Coaching von Sales Manager:innen sowie im Aufbau von Gesprächsleitfäden und Sales-Playbooks. Datengetriebener Steuerungsansatz: Du arbeitest sicher mit CRM-Systemen und KPI-Dashboards und erkennst Hebel im Funnel schnell. Aufbau-Mentalität: Du gehst gern in Greenfield-Situationen, packst selbst mit an und übernimmst volle Ownership. Du kommunizierst stark und überzeugend, begeisterst Menschen und führst sie zu Spitzenleistungen. Du sprichst verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und gutes Englisch in Wort und Schrift. Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, dein Potenzial zu entdecken - unabhängig davon, ob deine Erfahrung jede einzelne Voraussetzung erfüllt. ☀️ Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit. Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten. Grown-up Business & Startup Spirit - In unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain findest du von höhenverstellbaren Tischen, Tischtennisplatte bis gefüllten Getränkekühlschränken und Barista-Coffee alles was das Herz begehrt. Dein Kick-start bei Enpal - Onboarding-Tag mit Welcome Bag, Buddy-Programm und einem Team, das dich wirklich abholt. Bleib auf dem Laufenden & gestalte mit - Transparente All-Hands, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Feedback-Kultur, denn ohne Fehler gibt es keinen Fortschritt. Energiewende geht nur gemeinsam - Bei Enpal erwartet dich ein legendärer Teamspirit und unvergessliche Team- und Companyevents. Dein Extra-Boost - 29 Urlaubstage + je ein freier Tag an Heiligabend und Silvester, vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Wellhub und Corporate Benefits. Alles, was dir hilft, Arbeit und Leben gut zu verbinden. Vorsorge für deine Zukunft – Wir denken nicht nur nachhaltig, wenn es um Energie geht, sondern auch, wenn es um dich geht. Nutze unsere betriebliche Altersvorsorge und baue dir Schritt für Schritt ein solides Fundament für deine Zukunft auf. Mache dein Zuhause smart – Nachhaltigkeit fängt in den eigenen vier Wänden an. title: Process Automation Engineer - Internship (f/m/d)
description: We are Metrify Smart Metering , Germany’s largest competitive smart metering operator, and a new strategic spin-off initiative by Enpal. Are you ready for one of the great infrastructure challenges of the 2100s? To truly transform into a decentralized power grid that can support a fully electrified, renewable future, millions of homes need to be equipped with smart meters and control systems. That’s why we are performing the fastest smart meter roll-out in the German market at unprecedented scale, shaping the way this digitally transformed grid will operate. Our mission is to enable utilities, grid operators, and energy providers to install and operate smart meters. Our service portfolio covers all aspects of metering operations: from electricity meter installation and market communication to data management and clearing. While Metrify emerged from Enpal, we now operate independently in the market, serving a broad range of commercial customers, energy suppliers, and municipal utilities Automate the operations behind every meter exchange Metrify's Multi-Family Home team runs meter exchanges in apartment buildings, and your code will help run them. In a team of seven, you'll turn the operations we do by hand into automations that save time, reduce errors, and ship faster. What you'll do Develop the automation layer on our ERP system. Write Python scripts that pull and process data from internal and external APIs, Airtable, and our ERP interface. Map end-to-end operational processes with the team, then design automations that handle every edge case. Build an ops layer so non-technical colleagues can run and understand your tools without asking you. Work directly with the Multi-Family Home team, business operations, and tech and product, and be the bridge between them. What you'll bring A technical background in computer science or engineering (EEE, mechanical, or similar). Strong business profiles with real tech skills are welcome too. Programming experience, ideally Python, and comfort working in a code repository (e.g., Git, GitHub, or similar). Curiosity about how businesses actually run, and an eye for edge cases. Clear communication, including explaining technical topics to people who don't code. Fluent English. German is a plus. Availability for a 6-month full-time internship, with the chance to stay on. Nice to have: SQL experience. Why this role stands out Real impact from day one: Your automations will be used in live meter installation and business operations. Design freedom: You choose the tech stack, tooling, and approach. We're early, so you'll shape how things are built. Visibility: You'll work closely with the team lead and see how a business runs end to end. Are you interested, even if you don't meet all the requirements? Apply anyway! We look forward to discovering your potential — regardless of whether your experience meets every single requirement. ☀️ What we offer Work at Germany's first green unicorn - Play an active role in shaping the solar energy transition. The sun shines all over the world - At Enpal, you'll work with a highly motivated, diverse team of over 65 nationalities. Grown-up business & startup spirit - In our modern office in Berlin-Friedrichshain, you'll find everything your heart desires, from height-adjustable desks and table tennis to stocked beverage fridges and barista coffee. Your kick-start at Enpal - Onboarding day with a welcome bag, buddy program, and a team that really supports you. Stay up to date & help shape the future - Transparent all-hands meetings, short decision-making processes, and an open feedback culture - without mistakes, there is no progress. The energy transition can only be achieved together - At Enpal, you can expect legendary team spirit and unforgettable team events. Investing in your future – We don’t just think sustainably when it comes to energy, but also when it comes to you. Take advantage of our company pension scheme to build a solid foundation for your future, step by step. Make your home smart – Sustainability starts at your doorstep. As part of our team, you’ll benefit from a permanent 25% discount on the entire Bosch Smart Home product range – for an even more efficient and connected home. At Enpal, we are proud of the diversity of our team. We do not make decisions based on skin color, religion or religious beliefs, ethnic or national origin, nationality, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, or age—neither during the hiring process nor throughout the employment relationship. Enpal is committed to providing a safe workplace and takes a firm stance against discrimination and harassment of any kind. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: HPC and CAE Owner
description: Engineering Environment Owner - HPC & CAE Location: Cambridge (UK) or Lausanne (Switzerland) About the role Neural Concept builds AI-powered solutions that help the world’s leading engineering teams design better products, faster. As Engineering Environment Owner, you’ll enable our teams to develop blueprint solutions across different CAD/CAE environments and create a strong foundation for testing and improving our agents. You’ll own a critical part of how we work and help our product succeed in the diverse engineering environments our customers rely on. What you will do Own the internal engineering environment: CAD and CAE tools, licences and compute infrastructure. Work with product engineers and vertical engineers to understand their needs and improve their CAD/CAE setup, from software and configuration to access and compute resources. Stay hands-on: script, automate and troubleshoot to keep environments reproducible and catch issues before they disrupt teams. Manage shared compute and licence resources, vendor relationships and spend. Monitor usage and performance (utilization, wait times, cost per run) and share what you see with the teams. Who you are A builder at heart, you enjoy turning engineering needs into useful tools and workflows. Your approach combines creativity and independence with a product mindset: choosing what to build or reuse, making it easy for teams to adopt, and owning its deployment, operation and improvement. Experience at an OEM, Tier 1 supplier, or CAE or cloud provider, with practical insight into engineering workflows in sectors such as automotive, aerospace or electronics. Hands-on CAE experience (CFD and/or FEA) and a practical understanding of high-performance computing (HPC) for simulation workloads. Ability to design how CAD, PLM, CAE and compute fit together, drawing on domain experts for depth in individual tools. A pragmatic approach to collaboration and problem-solving, keeping processes simple and removing barriers for others. What you get A world-class technology team that aims for excellence. Competitive salary and rewarding opportunities as we scale. A collaborative, multicultural environment where work is visible and recognized. Professional growth alongside talented colleagues who share knowledge freely. Global impact, helping customers shift to AI-assisted design. Hybrid model (40% remote) and flexible hours. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where you can thrive. title: Outcome Testing and Controls Assurance Officer
description: About Allica Bank Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech. Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers. Role Description This role is responsible for delivering Outcomes Based Testing (OBT), providing independent, evidence-based assurance that Allica is consistently delivering good customer outcomes in line with the FCA's Consumer Duty. The role also undertakes Secondary Controls Testing in accordance with Allica's Risk Management Framework. The successful candidate will plan and execute a portfolio of testing activities, communicate findings clearly to stakeholders, and agree, monitor, and support action plans through to resolution. They will work collaboratively with Risk Business Partners and the wider First Line of Defence (1LoD) Controls team. Beyond completing testing against a defined framework, the role requires a proactive and analytical approach. The role holder will identify root causes, drive meaningful remediation, and provide constructive challenge to stakeholders, helping to improve customer outcomes and strengthen Allica's control environment. Principal Accountabilities Conduct outcome-based testing across Allica’s customer facing journeys to assess whether customer outcomes are consistent with Consumer Duty obligations.  Review customer cases, communications and operational activity to identify potential customer harm, process weaknesses or customer experience issues, including the treatment of vulnerable customers.  Assess both process execution and customer experience, ensuring documentation is complete, communications are clear and customers do not face unnecessary barriers or delays.  Communicate Outcomes Based Testing results clearly to relevant stakeholders, ensuring findings are understood and owned.  Agree appropriate action plans with stakeholders to remediate instances of poor outcomes and track these through to closure.  Deliver Secondary Controls Testing, assessing the design and operating effectiveness to obtain an overall rating for each control, in line with Allica’s Control Testing Standards.  Communicate control testing output to stakeholders and agree action plans where control weaknesses or failures are identified.  Accurately update RiskSmart with control test results, ratings, findings and associated action plans.  Maintain regular engagement with Risk Business Partners across the wider 1LoD Controls team on control testing outputs, sharing themes and supporting a consistent testing approach.  Escalate significant issues, risks or thematic concerns in a timely manner.  Contribute to the continuous improvement of Outcomes Based Testing and controls testing methodology, templates and reporting.  Ensure all testing is conducted objectively and independently, in line with Allica's Risk Management Framework and relevant regulatory requirements, including the FCA Consumer Duty and Conduct Rules.  Support reporting and insight through dashboards and analysis, contributing to root cause identification and continuous improvement initiatives. Personal Attributes & Experience Capable of working in a fast-paced environment, managing complex, competing and alternating priorities across control testing and outcomes based testing with a constant focus on delivery.  Strong analytical and investigative skills, with the ability to identify root causes behind poor customer outcomes or control failures, not just symptoms.  A confident, clear communicator, able to present findings and constructively challenge stakeholders at varying levels of seniority.  Show curiosity and sound judgement when assessing customer journeys and identifying potential customer harm or process weaknesses.  Demonstrate a proactive and solution-focused mindset, with a desire to improve processes and customer experience.  Be able to work independently with minimal supervision, while remaining a collaborative and engaged member of the wider team.  Have experience of controls testing, quality assurance, outcomes-based testing, or 1st/2nd line risk and assurance work, ideally within Financial Services.  Have a working knowledge of the FCA Consumer Duty and Conduct Rules, and how these apply in practice to Allica’s products and supporting customer journeys.  Be explicit in demonstrating where they've gone the extra mile, embraced new challenges, or stood out from their peers in a previous testing, assurance or risk role. Working at Allica Bank At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers. Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind: Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities Options for flexible working Regular social activities Pension contributions Discretionary bonus scheme Private health cover Life assurance Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave Don’t tick every box? Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you! Flexible working We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate. Diversity We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Software Engineer, Delivery : Release
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p>The Software Delivery Section, part of the Infrastructure Platforms Department, is dedicated to enhancing the safety, reliability, and overall customer experience of GitLab’s complete software delivery process. We aim to provide seamless and efficient delivery of GitLab products across all platforms, including SaaS multi-tenant, self-managed, and SaaS single-tenant environments. Our primary goals are to accelerate delivery cycles, minimize incidents, and ensure high-quality releases that consistently meet and exceed customer expectations. By focusing on these objectives, we aim to improve GitLab’s end-to-end software delivery process, making it more reliable, efficient, and aligned with the needs of our users.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <p>Backend Engineers with the Software Delivery:Release bring not only a strong background in backend development but also a solid understanding of, or keen interest in, infrastructure and operations. In this role, you will work alongside Site Reliability Engineers (SREs) to enhance release management tooling, infrastructure, and processes. While SREs approach these responsibilities from an operational standpoint, Backend Engineers provide a software development perspective, collaborating closely to deliver efficient and safe solutions for streamlined code delivery across various supported environments. This role is ideal for individuals with a strong coding background who are also comfortable working on infrastructure, automation and operations-related topics or are motivated to develop expertise in these areas.</p> <ul> <li>Guarantee the<a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/releases/"> GitLab Release Process</a></li> <li>Create new tools and frameworks to automate the release process</li> <li>Build new GitLab release features to replace existing custom tooling by contributing to <a href="https://theseus.gitlab.net/platform/components/release-framework/">new work for our Release Framework</a> </li> <li>Work with individual teams on defining and implementing solutions that will help them release quicker</li> <li>Create frameworks that allow engineers to write code that scales with demand</li> <li>Help teams instrument their code and helps recognize parts of code that could benefit from increased observability</li> <li>Work closely with peer Infrastructure Platforms groups to control the impact of application code running in user facing products</li> <li>Help communicate the release schedule clearly with others</li> <li>Develop monitoring and alerting to measure release process velocity</li> <li>Identify process bottlenecks and introduce optimizations</li> <li>Participate in <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/deployments-and-releases/#release-managers">Release Manager</a> rotation</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements</strong></p> <p>As an ideal candidate, you will have </p> <ul> <li>Strong coding background. Mandatory Ruby or Go (willing to learn Ruby is a must). Proficiency with Ruby is a strong plus. <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/job-families/engineering/backend-engineer/#professional-experience">Ruby on Rails</a> knowledge is not mandatory</li> <li>Experience working on large-scale systems</li> <li>Experience optimizing Continuous Delivery and Continuous Deployment pipelines as well as the tooling and processes that go with them</li> <li>Interest in cloud platforms, containerization, and Infrastructure as Code tools</li> <li>Application and systems observability background</li> <li>Collaboration mindset, boundless curiosity and a demonstrable ability to learn</li> <li>A product development mindset when developing new components</li> </ul> <p> You share our<a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/values/"> values</a>, and work in accordance with those values.</p> <p><strong>Performance indicators</strong></p> <p>The Delivery team has the following performance indicators:</p> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/infrastructure/performance-indicators/#mean-time-to-production-mttp">Mean Time to Production</a> </li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

title: Territory Account Executive, Philippines
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Singapore</p> <p><strong>About the Department</strong></p> <p>The Cloudflare APAC sales organisation operates as one integrated revenue system. Account Executives, Customer Engineers, Partner Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Customer Experience Managers, Professional Services and Revenue Operations work as a continuous engine — winning, deploying, adopting, expanding, and scaling platform commitments across the full customer lifecycle.</p> <p>The system is supported by an AI-embedded operating model. The work itself, however, remains human. The role of every seller at Cloudflare is to bring critical thinking, judgment, and trust to customer relationships and outcomes.</p> <p><strong>About This Role</strong></p> <p>In this role, you will be responsible for driving significant growth by landing and expanding a portfolio of commercial accounts in the <strong>Philippines market</strong>. The ideal candidate possesses a strong blend of sales acumen and technical understanding, enabling them to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical buyers. As an Account Executive, you will drive revenue velocity by utilizing foundational sales data layers for accurate forecasting, proactive pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets.</p> <p>You are the kind of operator who uses AI as a force multiplier every day, cares more about customer outcomes than job boundaries, and demonstrates curiosity, judgment, and high agency.</p> <p><strong>Role Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and execute a comprehensive territory plan to consistently achieve and exceed sales and revenue targets.</li> <li>Cultivate long-term strategic relationships with key accounts and partners. Lead executive-level transformation narratives that earn the right to be in the architecture conversation.  </li> <li>Leverage top partners as an extension of the sales team to co-sell alongside where they bring customer relationships, services capability, or procurement leverage. Drive regular forecast & pipeline cadences with top partners.</li> <li>Understand customer network architectures, the problems that Cloudflare can solve and effectively translate Cloudflare’s solutions to drive successful platform sales, ensuring clients can secure and scale their own AI-driven workloads.</li> <li>Manage contract negotiations and structure platform-level commercial commitments (multi-year, multi-product, outcome-anchored) rather than point-product deals.</li> <li>Stay engaged through onboarding, adoption, and the first renewal. Partner with Customer Engineers, Professional Services on a deployment plan with milestones tied to measurable outcomes.</li> <li>Proactively build and manage a robust sales pipeline by leveraging internal tools, AI-assisted research and pipeline sources (BDR, Channel, Marketing).</li> <li>Maintain high standards in pipeline discipline, CRM hygiene and forecasting accuracy. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Required Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Fluent in English and Tagalog to engage with customers in Philippines</strong></li> <li><strong>Sales experience in cities outside of Manila (e.g. Antipolo, Cebu, Davao, Batangas) is a plus</strong></li> <li>Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.</li> <li>Experience selling technology solutions in high-growth technology firms.</li> <li>Demonstrated track record of consistently meeting and exceeding multi-million dollar quota targets.</li> <li>Proficient in discovery, positioning, competitive selling, negotiation, closing, and multi-threaded land and expand strategies.</li> <li>Strong understanding of computer networking, cloud security technology, and how enterprise infrastructure adapts to automated data workflows.</li> <li>Exceptional interpersonal communication skills and value selling skills.</li> <li>Proficiency in modern sales software, customer data environments, and core systems (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, G-suite).</li> <li>Thinks critically rather than reacting, exercises judgment under uncertainty, names risks honestly, shows genuine empathy for customers as people, can point to relationships built over time on trust, and demonstrates visible curiosity in how they prepare, sell, and learn.</li> <li>Willingness to actively engage with AI tools and experiment.</li> <li>Ability to travel as required.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Singapore</p> <p><strong>About the Department</strong></p> <p>The Cloudflare APAC sales organisation operates as one integrated revenue system. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. title: Senior Engineering Manager - Agents and Context - Platform
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.</p></div><h3><strong>What is The Role</strong></h3> <p>The Chat team, part of Elastic’s Agents and Context group, builds the conversational and agentic platform that lets customers chat with and operate on their own data in Elasticsearch. We own the conversation experience, the agent harness and tools, retrieval and citations, streaming, memory, and the evaluation layer that keeps answers grounded and reliable. Everything we ship is production software that other Elastic solutions build on.</p> <p>As Senior Engineering Manager you will lead a distributed team of approximately 12 engineers building this platform. Every engineering team at Elastic is led by a trio of Product Manager, Technical Lead and Engineering Manager. You will directly manage the engineers on the team, act as its primary project manager, and work with the PM and Tech Lead to define and deliver the roadmap. This is a people and delivery leadership role in a fast-moving space: the right person is energized by shaping structure where there is little, and keeps a calm, direct style while priorities shift.</p> <p>Our company is distributed by intention. We hire the best engineers we can find wherever they are, whoever they are. As a result, our team is diverse and distributed across continents. The ability to lead a distributed team is critical.</p> <h3><strong>What You Will Be Doing</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own delivery of the Chat roadmap: break it into milestones, see around corners on risk, and make sure the team ships predictably.</li> <li>Run hiring end to end for the team: job descriptions, interview loops, sourcing with Recruiting, and onboarding.</li> <li>Coach and develop engineers at every level, with regular 1:1s, clear expectations and honest feedback.</li> <li>Run performance management with consistency: promotions, development plans, and managing underperformance through to resolution.</li> <li>Partner with the Tech Lead and PM to shape roadmap and priorities, and with data science, UX, and the other Agents and Context teams on shared primitives and quality signals.</li> <li>Build and improve team process (planning, async communication, release and on-call practice) through consensus and clear writing rather than top-down mandate.</li> <li>Represent the team to leadership and stakeholders.</li> </ul> <h3>What You Bring</h3> <ul> <li>A proven track record as an established engineering manager of software engineering teams, including hiring, coaching, promotions and performance management.</li> <li>A track record of delivering large, multi-team software initiatives in a distributed, async-first environment, including creating or improving team processes.</li> <li>Previous hands-on software engineering experience as a senior contributor, with enough technical depth to understand a TypeScript/Node/React stack, an Elasticsearch-backed system, and how LLM-powered products are built and evaluated. You will not write production code, but you need to spot bottlenecks, risks and one-way-door decisions.</li> <li>Familiarity with LLM applications, ideally including RAG, agents and tool use, evaluation, and prompt and context engineering.</li> <li>Experience with Elasticsearch, Kibana, search and information retrieval, or open source communities is a plus.</li> <li>Product acumen: comfortable with ambiguity, able to set and communicate priorities, and genuinely interested in what makes an agentic product good for users.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication. Clear, concise long-form writing is how this team works.</li> <li>Direct, kind, calm and empathetic. You hold people accountable and navigate hard conversations without drama.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People</strong></h2> <p>As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.</p> <p>We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.</p> <ul> <li>Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary</li> <li>Health coverage for you and your family in many locations</li> <li>Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles</li> <li>Generous number of vacation days each year</li> <li>Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service</li> <li>Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love</li> <li>Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave</li> </ul> <p>Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.</p> <p>We welcome individuals with disabilities and strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all individuals. To request an accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email <a ----- ----- class="gmail_default">.</span> We will reply to your request within 24 business hours of submission.</p> <p><span style="color: #000000;">Applicants have rights under Federal Employment Laws, view posters linked below:</span> <a href="https://www.dol.gov/sites/dolgov/files/WHD/legacy/files/fmlaen.pdf" target="_blank">Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA)</a> <span style="color: #000000;">Poster;</span><span style="color: #000000;"> <a href="https://www.dol.gov/sites/dolgov/files/ofccp/pdf/pay-transp_%20English_formattedESQA508c.pdf" target="_blank">Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination Provision</a> Poster; </span><a href="https://www.dol.gov/sites/dolgov/files/WHD/legacy/files/eppabw.pdf" target="_blank">Employee Polygraph Protection Act (EPPA)</a> <span style="color: #000000;">Poster and <a href="https://www.dol.gov/sites/dolgov/files/OFCCP/regs/compliance/posters/pdf/22-088_EEOC_KnowYourRights.pdf" target="_blank">Know Your Rights</a> (Poster)</span></p> <p><span style="color: #000000;">Elasticsearch develops and distributes technology and information that is subject to U.S. and other countries’ export controls and licensing requirements for individuals who are located in or are nationals of the following sanctioned countries and regions: Belarus, Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Syria, or Russia, including the Ukrainian territories annexed by Russia (The Crimea region of Ukraine, The Donetsk People's Republic (DNR), The Luhansk People's Republic (LNR), Kherson or Zaporizhzhia). If you are located in or are a national of one of the listed countries or regions, an export license may be required as a condition of your employment in this role. Please note that national origin and/or nationality do not affect eligibility for employment with Elastic.</span></p> <p>Please see <a href="https://www.elastic.co/legal/applicant-privacy-statement" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.elastic.co/legal/applicant-privacy-statement&source=gmail&ust=1611068262479000&usg=AFQjCNG3orAPk5sJIr9WVm0ZDxYw82c5DA">here</a> for our Privacy Statement.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Functioneel applicatiebeheerder Backend Platform
description: Bouw jij mee aan betrouwbaar functioneel beheer voor applicaties die onze collega’s dagelijks nodig hebben? Wie ben jij Je vindt het leuk om je vast te bijten in applicaties en processen en neemt technische kennis mee. Wanneer een gebruiker met een vraag of probleem komt, wil jij niet alleen weten hoe je het oplost, maar ook begrijpen waar het vandaan komt. Je beweegt gemakkelijk tussen business en IT. Je kunt met een gebruiker praten over een bedrijfsproces en vervolgens met technische collega's of een leverancier bepalen wat er nodig is om een probleem op te lossen of een verbetering te realiseren. Daarnaast kijk je verder dan je eigen applicatie. Je begrijpt dat systemen steeds meer met elkaar verbonden zijn en houdt daarom rekening met afhankelijkheden binnen de gehele keten. We vinden het belangrijk dat je: HBO werk- en denkniveau hebt, bij voorkeur met een relevante opleiding; ervaring hebt met applicatiebeheer of een vergelijkbare functie; affiniteit hebt met bedrijfsprocessen en informatiesystemen; gebruikersvragen en problemen kunt analyseren en vertalen naar effectieve oplossingen; ervaring hebt met het testen en implementeren van wijzigingen; oog hebt voor de samenhang tussen applicaties, processen en IT-ketens; ervaring hebt met Agile werken; initiatief neemt, verantwoordelijkheid pakt en proactief handelt; helder communiceert en gemakkelijk samenwerkt met gebruikers, IT-collega's en leveranciers. Ervaring met applicaties of processen binnen Finance, Verzekeringen of HR is een pré. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan CODA, Crescendo, QIS of AFAS. Je hoeft ze zeker niet allemaal te kennen. We vinden het vooral belangrijk dat je ervaring hebt met applicatiebeheer en je nieuwe applicaties en bedrijfsprocessen snel eigen kunt maken. Wat ga je doen Als Functioneel Applicatiebeheerder ben jij een belangrijke schakel tussen gebruikers, de business, IT-teams en leveranciers. Je zorgt ervoor dat applicaties en IT-diensten betrouwbaar functioneren en dat gebruikers goed worden ondersteund. title: Senior Recruiter
description: Bouw jij vandaag al aan het talent dat Athora morgen nodig heeft? Dan maken we graag kennis met je! Wat je over ons moet weten? Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en wij willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat. Wat ga je doen? Recruitment bij Athora gaat verder dan het invullen van vacatures en interim opdrachten. We willen vooruitkijken: welke kennis, expertise en talenten hebben we nu en in de toekomst nodig en hoe zorgen we dat we deze tijdig aan ons binden? Wij helpen managers hun future fit teams bouwen. Als Senior Recruiter combineer je strategisch recruitmentadvies met sterke operationele executie. Je bent gesprekspartner voor management en HR Business Partners, kent de arbeidsmarkt en brengt een eigen visie mee. Tegelijkertijd sta je midden in de dagelijkse recruitmentdynamiek. Je hebt een sleutelrol in het aantrekken van het talent dat Athora nodig heeft om haar ambities voor vandaag én morgen te realiseren. Je verdiept je in wat er binnen de organisatie speelt, begrijpt de uitdagingen van verschillende bedrijfsonderdelen en vertaalt deze ontwikkelingen naar recruitmentoplossingen. Je belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden zijn: Je bent regisseur van het recruitmentproces. Je bent de verbindende schakel tussen kandidaten, hiring managers en HR Business Partners en zorgt voor een professioneel én persoonlijk proces, van intake en werving tot selectie, aanbieding en onboarding. Je houdt tempo, stuurt actief op voortgang en zorgt dat afspraken en contacten zorgvuldig worden vastgelegd. Je ondersteunt bij externe inhuur. Je adviseert managers over passende inzet, onderhandelt over tarief, duur en andere voorwaarden en draagt zorg voor een zorgvuldig proces en goede vastlegging. Je brengt Recruitment verder als strategische gesprekspartner. Je vertaalt ontwikkelingen in de organisatie en op de arbeidsmarkt naar een heldere recruitmentaanpak en adviseert managers en HR Business Partners proactief over de personeelsbehoefte van vandaag én morgen. Je maakt data leidend in recruitmentadvies en besluitvorming. Je ontwikkelt samen met het team onze visie op AI binnen Recruitment. Je onderzoekt waar AI het recruitmentproces slimmer en effectiever kan maken en helpt bepalen waar technologie waarde toevoegt én waar persoonlijk contact het verschil moet blijven maken. Je benut recruitment- en arbeidsmarktdata om trends, knelpunten en kansen zichtbaar te maken, vertaalt deze naar impactvolle inzichten en gebruikt de data om gericht te adviseren en bij te sturen op onder andere instroom, doorlooptijd, kwaliteit en inzet van recruitmentkanalen. Je bouwt mee aan de verdere professionalisering van Recruitment. Je draagt bij aan de ontwikkeling van onze recruitmentstrategie, employer branding en kandidaat propositie. Je vertaalt nieuwe ontwikkelingen naar concrete verbeteringen in werkwijze, processen en dienstverlening. Wat vragen we van jou? Je bent een stevige en verbindende recruitmentprofessional die gemakkelijk schakelt tussen strategie en uitvoering. Je bent nieuwsgierig en resultaatgericht. Je bent een gelijkwaardige gesprekspartner voor (senior) management en HR, je durft vanuit je expertise te adviseren en te challengen. Je stelt de juiste vragen en neemt een vacatureaanvraag niet automatisch voor gegeven aan. Je wil eerst begrijpen: wat is hier werkelijk nodig? Je weet mensen mee te krijgen in je aanpak. Tegelijkertijd houd je oog voor wat er in de dagelijkse recruitmentpraktijk nodig is en zorg je ervoor dat afspraken en processen zorgvuldig worden opgevolgd. Daarnaast: heb je hbo+/wo werk- en denkniveau en minimaal 7 jaar relevante ervaring in corporate recruitment; werk je graag met data en AI en vertaalt inzichten naar concrete adviezen en acties; werk je gestructureerd en accuraat en weet je hoe belangrijk goede vastlegging is voor een professioneel recruitmentproces en goede samenwerking binnen het team; kun je overzicht houden over meerdere processen tegelijkertijd zonder de persoonlijke aandacht voor kandidaten en managers te verliezen; heb je ervaring binnen financial services of een andere kennisintensieve en gereguleerde omgeving een pré; beheers je zowel de Nederlandse als de Engelse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift. Wat krijg je van ons? Je krijgt pakweg 900 collega's die allemaal vinden dat ze bij een bijzonder bedrijf werken. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan het maatschappelijk relevante thema van pensioenen. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je pensioen goed geregeld is, zodat je zorgeloos kan genieten van je oude dag. Jij krijgt de kans om echt het verschil te maken als het gaat om duurzaamheid, omdat we in onze bedrijfsvoering en onze beleggingen al jaren de toon aangeven. Uiteraard krijg je een (flexibele) werkplek op ons kantoor in Amsterdam dat behoort tot de beste 7% van de wereld, echt waar. title: Lead Product Manager - AI Platform
description: At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store. Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko. From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it. Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US. It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us! 📱 Our Product Team Led by Fabien, our VP Product, Joko's Product team groups the passionate individuals behind our users' delight! From brainstorming to development to launch, the Product team's main mission is to turn ideas into reality by working hand-in-hand with the Engineering, Design, and Business teams. Joko is organized into four product tribes, each owning a key dimension of the company's value: Business lines owns the current core value proposition, covering online shopping, in-store experiences, and gift cards, each run as a dedicated team. Scale focuses on growing and amplifying this value through growth, international expansion, and shared core user experiences across the app. Juno builds the next value proposition: an AI shopping assistant that finds the right product at the best price in seconds, backed by a universal catalog of what merchants actually sell. AI Platform helps Joko become a state-of-the-art AI company from the inside, owning the internal agent infrastructure, automation layer, internal tools, infrastructure, compliance, security and operational scalability. ⚡ The AI Platform tribe AI Platform's mission is to turn Joko into a state-of-the-art AI company from the inside. The tribe builds the internal agent infrastructure that will let every team work faster, automate complex workflows, and create new 0-to-1 features with AI. Its flagship product is Joker , Joko's internal AI teammate. Already live in Slack, Notion and Linear, Joker can understand context, use tools, act across systems, and take real work from idea to execution. The ambition is not just to automate repetitive tasks, but to make agents a new production layer for how Joko builds and operates. For this to work at company scale, AI Platform also owns the backbone underneath: Gotham , the identity and permission layer that lets agents act with exactly the access of the person they work for; plus the internal tools, infrastructure, compliance, security, reliability and server-cost foundations that keep Joko fast, safe and scalable. The tribe's users are the teams inside Joko. Its goal is simple: help them run extremely efficient processes, remove operational bottlenecks, and give the company the leverage it needs to scale in the coming years. 🎯 What you will do As Lead Product Manager for the Platform tribe, your mission is to make Joko's own machine faster, safer and increasingly agentic. You will report to Fabien, our VP Product, own the tribe's roadmap end to end, and lead the Product Managers on its task forces as the team grows. The tribe is being staffed right now, so expect to be hands-on from day one on scopes you own personally, and to build the function as the team grows. Set the tribe's strategy: You will decide what Platform builds, in what order, and what it stops doing. You will map what teams across the company do today in our internal tools, what it costs them and what they need next, then turn that into a roadmap you can defend in front of leadership. This intake runs permanently, as a standing part of the job. Own Joker and Gotham: These are the tribe's most strategic bets and you will drive them personally. Taking Joker from what it is today to a production-grade agent platform, and shipping Gotham's permission model so agents never hold more access than the person they act for, is the highest-leverage work in your scope. Build the automation layer: The approach is capability first: expose an action as a scoped tool, write the instructions an agent needs to use it well, then let the agent run the job. Interfaces come only where they earn their place, and deciding what still deserves a screen is a genuinely new kind of product judgment. Retire what should not exist: Part of the mandate is subtractive: migrating off tools that have outlived their purpose and progressively switching off legacy systems, without breaking the teams that depend on them every day. Own security, compliance and reliability: Identity and access, data retention and minimization, log centralization, audit, test coverage. The requirement often comes from Legal or an auditor, and still has to be shaped into something people will actually adopt. Lead and grow the team: You will hire, mentor and lead the Product Managers who own the tribe's task forces, set the bar on discovery and delivery, and be the person the tribe's engineers and designers look to for product direction. Be the interface for the whole company: You will be the point of contact for Engineering, Ops, Finance, Legal, Data and Care, structuring their demands and arbitrating between them. You will define success in time saved, cost removed, risk reduced and adoption by internal teams, and report on it in those terms. 👀 Who we're looking for Experience: You have 5+ years of experience in Product, including experience leading or mentoring other Product Managers. A background on internal tools, back-office products, APIs, platforms or complex B2B products is a strong plus. AI fluency, hands-on: This scope is being rebuilt around agents, so this criterion carries the most weight. You use AI tools daily in your own work, you understand what agents are actually good and bad at, and you have opinions about where automation belongs and where a human interface still earns its place. Product for teams mindset: You are comfortable building for internal users, where the bar is efficiency, robustness and adoption rather than polish. Problems nobody outside the company will ever see still energise you. If what drives you is craft on a consumer surface seen by millions, this scope will frustrate you. Comfortable with HITL testing; debugging across the hardware/software boundary. Able to explain technical risk clearly to systems and safety engineers, and to customers and assessors. You use AI agents in your own work, and you have clear views on where they help and where they don't. A fast paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from test and flight drives real decisions. A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly. Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy. At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential. You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. title: Senior Legal Counsel
description: Why Coda Coda is a global growth engine for commerce, connecting people, digital products, and payments through trusted monetization and distribution solutions. With 600+ people from 57 nationalities across 23 locations, we’re a truly global team headquartered in Singapore, with offices in Amsterdam, Dubai, Bristol, Shanghai, Eindhoven, and across Southeast Asia. We power global commerce through a dual model. Our B2B solutions, Codapay , Coda Webstore, Coda Links, Coda Distribution, and Giftcloud , enable publishers and brands to monetize and distribute digital content globally. On the consumer side, we operate a portfolio of trusted storefronts including Codashop , Recharge.com , Startselect.com , and mobiletopup.co.uk , that give customers secure and easy access to game top-ups, digital credits, vouchers, gift cards and prepaid products in over 70 markets. Our culture is built on respect, ownership, and collaboration. We move fast, support each other, and celebrate wins together. If you’re looking to grow your career and make a real impact in a global team, Coda is the place for you. The Role We’re looking for a Senior Legal Counsel to join our close-knit commercial Legal team at Coda in Amsterdam, supporting a fast-growing business across fintech, payments, ecommerce and digital platforms. This is an exciting opportunity to develop your skills and gain valuable experience in a truly international, digital-first company. You'll work in a dynamic, collaborative environment, with exposure to both our European businesses and the wider global Coda group. The role is ideal for a commercially minded, proactive lawyer who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, applying legal expertise creatively and pragmatically to support business growth. You will report to the Lead Counsel, Europe, who is based in India, and work closely with our global legal team and stakeholders across the company. What You'll Do Provide end-to-end legal support to Coda’s European businesses, advising on commercial contracts, product-related matters, corporate issues and general legal queries Draft, review and negotiate a wide range of customer, partner, vendor and technology agreements, providing pragmatic advice on deal structuring, risk allocation and regulatory requirements Act as a trusted legal partner to Product, Commercial, Engineering and Operations teams, supporting product launches, new features and go-to-market initiatives Take ownership of key legal matters and projects, working independently and proactively while balancing commercial priorities and legal risks Support strategic initiatives, including M&A projects, disputes, European regulatory matters and cross-border projects involving Coda’s global businesses Collaborate with global legal, compliance, corporate secretarial, investigations and regulatory teams to ensure effective and consistent legal support across Europe Contribute to the development of legal processes, templates and playbooks to support the business's continued growth and international expansion Work closely with senior business stakeholders and the Lead Counsel, Europe, acting as a key legal point of contact for European matters and ensuring alignment on priorities and risks What You'll Have A Dutch-qualified lawyer with a Master’s degree in Law, preferably from a Dutch university, and at least 7 years of relevant experience in commercial or corporate law, ideally gained in-house or at a leading law firm Strong experience drafting and negotiating complex commercial contracts, with sound commercial judgement and a pragmatic, business-focused approach to managing legal risk Experience in fintech, payments, e-commerce, SaaS or digital platforms, with a good understanding of payments regulations and frameworks, including PSD2/PSD3, AML and EMD Familiarity with handling commercial disputes, investigations and related legal matters Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Dutch and English, with the ability to explain complex legal matters clearly and concisely Proactive, independent and hands-on, with the confidence to take ownership of legal matters, manage competing priorities and seek support when needed Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams, jurisdictions and time zones in an international environment We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, embracing the unique qualities of every individual, regardless of gender, race, age, religion, disability, or other local protected classes. Our goal is to foster an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome and valued. Due to the large number of exceptional applications we receive, we can only reach out to shortlisted candidates.
