title: Cdi - Responsable Chef De Produit Chaine Et Trame Femme (H/F)
description: LA MAISON JACQUEMUS Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France. Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture. Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière). Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street). VOTRE RÔLE Le/la Responsable Chef de produit Chaîne & Trame Femme est en charge du développement des catégories C&T, Denim et Cuir. Il/Elle est en lien avec la direction créative et assure le développement des collections dans le respect des objectifs de prix, de qualité et de délais. Le poste combine une forte implication opérationnelle sur le développement produit ainsi que le management de 2 chefs de produit et d’une alternante. VOS MISSIONS Produit : piloter le développement des modèles chaîne & trame femme (incl. denim et cuir) du brief à la normalisation. Assurer la mise au point des produits (du 1er prototype au SMS) et garantir la qualité, le bien-aller et la cohérence produit. Sécuriser la faisabilité industrielle tout en proposant des ajustements adaptés. Coûts : contribuer au respect des cibles prix et marge, en intégrant les contraintes industrielles dès le développement et en proposant des optimisations si nécessaire. Suivi & coordination : piloter les échanges avec les façonniers, assurer le lien avec les différents intervenants (studio, tissus et fournitures, merchandising, atelier et production), et garantir la bonne circulation de l’information. Suivre l’avancement des développements, anticiper les risques et veiller au respect des différents jalons de développement. Management : encadrer 3 ressources, organiser les priorités, accompagner le suivi des développements et garantir la bonne tenue du périmètre. VOTRE PROFIL Solide expérience en développement chaîne & trame femme, incluant denim et cuir. Excellente compréhension des process industriels, de la mise au point produit et des exigences qualité. Capacité à piloter plusieurs projets simultanément dans un environnement créatif et exigeant. Rigueur, sens du détail, autonomie et forte capacité d’adaptation. Aisance dans la coordination avec les équipes internes et les partenaires externes. Première expérience réussie en encadrement ou forte appétence pour le management. Le poste est basé dans le 8ème arrondissement de Paris. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Software Engineer (f/m/d)
description: About Focused Energy Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A — the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry — we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies. Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally. Your Role Focused Energy’s Software Department builds the internal applications, data workflows, system integrations and automation that help our scientists, finance, legal, people and executive teams work faster and more reliably. As a Software Engineer in our forward deployed model, you will join projects where Focused Energy has an important technical or operational need, understand the context, build and deliver a reliable solution, complete a clean handover, and then move on to the next priority. You will quickly learn several project domains across fusion systems, finance, legal and executive work, and you will own moderately complex features from design to deployment. You will be a go-to engineer for turning cross-functional needs into maintainable software, raising the standard for internal tools, and helping us reuse shared platforms and patterns. You will see your work directly shape how fusion research and company operations run. You will gain broad exposure to scientific, hardware, operational and business problems, and you will take ownership from day one. What You'll Do Own moderately complex, well-scoped features from technical design through testing, deployment and handover. Work directly with scientists, the people team, legal, operations, IT and other specialists to understand their goals and turn them into practical software. Build internal applications, data workflows, system integrations, APIs, automation and engineering tools based on each project’s needs. Add automated tests, logging, metrics, error handling and basic operational guidance to the software you deliver. Move between projects after delivering agreed outcomes, leaving software tested, documented, maintainable and ready for its long-term owner. Improve code quality, remove small areas of technical debt, contribute to code reviews, and reuse shared platforms and patterns where they fit. Learn several project domains quickly, deliver your first end-to-end features, and establish a reliable routine for testing, documentation and handover. Take on broader and less clearly defined projects, help standardize how internal software is built, secured and operated, and become a trusted partner for teams across the company. Who You Are You can independently own well-scoped work, with support available for broader architecture or highly unclear decisions. Strong software engineering fundamentals, including readable code, data structures, debugging, automated testing, version control and code review, with evidence of delivered working software. Ability to build and maintain software in a modern typed language such as TypeScript or JavaScript. Strong experience with a similar language is also relevant. Experience building web applications with a component-based frontend framework such as React, Vue or Angular. Understanding of relational databases and SQL, including schemas, migrations, permissions and data modeling. Experience integrating software through REST APIs, events, scheduled jobs or similar communication patterns. Understanding of authentication, authorization, role-based access and secure data handling. Familiarity with CI/CD, package management, basic infrastructure configuration and automated build, test and deployment workflows. Ability to use tests, logs, metrics and traces to find problems and confirm that software works as expected. Ability to use AI-assisted development tools responsibly for learning, prototyping, testing, documentation and delivery, reviewing output to the same quality and security standard as other work. Ability to learn new languages, frameworks, systems and technical domains, and a willingness to move between projects after completing agreed work. Ability to turn the needs of non-software specialists into clear technical requirements and to explain software decisions in simple language. Clear communication: you raise risks and blockers early, make realistic commitments, and take full ownership of handover, leaving no undocumented code. Understanding of maintainability, documentation, security, access control and operational readiness. Nice-to-haves Experience with TypeScript, React, SQL, PostgreSQL, serverless functions or Azure services. Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS or Google Cloud, including serverless or managed application platforms. Experience working in a monorepo or with shared packages, reusable components and common engineering tooling. Experience with database security, row-level permissions, identity providers, single sign-on or role-based access control. Experience with infrastructure as code, CI/CD systems, cloud observability or secure secret management. Experience building internal tools, technical dashboards, data pipelines, search systems, automation or third-party service integrations. Experience working with scientists, hardware engineers, research teams, industrial systems or other technical domain experts. Experience supporting a project through handover, production use or transfer to a long-term owner. Familiarity with AI-assisted development workflows, used without lowering review, testing, security or maintainability standards. title: Senior Network Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Austin, US</li> <li>Atlanta, GA</li> <li>Denver, CO</li> <li>Seattle, WA</li> <li>Toronto, CA</li> </ul> <p><strong>Applications will be accepted until December 01, 2026.</strong></p> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Cloudflare operates one of the world's largest and most interconnected networks, spanning 335+ cities across every region of the globe. We are looking for a Senior Network Engineer to join our Edge Network & Backbone team — someone who brings deep operational experience, an AI-first mindset, and the instinct to mentor and lift the engineers around them. In your first year, this role is deliberately hands-on: you'll be in the operational trenches, owning complex faults, driving capacity work, and setting the standard for how we run the network. Beyond that, you'll help shape how the team works — building AI-enabled tooling and agents that reduce toil, accelerate troubleshooting, and make the whole team more effective. This is a North American based role, but you'll be joining one global team: the sun never sets on Cloudflare, and our engineers hand off work across every time zone to keep the network running around the clock.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Own the technical operation, engineering, and architecture of Cloudflare's global network, including planning, installation, and day-to-day management of hardware and software across the edge and backbone.</li> <li>Serve as a hands-on operational anchor for the team — diagnosing and resolving complex network faults, owning incident response end-to-end including on-call rotation, and contributing to post-incident reviews to drive continuous improvement.</li> <li>Build production AI agents for network operations. Design, ship, and own LLM-powered tools that integrate with our operational systems of record via tool calling. Ship them with evals, observability of agent decisions, cost tracking, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints where autonomous action carries blast radius.</li> <li>Apply AI to accelerate troubleshooting. Use and extend our internal AI platform (Workers AI, AI Gateway) to speed up root cause analysis, pattern recognition across faults, and operational decision-making under pressure.</li> <li>Architect network improvements that lower latency, reduce packet loss, and increase scale — optimising end user experience across Cloudflare's global infrastructure.</li> <li>Mentor and develop junior engineers on the team, setting technical standards, conducting structured troubleshooting sessions, and building a culture of operational excellence and continuous learning.</li> <li>Collaborate with internal teams on cross-functional network projects, contributing to design documentation, SOPs, and knowledge base articles that outlast any individual contributor.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>Proven track record in large-scale network engineering and operations.</li> <li>Proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript and/or Go sufficient to build, debug, and maintain agent code, not just to glue scripts together.</li> <li>Working knowledge of agent integration patterns: function/tool calling, MCP or equivalent, retrieval over operational corpora (runbooks, postmortems, change history), and prompt iteration with evals.</li> <li>Experience reasoning about agent failure modes in production: hallucination guards, fallback paths, rollback, blast-radius control.</li> <li>Deep expertise in BGP and anycast routing, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex routing issues in a production environment.</li> <li>Strong understanding of MPLS and Segment Routing.</li> <li>Proficiency across multiple network vendor operating systems (Juniper, Cisco, Arista, or similar).</li> <li>Experience with network automation frameworks such as SaltStack, Ansible, or equivalent, and a strong instinct for solving operational problems through code.</li> <li>Ability to prioritise effectively and lead calmly when faced with high-pressure scenarios.</li> <li>An effective communicator who can adapt their style to any audience — whether guiding a junior engineer through a fault or presenting a network architecture decision to senior leadership.</li> </ul> <h2>Bonus Points</h2> <ul> <li>Shipped LLM-powered tooling into production use by a team other than your own, with measurable operational impact.</li> <li>Professional-level network certification (JNCIP, CCNP, or equivalent or higher).</li> <li>Experience with optical transport technologies such as CWDM and DWDM.</li> <li>Linux system administration.</li> <li>Experience writing network configuration and design documentation at an architectural level.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3>Compensation</h3> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For Colorado based hires: Estimated annual salary of $168,000 - $231,000</li> <li>Washington, based hires: Estimated annual salary of $172,000 - $237,000.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p>Health & Welfare Benefits</p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p>Financial Benefits</p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p>Time Off</p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. description: Chez EndLess, un service rendu est un service payé. Soyons francs : c’est un poste de terrain dans une PME, pas un poste de pilotage à distance. Nous cherchons quelqu’un qui prend le téléphone, traite les litiges et mène ses dossiers de bout en bout. Vous gérez l’ensemble du portefeuille clients en autonomie, sans équipe à encadrer, et vous êtes rattaché(e) à notre Responsable Administratif et Financier. Vous gardez ce qui fait la différence : le téléphone, le jugement, la décision. Mener les mises en demeure, les injonctions de payer et les déclarations de créance. Suivre vos indicateurs : cash encaissé, délai de paiement, échu à plus de 90 jours. Votre profil 3 à 5 ans d’expérience en recouvrement B2B ou en credit management, idéalement auprès de PME, dans le BTP ou les services. Une vraie aisance au téléphone : ferme sur le fond, courtois sur la forme. Les bases juridiques du recouvrement et des procédures collectives. De la rigueur, de la ténacité, et l’habitude d’un logiciel comptable (Pennylane idéalement) et d’un tableur. L’envie de travailler avec des outils d’IA et de les pousser plus loin. Un impact visible dès le premier mois : chaque jour de délai gagné, c’est du cash pour financer la croissance du groupe. Des outils qui vous libèrent du travail répétitif. Vergleichsrechnungen erstellen: Kosten heute gegen Kosten mit Contracting über 15 Jahre (Brennstoff, CO2-Preis, Wartung, Investition) mit unseren Tools aufbereiten und dem Eigentümer erklären können. Beteiligte koordinieren: Eigentümer, Hausverwaltung, Messdienst, Vertrieb und Technik des Anbieters und unsere Vermittlungspartner. Du holst fehlende Unterlagen ein, hältst Fristen nach und vermittelst, wenn es hakt. Übergabe an den Anbieter: Objekte in das gemeinsame Portfolio-Sheet einstellen, Status pflegen, Begehungen koordinieren und den Vertragsprozess bis zur Unterschrift treiben. Partner-Netzwerk abrechnen: Vermittelte Objekte den Partnern zuordnen und Provisionen vorbereiten. Prozesse und Tools aufbauen: Du definierst, wann ein Objekt „vollständig“ und wann es „vertragsreif“ ist, schreibst die Abläufe auf und automatisierst mit Google Sheets, Drive und KI-gestützten Auswertungen, was heute Handarbeit ist. Dein Profil Erfahrung 3 bis 7 Jahre in einer Rolle, in der du viele Vorgänge parallel koordiniert hast, zum Beispiel: Projektleitung oder Projektassistenz bei einem Heizungsbauer, Energieversorger, Messdienst oder Contracting-Anbieter Objektmanagement oder Teamleitung in einer größeren Hausverwaltung Operations oder Customer Success in einem PropTech- oder Energie-Startup Projektsteuerung bei Sanierungen und Modernisierungen im Wohnungsbestand Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium, zum Beispiel Immobilienkaufmann/-frau, Versorgungstechnik, Energiewirtschaft, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder Betriebswirtschaft. Projektmanagement Du hältst 80 Bälle gleichzeitig in der Luft, ohne dass einer liegen bleibt, und entscheidest selbst, was Vorrang hat. Du kannst mit Eigentümern, Hausverwaltungen und Technikern gleichermaßen reden und hakst freundlich nach, auch zum dritten Mal wegen derselben Abrechnung. Du definierst Übergabepunkte und Fristen, hältst sie nach und kannst jederzeit sagen, wo die Pipeline steht. Fachlich Du kannst einen Energieausweis und eine Heizkostenabrechnung lesen und weißt, was eine Gasetagenheizung von einer Zentralheizung unterscheidet. Du verstehst, wie eine Hausverwaltung arbeitet, was eine WEG ist und wer beim Eigentümer entscheidet. Du rechnest gern, prüfst Zahlen auf Plausibilität und kannst eine Vergleichsrechnung erklären. Arbeitsweise und Tools Sicher in Excel oder Google Sheets, idealerweise hast du schon ein CRM oder Ticketsystem betrieben. Du schreibst Prozesse selbst auf und verbesserst sie, statt sie nur abzuarbeiten. Offen für KI-Tools im Alltag, weil ein großer Teil der Dokumentenauswertung darüber läuft. Deutsch verhandlungssicher. Pluspunkte: Kenntnisse im GEG oder CO2KostAufG, Erfahrung mit Wärmecontracting oder Energieberatung, Aufbau eines Backoffice von null. Was wir nicht suchen: Reine Sachbearbeitung ohne Koordinationserfahrung, oder Konzern-PMO mit Projekten, die 200 Tage Vorlauf haben. Bei uns sind die Projekte klein, viele und schnell. Was wir bieten Eine Rolle mit direktem Einfluss: Jedes Objekt, das du vertragsreif machst, ersetzt eine alte Gas- oder Ölheizung. Aufbauarbeit statt Verwaltung: Du definierst die Prozesse, die später ein Team von 4 bis 5 Leuten nutzt, und wächst mit in die Leitung von Operations. Kurze Wege: Du arbeitest direkt mit den beiden Geschäftsführern und mit dem Team unseres Contracting-Partners. Festgehalt plus Beteiligung am Erfolg, abhängig von den vermittelten Wohneinheiten. Hybrides Arbeiten, Büro in Hamburg Moderne Tools: Google Workspace, KI-gestützte Auswertung von Unterlagen, keine Papierakten. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Director, Customer Compensation & Policy
description: <h2>About the Role </h2> <p>Within Global Customer Experience (GCX), our mission is to advance the HelloFresh customer relationship from reactive resolution to proactive, trust-building service. The compensation function sits at the heart of that mission: it is the mechanism through which the business acknowledges failures, restores customer confidence, and, when done well, turns a bad experience into a reason to stay.</p> <p>The Associate Director, Customer Compensation & Policy is responsible for the global strategy, architecture, and governance of how HelloFresh compensates customers across all markets and brands. This is not a policy maintenance role. It is a strategic function that sits at the intersection of customer economics, operational data, behavioral experimentation, and cross-functional influence.</p> <p>You will own one of the most financially material and customer-sensitive levers in the business. You will shape a multi-year roadmap and hold peers in Operations, Technology, Finance, and Market Leadership accountable for the quality of inputs that determine how well and how efficiently we recover customer trust.</p> <p><em>The ideal candidate brings a rare combination: analytical rigor sharp enough to architect a global compensation engine from first principles, and the executive presence to drive adoption across a complex, multi-market organization without formal authority over most of the people they need to move.</em></p> <h2>What You'll Own </h2> <p><strong> Global Compensation Strategy & Engine Architecture</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the end-to-end strategic vision for how HelloFresh categorizes customer errors and determines compensation across all markets, brands, and contact channels.</li> <li>Lead the design and continuous evolution of the compensation engine: along with Tech, you’ll define the the rules, thresholds, segmentation logic, and automation frameworks that govern recovery decisions at scale.</li> <li>Define the principles that govern trade-offs between customer generosity and cost discipline and translate those principles into operational rules that hold across market complexity and brand variation.</li> <li>Partner with Technology to ensure the compensation engine is scalable, auditable, and capable of supporting dynamic, AI-assisted decisioning as the product evolves.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Experimentation & Behavioral Economics</strong></p> <ul> <li>Set the global roadmap for compensation experimentation: A/B testing across offer types, value levels, channel timing, and segmentation variables.</li> <li>Apply behavioral economics frameworks to compensation design understanding how recovery offers shape long-term retention, repurchase behavior, and brand perception, not just immediate satisfaction.</li> <li>Define the measurement framework for experimentation: what constitutes a successful test, what confidence warrants global rollout, and how results are synthesized into durable policy change.</li> <li>Partner with Analytics & Insights to ensure test design, sample integrity, and rollout analysis meet a rigorous standard of evidence.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Stewardship & Cost Governance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the global compensation P&L line: tracking spend by market, error category, customer segment, and channel — and holding yourself accountable to defined cost-per-incident and avoidable-contact targets.</li> <li>Identify and close financial leakage: cases where compensation is being issued without policy justification, at incorrect values, or at the wrong frequency.</li> <li>Build the reporting infrastructure that makes compensation economics visible to GCX leadership, market GMs, and Finance — with the granularity and context needed to drive decisions.</li> <li>Define the right balance between cost optimization and customer lifetime value investment: not just 'spend less' but 'spend where it earns back.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Fraud Policy & Global Governance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the global fraud and abuse prevention framework: the policies, detection logic, thresholds, and escalation paths that protect the business without creating friction for genuine customers.</li> <li>Lead the governance rhythm for policy: quarterly reviews, market exception management, escalation adjudication, and framework versioning across a multi-brand, multi-market environment.</li> <li>Act as the final authority on complex, cross-market policy gaps — resolving ambiguity with speed, consistency, and strategic clarity rather than routing decisions upward by default.</li> <li>Maintain global standards while creating principled space for market-level adaptation where local context genuinely requires it.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Cross-Functional Leadership & Stakeholder Accountability</strong></p> <ul> <li>Represent the compensation function in senior forums translating customer economics into requirements that peers in Operations, Technology, Finance, and Market GMs must respond to.</li> <li>Hold cross-functional partners accountable for the upstream data quality, operational accuracy, and system reliability that the compensation engine depends on.</li> <li>Drive adoption of policy changes across markets and brands, building communication and change management plans that make new frameworks land — not just launch.</li> <li>Influence at VP and Director level across multiple functions; escalate only strategic blockers, not routine alignment.</li> </ul> <h2>What You'll Bring </h2> <p><strong>Education</strong></p> <ul> <li>MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification required.</li> <li>Undergraduate degree in Economics, Business, Engineering, or a quantitative discipline.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>8–12 years of progressive experience in customer strategy, pricing, operations, or a directly adjacent domain with meaningful exposure to global, multi-market environments.</li> <li>Demonstrated track record of owning a financially significant operational lever and managing it with both analytical precision and strategic judgment.</li> <li>Prior experience leading and developing teams; comfort operating as a senior individual contributor and a people leader simultaneously.</li> <li>Background in subscription commerce, logistics, or consumer-facing operations strongly preferred. Familiarity with the economics of customer recovery in high-volume, low-margin environments is a distinct advantage.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Technical & Analytical</strong></p> <ul> <li>Advanced proficiency in SQL and data analysis; able to build and pressure-test the analytical models that underpin policy decisions without delegating the logic to others.</li> <li>Fluency with experimentation methodology: test design, statistical significance, holdout analysis, and the translation of results into policy not just reporting.</li> <li>Experience working with or alongside engineering teams to define product and system requirements for rules-based or AI-assisted decisioning tools.</li> <li>Comfort with financial modeling: building the business case for compensation investment, forecasting spend impact, and tracking actuals against plan.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Leadership & Influence</strong></p> <ul> <li>Senior executive presence: able to walk into a GM, COO, or CFO conversation with a clear point of view, defend it under pressure, and leave with alignment.</li> <li>A credible voice with peers and upward stakeholders not because of title, but because of the quality of analysis and clarity of communication.</li> <li>Structured and decisive under ambiguity: able to make a defensible call with incomplete information and adjust as evidence develops.</li> <li>Genuinely collaborative across markets and functions able to hold people to standards without damaging the relationships needed to sustain them.</li> </ul> <h2>What we offer</h2> <ul> <li><em>Modern and comfortable working space with great co-workers in Berlin-Kreuzberg</em></li> <li><em>Discount for HelloFresh boxes and Convini products</em></li> <li><em>Development possibilities along with internal trainings and a yearly Learning & Development budget</em></li> <li><em>Flexible working hours including Work From Home/Work from Abroad/Sabbatical Policy, as well as a home office set up budget </em></li> <li><em>Extensive Onboarding and Buddy Program</em></li> <li><em>Social events including team events, Friday beers, company runs, book club, etc.</em></li> <li><em>Discounted fitness offers with our Urban Sports Club and John Reed partners and yoga classes</em></li> <li><em>Well-being initiatives in cooperation with Headspace and Spill</em></li> <li><em>Childcare and company pension scheme benefit</em></li> <li><em>Monthly transportation budget via NAVIT</em></li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2> </h2> <p style="text-align: justify;"> </p> <p style="text-align: justify;"> </p> <h2> </h2> <h2> </h2> <li><strong>Wellbeing first: </strong>Gesundheitsleistungen, attraktive Altersvorsorge sowie Mental Health Awareness Days stellen deine Gesundheit in den Mittelpunkt.</li> <li><strong>Practice makes perfect</strong>: Entfalte dich mit unseren vielfältigen Weiterbildungen und nutze unsere internen Karriereprogramme für deine Entwicklung im WPP-Netzwerk.</li> <li><strong>More than just a job</strong>: Dich erwarten unvergessliche Events, Mitarbeitendenrabatte und weitere Highlights wie das Job Ticket, Wellhub oder das Job Bike.</li> <li><strong>Be yourself</strong>: Bei uns ist jede:r herzlich willkommen - Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit liegen uns am Herzen.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><strong>Das bewegst du:</strong></h2> <p>Als <strong>Werkstudent Media (Mensch)</strong> magst du große Datenmengen und möchtest aktiv dazu beitragen, die Performance unseres Kunden zu optimieren.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Fundierte Analysen & Reportings:</strong> Du unterstützt uns bei der Erstellung aussagekräftiger Analysen und Reportings, die als wichtige Entscheidungsgrundlage dienen.</li> <li><strong>Performance-Tracking:</strong> Die Aufbereitung und Analyse von kampagnenbezogenen Wochen- und Monatsauswertungen zur Erfolgsmessung gehört zu deinen Kernaufgaben.</li> <li><strong>Datenmanagement & Qualitätssicherung:</strong> Du bist maßgeblich an der präzisen Erfassung, Pflege und Ergänzung von Mediadaten in unseren internen Systemen und proprietären Tools beteiligt.</li> <li><strong>Regelmäßige Reporting-Aufgaben:</strong> Du übernimmst eigenverantwortlich vordefinierte Kundenteams im operativen Tagesgeschäft und trägst so direkt zum reibungslosen Ablauf der Projekte bei.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><strong>Das zeichnet dich aus:</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Dein Excel (Advanced-Skills wie Pivot-Tabellen und S-Verweise sind von Vorteil).</li> <li><strong>Deine Arbeitsweise:</strong> Eine strukturierte, sorgfältige und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise zeichnet Catch the AI errors that matter, such as false positives, merged syndicates, and misclassified scam patterns, before they propagate downstream. Enrich complaint selectors using a stack of more than forty commercial data-source integrations. Take the highest-priority complaints beyond disposition: trace funds through consolidation wallets to regulated exchanges or other actionable endpoints Own clean shift handoffs so the around-the-clock operation never drops a lead, providing EMEA-hours coverage that keeps the queue moving while colleagues in other regions are offline. What we’re looking for: 4 or more years of investigative or analytical experience in the public or private sector, including hands-on blockchain analysis. Demonstrated experience tracing funds across chains and attributing addresses to real-world actors, including the judgment to tell an unattributed service from a privately controlled (unhosted) wallet Experience building or contributing to cases that led to a freeze, seizure, arrest, or takedown. Strong AI fluency, meaning comfort using AI tools as a daily co-pilot, plus the judgment to know when they are wrong. Comfort operating in a fast-paced, fluid environment where the project's scope and emphasis may shift quarter to quarter. Strong written and verbal communication. About the Team: The team is built around a mix of seasoned investigators and rising talent. Triage investigators sit alongside experienced crypto tracers and intelligence-trained individual contributors. Team Operating Rhythms: Daily schedule: standard business hours in your local time zone. Collaboration: coordinate with global teammates for handoffs on time-sensitive items, giving the wider operation near follow-the-sun coverage. On-Call Responsibilities: Formal on-call rotation for high-priority events, such as hacks, law-enforcement support, and other time-sensitive matters. Weekly rotation, with occasional weekend coverage as needed. Learn about TRM Speed in this position: React quickly to incoming complaint surges and live takedown events. Continuously learn new patterns in crypto-enabled crime. Application Instructions If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role. If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered. Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way. AI Fluency at TRM AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM. We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks. At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to: Accelerate repeatable workflows Structure and solve problems Improve output quality Increase speed and leverage You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process. Life at TRM We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day. TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days. Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving. At TRM, you should expect: Priorities and targets to change quickly Operating with a high degree of ambiguity A high level of personal ownership and accountability Close collaboration across teams and functions Frequent, high-touch communication Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. title: Founding Product Manager
description: About Dust Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it. With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done. With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast. We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026. Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50 . The Role This is Dust's first PM hire. You'll work closely with the product team, turning raw GTM signal, company priorities, and user feedback into well-formed problems the team can act on. What you will change: A lot of product signal doesn't reach the team in an actionable shape today. You'll create and run the process that connects signal to shaping to prioritization. Implementing company strategies across functions requires ownership and orchestration. You'll translate company priorities into an intelligible, trackable set of product, marketing, and operations initiatives. You'll enrich prioritized projects with distilled business and user context and market perspective so that the people building them make better decisions. Our designers and engineers stay close to product decisions from conception to delivery. You're here to make their context richer and their priorities sharper. You enable distributed ownership, you don't replace it. What You'll Do Qualify and synthesize feedback : Sit at the intersection of GTM, users, and product. Turn high-volume, unstructured input into a small set of well-framed problems worth solving. Shape initiatives : Work with engineers and designers to translate validated problems into initiatives ready for Stack Rank — with clear objectives, KPIs, and scope. Drive outcome tracking : Own reporting on whether what shipped actually moved the needle. Feed that back into the next round of decisions. Improve internal coordination : Connect Marketing, Comms, GTM, and Product — reduce the friction that slows things down when multiple functions need to move together. Own outcomes, not outputs : For cross-functional initiatives, you'll own the goal — objectives, KPIs, orchestration, reporting. Own artefacts in the Dust platform (agents, skills, data, etc..) to continuously rewire and augment the above for yourself and the team What You Can Expect Team Dust is a growing team of about a 100 people. Most of the product and engineering team is based in Paris, with close collaboration across our teams in New York, San Francisco, and London. The interview process The process is designed to understand how you think, collaborate, and operate in an ambiguous, technical environment: Recruiter conversation: motivation, background, logistics, and fit for an early-stage environment. Hiring DRI conversation: discussion with a senior member of the product team. Product exercise: collaboration exercise based on a real company priority. Founder conversation: discussion with one of our founders on product judgment, attitude, and ability to operate with distributed authority. Onsite: working sessions with members of Engineering, Design, and GTM. We’ll look at how you gather context, identify the important problems, collaborate on possible approaches, and leave ownership with the people closest to the work. We care more about the quality of your reasoning and collaboration than about arriving at a predetermined answer. What We're Looking For Founding PM mentality: Senior individual contributor and builder balancing capacity to build the practice in the company while being hands-on. 5–8+ years of product experience, including time at an early-stage company where you had to build process from scratch. Genuine product taste. You know great from good in the world of tech products, and you bring deep perspective, judgment and conviction to any preferences you voice. Excellent information synthesis skills, distilling a messy pile of customer feedback, sales calls, and Slack threads into sharp problems. Technical proficiency earn the respect of engineers. You don't need to code, but you understand systems and tradeoffs easily deeply. Builder mindset at heart. You use AI tools fluently and you're excited about what they unlock for how PMs operate. You've thrived in environments where everyone is a builder and you want to strengthen that. Effective communication. You'd rather say one clear thing than three vague things. Comfort with distributed authority. You influence by being right, not by being in charge. Location We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together. We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect. That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call. Why Dust The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves. We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast. If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk. Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist. Learn how we think and work. Our product constitution, a story about our mission Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human , Stanislas Polu , VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them. Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI , Gabriel Hubert , Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe. Wachstum Du baust Strukturen für Leadgenerierung und Outreach auf und später unser Vertriebsteam. Du unterstützt Events, Partnerschaften und Community-Building. Real Life Team Building: Wir veranstalten regelmäßig Teamevents und Offsites in Person, sodass alle Teammitglieder zusammenkommen. Wir supporten deine Gesundheit mit einer Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft und Bikeleasing. Unsere Vision: Wir vereinen das Skillset der besten kreativen und datengetriebenen Menschen aus der Branche und skalieren so Ecom- und D2C-Brands in ganz Europa. Wir sind stolz auf unser tolles Team, lieben unsere Arbeit und leben nach diesen Werten: 🔝 Constant Growth. ❤️ Candor & Tough Love. 🧠 Always innovating. 💸 Creativity Sells. 🚀 Passion, fun and love. title: Systems Engineer, MAPS
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>New York, NY</li> <li>Washington DC</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Cloudflare’s engineering teams build and maintain the systems and products that power our global platform. A global platform which is within approximately 50 milliseconds of about 95% of the Internet connected population, serving on average, over 46 million HTTP requests per second.</p> <p>Cloudflare engineering delivers multiple products and features to production at a tremendous pace, and depends on real time load balancing and long term capacity planning to do so with high performance and efficiency. The MAPS team is responsible for highly granular and large-scale resource usage instrumentation and measurement of Cloudflare's edge platform.  The team builds and runs data pipelines, as well as systems and libraries for measuring and collecting the data, and collaborates closely across the range of teams that build and run services on Cloudflare's global edge network to ensure consistent, complete, and correct attribution of all resource usage.</p> <p><strong>What are we looking for?</strong></p> <p>We are looking for highly motivated software engineers to join our MAPS team.  You’ll have a strong programming background with a deep understanding and experience developing and maintaining  distributed systems. You’ll need to be able to communicate effectively with engineers across the company to understand the behaviours of our systems and products in order to deliver tooling to meet their testing needs. You will also work closely with product managers to support our public facing synthetic testing and load testing products for enterprise customers.</p> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>Experience as a software engineer or similar role working on latency and efficiency sensitive server infrastructure.</li> <li>Experience working with large-scale data pipelines and processing, including use of distributed column-oriented data storage and processing such as ClickHouse, BigQuery/Dremel, etc.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of TCP/IP networking fundamentals and routing basics</li> <li>Successful track record of collaborating with many teams concurrently to achieve goals that require alignment across a range of teams and orgs.</li> <li>Track record of owning problems, goals, and outcomes - not (just) specific pieces of software.</li> <li>Track record of building long-term sustainable, maintainable systems.</li> <li>Ability to dive deep into technical specifics of systems and codebases, while always keeping the big picture in mind.</li> <li>Experience with one or more of the following programming languages: Go, Rust, C</li> </ul> <h2>Bonus Points</h2> <ul> <li>Strong understanding of Linux kernel internals, especially any of: networking, scheduling, resource isolation, virtualization</li> <li>Experience troubleshooting and resolving performance issues in large-scale distributed systems.</li> <li>Experience with large scale configuration/deployment management.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Senior Software Engineer, Cloudflare Hyperdrive
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>Available Locations | Austin, TX | New York, NY | San Francisco, CA or Seattle, WA (Hybrid)</h3> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>The Cloudflare Hyperdrive team builds the technology that makes regional databases feel like they are global. Hyperdrive is a core piece of the Cloudflare Developer Platform that accelerates database queries from Cloudflare Workers by pooling connections and caching data at the edge. By eliminating the massive latency overhead of TCP, TLS, and database-specific handshakes, Hyperdrive allows developers to use the databases they already know and love—like PostgreSQL and MySQL—without the "cold start" performance penalties typically associated with serverless environments.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <p>Hyperdrive is integrated directly into the Cloudflare global network and features:</p> <ul> <li>Global Connection Pooling: Maintains "warm" connections to origin databases across the globe, reducing connection times by up to 90%.</li> <li>Intelligent Query Caching: Automatically caches frequently run read queries as close to the user as possible.</li> <li>Protocol-Aware Proxying: Features custom-built implementations of database wire protocols (PostgreSQL and MySQL) to parse and optimize traffic in real-time.</li> <li>Seamless Integration: Works with existing ORMs and drivers, providing a simple connection string that "just works" for developers.</li> <li>The team is geographically distributed across North America.</li> <li>You will own your code from inception to release, delivering solutions at all layers of the software stack to empower Cloudflare customers. On any given day, you might write a design document that outlines how you plan to solve a specific problem, or fix a bug in how our user experience renders. You can expect to interact with a variety of languages and technologies including, but not limited to Rust, Go, C++, Typescript.</li> </ul> <h3>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h3> <ul> <li>You have 5+ years of professional experience with Rust, Go, or C++. You understand how to write code that respects CPU and memory constraints.</li> <li>You are comfortable with the Linux networking stack. You know your way around TCP/IP, TLS, and WebSockets.</li> <li>You don’t just use databases; you understand how they work. You’re familiar with connection lifecycles, transaction states, and wire protocols.</li> <li>You enjoy the challenge of debugging complex, distributed systems and building for "five nines" reliability.</li> </ul> <h3>Bonus Points</h3> <ul> <li>Experience with PgBouncer, ProxySQL, or custom database middleware.</li> <li>Familiarity with the Cloudflare Workers ecosystem and the unique stateful connection challenges of ephemeral computing.</li> <li>You’ve contributed to database drivers, ORMs, or low-level networking libraries.</li> <li>Experience using eBPF, perf, or other profiling tools to find and kill bottlenecks.</li> </ul> <h3>Compensation</h3> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>F<span data-sheets-root="1">or Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $194,000 - $266,000</span></li> <li>For New York City, New Jersey, Washington, Washington DC, and California (excluding Bay Area) based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $254,000</li> </ul> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <h3>Health & Welfare Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <h3>Financial Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <h3>Time Off</h3> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Senior Account Manager | Toxic
description: Op duizenden werkvloeren in Nederland wordt dagelijks gewerkt met gevaarlijke stoffen. Dat kan veilig, als je weet wat je in huis hebt, wat het doet en welke regels erbij horen. Daar helpt Sdu Toxic organisaties bij. Toxic is de meest complete SaaS-oplossing voor wet- en regelgeving rond gevaarlijke stoffen in Nederland. Organisaties registreren er hun stoffen mee, beoordelen blootstelling, leggen maatregelen vast en informeren hun medewerkers. Zo helpen we QHSE-professionals om mensen veilig te laten werken en aan de arbowetgeving te voldoen. Achter Toxic staat een team met diepgaande kennis van chemische producten en de regels die erbij horen. En een succesvol marketing- en salesteam dat zorgt dat steeds meer organisaties ons vinden. Toxic is onderdeel van Lefebvre Sdu, dat al 200 jaar bouwt aan juridische en fiscale kennis, en van Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider op dat gebied. De vraag groeit. Onze Commercieel Medewerkers Binnendienst en marketing plannen meer afspraken in dan we nu kunnen afronden. Daarom zoeken we een Senior Accountmanager die van die gesprekken klanten maakt. HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT Jij bent het gezicht van Toxic. Voor de veiligheidskundigen, managers en directies die met ons werken, word jij degene die ze kennen en vertrouwen. Je leert hun organisatie kennen, luistert naar wat er speelt en denkt mee over wat ze nodig hebben. Zo bouw je relaties die jaren meegaan, en groeit Toxic met je klanten mee. Je leert je klanten kennen: hun mensen, hun processen en wat er bij hen speelt. Zo word je hun vaste gesprekspartner en denk je mee over de volgende stap. Elke nieuwe relatie begint met een goed gesprek. De binnendienst en marketing plannen de afspraken, jij bereidt je voor en ontdekt wat een organisatie nodig heeft. Daarnaast zoek je zelf nieuwe kansen. In je demo's laat je zien hoe Toxic werkt en wat het oplevert. Gaat de vraag verder dan het standaardplatform? Dan werk je met collega's een oplossing op maat uit, met API-koppelingen en AI-toepassingen. Je bouwt relaties met veiligheidskundigen, inkopers en directie, brengt hun belangen samen in 1 voorstel en sluit deals met een hogere dealwaarde. Met strategische accountplannen houd je overzicht op je belangrijkste klanten. Je ziet kansen voor up- en cross-sell en herkent retentierisico's vroeg. Samen met Customer Success zorg je dat nieuwe klanten goed starten. Je houdt je pipeline en forecast actueel in Salesforce en deelt wat je bij klanten hoort met marketing en product. Als senior ben je mentor en sparringpartner voor collega-accountmanagers. DIT ZOEKEN WIJ Je bent iemand bij wie klanten zich gehoord voelen. Je luistert goed, stelt de juiste vragen en vertaalt een complex vraagstuk naar een helder voorstel. De markt van gevaarlijke stoffen hoef je nog niet te kennen. Wat je wel meebrengt, is ervaring met het opbouwen van klantrelaties en interesse in software. Je hebt meerdere jaren ervaring als accountmanager, bij voorkeur in SaaS of met digitale oplossingen. Je hebt interesse in software en wilt begrijpen hoe een platform als Toxic werkt, inclusief API-koppelingen en AI-toepassingen. Je bouwt relaties met meerdere stakeholders tegelijk en beheerst het volledige salesproces, van eerste kennismaking tot getekend contract. Je stuurt op data en haalt je targets, met nieuwe klanten en binnen je eigen portefeuille. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands. Je hoeft de markt nog niet te kennen. Klanten, stoffen en regelgeving leer je bij ons, van collega's die het vak door en door kennen. HIER TEKEN JE VOOR Je tekent voor een rol die past bij je ambitie. Je werkt aan grotere deals, bouwt je eigen netwerk op en ontwikkelt je in een groeiend SaaS-team. Dat doe je binnen Lefebvre Sdu, een legaltechbedrijf met 200 jaar kennis en de energie van een scale-up. Dit krijg je ervoor terug: Een inwerkperiode waarin je Toxic, de markt en onze klanten leert kennen. Een plek waar je vanaf dag 1 invloed hebt op de aanpak, de processen en de richting. Collega's met diepgaande kennis van stoffen en regelgeving, van wie je elke dag leert. Doorgroeimogelijkheden naar Teamlead, Key Accountmanager of Propositiemanager. Een salaris vanaf €4.477 per maand, op basis van een werkweek van 36 uur. Een variabele bonusregeling die kan oplopen tot 30% van je jaarsalaris. 23 vakantiedagen en een persoonlijk keuzebudget van 12%, waarvan 8% vakantiegeld en 4% vrij besteedbaar aan extra vakantiedagen of salaris. Een goede pensioenregeling via PGB, inclusief aanvullende partnerverzekering. Een leaseauto of een reiskostenvergoeding van €0,25 per kilometer, en een aantrekkelijke fietsregeling. Voor een reisafstand onder de 10 km of boven de 60 km geldt een aangepaste regeling. Thuiswerkvergoeding en hybride werken: reken op 2 dagen per week op kantoor in Den Haag. MEER WETEN? Benieuwd hoe Toxic werkt? Kijk alvast op toxic.nl/en. We vertellen je graag meer over het team en de rol. Stuur je cv en je hoort binnen 2 werkdagen van ons. Eerst nog vragen? App of bel Mak via +31 6 18 60 98 89. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Data & AI Engineer
description: Waarom jij hier JA op zegt! ✔ Werken aan data-oplossingen én AI-initiatieven met directe impact op de business ✔ Veel vrijheid, autonomie en ruimte voor eigen ideeën ✔ Salaris van maximaal €5.000 bruto per maand o.b.v. 40 uur en afhankelijk van ervaring ✔ Werken in een klein, wendbaar team zonder corporate bureaucratie ✔ 28 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband + mogelijkheid om 5 dagen bij te kopen In deze rol ben je in de eerste plaats verantwoordelijk voor het bouwen en verbeteren van data-oplossingen. Je zorgt ervoor dat data beschikbaar, betrouwbaar en bruikbaar is voor de organisatie door data pipelines, dashboards en integraties te ontwikkelen. Tegelijkertijd krijg je de kans om mee te bouwen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van AI binnen Rail Innovators Group. AI vormt daarbij een waardevolle aanvulling op de rol, maar de basis ligt in data engineering en business intelligence. Je werkt aan uiteenlopende vraagstukken, van stuurinformatie voor de business tot innovatieve AI-toepassingen die processen slimmer en efficiënter maken. Rail Innovators Group Rail Innovators Group, opgericht in 2005 en gevestigd in Rotterdam, is een internationale specialist in goederenvervoer per spoor. Met meer dan 250 railprofessionals zijn wij actief in 23 landen en vervoeren wij jaarlijks meer dan 6 miljoen ton aan vracht. Onze moderne vloot bestaat uit hoogwaardige locomotieven, een breed scala aan wagons en intermodale units. Daarmee bieden wij flexibele, betrouwbare en duurzame transportoplossingen in heel Europa en daarbuiten. Via onze vier bedrijven Raillogix, Rail Force One, Railrelease en CWS verzorgen wij de volledige railketen: van planning en tractie tot leasing en onderhoud. Wat ga je doen? Je werkt aan uiteenlopende data- en AI-vraagstukken die bijdragen aan betere besluitvorming, efficiëntere processen en verdere digitalisering van de organisatie. Je werkt vanuit een backlog en roadmap, waarbij je samen met de business bepaalt welke oplossingen de meeste waarde toevoegen. Daarbij schakel je met verschillende stakeholders, van finance en operations tot directie. Iemand die analytisch sterk is, zelfstandig werkt en energie krijgt van complexe vraagstukken. Je vindt het leuk om techniek en business met elkaar te verbinden en durft kritisch mee te denken wanneer een antwoord niet de juiste oplossing lijkt. Dit past bij iemand die: Beschikt over HBO werk- en denkniveau Een opleiding heeft afgerond richting IT, Informatica, Bedrijfskundige Informatica, Econometrie of vergelijkbaar Communicatief sterk is en gemakkelijk schakelt met verschillende stakeholders Analytisch en probleemoplossend ingesteld is Zelfstandig werkt, verantwoordelijkheid neemt en prioriteiten weet te stellen Affiniteit met IT heeft De Nederlandse taal goed beheerst, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk Daarnaast is het mooi meegenomen als je ervaring hebt met: Data Engineering, SQL en ETL Business Intelligence AI-oplossingen en tooling zoals ChatGPT of Claude Agile of Scrum werkwijzen Heb je nog niet overal ervaring mee, maar beschik je over een sterk analytisch vermogen en een hoge leercurve? Dan nodigen we je ook van harte uit om te reageren Wat bieden wij? Het salaris voor deze functie bedraagt maximaal €5.000 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van jouw kennis, niveau en werkervaring Je krijgt 28 vakantiedagen op fulltime basis, met daarnaast de mogelijkheid om 5 extra dagen bij te kopen Daarnaast ontvang je een winstafhankelijke bonusregeling en profiteer je van een uitstekende pensioenregeling We bieden flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid om hybride te werken. Je werkt gemiddeld twee dagen per week op kantoor en de overige dagen flexibel vanuit huis Reiskostenvergoeding van €0,23 per kilometer Je beschikt over een laptop en mobiele telefoon om je werk optimaal uit te voeren Korting op fitness, zodat je ook buiten werktijd fit en vitaal blijft Werken vanuit een modern kantoor in de Rotterdamse Waalhaven, met goede faciliteiten en uitstekende koffie Herken jij jezelf in deze rol op het spoor? Als stagiair werk je aan het verbeteren van processen binnen domeinen zoals sales, projecten in nieuwbouw en finance. Je analyseert hoe processen vandaag werken en vertaalt dit naar slimme oplossingen met behulp van Power BI en Power Automate. Tenslotte lever je een meetbare bijdrage aan efficiëntie (bijv. tijdbesparing of minder fouten). Jouw werkzaamheden In kaart brengen van huidige processen en knelpunten. title: Stage - Commercial·e / Sales / Business Developer
description: Le département Sales compte une trentaine de personnes réparties entre la qualification des prospects et le closing. Leur objectif commun : accompagner les prospects jusqu’à la signature du contrat en Assemblée Générale. Notre cycle de vente est long et complexe en BtoC (3 à 4 mois en moyenne). La particularité ? La copropriété doit voter à la majorité lors de son assemblée générale pour souscrire à notre solution. Tu rejoins l'équipe SDR, et ton objectif principal sera d'accompagner et de convaincre nos prospects à poursuivre le processus de vente en organisant des rendez-vous avec les Account Executives. En tant que SDR, tu représentes le premier contact client, tu es le premier maillon de notre processus de vente ; ainsi, tu participes activement à l'atteinte de nos objectifs commerciaux. En rejoignant le département Sales de Matera, tu auras l’opportunité d’échanger chaque jour avec des interlocuteurs très différents ! Il existe 600.000 copropriétés en France et chacune d’elle constitue une communauté à part entière, dont il nous faut comprendre le fonctionnement afin de les convaincre de nous rejoindre ! Nos prospects peuvent aussi bien être une petite copropriété de 3 lots en zone rurale, déjà autonome, qu’un grand ensemble immobilier de 300 logements en centre-ville, géré par un professionnel en face duquel nous présenterons une offre concurrente. Tes missions : En binôme avec nos commerciaux et sous la responsabilité de ton/ta manager, tu seras formé·e pour découvrir le métier de Sales Development Representative (SDR). Prendre en main la qualification : Réaliser les premiers échanges téléphoniques avec les prospects ayant formulé une demande de devis pour instaurer un premier contact de confiance. Comprendre les besoins : T’entraîner à analyser les problématiques rencontrées au sein des copropriétés et présenter les offres Matera. Assister les Account Executives : Participer à la prise de rendez-vous de démonstration et épauler les AE dans le suivi des prospects, la préparation des assemblées générales et les tâches administratives. Découvrir nos outils Sales : Participer à la tenue à jour de notre CRM (Hubspot) et appliquer les bonnes pratiques de suivi.Organiser des rendez-vous de démonstration avec les Account Executives, Contribuer à l’amélioration continue : Proposer tes idées et participer aux projets internes visant à fluidifier nos processus commerciaux. Déroulement du stage : • Deux semaines d’immersion : Découverte de nos métiers, de nos équipes et de notre vision globale. • Intégration à la Sales Academy : Tout du long de ton stage, tu bénéficieras d’un accompagnement sur mesure (formations techniques sur la copropriété, ateliers pratiques sur les méthodes de vente). • Suivi régulier : Des échanges hebdomadaires avec ton/ta manager pour accompagner ta montée en compétences et lever tes blocages. • Perspective d’évolution : En fonction de ta progression et de ton projet, tu pourras élargir ton champ d’apprentissage en découvrant les étapes suivantes du cycle de vente auprès de nos Account Executives.
