title: Workplace Operations Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Austin, TX</strong></p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>The <strong>Places Team</strong> at Cloudflare is seeking an experienced and enthusiastic <strong>Workplace Operations Manager</strong> to lead and elevate the day-to-day operations of our Austin hub. Support emergency preparedness efforts, safety drills, and incident response protocols.</li> <li><strong><em>Scale Smartly</em></strong><strong>: </strong>As the hub grows, help onboard new team members, support hiring needs for workplace roles, and participate in long-term workplace planning.</li> <li><strong><em>Support the Regional Places Team:</em></strong> Assist with administrative tasks such as responding to tickets, managing emails and inquiries, and providing holiday coverage to ensure seamless team operations across regions.</li> <li><strong><em>Lead Onsite Operations:</em></strong> Own the day-to-day management of the workplace—from front desk services, greeting guests/employees/visiting employees, and mail handling to office supplies, swag, deliveries, and space readiness. Oversee vendor performance and contracts, lead RFPs when needed, and track workplace budgets responsibly.</li> <li><strong><em>Create a World-Class Environment:</em></strong> Champion an inspiring, inclusive, and vibrant office culture. Plan and execute engaging onsite events, team celebrations, catering, and daily amenities that make coming into the office exciting, productive, and memorable for our team.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Have 5+ years of experience leading workplace operations teams, ideally in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, including 3+ years of people management experience.</li> <li>Are people-first and service-minded, with a friendly, professional presence that makes everyone feel welcome</li> <li>Know how to juggle vendors, projects, and priorities—and still sweat the small stuff</li> <li>Bring sharp budget management skills and make thoughtful, cost-effective decisions</li> <li>Communicate clearly and confidently across all levels and time zones using Google Workspace</li> <li>Are highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive—you spot what needs doing before anyone else does</li> <li>Thrive in fast-moving environments, stay calm under pressure, and love finding creative solutions</li> <li>Have experience collaborating cross-functionally with teams like IT, Security, People Ops, and more</li> <li>Bring a hospitality mindset and a passion for building inspiring, functional spaces where people love to work</li> <li>Work onsite in the office 5 days a week (Monday–Friday).</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? title: Head of Finance / Finanzleiter / Finanzleiterin
description: Deine Aufgaben 1. Kaufmännische Gesamtverantwortung Sie übernehmen die operative Steuerung der Finanz- und Rechnungswesenprozesse unserer Immobilien- und Projektgesellschaften. Sie stellen die ordnungsgemäße und termingerechte Erstellung der Jahresabschlüsse sicher und steuern die Zusammenarbeit mit Steuerberatern und Wirtschaftsprüfern. Sie verantworten Liquiditätsplanung, Zahlungsverkehr, Budgetierung und kaufmännisches Controlling. Sie entwickeln ein aussagekräftiges monatliches Reporting über Gesellschaften, Immobilien und Projekte. Sie schaffen Transparenz über Kosten, Erträge, Verbindlichkeiten und wirtschaftliche Risiken. 2. Immobiliencontrolling und Nebenkosten Sie verantworten die kaufmännische Kontrolle unserer Immobilienbestände und Mietverhältnisse. Sie prüfen die bereits teilweise automatisiert erstellten Nebenkostenabrechnungen auf rechnerische, vertragliche und wirtschaftliche Richtigkeit. Sie kontrollieren Umlageschlüssel, Kostenpositionen, Mietvertragsregelungen und Abweichungen. Sie stellen die Qualität der Abrechnungen sicher und entwickeln die bestehenden Prüf- und Freigabeprozesse weiter. Sie identifizieren Fehlerquellen und sorgen für dauerhaft zuverlässige Abläufe. 3. Finanzierung und Transaktionen Sie betreuen unsere bestehenden Bankverbindungen und koordinieren laufende Immobilienfinanzierungen. Sie erstellen und prüfen Finanzierungsmodelle, Wirtschaftlichkeitsrechnungen und Investitionskalkulationen. Sie überwachen Kreditbedingungen, Covenants, Zinsbindungen und Finanzierungstermine. Regelmäßige Firmenveranstaltungen und Meetings, bei denen alle zusammenkommen, um Erfolge zu feiern und voneinander zu lernen. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Territory Sales Director, West (Los Angeles/Phoenix)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Los Angeles, CA or Phoenix, AZ</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>We are looking for a Director of Sales to manage a team of Territory Account Executives in the SW . This leadership role within the Enterprise team focuses on both the acquisition of new accounts and the expansion of existing customer accounts. The ideal candidate will possess a strong sales management background and a technical foundation, enabling them to drive engagement with both technical professionals and executive buyers. As a Sales Director, you will have the opportunity to position and differentiate the Enterprise platform experience for Cloudflare while reinforcing strong pipeline and automated forecast management practices across Security, Network, Development, and Infrastructure teams.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Accurately forecast commits by month and quarter, leveraging automated internal data layers and predictive metrics to consistently deliver attainment to quarterly and annual sales targets.</li> <li>Oversee, coach, and motivate a team of 8 Account Executives, measuring success against overall quota attainment, new logo acquisition, and expansion tactics.</li> <li>Develop and uplevel team selling abilities through consistent focus on enablement, solution selling, and interpreting automated, data-led customer insights.</li> <li>Assist in the continued codification and execution of product-focused playbooks to connect platform data to Cloudflare solutions that solve critical business challenges.</li> <li>Collaborate with Sales Enablement, Product, and Product Marketing to optimize sales training and accelerate execution around newly launched features and products.</li> <li>Maintain a robust funnel of new hire candidates by continuously interviewing and building a strong network of potential talent.</li> <li>Hold regular 1x1s with team members, maintaining open and transparent communication while monitoring the proficiency and adoption of sales enablement tooling and resources.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>5+ years of Sales Management experience leading high-performing sales teams at a high-growth SaaS company.</li> <li>Proven record of high performance in consistently meeting and exceeding team plan through strategic acquisition and expansion tactics.</li> <li>Experience developing relationships with highly technical customers and selling through modern, data-driven Product-Led Growth (PLG) models.</li> <li>Coaching-level knowledge of Gap Selling, Sandler, Challenger, or other structured sales methodologies.</li> <li>Strong talent for multi-threading across business units to identify, engage, and close new divisional buyers, as well as driving consensus among internal and external stakeholders.</li> <li>Excellent written communication, presentation, and pipeline management skills.</li> </ul> <h2>Bonus Points</h2> <ul> <li>Experience leading sales teams specifically within Cloud Security or Hyperscaler ecosystems.</li> <li>Experience navigating complex accounts undergoing Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A) to expand the partner ecosystem.</li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2> <ul> <li>Compensation will be adjusted based on location and level.</li> <li>For California based hires: Estimated On Target Earnings of $361,000 - 496,000</li> </ul> <p><strong>This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan.</strong></p> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <h3>Health & Welfare Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <h3>Financial Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <h3>Time Off</h3> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Accountant
description: <h3> </h3> <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <h3> </h3> <h3><strong>The role of an Accountant at Canonical:</strong></h3> <p>If you are passionate about the technology industry and want to work for a company that aligns with your interests, we might be the place for you! Canonical, and our world class Ubuntu product, attracts some of the leading talent from around the world. Come and work with exceptional people and advance your career in Finance! </p> <p>Our Finance team is growing and it's a really exciting time to join the team. We are looking for bright, motivated people who have a passion for making a difference. You will be seeking an opportunity to drive process improvements and change, input your ideas and truly contribute to a highly productive team. </p> <p>We are looking for an exceptional Accountant with IFRS experience to help us ready the business for public market scrutiny through our planned IPO.  The right candidate will have domain expertise and a passion for IFRS.  </p> <p><strong>Location: </strong>This role may be office based in London, or Remote in EMEA Time Zones. </p> <h3>What your day will look like</h3> <ul> <li>Assist in the month end reporting process to deliver timely and accurate information</li> <li>Have full responsibility for a part of the ledger processes relevant to your strengths</li> <li>Assist with the year end audit process and statutory reporting</li> <li>Support the finance team's wider plans to prepare for an IPO</li> <li>Improve the efficiency of financial processes and procedures and monitor compliance</li> <li>Share knowledge between team members to ensure cover is available when needed</li> <li>Actively develop your own skills to ensure current knowledge of applicable standards and regulations</li> <li>Establish strong relationships with key colleagues outside the wider finance team</li> </ul> <h3>What we are looking for in you</h3> <ul> <li>Exceptional academic track record and subsequent career performance</li> <li>Bachelor's degree in Accounting or equivalent</li> <li>Qualified accountant (ACCA, ACA, ACMA, CPA, etc.)</li> <li>Experience at a large public accounting firm, or public multinational corporate accounting department preferred</li> <li>NetSuite or similar enterprise grade systems experience</li> <li>Willingness to travel up to four times per year</li> </ul> <h3> </h3> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</li> </ul> <h3> </h3> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote</p> <h3> </h3>

title: Customer Success Manager (m/w/d)
description: Ein Betrieb läuft mit SO'USE, das Terminal funktioniert, die Gäste bestellen selbst. Und dann? Genau da setzt du an - schlägst noch die Anbindung der Lieferdienste und den eigenen Webshop vor. Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Bestandskunden das volle Potenzial unserer Plattform nutzen, und machst aus zufriedenen Kunden Betriebe, die mit uns wachsen. SO'USE ist eine Plattform für digitales Bestellen und Bezahlen in der Gastronomie. Gäste scannen einen QR-Code oder tippen am Self-Order-Terminal, bestellen selbst und zahlen direkt – die Bestellung landet ohne Umweg in der Kasse und auf dem Küchendisplay. Dazu kommen Webshop, Tablet-Bestellung und die Anbindung von Lieferdiensten wie Lieferando, Wolt und Uber Eats. Über 1.500 Betriebe arbeiten damit täglich: vom Foodtruck über Bäckereiketten bis zu HANS IM GLÜCK. Was du bei uns machst Du betreust unsere Bestandskunden aktiv, vor allem am Telefon und in MS-Teams-Calls, und suchst den Kontakt, bevor Probleme entstehen. Dein Ziel: Kunden nutzen das volle Produktportfolio von SO'USE, vom Self-Order-Terminal über Webshop und Tablet-Bestellung bis zur Lieferdienst-Anbindung. Du erkennst Upsell-Potenziale im Bestand und bringst sie im Gespräch auf den Tisch, passend zum Betrieb. Du wirkst durch Schulungen oder weitere Produkte darauf hin, dass möglichst viele Bestellungen per Onlinezahlung abgewickelt werden, und zeigst Betrieben, welchen Mehrwert das für sie hat. Du verstehst, wie ein Betrieb vor Ort wirklich arbeitet, und passt Empfehlungen und Lösungen an seine Prozesse an. Du nimmst Kritik und Beschwerden ernst, bleibst ruhig, hörst zu und wendest schwierige Situationen bis zur Kündigung zum Guten. Bei technischen Fragen arbeitest du eng mit Support und Entwicklung zusammen. Der Bereich ist im Aufbau. Du findest proaktiv Aufgaben, entwickelst Prozesse und Vorgehensweisen mit und gibst Kundenfeedback an das Produktteam weiter. Du nutzt KI-Tools, um Kundenkommunikation, Auswertungen und deine Arbeitsabläufe effizienter zu gestalten. Was du mitbringst Starke Kommunikation, besonders am Telefon und in MS-Teams-Calls. Du telefonierst gern und viel, auch mit Menschen, die gerade keine Zeit haben. Emotionale Intelligenz und Einfühlungsvermögen. Du kannst Kritik aushalten, Kunden beruhigen und Gespräche in eine konstruktive Richtung lenken. Proaktivität und Eigeninitiative. Du arbeitest gern selbstständig und packst Aufgaben an, bevor sie jemand verteilt. Gastro-Erfahrung! Du hast im Service, in der Küche, oder in der Betriebsleitung oder in gearbeitet und weißt, wie sich ein voller Laden anfühlt. Das hilft dir, Prozesse vor Ort zu verstehen. Verkaufsgeschick und Freude daran, Bestandskunden weiterzuentwickeln. Keine Berührungsängste mit KI. Du bist offen für neue Tools und nutzt sie selbstverständlich. Schnelle Auffassungsgabe. Neue Produkte und Prozesse sind für dich der spannende Teil. Von Vorteil, aber kein Muss: Erfahrung im Customer Success, Account Management oder Vertrieb, idealerweise in einem Gastrotech-Unternehmen Erfahrung mit Gastro-Kassensystemen Was wir bieten Vergütung: Gesamtvergütung von 45.000 bis 60.000 Euro im Jahr, je nach Erfahrung und Zielerreichung. Sie setzt sich aus einem festen Gehalt und einem variablen Bonus zusammen. Gestaltungsspielraum: Du prägst einen Bereich, der sich schnell entwickelt, und bringst deine Ideen direkt ein. Perspektive: Wer bei uns Kunden und Produkt kennt, hat gute Chancen, den Bereich perspektivisch als Teamleitung zu entwickeln. Arbeitsplatz: Vorzugsweise in Leipzigs Mitte, aber auch remote möglich. Wir sitzen gern zusammen im Büro, aber wenn du von woanders arbeitest, funktioniert das auch. Arbeitskultur: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, flache Hierarchien und ein entspannter Umgang im Team. Entwicklung: Regelmäßiges Feedback und Workshops statt Jahresgespräch. Klingt nach dir? Dann schreib uns. Ein kurzes Motivationsschreiben und dein Lebenslauf reichen uns völlig. Erzähl uns gern, aus welchem Laden du kommst. Fragen vorab? Melde dich einfach direkt, auch ohne fertige Bewerbung. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: (Stage) Chargé(e) de Communication & Branding - Janvier 2027
description: QUI SOMMES-NOUS ? Sowefund est la plateforme pionnière du co-investissement Venture Capital en France, adossée au groupe Founders Future (le fonds fondé par Marc Ménasé). Notre métier : repérer les pépites de la tech et permettre à notre communauté de plus de 180 000 investisseurs d'entrer à leur capital aux côtés des meilleurs fonds. Le Venture Capital finance l'économie réelle et les boîtes qu'on utilise tous les jours sans y penser : Lydia pour rembourser ses potes, Yuka pour scanner ses courses, Lunii pour occuper les enfants, et demain des startups qui façonnent l'IA ou la santé. Quelques chiffres : Plus de 145 pépites financées (Mon Petit Placement, Merveilles du Monde,ekWateur, Lemrock...). Plus de 150 M€ injectés dans l'économie réelle. Une communauté de plus de 180 000 membres actifs. TON RÔLE : FAIRE RAYONNER SOWEFUND ET BOOSTER NOTRE NOTORIÉTÉ Ton défi principal : faire connaître Sowefund, vulgariser l'univers du VC et positionner notre marque comme le réflexe n°1 pour investir dans les futures pépites françaises. Au cœur de notre visibilité, tu seras le moteur de notre création de contenu et de nos prises de parole. 1. Réseaux Sociaux & Notoriété de Marque Élaboration stratégique & animation : piloter nos prises de parole sur LinkedIn et Instagram. Trouver les angles, concevoir le calendrier éditorial et animer la communauté. Storytelling & Formats : vulgariser l'actualité tech, imaginer des carrousels percutants et mettre en lumière les sociétés qui lèvent des fonds chez nous. Suivi de performance : analyser les métriques (portée, engagement, croissance des abonnés) pour tester de nouveaux formats en continu. 2. Podcast & Vidéo : De l'Enregistrement à la Diffusion Gestion du podcast : participer à la production du podcast du fondateur de Sowefund Post-production & Formats courts : monter les meilleurs extraits pour concevoir des capsules courtes et rythmées (TikTok, Reels, Shorts, LinkedIn) avec titrages et sous-titrages dynamiques. Distribution : assurer la mise en ligne sur les plateformes audio (Spotify, Apple...) et YouTube avec des visuels et miniatures qui donnent envie de cliquer. 3. Création Visuelle, Ads & Supports Clés (Decks & Slides) Decks & Présentations : concevoir et mettre en page des présentations visuelles irréprochables (Pitch Decks, présentations partenaires, bilans) pour valoriser Sowefund auprès de toutes nos parties prenantes. Assets visuels : créer les visuels, bannières et carrousels pour rythmer les annonces de levées et les temps forts de la marque. Formats publicitaires : décliner les créas visuelles pour nos campagnes d'acquisition payante (Meta Ads, Google Ads). 4. Gestion de Projet Communication Être le garant de la cohérence de l'image de marque et du ton Sowefund sur l'ensemble des points de contact. CE QUE TU APPRENDS ICI Une liberté d’action directe : une structure agile où tes initiatives du matin peuvent être concrétisées l'après-midi. Une immersion dans l'écosystème tech : des échanges directs avec les fondateurs et figures de l'écosystème startup français. title: Analytics - Future Leaders Graduate Program
description: <h2><strong>Real ownership. Real impact. Build from day one.</strong></h2> <p>Are you an ambitious graduate ready to tackle complex<strong>,</strong> real-world challenges at the intersection of data, strategy and tech? </p> <p><strong>The Future Leaders Graduate Program – Business Analytics</strong> at Picnic is a one-year launchpad for exceptional talents. From day one, you join a business team, own a business topic, and become an expert in your field.</p> <p>At Picnic, we’re building the future of grocery. Using cutting-edge technology and data-driven innovation, we challenge the status quo and build the world’s smartest, most customer-focused supermarket. <br>We move fast, think big, and turn bold ideas into tangible impact.</p> <h2><strong>Tricks of the trade</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Lead with ambition</strong>: Bring your relentless determination, creativity, and grit. Take the driver’s seat and redefine the grocery shopping experience for millions. You will be expected to think independently, move fast, and deliver results.</li> <li><strong>Steep learning curve</strong>: Your growth comes from owning real problems, testing your ideas, learning from your mistakes and starting again. You'll blend hands-on training with immediate execution, you’ll move at a pace that accelerates your growth like nowhere else.</li> <li><strong>Solve real-life puzzles</strong>: Spot opportunities, use tools at the forefront of technology, and own the outcome end to end. Not just making slides, but building the solution yourself.</li> <li><strong>Innovate across borders</strong>: You’ll collaborate with teams across the Netherlands, Germany, and France, tackling challenges that redefine how Picnic operates at a European scale.</li> <li><strong>High-performance environment</strong>: You’ll work alongside some of the best teams in analytics and tech, people who set a high bar and expect you to do the same.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>From learning to leading</strong></h2> <p>Throughout this one-year program, you’ll own business-critical projects from start to finish right from the get-go, supported by mentorship, learning sessions, and regular feedback.</p> <p>You’ll strengthen your leadership skills in project management, storytelling, stakeholder communication, and giving and receiving feedback, while sharpening your technical skills in Python, SQL, Excel, and PowerPoint.</p> <p>As your scope grows, so does your responsibility. You might scale your initial project or take on new challenges within the same domain. Either way, there’s always a new challenge to lead and an opportunity to make an impact. That’s why every journey is unique: there’s no standardized path through the program, just continuous opportunities to grow and lead.</p> <h3><strong>Where you’ll make an impact</strong></h3> <p>From day one, you’ll be embedded in a business team, taking ownership in one of the following domains:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Consumer</strong> - Drive growth through pricing, supplier strategy, and our market strategy. Think: Shaping our successful market entry into new cities. Your decisions shape how millions of customers experience Picnic. </li> <li><strong>Logistics </strong>- Build the backbone of Picnics operations. Think: robotic fulfilment, demand forecasting, route optimization across Europe and much more</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Your superpowers</strong></h2> <p>You don't wait for permission. You see a problem, build the solution, and bring people with you, before anyone asks. You've probably already started something: a project, a product, a business, an initiative that didn't exist until you made it happen.<br><br>More specifically, you:</p> <ul> <li>Are about to graduate (or recently graduated) a Masters in a <strong>quantitative field</strong>: e.g., mathematics, econometrics, engineering, or similar</li> <li>Have experience in <strong>high-performance environments:</strong> consulting, fast-growth startups, or competitive internships and know what it means to raise the bar</li> <li>Show an <strong>entrepreneurial mindset</strong>: you build, improve, and take ownership without being asked</li> <li><strong>Think like a builder</strong>: hands-on, curious, and driven to challenge the status quo with practical solutions</li> <li>You have already gained basic knowledge in <strong>PowerPoint, Python, SQL, Excel</strong> or alternative coding languages </li> <li><strong>EU citizenship</strong> or valid <strong>EU working permit required</strong>.</li> </ul> <p><em>Many strong candidates (particularly women) talk themselves out of applying because they don't tick every box. If this excites you and you believe you have what it takes, apply. </em><em>We only hire when we find the right match. That’s why our selection process is intentionally highly selective.</em></p> <h2><strong> </strong><strong>Why Picnic?</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Grow as we grow</strong>. We’re scaling quickly across countries and millions of customers and this is just the start. description: 🍿 About Staycation For most people, hotels are places you only visit when you travel. But we see something different. You’ll join one of our cross-functional product squads, working closely with a Lead Developer, a Product Manager, a Product Designer and other Fullstack Developers. Work closely with Product Management and Product Design from the problem-definition stage, helping shape the solution rather than simply implementing a finished specification. Break down projects into clear increments, estimate your work, identify dependencies and risks, and communicate early when the plan needs to change. Take ownership of what you ship in production, from instrumentation and monitoring to incident diagnosis and continuous improvement. Contribute to high-quality code reviews, pragmatic testing strategies, refactoring and the active management of technical debt. Document decisions, share knowledge and help improve our engineering practices and codebase over time. Depending on your level, plan multi-week projects, design architectures that others can implement and introduce practices that continue to work without you in the loop. 🧰 Our tech environment Four products running on a shared stack: The website (React / Next.js), our storefront and booking funnel. The mobile app (React Native), used daily by our users, with its own release cycles and performance stakes. The hotel extranet , where our partners manage their offers, inventory, bookings, billing, timeslots. The internal admin platform , the tool our teams use to run the marketplace. On the back-end side: micro-services in NestJS and more, PostgreSQL for our databases, hosted on AWS with Terraform. 📌 Key results In your first 3 months, you’ll be expected to: Understand your squad’s product mission, users, metrics and main technical flows. Become familiar with our stack, codebase, rituals and path to production. Ship a first end-to-end increment and monitor its performance in production. Contribute useful code reviews and identify at least one relevant technical risk or improvement. Build reliable working relationships with Engineering, Product Management and Product Design. In your first 12 months, you’ll be expected to: Own a meaningful product and technical scope within your squad. Have contributed to a measurable product outcome for our users and the business. Deliver reliably, surface risks early and make sound trade-offs between speed, quality and reversibility. Have improved at least one engineering practice or part of the codebase in a way that benefits the wider team. At senior level, have planned and driven a multi-week project or designed an architecture successfully implemented by others. 🌍 Location This position is open to candidates based anywhere in France , with two possible working arrangements: If you are based in the Paris region , you will work in a hybrid setup, with three days per week at our Paris office. If you are based elsewhere in France, you can work fully remotely and will join us in Paris for three consecutive days each month (Wednesday to Friday during the first week of the month). 🚀 Why join us? Work on a product used by millions of people, with a direct and visible impact on their experience. Contribute to ambitious product challenges across the full user journey. Own features end to end and take part in product decisions alongside Product and Design. Work across web, mobile and backend challenges in an engineering culture that values pragmatism over technical dogma. Join a small team with real autonomy, short decision cycles and room to shape the codebase, architecture and ways of working. Combine remote flexibility with regular time together as a team in Paris. 🎯 You’re the ideal candidate if you: Must-haves Have at least 5 years of professional software development experience, with a track record of shipping and owning meaningful product features. Have real experience contributing to both frontend and backend development, even if one side is currently stronger. Have solid experience with React/Next.js or a comparable modern frontend stack , as well as building APIs and working with data using Node.js or a comparable backend stack . Have good knowledge of SQL and PostgreSQL . Can take a feature from an ambiguous problem to a reliable production release, making pragmatic technical and product trade-offs along the way. Care about code quality, testing, maintainability and production reliability without losing sight of delivery and user impact. Communicate clearly, collaborate without ego and are comfortable working closely with Product and Design. Are autonomous and reliable in a distributed team, while knowing when to ask for context, feedback or support. Nice-to-haves Experience with React Native . Experience working on a B2C product, marketplace, mobile application, booking or payment journey. Previous experience working remotely. Comfortable working in English in a professional environment. ⚙️ Hiring process Recruiter interview with Mathieu , our Talent Acquisition Manager (30–45 min) Manager interview with Robin , our CTO & Head of Product, and Charlie , one of our Lead Developers (60 min) Technical interview with Corentin and Joachim , our Tech Leads (60 min) Final meetings with members of our Leadership team (60 min) and your potential future teammates (30 min) In the meantime, meet Robin, our CTO & Head of Product: Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Product Manager - Data Integrations
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As a Senior Product Manager for Data Integrations, you'll help GitLab's analytics and artificial intelligence (AI) agents see beyond the data held in GitLab. You'll decide which external systems connect to the Data Insights Platform and Orbit, which integrations come first, and how their data fits into shared models.</p> <p>Engineering teams plan work, track incidents, monitor production, and manage security findings across different tools. Your challenge is to bring that context together with GitLab's code, merge requests, pipelines, deployments, and vulnerabilities. You'll shape a consistent approach that gives customers a trustworthy picture they can query, report on, and use with agents, rather than another set of disconnected data sources.</p> <p>This role is based in Bangalore, India. You'll work from home and come to the Bangalore office when needed for business or team activities. You should be based in Bangalore or willing to relocate there.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Set integration priorities using evidence from customers, field teams, and other product managers to identify the biggest gaps in context.</li> <li value="2">Shape how external data maps into GitLab's shared data models, including the extract, transform, and load (ETL) approach and the transformations needed to make sources work together.</li> <li value="3">Define the customer problems and user groups each integration serves. Partner with engineering to agree on the intended experience, trade-offs, and delivery sequence.</li> <li value="4">Translate product decisions into a clear backlog of epics and issues for engineering.</li> <li value="5">Define telemetry and adoption signals to understand whether connected data helps customers answer new questions, and use those findings to guide priorities.</li> <li value="6">Help shape integration pricing and packaging as the product area matures.</li> <li value="7">Use AI coding agents and GitLab to explore data, prototype integrations, and document the intended experience.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Product management experience, with the ability to connect customer needs to priorities and make trade-offs with incomplete information.</li> <li value="2">Strong knowledge of the software development and operations (DevOps) ecosystem, including how planning, security, observability, and IT service management tools fit into engineering workflows.</li> <li value="3">A working understanding of data integration, ETL, and data transformation, including how data from different systems maps to a common model. You don't need a background as a data engineer.</li> <li value="4">Comfort using AI tools for prototyping and documentation as part of your product work.</li> <li value="5">Clear communication about customer problems, close collaboration with engineering, and a habit of using data to evaluate adoption.</li> <li value="6">Experience with integration products, data models, or value stream analytics is helpful, but isn't required.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>We're part of GitLab's Core Data Products organization, which focuses on insights, analytics, and data-driven decision-making. You'll report to the Vice President of Product Management and join as our third product manager, focused on Data Integrations. You'll work alongside a Principal Product Manager responsible for the Data Insights Platform and dashboards, and a Product Manager focused on Orbit.</p> <p>GitLab is all-remote, with asynchronous collaboration across regions. Transparency, written communication, and clear decisions are central to how we work. This role has the Bangalore location and in-person requirements described above.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

Freude daran, dein Fachwissen weiterzugeben, zeichnet dich ebenso aus wie die Fähigkeit, auch komplexe audiologische oder technische Zusammenhänge am Telefon verständlich und lösungsorientiert zu erklären. Im Umgang mit digitalen Anwendungen bist du sicher und bringst eine gute Software- und Technikaffinität mit. Mehr über das, was wir bieten Bei uns kannst du deine Erfahrung aus der Hörakustik in einem neuen Umfeld einsetzen: Du bleibst nah an audiologischen Themen und der täglichen Praxis unserer Fachkundschaft. Gleichzeitig gibst du dein Fachwissen an andere Fachkräfte aus der Hörakustik weiter und unterstützt sie kompetent bei audiologischen und technischen Fragestellungen. Als Teil eines großen und erfahrenen Teams profitierst du vom regelmäßigen fachlichen Austausch und erhältst gleichzeitig Einblicke in die Arbeit eines der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Hörlösungen. Wir möchten ein Umfeld schaffen, in dem du eine erfolgreiche Karriere mit deinen persönlichen Verpflichtungen und Interessen vereinbaren kannst. Darüber hinaus bieten wir dir vielfältige Möglichkeiten zur fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterbildung sowie individuelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. title: Project Manager
description: About Taurus Do you want to be part of a new entrepreneurial adventure and help build the next global FinTech? Then we might just have the job for you. Taurus is a FINMA-regulated securities firm, headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, and a leading European provider of digital asset infrastructure solutions for banks, broker-dealers, corporates, and private companies. Using blockchain technology, our platform covers cryptocurrencies, tokenized securities and assets, digital currencies, and stablecoins. We are looking for ambitious and driven individuals to support our fast global growth. Tasks The Role We are seeking a highly motivated Project Manager to join our Project & Organization team. You will play a central role in managing high-impact projects — from the implementation of our platform within financial institutions to strategic cross-functional initiatives. Working closely with both clients and internal teams, you will help deliver a seamless, high-quality experience while contributing directly to Taurus's continued growth. This role sits at the intersection of business, technology, and digital assets — ideal for someone eager to grow in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. We are looking for a resourceful, forward-thinking, and hands-on professional capable of driving strategic planning, operational execution, and client delivery in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Main Responsibilities Client-Facing Project Management: Lead end-to-end delivery projects for our clients (financial institutions, issuers, or LP/market makers). This includes designing operating models and workflows, setting up custody and tokenization platforms, and managing technical implementations in close collaboration with client teams and Taurus' Engineering and Security departments. Internal Strategy & Operations: Deliver cross-functional projects sponsored by the Executive Committee, working across Product, Operations, Compliance, Technology, and Sales. Typical assignments involve regulatory filings, business requirement specifications, operational improvements, and international expansion Blockchain Forensics & Due Diligence: Produce high-quality source-of-funds analyses, wallet screening, and crypto due diligence reports using blockchain intelligence tools to support compliance reviews, onboarding, and investigations. Commercial & Operational Support: Contribute to sales RFPs/RFIs, support ad-hoc commercial or operational priorities across the company. Requirements Your Profile Master's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Technology, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in a top-tier consulting firm or in project management within a financial services or fintech environment. Solid understanding of blockchain, cryptocurrencies, and the broader digital asset ecosystem (custody, trading, tokenization, staking, derivatives, etc.). Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize effectively, and deliver with a high level of attention to detail. Precise, organized, autonomous, open-minded, hands-on, and results-oriented — a true self-starter and fast learner. Fluent in French and English; additional languages are a plus. Willingness to travel to client locations as required Benefits What We Offer An opportunity to work at the intersection of digital assets and traditional finance, with direct exposure to leading financial institutions. A skilled and experienced team, including world-renowned experts in digital assets and blockchain. A fast-paced, entrepreneurial learning environment with strong team spirit. A great moment to join as Taurus grows and expands globally As the company evolves in a dynamic and innovative environment, its DNA is based on merit. There will be growth opportunities for candidates with an open mindset and a strong delivery track record. We are an equal opportunity employer. Note We will only consider direct applications and won't consider applications submitted via recruitment agencies. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Telco Field Engineering Director
description: <p>This is an opportunity to run the worldwide Telco Field Engineering business, helping customers understand and implement Canonical's open source solutions in public clouds and in their own data centers. We work across the entire spectrum of cloud offerings, from Ubuntu itself to virtualisation and private cloud, Kubernetes, and the implementation of sophisticated open source solutions such as MLops platforms, data platforms and more. The Telco department is composed of three regional teams (APAC, EMEA and AMER). </p> <p>We believe that Engineering Directors should be outstanding engineers themselves. They should feel completely at home troubleshooting technical issues and having technical presales conversations with customers. They should contribute to project delivery themselves, but know that the technical contributions they bring are far less significant than their ability to shape the whole team’s direction, focus and delivery. We grow management skills and train engineers, who are interested in soft skills, to be managers.</p> <p>We believe that open source is just starting to transform the tech sector and enterprise compute. Our goal is to make open source easier, more reliable and more secure for deployment and development. We strive to be the provider of ‘most software to most companies’. To deliver on that ambition, our engineers are carefully selected from the applicants across the globe. We select for brilliance and motivation to take open source to the next level. Our engineering managers help teams achieve more than they realised they could, and feel proud of the result.</p> <p><strong>The role of a Telco Field Engineering Director at Canonical</strong></p> <p>The Field Engineering department is our team of cloud solutions architects at Canonical, working directly with our customers, designing private and public cloud solutions fitting their workload needs. The portfolio of products includes on-premise cloud solutions such as Openstack, MicroCloud and Ceph, and solutions that could be deployed either on-premises or in public clouds such as Kubernetes, Kubeflow, Spark, PostgreSQL, etc.  The team works hands-on with the technologies by deploying, testing and handing over the solution to our support or managed services team at the end of a project. Managers and team members also take part in presales conversations to provide technical advice during the sales process. </p> <p>Within the Field Engineering department, there are multiple focused teams : the Cloud/DC team, the Alliances/Partners team, the IoT team, and the Telco team. </p> <p>The telco industry is moving to software-defined services. This transformation is driven by open source software, cloud computing and the move to VNF / CNF approaches. Canonical Ubuntu is a key platform for telco innovation, and we are growing our team of specialists who work in the industry to accelerate the change.</p> <p>Canonical enables operators and communications service providers to embrace this new world, with a focus on platforms such as Ubuntu, OpenStack, and Kubernetes, and reusable, high quality automation for operations at scale.</p> <p>A Cloud Field Engineering Director is responsible for driving the strategy in presales and delivery for our telco customers. The ability to develop engineering talent, to represent your team from a technical perspective, and to drive collaboration with other teams and customers are all critical to success in this role. You are also expected to actively participate in technical presales to help our department achieve our quarterly goals.</p> <p><strong>Location: </strong>This role will be home based, managing teams in worldwide.</p> <p><strong>What your day will look like</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead and develop managers and teams of Field engineers in the areas of Presales and Professional Services</li> <li>Solve customer problems by promoting our technologies and being a trusted advisor</li> <li>Work remotely in a single major time zone</li> <li>Coach, mentor, and offer career development feedback</li> <li>Identify and measure team health indicators</li> <li>Implement disciplined engineering processes</li> <li>Represent your team and product to stakeholders, partners, and customers </li> <li>Develop and evangelise great engineering and organisational practices</li> <li>Plan and manage progress on agreed goals and projects</li> <li>Be an active part of the leadership team, collaborating with other leaders</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></p> <ul> <li>A thorough technical understanding of the telco NFVi (VIM), NFVO, VNFM and MEC space and key telco cloud infrastructure technologies like CPU Pinning, NUMA, SR-IOV, DPDK, etc<br>Familiarity with telco architecture and industry standards<br>Working knowledge of at least one of the following domains: Mobile Packet Core (4G/5G), Private Network, Radio Access Network (RAN), Voice, IP Backbone, VAS or OSS/BSS</li> <li>Knowledge of cloud computing concepts & technologies, such as Kubernetes, Openstack, AWS, GCP, Azure, Ceph, etc.</li> <li>Practical knowledge of Linux and networking</li> <li>Experience in technical presales</li> <li>You are a dynamic person who loves to jump in new projects and interact with people</li> <li>Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English</li> <li>Passion and a track record of developing and growing people</li> <li>Experience in leading, coaching and mentoring engineers and managers</li> <li>Organised and able to ensure your team delivers timely, high quality results</li> <li> An exceptional academic track record from high school and, preferably, university as well</li> <li> Willingness to travel up to 25% of the time. Field Engineers attend internal company events, external tech events and customer meetings.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Additional skills that you might also bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>Second language - Spanish or French preferred</li> <li>Python knowledge</li> <li>Experience collaborating with external partners</li> <li>Experience collaborating with several internal teams and providing stakeholder feedback for engineering roadmaps</li> <li>Understanding of AI and machine learning concepts, including sovereign AI, and their potential applications in telco environments, such as network optimization, predictive maintenance, unified communication, and customer experience improvement</li> <li>Exposure to frameworks such as 3GPP, TM Forum ODA, eTOM, ETSI NFV, ONAP, O-RAN, or similar is a plus</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we offer you</strong></p> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others</li> <li>Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <p><strong>About Canonical</strong></p> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.</p> <p>Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p> </p> <p>#LI-remote </p> <p><br><br></p>

description: Everything as a Service. title: Director of Structured Finance
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>New York, NY</strong></li> <li><strong>San Francisco, CA</strong></li> <li><strong>Austin, TX</strong></li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The Finance team is a critical pillar of Cloudflare’s success, translating strategy into financial outcomes. Structured Finance is responsible for making sure Cloudflare has the right capital, on the right terms, to keep building one of the world’s largest networks.</p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare is looking for a Director of Structured Finance to lead the structuring and execution of financings that support our global network and infrastructure strategy. Our infrastructure spans hundreds of cities worldwide, and as we continue to scale — including the servers, GPUs, and data center capacity that power our network, Workers AI, and our Developer Platform — how we finance that build-out is a strategic lever for the business.</p> <p>You will own financing workstreams end-to-end: structuring, counterparty engagement, term negotiation, documentation, and close. You will partner closely with our Infrastructure, Hardware Sourcing, Treasury, Legal, Accounting, Tax, and FP&A teams to turn infrastructure plans into investable, well-priced transactions. The role will also extend to broader capital markets and capital structure work as the company grows.</p> <p>This is a high-visibility, high-ownership role on a lean team. It combines hands-on transaction execution with financial analysis, relationship building with the financing community, and strategic decision support for senior leadership and the Board. We hold a very high bar on rigor and judgment, and we are AI-native in how we work.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <p><strong>Infrastructure and asset financing</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own financing workstreams end-to-end for Cloudflare’s network and data center infrastructure — including equipment and hardware financing, leasing, vendor financing, and other structured solutions — from structuring and counterparty engagement through term negotiation, documentation, and close.</li> <li>Translate infrastructure requirements and capex plans into clear, investable frameworks and materials for lenders, lessors, and other financing counterparties.</li> <li>Represent Cloudflare independently in negotiations with external counterparties, exercising sound judgment on risk allocation, collateral, covenants, and commercial terms.</li> <li>Evaluate lease vs. buy vs. finance trade-offs and recommend the structures that best balance cost of capital, flexibility, and risk.</li> <li>Build repeatable internal frameworks, playbooks, and processes for evaluating, approving, and executing financing transactions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Capital markets and capital structure</strong></p> <ul> <li>Collaborate with Cloudflare’s Treasury team on the company’s broader capital markets strategy, including debt, convertible, and other structured transactions, and contribute analysis on capital structure, liquidity, and cost of capital.</li> <li>Develop and maintain a credible network of financing counterparties — banks, private credit funds, private equity, lessors, infrastructure investors, and OEM/vendor finance teams.</li> <li>Monitor market conditions, pricing, and emerging financing structures, and bring new ideas to leadership.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Modeling, analysis, and decision support</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and maintain rigorous financial models supporting transaction structuring, pricing, returns, and capital allocation decisions.</li> <li>Prepare analysis and materials that distill complex financing decisions into clear recommendations for the CFO, senior leadership, and the Board.</li> <li>Partner with Accounting, Tax, and Legal on accounting treatment (e.g., lease classification), tax implications, disclosure, and documentation.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Cross-functional partnership and execution</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner with Infrastructure, Sourcing, Treasury, Legal, and leadership teams to keep transaction terms aligned with network build-out plans and broader company priorities.</li> <li>Own post-close management of financing arrangements, including covenant compliance, reporting obligations, and ongoing counterparty relationships.</li> <li>Use AI-native tooling and automation to scale the function — models, trackers, and workflows that let a small team operate with speed and accuracy.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>10+ years of experience</strong> across structured or project finance, infrastructure investing, private credit, equipment leasing, private equity, investment banking, and/or corporate capital markets — ideally including time in-house at a high-growth technology or infrastructure company.</li> <li><strong>A track record of leading complex financing transactions through to close</strong>, including direct negotiation and documentation with external counterparties.</li> <li><strong>The ability to run a financing workstream independently</strong>, without close supervision, and to represent the company credibly with senior external counterparties.</li> <li><strong>Deep structuring expertise</strong> — e.g., equipment finance, leasing and sale-leaseback, asset-backed and project finance, vendor financing, and debt or convertible capital markets — plus creativity in designing new structures to meet company goals.</li> <li><strong>Advanced financial modeling, credit analysis, and transaction documentation skills</strong>, including familiarity with credit agreements, master lease agreements, and related legal documentation.</li> <li><strong>Working knowledge of the accounting and tax implications</strong> of financing structures, and comfort partnering with Accounting, Tax, and Legal to get them right.</li> <li><strong>Exceptional written and verbal communication skills</strong>, with the ability to make complex structures legible to non-specialist leadership and to influence diverse stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Comfort with ambiguity</strong> — the ability to drive clarity, manage competing priorities, and execute at a high bar in a fast-moving environment.</li> <li><strong>High-trust collaboration</strong> — the ability to build credibility quickly with senior internal stakeholders (CFO, Treasury, Legal, Accounting, Infrastructure) and external counterparties.</li> <li><strong>AI-native curiosity and skill</strong> — fluency with modern AI tooling and a track record of using it to amplify your impact.</li> <li><strong>Sound judgment with confidential information</strong>, including an understanding of the discretion required at a public company.</li> <li><strong>Sector background</strong> in data centers, digital infrastructure, telecom, cloud, or AI compute preferred; existing relationships with lenders, lessors, and infrastructure investors a plus.</li> <li>MBA, CFA, or similar a plus, but not required.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> salary of $196,000 - $270,000</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare
