title: Strategic Account Executive (French and English speaking)
description: Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋 Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place! We’re looking for a Strategic Account Executive to join our sales team in Paris. As a Strategic Account Executive focused on new business, you will be at the forefront of our company's growth in France, driving revenue by identifying, pursuing, and closing strategic deals with high-value new clients in the Hospitality industry . This role demands a proactive and results-oriented professional, with a demonstrated ability to consistently exceed sales targets within a direct sales environment. You will act as a trusted advisor, understanding potential clients' complex business needs and delivering tailored solutions that resonate and close ** Please note this role is based in Paris, France. ** What you’ll be doing: New business development Proactively identify and qualify high-potential new clients within the hospitality sector, demonstrating how Lightspeed's platform can optimise their operations and enhance guest satisfaction. Develop and execute strategic sales plans to acquire key hospitality accounts, highlighting the benefits of our integrated POS, online ordering, and inventory management solutions. Build and maintain a robust pipeline of qualified leads, showcasing the future-proof capabilities of Lightspeed K platform for restaurants, bars, and hotels. Direct Sales and Closing Conduct demonstrations illustrating how Lightspeed's product empowers hospitality businesses to streamline operations and elevate guest experiences. Lead complex sales cycles, from initial contact to contract negotiation and closing, focusing on the value of Lightspeed's integrated payments and operational efficiency. Achieve and exceed quarterly and annual sales targets for new customer acquisition, driving the adoption of Lightspeed's transformative technology within the hospitality industry. Client Relationship Building : Establish strong relationships with owners, managers, and key decision-makers at prospective hospitality clients, understanding their specific needs and presenting Lightspeed as the ideal solution. Understand potential clients' business objectives and challenges, and align our solutions to address their needs, emphasising the benefits of Lightspeed's robust reporting and analytics. Smoothly transition new customers to the implementation and launch teams, ensuring a seamless onboarding experience with the Lightspeed hospitality platform. And a little bit of.... Work on other sales/marketing campaigns designed to improve the customer experience as well as grow Lightspeed MRR in the process. Maintain accurate records of sales activities and prospect interactions within the CRM system Contributing as part of the wider team to achieve organisational objectives even if this means doing things that aren’t strictly within the scope of your role. What you need to bring: 3-5 years relevant work experience in a 360 selling environment Relevant work experience in an industry like IT solutions, software sales, e-commerce, cloud applications, SaaS, POS, retail/hospitality or technology. Experience working in a hospitality environment would be great, but isn’t necessary. Experience in an outbound sales environment. What’s in it for you? Come live the Lightspeed experience... Genuine career opportunities in a company that’s creating new jobs every day; Work in a team large enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact; Exposure to modern and proven technology; Ability to work and grow in a truly flexible environment; Opportunity to learn, expand your skill set, forge wonderful relationships and make your mark within the diverse and inclusive Lightspeed culture, a true Canadian tech success story … and enjoy a range of benefits that’ll keep you happy, healthy and (not) hungry: Lightspeed equity scheme (we are all owners) Health & Wellness Credit- expense up to 400 EUR per year towards your gym membership, yoga classes, a new bike or whatever else you do for your health Mental Health Support through the Modern Health App- whether it is meditation, coaching or counselling you need - each employee gets access to this platform Time off to volunteer and give back to your community Transit benefit if you travel by public transport to the office Lunch reimbursement on the days you work from our Paris office Healthy snacks and after work organised by the company Health insurance with attractive guarantee plans To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Where to from here? Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here . Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs. Who we are: Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks. Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries. Lightspeed handles your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Statement . Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Team Lead Sales – Steuerkanzleien (m/w/d) | B2B SaaS Fintech, Berlin
description: Team Lead Sales – Steuerkanzleien (m/w/d) | B2B SaaS Fintech, Berlin Du willst als Team Lead Sales in Berlin ein Vertriebsteam führen und gleichzeitig mitgestalten, wie Pennylane Steuerkanzleien in Deutschland gewinnt? Als erste Sales-Teamleitung für unser deutsches Kanzleisegment entwickelst du ein wachsendes Team regionaler Account Executives weiter: Du coachst im Kundengespräch, steuerst die Vertriebsleistung und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Head of Sales den Ansatz für den deutschen Markt – mit dem Rückenwind eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs Europas. Unsere Vision Wir wollen das beliebteste finanzielle Betriebssystem für KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und Steuerkanzleien werden. Wir helfen Unternehmern, sich von zeitraubenden Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu befreien, während wir ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu wichtigen Finanzinformationen verschaffen, um die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen zu treffen. Steuerkanzleien geben wir die Plattform, mit der sie ihre Mandate effizienter betreuen und ihre Steuerberatung digital weiterentwickeln. Über uns Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs Europas – seit 2025 auch in Deutschland. Das haben wir seit der Gründung 2020 erreicht: 💻 Wir haben uns als All-in-One-Plattform für Buchhaltung, Finanzen und die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Unternehmen und ihren Steuerberater:innen etabliert – KI-gestützt, cloudbasiert, mit offenen Schnittstellen. 💰 Wir haben rund 360 Millionen Euro Kapital eingesammelt – zuletzt 175 Millionen Euro in unserer Series E im Januar 2026, angeführt von TCV und Blackstone Growth, neben Investoren wie Sequoia, CapitalG (Alphabet) und DST Global. Unsere Bewertung liegt bei 3,5 Milliarden Euro. 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf über 900 Pennylaner:innen angewachsen, davon mehr als 400 in Tech, Data und Product – mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor. 🚀 Bereits mehr als 900.000 KMU und über 5.000 Steuerkanzleien nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich – in diesem Segment sind wir dort in fünf Jahren zum Marktführer geworden. 🇩🇪 Deutschland ist unser wichtigster Wachstumsmarkt: Geführt von Managing Director Tobias Janiesch wächst das deutsche Team in Berlin und München 2026 auf rund 100 Kolleg:innen. Du kommst in der Gründungsphase dazu und prägst, wie Pennylane hier verkauft. Deine Mission Du wirst die oder der erste Team Lead Sales (m/w/d) – Steuerkanzleien in Deutschland sein. Deine Mission ist es, mit deinem Team von Account Executives Steuerkanzleien in ganz Deutschland für Pennylane zu gewinnen – du führst, coachst und baust das Team aus. In Frankreich ist Pennylane in diesem Segment innerhalb von fünf Jahren zum Marktführer geworden. Du übernimmst das bewährte Playbook und passt es gemeinsam mit unserem Head of Sales, an den du berichtest, an den deutschen Kanzleimarkt an. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Tobias Janiesch, Managing Director Deutschland, zusammen. Unser Prozess: Erstgespräch, Interview mit dem Head of Sales, Case Study, Abschlussgespräch mit dem Managing Director in Berlin. Dein Team Full-Cycle Sales: Deine Account Executives verantworten den gesamten Prozess – von der Qualifizierung über die Produkt-Demo und den Abschluss bis zum Onboarding und Account Management ihrer Kanzleien. Starkes Setup: Dabei seid ihr nicht allein: Unser eigenes Customer-Success-Team in Berlin unterstützt euch bei Onboarding und Betreuung der Kanzleien, damit deine AEs genug Zeit für die Neukundengewinnung haben. Regional organisiert: Jede:r AE betreut eine feste Region in Deutschland – per Inside Sales und vor Ort in den Kanzleien. Im Aufbau: Du übernimmst aktuell zwei Account Executives und stellst gemeinsam mit unserem Talent-Acquisition-Team weitere ein – das Team wächst mit dir. Beratender Vertrieb: Dein Team gewinnt Kanzleiinhaber:innen und Partner:innen für eine neue Art der Zusammenarbeit mit ihren Mandanten. Ihr macht den Nutzen von Pennylane für den Kanzleialltag konkret und schafft Vertrauen in die Einführung einer neuen Plattform. Standort Berlin: Das Team wird aus unserem Berliner Office geführt – du bist an zwei Tagen pro Woche vor Ort, den Rest flexibel. Rund 30 % deiner Zeit bist du bei deinen AEs und in Kanzleien in Deutschland unterwegs, in der Regel ein Termin pro Woche, den du selbst planst. Du wirst für die Leistung dieses Teams verantwortlich sein durch: Du verantwortest die Vertriebsleistung deines Teams – gemessen am MRR aus deutschen Steuerkanzleien – und leistest damit einen wesentlichen Beitrag zum Wachstum im deutschen Kanzleimarkt. Du schaffst klare Erwartungen, coachst regelmäßig anhand konkreter Kundengespräche und nutzt Pipeline- und Conversion-Daten, um dein Team gezielt weiterzuentwickeln. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Head of Sales den Go-to-Market-Ansatz für Kanzleien weiter (Inside Sales + Field Sales) und setzt ihn mit deinem Team um. Du begleitest deine AEs im Feld – bei Kanzleibesuchen, Branchenevents und Key Deals. Du arbeitest eng mit dem französischen Sales-Team zusammen und überträgst, was vom Playbook für Deutschland funktioniert. Als Team Lead Sales – Steuerkanzleien sind deine Ziele vielfältig: Du erreichst die Vertriebsziele des Teams und steuerst das Tagesgeschäft – im Office wie bei den AEs in ihren Regionen. Du verantwortest das Sales Enablement deiner Account Executives: Techniken, Messaging und der gesamte Pennylane-Sales-Prozess. Du begleitest neue AEs durch Onboarding und Ramp-up und führst sie zu ihren Zielen. Du baust Teamgeist, Engagement und Wohlbefinden auf – mit Challenges, Teambuildings und Formaten, die du selbst gestaltest. Du bringst die Perspektive des Kanzleivertriebs in die Sales-OKRs von Pennylane Deutschland ein. Du gehst bei wichtigen Deals selbst mit rein – vor Ort in der Kanzlei oder per Video-Call. Dein Profil Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-Sales mit – idealerweise SaaS mit mehrstufigen Deal-Zyklen und mehreren Stakeholdern – und hast bereits ein Sales-Team (AEs / Full-Cycle) erfolgreich geführt. Diese Führungserfahrung ist uns wichtiger als eine bestimmte Jahreszahl. Ein Plus: Du kennst den Markt der Steuerkanzleien oder das Accounting-/Fintech-Ökosystem – oder hast an Steuerberater:innen, Kanzleien oder andere Berufsträger verkauft. Wenn nicht, bringst du die Neugier mit, dich schnell einzuarbeiten. Du führst über Coaching: Du entwickelst Menschen anhand echter Kundengespräche, mit Daten, klarem Feedback und dem Mut, Entscheidungen zu treffen und durchzuhalten. Du bist offen für Selbstreflexion und fühlst dich wohl dabei, Feedback zu geben und zu empfangen. Du arbeitest bereichsübergreifend mit anderen Abteilungen zusammen – Marketing, Customer Success, Product und dem französischen HQ. Du bist hands-on: Du führst nicht nur vom Dashboard aus, sondern gehst selbst mit in Deals – auch vor Ort. Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau – deine Kund:innen sind deutsche Kanzleien – und sicheres Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit mit Paris. Du lebst in Berlin oder bist bereit, nach Berlin zu ziehen – und du bist gern bei Kunden vor Ort (rund 30 % Reiseanteil). Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen 🏢 Berlin, hybrid: zwei Tage pro Woche in unserem Berliner Office, die übrigen Tage flexibel. 🌴 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr. 💵 Ein attraktives OTE-Paket: Fixgehalt plus variabler Anteil, gekoppelt an den MRR, den dein Team erzielt. 📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust. 🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln. 🇫🇷 Onboarding im Pariser HQ, regelmäßiger Austausch mit dem französischen Sales-Team und Zugang zu Busuu, um dein Englisch oder Französisch zu perfektionieren. 💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung. 🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (alle 3 Monate) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar – plus Team-Events in Berlin. Wir wissen, dass einige Menschen eher zögern, sich zu bewerben, wenn sie das Gefühl haben, nicht die gesamte Liste der Kriterien zu erfüllen. Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben: Wer weiß, vielleicht ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit. Wir möchten auch betonen, dass wir Vielfalt, Gleichheit und Inklusion voll und ganz befürworten und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und integratives Umfeld zu schaffen. Wir verpflichten uns, gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderungen oder anderen Merkmalen, die dich ausmachen, zu gewährleisten. title: SDR – Sales Development Representative (m/w/d) – SME / KMU | Berlin (Hybrid)
description: SDR – Sales Development Representative (m/w/d) – SME / KMU | Berlin (Hybrid) Unbefristet · Vollzeit · Start zum 1. Januar 2027 oder früher · Berlin, 2 Tage pro Woche im Office (Montag und Donnerstag) Du hast bereits mindestens zwei Jahre B2B-Sales-Erfahrung und willst im Inbound-Vertrieb für den deutschen Mittelstand richtig Verantwortung übernehmen? Bei Pennylane in Berlin qualifizierst du Unternehmen, die bereits Interesse an unserer Software gezeigt haben, verstehst ihr Buchhaltungs-Setup und ihre Herausforderungen und vereinbarst passende Demo-Termine für unsere Account Executives – ohne Kaltakquise. Du willst Arbeit, die etwas bewirkt – an einem Produkt, das bald Millionen von Unternehmer:innen in Europa helfen könnte? Du arbeitest am besten in einer Kultur, die auf Vertrauen und Eigenverantwortung setzt? Dann könnte Pennylane genau der richtige Ort für dich sein. Unsere Vision Unser Ziel ist es, die beliebteste Finanzmanagement-Software für KMU in Europa zu werden. Wir befreien Unternehmer:innen von zeitraubenden Aufgaben in Buchhaltung und Finanzen und geben ihnen die Finanzkennzahlen an die Hand, die sie für die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen brauchen. Gleichzeitig helfen wir Steuerkanzleien, weniger Zeit mit repetitiven Aufgaben und mehr Zeit mit der Beratung ihrer Mandant:innen zu verbringen. Kontext Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs in Frankreich – und wir sind im zweiten Jahr unserer Expansion nach Deutschland, mit unserem deutschen Team in Berlin. In 6 Jahren unseres Bestehens haben wir Folgendes erreicht: 💻 Wir haben uns als bahnbrechende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Steuerberater:innen bekannt gemacht. 💰 Wir haben insgesamt 400 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem berühmten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, PayPal und viele mehr investiert hat. 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf mehr als 1.100 zufriedene Pennylaner angewachsen: Wir gelten heute als einer der besten Arbeitsplätze in Frankreich (auch remote), mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor. 🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeitenden bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten. 🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen tausender Kund:innen und Steuerkanzleien gewonnen – mit herausragenden Bewertungen. 🚀 Bereits mehr als 1.300.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 6.500 Steuerkanzleien nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich! Warum ist diese Rolle so wichtig für uns? Das SDR-Team ist entscheidend dafür, wie wir neue Kund:innen gewinnen. Als erstes Glied in unserer Sales-Kette prüfen SDRs, welche Anfragen gut zu Pennylane passen, und machen daraus Gesprächstermine – und legen damit die Basis für den Erfolg des gesamten Teams. Das deutsche SDR-Team besteht aktuell aus 2 Personen, und du gestaltest es mit, während es wächst. Du berichtest direkt an Jacob, unseren Global Head of Sales SME, und bringst deine Erfahrung aktiv in den Aufbau unseres deutschen SME-Vertriebs ein – mit Sales Academy, Buddy und Shadowing bringen wir dich schnell auf Pennylane-Niveau. Wie trägst du zum Projekt bei? Wir erhalten täglich viele Inbound-Anfragen von Unternehmen, die Pennylane kennenlernen möchten. Experience with ML compilers, accelerator SDKs, or model compression libraries, particularly for non-NVIDIA accelerators such as TPU, Trainium/Inferentia, Tenstorrent, Groq, or Cerebras. Experience with model quantization, sparsity, codebooks, low-rank factorization or other compression techniques. Contributions to distributed inference or serving frameworks such as vLLM or SGLang. title: Manager, Applied AI Engineering (Codex)

Our work helps ensure AI-powered software development is effective, reliable, secure, and deeply integrated into how engineering organizations operate. This role is open in our Munich and Berlin offices. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. Guide teams in designing and implementing AI-enhanced development workflows, agentic systems, automations, evaluations, and scalable application architectures. title: Senior Product Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>We are the platform turning browsing into shopping</strong>. We connect 200 million shoppers with deals they love while boosting local sales for hundreds of top retailers and brands.</p> <p>We help consumers save time and money while making smart shopping decisions, and we support retailers and brands in engaging customers from online research to in-store purchases.</p> <p>In 2024, Shopfully joined forces with the North American company <a href="https://corp.flipp.com/">Flipp</a>, creating a global leader in the sector. Together, we reach 400 million households and serve over 1,000 top retailers and brands across 27 markets, including Europe, Canada, the USA, Latin America, and Australia.</p> <p>Ready to <strong>spark</strong> your growth with us?</p></div><p><strong>WHO WE LOOK FOR</strong><strong> 🦄</strong></p> <p>Flipp + Shopfully’s Product team focuses on driving adoption and revenue of our products by identifying the biggest market opportunities, building the case for investing in them, and shipping solutions with engineering, all while representing the voice of our merchant customers.</p> <h3><strong>About the role</strong></h3> <p>The Senior Product Manager is a senior, commercially minded product leader who already understands digital advertising. This role requires a strong strategic thinker with good business sense and solid hands-on product skills who leads opportunity identification, builds decision-ready business cases, and works with engineering to ship.</p> <p>You will work closely with Sales, Engineering, Data, and Marketing teams across markets to align on key business objectives. By combining market insight, customer feedback, and industry trends, you will make sure our products resonate with merchants and drive growth. We’re looking for someone who can ramp up quickly and contribute independently.</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU WILL DO </strong>🏄</p> <p><strong>Market Understanding and Opportunity Identification</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work with Product Marketing, Sales Engineering and customer-facing teams to understand customer needs and prioritize the opportunities that matter most.</li> <li>Find the highest-leverage areas to invest in, and weigh customer demand against our resources, capabilities and strategic direction.</li> <li>Turn complex questions into clear priorities. For example: how do we create more value for retail partners as their strategies move toward e-commerce? How do we find and build opportunities at scale as products launch in new markets?</li> </ul> <p><strong>Business Cases and Strategy</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build business cases that size opportunities, weigh revenue trade-offs, and structure a clear recommendation so leadership can make a decision.</li> <li>Own your recommendations, and be ready to explain them and adapt them as you learn.</li> <li>Lead the strategy for how our products differentiate from competitors in the market.</li> <li>Partner with Sales and Finance on pricing and monetization so our offering stays cohesive.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Product Discovery and Delivery</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead discovery with merchants, advertisers, and internal teams to define problems worth solving.</li> <li>Prioritise ruthlessly, balancing revenue impact, effort, and strategic fit.</li> <li>Work hands-on with engineering to define requirements and ship, from alpha and testing through broad launch.</li> <li>Partner with Sales and Marketing on launch timing and readiness, and run retrospectives on past launches to improve future ones.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Alignment and Stakeholder Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Generate cross-functional alignment (Engineering, Data, Sales, Marketing, Content) with a shared focus on goals and timing.</li> <li>Work across markets and levels of seniority, including senior leadership, with confidence.</li> <li>Track progress and impact of product initiatives and communicate results clearly.</li> <li>Build relationships with industry analysts, partners, and customers, and represent Flipp + Shopfully at conferences and industry events where relevant.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU WILL NEED</strong><strong> </strong>🪄</p> <p><strong>Must-haves</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Digital advertising foundations:</strong> supply vs. demand, how exchanges, SSPs, and DSPs work, programmatic bidding, pricing models (CPM, CPC, CPV), and fill rate and yield. Ideally gained in ad tech, a retail media network, a publisher, or a marketplace.</li> <li>Proven experience building business cases: sizing opportunities, weighing revenue trade-offs, and structuring recommendations for decisions.</li> <li>High autonomy: you figure things out, own the outcome and don’t need close management.</li> <li>Genuine excitement about using AI tools and rethinking how work gets done.</li> <li>Hands-on product skills: discovery, prioritisation, and working with engineering to ship, not only strategy.</li> <li>Stakeholder management, with the confidence to work across markets and levels of seniority.</li> <li>A scrappy, curious and confident approach. You’re hungry to make an impact.</li> </ul> <p>👉 At our company, we value diversity and actively encourage it — we believe a variety of perspectives and backgrounds makes us stronger. We focus on potential rather than on having a “perfect” CV. If this role excites you and you believe you could grow into it — even if you don’t tick every single box in the requirements — we’d love to hear from you!<br><br></p> <p><strong>NICE TO HAVE  </strong><strong>🎆</strong></p> <ul> <li>Retail, CPG, or retail media background</li> <li>Multi-market experience</li> <li>Can speak Italian or German</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>LOCATION 🌐</strong> </p> <p>While we have offices in Milan, Berlin, Barcelona, you can benefit from our flexible hybrid model (full remote available), empowering you to work where you're most effective.</p> <p><strong>HOURS </strong>⏰<br>Your manager and several partner teams are in North America, so you’ll need to be flexible about working some later hours, beyond a standard 9-5 CET.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU WILL FIND AT SHOPFULLY</strong><strong> 🤗</strong></p> <p>🌎 An opportunity to thrive in a rapidly scaling multinational company</p> <p>🕶️ A vibrant, informal, and inclusive work environment</p> <p>🧠 We champion autonomy, flexibility, and a hybrid work model, empowering you to own your work</p> <p>📚 Access to learning opportunities and regular feedback sessions</p> <p>🍓 Enjoy our central, modern offices featuring fresh snacks, coffee (including vegan options!), and ergonomic setups</p> <p>🎉 Engage in meaningful team events: offsites, happy hours, company parties and celebrations that unite us beyond daily tasks</p> <p>💻We provide all the necessary equipment for you to work effectively and set up your workspace, wherever you are</p> <p>🧰 Benefit from additional country-specific advantages based on local contracts and practices</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>WHO WE ARE </strong>💜 </p> <p>We’re a team of 450 people (and counting!), from 30 different nationalities. We’re on a mission to innovate, and we believe the key to that is seeing the world through a variety of perspectives. That’s why building a more diverse team, as well as bringing in even more talent, is so important for us.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>TO FEEL AT HOME 🛋️ IN SHOPFULLY YOU NEED 🎯</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Progress Over Perfection</strong>: We move forward. Always. In a fast-moving world, speed with purpose beats certainty without action. Momentum matters—not for its own sake, but because it drives results.</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Clarity Through Transparency</strong>: We bring each other along. We work in teams, not silos. Transparency gives context, and context enables action. It’s the price of ambition.</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Challenge with Empathy</strong>: We speak up, even when it’s hard—because candor shows care, and leads to better outcomes. Listening deeply is how we grow. Disagreeing openly is how we build trust.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Always Build Better: We are builders—of products, systems, and ideas. But more than that, we are builders of better. Better has no finish line. title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description: <p>As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Auterion, you will play a pivotal role in the successful development, integration and deployment of Auterion-powered drone systems. </p> <p>In this role, you will collaborate closely with the production, hardware engineering, and firmware/software teams, as well as operations, ensuring that every platform transitions smoothly from an airframe concept into a fully validated flying robot ready for deployment. You will serve as the primary technical interface for partners, work closely with them to understand their technical requirements, configure and adapt existing solutions, contribute to core software development, and ensure successful implementation. </p> <p>This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys combining hands-on technical work with customer collaboration and system-level problem solving, bridging the gap between hardware, firmware, and real-world flight performance. </p> <p><strong>Responsibilities and Duties</strong></p> <ul> <li>Operate in a highly hands-on environment with evolving system requirements, rapidly iterating across hardware and software integration challenges.</li> <li>Manage software releases and perform firmware flashing and configuration using PX4 or adjacent autopilot ecosystems, including sensor calibration, ESC tuning, and system bring-up.</li> <li>Provide deep avionics and airframe expertise, including autopilot tuning, sensor and payload integration, power systems and airworthiness considerations.</li> <li>Work independently to troubleshoot integration and flight-readiness issues while collaborating cross-functionally with hardware engineering, firmware/software teams, operations, and QC engineering to escalate complex challenges when required.</li> <li>Act as the primary technical authority in customer engagements, translating mission requirements into concrete system architectures and demonstrable solutions built on AuterionOS and Skynode.</li> <li>Participate in flight testing activities to validate platform stability, safety, and mission performance, resolving technical issues often directly in the field during customer trials and demonstrations.</li> <li>Contribute to technical documentation and continuous improvement of engineering processes.</li> <li>Feed customer and market requirements back into product and engineering teams to influence the roadmap of the Auterion stack.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications and Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Degree in Software, Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace or Robotics Engineering, or a related field</li> <li>Working proficiency in C/C++ and Python: you can read, debug and patch existing code and write small tools and scripts</li> <li>Comfortable in Linux environments, including the command line, logs, Docker and basic networking (IP, TCP/UDP)</li> <li>Hands-on hardware-software integration: system bring-up, wiring and connectors, and embedded interfaces (UART, CAN, I2C, SPI) at a practical level</li> <li>Structured troubleshooting: you can isolate whether a title: AI Systems - Senior Software Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Ledgy, we’re on a mission to make Europe a powerhouse of entrepreneurship by building a modern, tech-driven equity management and financial reporting platform for private and public companies. In 2026, we aim to be the leading provider for European IPOs and reporting for share-based payments. We are a value-based company with a core focus on being humble, transparent, ambitious and impactful, all in order to delivery the best experience for our customers and end users.</p> <p>We are proud to partner with some of the world’s leading investors. New Enterprise Associates led our <a href="https://techcrunch.com/2022/09/21/ledgy-a-carta-for-european-startups-to-manage-equity-and-cap-tables-raises-22m-from-nea-sequoia-and-more/">$22m Series B</a> round in 2022, with Philip Chopin joining Sequoia’s Luciana Lixandru on our board.</p> <p>We were founded in Switzerland in 2017 and today we operate globally from offices in Zurich and London. We encourage diversity and are an international team coming from 26 different countries and speaking 25 different languages.</p> <p> </p></div><p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>As a Software Engineer on our AI Systems team, you'll build the AI foundations and product experiences of Ledgy: the Ledgy Agent, the tools and skills it runs on, our MCP server, and the platform capabilities that let other teams embed AI safely in their domains. You'll collaborate with fellow engineers, product managers, and designers in a new and fast-moving product area where correctness matters as much as speed - our customers need equity data they can trust.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> We hire remotely across the UK, Spain, Germany, Poland, and Romania. For candidates based in London, we use a hybrid model with 2 days in the office per week.</p> <p><strong>The team you'll join:</strong><br>AI Systems - Develops Ledgy's AI foundations and product experiences, from AI agents and AI-assisted workflows to the platform capabilities that help other teams embed AI safely in their domains. The team works in a new and evolving product area, balancing rapid iteration with reliable execution, evaluation tooling, and responsible automation.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Work On</strong></p> <p>Help build the future of how companies manage equity.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Ledgy Agent.</strong> You'll design and build the system behind our in-app agent, so equity administrators can do through AI what they do manually in the app today. Ledgy Agent takes real actions and runs real analysis on live equity data, like onboarding a stakeholder end to end, and administrators depend on its accuracy and observability. You'll design the tools, skills, context, and orchestration behind it, and how it decides to handle each request.</li> <li><strong>Ledgy MCP.</strong> Not everyone wants to open Ledgy to get things done. Our MCP server lets customers bring equity into the AI agents and tools they already use. You'll shape it alongside the in-app agent, so a capability built once works in both places, and you'll decide what we expose and how we keep it safe.</li> <li><strong>Measuring and improving the agent.</strong> You'll design and build the system we use to measure the agent's quality and learn from how customers use it: evaluations, tracing, and feedback from real conversations. You decide what "good" means for customers, how we measure it, and how what we learn changes what we build next.</li> <li><strong>Scaling.</strong> The Ledgy web application, the agent, MCP, and surfaces we haven't built yet all need the same capabilities. You'll design the foundations that let us build AI features once and reuse them everywhere, and that let other teams add AI to their domains without compromising correctness. You'll also design how it runs as usage grows: the backend infrastructure, cost, and latency behind the agent and MCP, and how we keep them reliable and observable.</li> </ul> <p>You'll own real parts of this and have a say in where we invest. You'll also spend time with customers to see how administrators actually use the agent, and use that to decide what to build next.</p> <p><strong>You'll Thrive in This Role If You</strong></p> <p>Don't worry if you don't tick every box. These are the things that would make you an especially good fit.</p> <ul> <li>You have 5+ years of experience working as a Software Engineer, with strong TypeScript/Node fundamentals across back end and front end</li> <li>You've built and shipped agentic or LLM-based software to production, such as an agent, an assistant, or a chat product, and you've been the one running it. You've debugged failures in real conversations and kept cost and latency in check as usage and models changed.</li> <li>You've designed the agent itself: tools and skills, context and prompt engineering, state, streaming, and the agent loop. You know at least one agent framework or runtime well and can say where it works and where it doesn't.</li> <li>You improve these systems with evidence. Evals, regression sets, tracing, and feedback from real usage tell you whether a change helped, and you use them to decide what to do next.</li> <li>You keep up with what the foundation labs and the wider community are learning about building agents. You try new techniques early and judge which ones make our product better and are worth adopting now, and which should wait.</li> <li>You take part in deciding what we build. You read the data, talk to customers, and push for what you think matters most.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Our Tech Stack</strong></p> <p>We work in a TypeScript monorepo: React and Tailwind on the front end, tRPC, Node.js, MongoDB, and Temporal on the back end. It runs on GCP with Kubernetes, managed through Terraform. The agent is currently built on the Vercel AI SDK, and we run an MCP server alongside it.</p> <p>You don't need to know all of it, but hands-on experience building with LLMs is strongly preferred.</p> <p><strong>What Your Journey Could Look Like</strong></p> <p><strong>First day:</strong> Get the app running locally and make your first commit. Your onboarding buddy helps you get there.</p> <p><strong>First week:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Meet the engineers, product managers, and designers you'll work with.</li> <li>Learn the agent end to end: its tools, skills, MCP surface, and how we evaluate it.</li> <li>Ship a few smaller features.</li> </ul> <p><strong>First month:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Meet the wider engineering team and learn how Ledgy works and how customers use it today. This is the background you'll use for decisions later.</li> <li>Make larger contributions and take a bigger part in code reviews.</li> </ul> <p><strong>First 3 months:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Drive part of a larger piece of work, such as process, tooling, a new product, or new functionality.</li> <li>Work with Product and Design to prove and deepen the value AI adds to the product.</li> <li>Take part in architecture and long-term decisions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>After the first 3 months:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Take a bigger role in shaping where the team is heading. Own key parts of our AI platform and decide where we can add the most value for customers.</li> <li>Mentor other engineers and raise the bar. Help teams across Ledgy add AI to what they build, whether that means advising, reviewing, or working alongside them.</li> <li>Help shape Ledgy's technical direction, for AI and for everything else we build.</li> </ul> <p><strong>The interview process:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Getting to know you (45 min):</strong> Meet with someone from our people team to talk about your experience and to ask questions about the role</li> <li><strong>Live Coding (60 min):</strong> An equity domain problem to solve collaboratively using your preferred language and IDE. We want to see how you think, so this step does not allow AI. But you can freely look up syntax questions if you need to.</li> <li><strong>System Design (60 min):</strong> A system design session where you will design an architecture for a problem from the Ledgy domain using a visual tool of your choice</li> <li><strong>Behavioural (45 min):</strong> Answer behavioural style questions about your experience, using the STAR method - with a PM and EM.</li> <li><strong>Culture Interview:</strong> A chance to meet one of our founders and your hiring manager for a 30-minute chat about Ledgy's mission and values</li> <li><strong>Offer</strong> 🎉</li> </ul> <p><strong>Being part of Ledgy means:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Recharge and re-energize with flexible working hours, 25 days of vacation, and up to 40 days of remote work from outside your home country.</li> <li>We make space for your own professional development, with a generous yearly learning & development budget.</li> <li>This role will receive a competitive salary + benefits + equity. All salaries are aligned with competitively benchmarked ranges based on work location and levelling.</li> <li>For candidates based in London we use a hybrid work model of 2 days in the office per week.</li> </ul> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: About Focused Energy Focused Energy is an international deep-tech company based in Germany and the US, working to commercialize laser-driven nuclear fusion. We are rapidly scaling and looking for talented individuals who thrive in building clarity and structure within fast-growing environments. Your Role The laser amplification chain scales the beam energy needed by our fusion system. Developing it involves complex technical decisions, interdependent teams and requirements that evolve as the programme advances. We are looking for a Light Amplification Lead (f/m/d) to give this function clear direction and accountability. Your mission is to lead the amplification team, critically evaluate technical information and turn stakeholder input into decisions, priorities and a credible development roadmap. You will guide the function towards delivery of a subsystem that meets agreed requirements and can integrate with the wider laser system. You do not need to be an expert in every amplifier technology. You do need strong engineering judgement, extensive technical leadership experience and enough laser understanding to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions and work effectively with domain specialists. What you’ll do Lead and develop the function. Provide line management for technical teams, set clear expectations, give feedback and develop their capabilities. Build a view of the skills and capacity needed as the programme evolves, and contribute to hiring and team development. Provide technical decisions and steering. Listen to different stakeholders, critically review their input and challenge assumptions. Work with specialists to assess options and make reasoned decisions, identifying where further evidence or expertise is needed. Own the development roadmap. Translate system requirements and programme priorities into a function-level plan that goes beyond individual task lists. Establish milestones, identify dependencies and capability gaps, and adapt the plan as requirements and evidence change. Guide complex project delivery. Lead larger technical projects through uncertainty. Keep priorities, resources, risks and trade-offs visible, coordinate with programme management and lab operations, and escalate issues early. Coordinate with adjacent laser functions and system integration so technical decisions support agreed performance and integration needs. You have enough relevant background to understand the function, engage with specialists and assess how its decisions affect the wider system. Direct hands-on amplifier development is an advantage, not a prerequisite. Extensive technical leadership experience. You have led technical teams and larger, complex engineering projects, with responsibility for people, priorities and delivery. You can develop specialists and provide direction across disciplines. Strong engineering judgement. You can evaluate technical arguments, distinguish assumptions from evidence, identify risks and challenge recommendations constructively. You do not need to know every answer yourself, but you know how to reach a sound decision with the right experts. Experience leading through uncertainty. You have worked on development programmes with incomplete information, evolving requirements or changing technical priorities. You can maintain direction while adapting plans as new evidence emerges. People and stakeholder leadership. You listen carefully, reconcile different perspectives, communicate decisions clearly and remain close to the team. Your leadership experience includes line management and developing technical colleagues, not only coordinating schedules. Your background may be in laser systems, photonics, optical systems or a broader complex-engineering programme that includes relevant laser work. Your current title is less important than the scope of technical and people leadership you have exercised. Familiarity with solid-state, fibre or diode-pumped amplification, CPA/OPCPA, or relevant pulsed and ultrafast systems. Industrialisation, supplier coordination, budget and resource planning, or design for cost and manufacture. Experience in fusion, a high-power laser facility or a defence laser programme. Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers, and professionals passionate about solving global challenges. Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace. title: Stagiaire Chargé(e) de projet ERP
description: Fondé à Paris en 1999, Advancy est un cabinet de conseil en stratégie de premier plan, comptant aujourd'hui plus de 300 consultants répartis dans nos bureaux mondiaux (Paris, New York, Boston, Shanghai, Francfort, Sydney, etc.). En forte croissance, nous modernisons actuellement nos propres outils internes et lançons un projet d'envergure : le déploiement mondial d’un nouvel ERP. Pour nous accompagner dans cette phase clé, nous recherchons un(e) Stagiaire Chargé(e) de projet ERP pour une durée de 6 mois , à partir de début septembre 2026 . Vos Missions Rattaché(e) directement au CFO, vous serez au cœur de la transformation digitale du cabinet. Vous participerez activement à l'implémentation de l’ERP sur les modules clés et accompagnerez la transition opérationnelle. Votre quotidien s'articulera autour des axes suivants : Assistange au pilotage Projet : coordination entre l’intégrateur et les équipes Advancy ; coordoniation entre les équipes Advancy (Finance, RH) : suivi des points bloquants ; participation aux comités projet Aide au paramétrage et déploiement des modules : Finance : Assistance au paramétrage, au nettoyage et à la migration des données Core HCM : Assistance au paramétrage, au nettoyage et à la migration des données RH (profils collaborateurs, structures organisationnelles ; gestion des congés et absences). Staffing : Aider à la modélisation des processus de staffing dans l'outil et à la sécurisation de la migration des données existantes. Recette & Tests (UAT) : Élaborer les scénarios de test, identifier les anomalies ; faire le lien avec l'intégrateur et veiller à la conformité de l'outil avec nos processus métiers. Accompagnement au changement : Participer à la rédaction des guides utilisateurs et aider au support des équipes (RH, Managers, Consultants) lors du lancement. Une première approche d'un outil type ERP ou SIRH est un vrai plus, mais pas obligatoire. Esprit Logique & Métier : Vous avez une excellente capacité à comprendre rapidement les processus métiers impliqués pour savoir les traduire de manière logique et fluide dans un outil informatique. Qualités personnelles : Rigueur analytique, sens de l'organisation et esprit de synthèse. Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre aisance relationnelle et votre capacité à travailler en mode projet dans un environnement exigeant et dynamique. description: Gestalte das perfekte Foodji-Erlebnis Ein großartiges Produkt allein reicht nicht – echte Kundenzufriedenheit entsteht durch starke Beziehungen und einen klaren Blick auf die Entwicklung des Kundenportfolios. title: Software Engineer II - Embedded Platform
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of the <a href="https://www.hudl.com/blog/hudl-2026-top-100-inspiring-workplaces?utm_medium=internal&utm_source=job-ad&utm_campaign=26_NA_talent_job-ad&utm_content=1org_learn-more_blog-link_learn-more_2blog_organic_3ctw">Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces</a>.<br><br>We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.<br><br>Ready to join us?</p> <div style="padding: 56.25% 0 0 0; position: relative;"><iframe style="position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; border: 0;" src="https://player.vimeo.com/video/1095624224?h=9e8cdc9dbe&badge=0&autopause=0&player_id=0&app_id=58479" width="" height=""></iframe></div> <p> </p></div><h2>Your Role</h2> <p>We’re looking for an Engineer II to join our Platform squad working on one of Hudl’s most innovative products: <a href="https://www.hudl.com/en_gb/products/focus">next-generation, fully automated sports cameras</a>. These autonomous cameras use edge AI to automatically track the action and upload to the cloud, giving our customers seamless access to vital, real-time video and insights.</p> <p>The Platform squad builds the foundation our hardware teams rely on - the build systems, tooling, update pipeline and security processes that take our cameras from development through manufacturing and into the field. As we bring up our next-generation hardware platform, you’ll help shape how it’s built, tested, shipped and kept secure.</p> <p>As an Engineer II, you’ll:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Support our hardware squads.</strong> You’ll help hardware squads integrate their work into our CI/CD pipelines, so every change is built, tested and delivered reliably.</li> <li><strong>Build development tools.</strong> You’ll create and improve the tools our engineers use every day to build, flash, debug and test devices.</li> <li><strong>Keep our infrastructure running.</strong> You’ll maintain our CI/CD infrastructure, including the regression testing that runs in manufacturing.</li> <li><strong>Ship updates to the field.</strong> You’ll roll out software updates to our customers’ cameras safely and predictably.</li> <li><strong>Enable manufacturing.</strong> You’ll provide the tooling our contract manufacturers use to flash, provision and test devices on the production line.</li> <li><strong>Own the problem.</strong> You’ll work in an autonomous squad that has the freedom and expertise to deliver the best solution.</li> </ul> <h2>Location</h2> <p>Time spent collaborating with your teammates in-office will be a regular part of how you work. title: Microwave Design Engineer
description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION Work on a civilisation-scale problem - Clean, baseload fusion energy is one of the few genuinely world-changing challenges, and every hire in Finance, People, or Legal directly accelerates the path to a working stellarator. Grow as fast as the company does - With headcount set to roughly 5x in a few years and major technical milestones ahead on the path to our demo machine and first power plant, your role grows under you; today's hire is tomorrow's function lead. Tackle problems that don't exist elsewhere - Fusion sits at a rare intersection of deep-tech R&D, industrial procurement, government relations, and venture financing, so non-tech functions face challenges no other workplace can offer. YOUR IMPACT As a microwave design engineer, you will help build the basis for the millimeter wave hardware acting as the spark plug that initiates a fusion plasma and raises its temperature to greater than 100 million degrees. You’ll join the Alpha Heating System team ready to drive the integrated RF and thermo-mechanical design of high-power components, and help build and test these components in the lab before installing them at scale on our net scientific gain Alpha stellarator. WHAT YOU WILL DO Provide innovative solutions to complex RF engineering challenges by collaborating closely with physicists to ensure component designs meet the Alpha plasma physics and thermal-mechanical constraints. Develop designs and evaluate vendor designs to determine an optimal path to efficiently deliver our power to the stellarator - driving down the denominator of input power that will limit fusion power plant gain Q=Pout/Pin - and drive down costs. Draw from and contribute to our stellarator development process, interfacing your RF components with other stellarator systems. Contribute to mechanical and thermal analysis and sensitivity studies for component viability under the loads and stresses imposed by the combination of vacuum, magnetic fields, temperatures, and MW-scale RF loads. Interface with the Alpha project management teams to realize the delivery of RF components and meet the tight Proxima timelines. WHO YOU ARE A highly capable RF engineer with experience in millimeter waves and knowledge of the tools and best practices for design of these systems Demonstrated familiarly with RF modeling codes - SURF3D, CST, COMSOL, GdfidL, openEMS, even self-developed python codes or ones plasma physics community hasn’t heard of - capable of performing modeling at 200 GHz frequencies Experience validating first-of-a-kind designs with uncertain performance, working as part of a team on multi-scale and multi-physics simulations, testing, and prototyping. Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly and persuasively. Experience with gyrotrons and associated components - transmission systems, launcher antennas, rf loads; experience with plasma physics is a plus. Understanding of quasi optical propagation of millimeter waves; ray tracing and where it breaks down INTERVIEW PROCESS Recruiter Interview (30-60 min) Technical Screening (30 min) Technical Panel (3x60 min) *This role sits at "L2-L3" of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. En tant que Forward Deployed Engineer, tu n'es pas dans un laboratoire : tu es notre force de frappe déployée au cœur du SI de nos clients. chez SFEIR, tu incarnes l'Architecte qui transforme l'ambiguïté technologique en impact métier. SFEIR en 30 secondes 950 consultants passionnés par la tech et augmentés par l'IA 8 agences en France, au Luxembourg et à Bruxelles Partenaire Anthropic Preferred (+200 certifiés) 15 ans de partenariat Google Cloud + AWS, Scaleway, S3NS, Databricks, Snowflake, Confluent, DBT +90 clients actifs et +5 000 personnes formées par an via SFEIR Institute 150 certifiés Google Cloud, 30 Google Authorized Trainers, 7 Google Developer Experts Ta mission Déploiement & Immersion — intervenir directement chez nos clients pour transformer une intention stratégique en résultat mesurable. Orchestration Multi-Agents — concevoir et intégrer des systèmes autonomes avancés (protocole MCP, RAG, function calling). Évaluation & Sécurité — construire des frameworks d'évaluation pour des systèmes non déterministes et garantir la sécurité FinOps IA & ROI — optimiser le compromis entre performance, latence et coût d'inférence. Capitalisation (Land → Expand → Abstract) — abstraire les solutions spécifiques développées chez le client en patterns réutilisables pour le reste de l'entreprise. Ton terrain de jeu Stack : Python, LangChain / LangGraph, Anthropic (Claude) / Vertex AI, outils MLOps (LangSmith, Langfuse), Docker, CI/CD. Tes outils au quotidien : Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot. Notre partenariat Anthropic te donne accès aux outils et certifications avant tout le monde. Des projets qui sortent : APIs GenAI unifiées, plateformes d'agents d'entreprise déployées chez nos clients au cœur de leur SI. Du concret, pas des PoC qui finissent au placard. Ce qu'on cherche chez toi Les incontournables : 4 ans minimum d’expérience Une expérience concrète de déploiement de systèmes intégrant des agents IA en production. Le mindset : Impact & Pragmatisme : tu as le sens du contexte client, tu sais vulgariser face à des interlocuteurs métiers ou exécutifs. Gouvernance & Rigueur : tu refuses un code non explicable par un agent, tu encadres l'autonomie de l'IA selon le niveau de risque métier. L'esprit 10x : tu automatises systématiquement les tâches à faible valeur pour te concentrer sur l'architecture et les problèmes complexes. Ton évolution Une trajectoire au choix : Staff Engineer / Principal Engineer ou Engineering Manager SFEIR Institute & C4E : formation continue et certifications (Claude Code, Dev Augmenté, Google Cloud) Le programme AI Champions : 6 mois pour rejoindre notre cercle d'ambassadeurs IA et propulser ton impact, en interne comme en externe Prêt(e) à devenir un(e) Sfeirian 10x ? title: AI Software Engineer (F/H/NB)
description: SFEIR est un cabinet d'expertise technologique spécialisé dans la conception, l'architecture et l'industrialisation de solutions numériques sur-mesure. Nous accompagnons les organisations dans leurs transformations les plus complexes en combinant la rigueur du Software Craftsmanship avec la maîtrise des technologies d'avenir. Convaincus que la souveraineté numérique est un enjeu stratégique majeur, nous concevons des architectures sécurisées, performantes et indépendantes, portées par des partenariats solides avec des acteurs clés comme SENS et Scaleway. Acteur de référence sur l'intelligence artificielle, nous faisons évoluer les standards d'ingénierie modernes. À travers notre plateforme GenAI RAISE et notre statut de partenaire Anthropic Preferred (au sein du Claude Partner Network), nous plaçons le Context Engineering et l'IA générative au cœur de nos pratiques. Nos chiffres clés : 950 consultants passionnés par la tech et augmentés par l’IA. 8 agences en France, au Luxembourg et en Belgique. Partenaire Anthropic Select au sein du Claude Partner Network. 15 ans de partenariat avec Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Databricks, Confluent... +5000 personnes formées par an via le SFEIR Institute. Rejoindre SFEIR, c'est intégrer un collectif où la culture technique prévaut. Nous offrons des trajectoires de carrière dédiées aux experts (Individual Contributor / IC), te permettant de progresser en haute maîtrise technique sans devoir basculer vers du management organisationnel. Nous intégrons l'IA à nos propres pratiques d'ingénierie (utilisation quotidienne de RAISE et Claude Code) pour automatiser les tâches à faible valeur ajoutée et concentrer nos efforts sur la conception d'architectures résilientes. ▪️ À propos du poste Tu conçois et déploies des agents IA et systèmes agentiques complets exécutant des processus métier de bout en bout : support client avancé, recherche multi-sources, opérations IT, ainsi que des cas d'usage avancés liés à l'industrie du futur et à la continuité digitale (ex. traçabilité des exigences, maintenance prédictive, continuité de l'ingénierie et jumeaux numériques). Tu sais aussi bien développer des agents sur-mesure en code que configurer des agents via des plateformes low-code/no-code avec des plateformes type Gemini Enterprise. Ton terrain d'action combine maîtrise technique du cycle de vie logiciel (SDLC) et compréhension fonctionnelle fine des enjeux métiers. Tu orchestres l'autonomie des agents, la planification, le choix des outils et la mémoire, tout en garantissant la fiabilité, la gouvernance et le respect des garde-fous. Les missions : Analyser et appréhender les besoins et processus métiers avec une vision fonctionnelle claire pour définir les cas d'usage d'automatisation et la répartition des tâches (autonomie agentique vs validation humaine). Concevoir et développer des systèmes agentiques complets (mono ou multi-agents), en choisissant l'approche adaptée : développement sur-mesure ou programmation/configuration d'agents low-code/no-code (Gemini Enterprise, Vertex AI Agent Builder, AWS). Construire les outils des agents : function calling, intégration d’API et de systèmes d’information, création et consommation de serveurs MCP, workflows asynchrones et longue durée. Maîtriser la fiabilité : gestion des erreurs et des reprises, boucles de contrôle, limites de budget et de pas, comportement face à l’imprévu. Évaluer les agents : jeux de scénarios, analyse des trajectoires, taux de réussite des tâches, LLM-as-judge, tests de non-régression à chaque changement de prompt, d’outil ou de modèle. Observer en production : traces détaillées, coûts par tâche, détection des dérives et des boucles, tableaux de bord. Sécuriser l’autonomie : permissions minimales sur les outils, protection contre la prompt injection, isolation des actions sensibles, validation humaine, traçabilité, conformité (RGPD, AI Act). S'intégrer dans le cycle de vie logiciel (SDLC) complet et déployer sur le cloud (Google Cloud / Vertex AI) avec intégration CI/CD et gestion des coûts. Partager : documenter les patterns, former les équipes clientes, contribuer aux publications et événements SFEIR. ▪️ Le profil idéal 5 ans d’expérience en développement logiciel (hors stage et alternance) avec une vision transverse du SDLC et une première expérience solide sur des projets LLM / IA Pratique démontrée de la création d'agents IA : développement custom (frameworks/code) ou création via des environnements low-code/no-code (Gemini Enterprise, AWS,...) Connaissance de MCP et des protocoles d’interopérabilité entre agents (A2A) Compréhension fine des modes d’échec des agents : dérive, boucles, mauvais choix d’outil, perte de contexte Solide maîtrise des API, de l’asynchrone et des architectures événementielles Rigueur d’ingénierie : tests, observabilité, code relu Aisance relationnelle et bon niveau fonctionnel pour échanger avec les équipes métiers, comprendre leurs enjeux et leur expliquer les possibilités et limites des agents IA Un plus Expérience d’évaluation d’agents et d’observabilité (OpenTelemetry, Langfuse…) Connaissance de la méthodologie BMAD Google Cloud (Vertex AI, Cloud Run, Gemini), Sensibilité sécurité : modèles de menaces sur les agents, gestion des identités et des permissions Notions de RAG, vues comme un outil de l’agent Contributions open source, side projects agentiques, talks ▪️ L'ancrage Bordelais L'agence SFEIR Bordeaux regroupe une quinzaine d'ingénieurs et d'architectes seniors. Tu y trouveras la proximité et l'agilité d'une structure à taille humaine, adossée à la solidité d'un grand groupe. Tu participes activement à l'écosystème tech local (meetups, conférences BDX/IO, SFEIR Talks) et tu peux intégrer le programme AI Champions pour piloter la R&D de l'agence. ▪️ Tes conditions de travail Organisation : 2 à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine. Équipement : Laptop haut de gamme au choix (MacBook Pro ou Dell Precision dernière génération). Package : Rémunération fixe attractive, prime de vacances, accord d'intéressement, forfait mobilités durables, mutuelle et titres-restaurant. ▪️ Le processus de recrutement Échange RH : Alignement sur ton parcours, tes attentes et les opportunités SFEIR. Session Technique ("PlayOffs") : Évaluation pratique en pair-programming (Algo et GenAI) avec deux Sfeirians. Échange Métier & Projection : Discussion approfondie sur les cas d'usage, les missions cibles et le contexte client à Bordeaux Entretien Final : Échange stratégique avec le Directeur d'Agence. title: Senior Systems Engineer
description: At CesiumAstro , we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team. We are looking to add a Senior Systems Engineer to our team in Munich Germany. If you enjoy working in a startup environment and are passionate about developing leading-edge phased array antennas and radios for satellites, spacecraft, and aerospace systems, we would like to hear from you. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in systems engineering, experience in space technology, and the ability to be the technical point of contact for our communication programs. In this position, you will lead the development of communication system architectures, operational concepts, requirements, and system-level performance analysis for advanced communication terminals and networks. You will coordinate activities across multidisciplinary engineering teams, raise issues at the program level, and drive complex programs to success. The successful candidate will communicate effectively with team members and internal stakeholders, both verbally and through written content. SUMMARY OF RESPONSIBILITIES Evaluate customer and operational needs to define requirements, integrate technical parameters, and assure compatibility of all physical, functional, and program interfaces. Represent CesiumAstro in customer meetings, design reviews, and technical discussions across Europe. Define and validate space system requirements and interfaces, ensuring end-to-end feasibility. Develop and direct technical concept development in support of proposals and demonstrations. Participate in developing system engineering processes for requirements management, flow-down, and traceability. Lead sys tem-level trade studies, including antenna architecture design, modem design, performance analysis and system level integration Coordinate with RF/Antenna, Electrical, and Software/FPGA engineers to ensure concept feasibility and compliance. Support proposal development, design reviews, and technical documentation. JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS M.S. or higher in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related field. 5+ years of experience in system engineering for communications payloads, RF systems, or space/defense platforms. Very strong background in communication theory. Practical experience working with antenna systems (design, integration, or performance evaluation). Experience with and understanding of satellite-communications standards (e.g., NR NTN, DVB-S2x, CCSDS). Proven ability to capture and manage requirements across multidisciplinary teams. Excellent communication skills; comfortable presenting to customers and leading design reviews. Fluent in English (German language skills a plus). Deep understanding of RF concepts, impairments, and their impacts on system performance. WHAT WE OFFER The opportunity to help establish CesiumAstro’s first European office and grow our Munich team. High-impact role with direct exposure to leading EU space programs. Competitive compensation and benefits package. A collaborative, innovative environment shaping the future of space communications. CesiumAstro considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, education/training, and key skills. Please be aware that many roles will be subject to both security and export control restrictions. These restrictions mean that factors including new starter’s nationality, any previous or dual nationalities held, place of birth and country of residence may limit those roles that you can perform for the organization. Please note: CesiumAstro does not accept unsolicited resumes from contract agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to our website or to CesiumAstro team members not through our approved vendor list or Talent Acquisition will be considered property of CesiumAstro, and we will not be obligated to pay any referral fees. title: Senior Sales Support Technician
description: At CesiumAstro , we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team. We are looking to add a Senior Sales Support Technician to our team. In this position, you will support the preparation, setup, and execution of aerospace communications demonstrations, field tests, and customer engagement activities. Working closely with the Sales Consultant and engineering teams, this role assists in deploying and operating satellite communication systems, RF hardware, ground station equipment, and related technologies used to demonstrate product capabilities to prospective customers and partners. This position plays an important role in supporting technical demonstrations, validating system performance in real-world environments, and ensuring equipment and systems are properly configured for successful customer engagements. The Communications Technician will also support equipment maintenance, test preparation, and troubleshooting activities while helping translate technical system capabilities into successful customer demonstration experiences. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Support the preparation, setup, and operation of aerospace communication systems used in customer demonstrations and technical presentations. Assist with deployment and configuration of ground station equipment, antennas, RF systems, satellite communication terminals, and related hardware. Participate in field demonstrations, trade shows, and customer engagement events to help showcase system capabilities. Work closely with Sales Consultants and technical teams to ensure demonstrations accurately represent system performance and capabilities. Prepare and configure communications equipment, hardware, and software prior to customer demonstrations or test activities. Assist in validating system performance and verifying that equipment is operating correctly prior to demonstrations. Support integration and connectivity between ground systems, communication payloads, software tools, and network infrastructure. Maintain demonstration equipment, test hardware, and supporting tools to ensure readiness for field use. Assist with diagnosing and resolving technical issues during demonstration activities or system testing. Provide hands-on support for RF systems, communication equipment, network connectivity, and hardware integration. Coordinate with engineering teams to address system issues or performance anomalies discovered during demonstrations or testing. Manage inventory, transport, and preparation of demonstration equipment used for customer engagements. Ensure proper handling, packaging, and transport of sensitive technical equipment. Support logistics planning for field deployments, including shipping, equipment preparation, and setup coordination. Support Sales Consultants during technical discussions with customers by assisting with equipment setup and system operation. Help demonstrate system functionality and capabilities during live customer demonstrations. Assist in documenting demonstration results and gathering feedback to support future product improvements. Work closely with engineering, operations, and business development teams to ensure demonstration environments accurately reflect product capabilities. Provide feedback to engineering teams regarding demonstration performance, usability, and potential improvements. Support internal testing and validation activities when demonstrations require integration with engineering prototypes or development systems. JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS Associate degree or technical certification in Electronics, Communications Technology, Telecommunications, or related field A minimum of 5 years of industry experience in engineering, systems development, or program/project management roles within aerospace, space, or defense industries. Experience managing cross-functional engineering and operations teams in complex technical programs. Basic understanding of RF communications, satellite communications, or wireless communication systems. Ability to set up and operate technical equipment used in communications demonstrations or testing environments. Familiarity with antennas, ground station equipment, or network connectivity systems preferred. Strong troubleshooting and hands-on technical problem-solving abilities. Strong organizational and time management skills. Ability to work collaboratively with both technical teams and customer-facing personnel. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE Proficiency in German and English (both written and spoken). Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team. Knowledge of market analytics and technology planning and commercialization. Experience with the aerospace telecommunications industry. Experience with startups. title: Senior RF Engineer
description: At CesiumAstro , we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team. We are looking to add a Senior RF Hardware Engineer to our team. If you are great at what you do, enjoy working in a startup environment, and are passionate about developing leading-edge electronics for satellites, spacecraft, and aerospace systems, we would like to hear from you. At the Senior II level, you will be tasked with full-stack hardware development for complex modules and small systems. You will have the opportunity to start at concept development and progress through detailed design, analysis, layout, build, test, and delivery, doing hands-on work at each phase. The Senior II level also introduces technical leadership opportunities, gaining responsibility for small teams of hardware engineers developing new products and systems. At a small company and a startup, your work will make direct contributions to the success of the business. The work is challenging and impactful, requiring both breadth and depth of technical knowledge. Our products are made for high-reliability space and airborne applications, so designs require high levels of technical rigor while maintaining the agility of a startup environment. The successful candidate will also present engineering design review materials to our customers and executive team. As such, excellent written and verbal communication skills are required. SUMMARY OF RESPONSIBILITIES Design and develop RF, mixed-signal, and digital hardware for electronically steered antenna (AESA) communication systems. Support the adaptation of existing hardware designs for new customer platforms, operational environments, and regional requirements. Develop RF front-end, power distribution, control, and interface circuitry for phased-array communication terminals. Own the development of hardware modules and subsystems from requirements through schematic capture, layout, integration, verification, and production release. Develop hardware requirements, perform trade studies, and support subsystem architecture development. Perform detailed schematic design for complex RF, mixed-signal, and high-speed digital circuit boards. Support PCB layout activities in Altium Designer, including stack-up definition, component placement, routing reviews, and design-for-manufacturing considerations. Perform engineering analyses including worst-case circuit analysis, signal integrity, power integrity, thermal, and reliability assessments. Develop and execute hardware bring-up, integration, debugging, and design verification activities. Support RF characterization, system integration, troubleshooting, and root-cause investigations using laboratory test equipment. Define and execute environmental, qualification, and compliance testing activities, including EMI/EMC verification. Collaborate closely with all the relevant engineering teams throughout the product lifecycle. Support technical design reviews, engineering documentation, requirements traceability, and customer-facing technical activities. Contribute to product qualification, certification, manufacturing transfer, and production support activities. Provide technical support for field trials, demonstrations, customer evaluations, and deployment activities. Mentor junior engineers and technicians while promoting engineering best practices and technical rigor. Apply knowledge of adjacent disciplines, including software, systems, RF, and mechanical engineering, to support efficient product development and integration. JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor of Science (BS) degree or higher in Electrical Engineering from an accredited university. Minimum of 6 years of relevant experience in board-level electronics design, analysis, and test. Direct experience designing high-reliability electronics for space or defense applications, including part derating, worst-case analysis, and thermal constraints. Experience owning the design phase of complex board-level electronics, including trade studies, key part selection, and detailed design. Experience delivering hardware designs through production and deployment. Expertise in PCB layout, including high-density interconnect (HDI) stackup design and high-speed routing. Experience running board-level signal integrity and/or power integrity simulation tools such as Ansys SIwave, ADS SIPro, or Mentor Hyperlynx.
