title: Senior Product Designer
description: Do you think in journeys, not just screens? Can you see where a learner gets stuck, where a buyer needs proof of value, and where an upgrade feels like a natural next step rather than a sales pitch? And do you want to be the person who sets the design direction for a whole product, not one corner of it? AIHR is looking for a Senior Product Designer to be the sole designer on our product team. You'll shape our learning platform end to end: how HR professionals discover content and keep learning, how teams see the value of learning, and how our design system helps everyone build consistently and fast. You'll work across both product squads as a hands-on designer and the team’s go-to for design advice. About AIHR Founded in 2016 with the mission to future-proof HR, the Academy to Innovate HR (AIHR) has become the world’s market leader in online training for human resources (HR) professionals. We have a global customer base spread across 140+ countries, amongst which companies like Unilever, Reckitt, Goldman Sachs, Philips, Deloitte, Nike, Heineken, and UBS. It is our goal to continuously upskill and empower 1,000,000 HR Professionals. We are an international team of 100+ people, driven by excellence, innovation, and a hunger to grow in everything we do. As such, we strive to provide the world’s best courses and excellent support to our customers while continuously optimizing every aspect of our work. With over 30 nationalities, our team is diverse, yet we all share a few traits: we're friendly, enthusiastic, and great team players. Being a fast-growing company, working at AIHR means taking on a lot of responsibility and getting countless opportunities to develop yourself in new areas and potential to craft your own role. Why a designer now We built the AIHR Academy for individual HR professionals who choose to learn on their own. That focus got us here. Now we're at a pivotal point: we're taking the full learning experience, our internal expertise and our content into the B2B market. That shift opens the platform to new personas with different needs. A learner whose employer provides their license comes in with different motivations than someone who paid for themselves. And a manager or buyer needs to see team progress, skill gaps and return on investment before they renew. Much of today's experience wasn't designed with them in mind. Role and Responsibilities As our Senior Product Designer , you own the user experience across the AIHR Academy, from how learners discover content to how buyers decide whether to renew. You represent the user in every product conversation and help the team make better decisions, faster. You report to the Head of Product and work daily with our Learner Experience and Manager Experience Squads, their Product Managers, front-end engineers and our Learning Consultants. PMs already prototype with AI tools, and you’ll help them do that well within the guardrails you set. Journeys and engagement Map and design end-to-end journeys for each persona, from first visit to long-term learning habit. Shape how learners discover content and keep coming back. You know which engagement mechanics, like progress, milestones and social learning, suit busy professionals and which feel gimmicky. Propose ideas quickly, test them pragmatically and learn from the data. Growth surfaces Design the moments where members and B2B customers upgrade and renew, as part of the wider journey rather than as standalone funnels. Tread the line between commercial goals and product quality. You know when an upgrade moment helps someone see more value and when it costs trust, and you bring a clear way of making that call that the team can learn from. Craft and UI ownership You don't stop at concepts. You turn decisions into clear, high-fidelity work in Figma, so engineers can build with confidence. During implementation, you're the go-to partner for front-end engineers and co-own the UI with them. You bring the cases and the fidelity, they bring the constraints and the shipping, and you resolve gaps together until what's live matches the intent. Design system and enablement Own our design system. You keep it up to date, audit it regularly across the product and turn what you find into your own improvement ideas and a prioritized plan. Set the bar and the guardrails that others build within. You raise the standard of the whole system, not just individual screens, and make it easy for others to prototype with. How you work You're a partner to Product Managers. You help define problems, challenge assumptions and bring the user's perspective into every decision. You stay with the work after a design is approved. You assess feasibility with engineers early, adapt designs when constraints appear and bring the trade-offs back to Product for a decision. You know where your time matters most. You can easily see when a journey needs a deep dive, when a quick sketch will do and when the right move is feedback on someone else's prototype rather than a redesign. On a typical week On Monday morning, you join the Product Weekly for a rundown of the week's priorities. Silvia shares the outcomes of the latest leadership quarterly meeting, and how this impacts product priorities. In the afternoon, you review a prototype from Alice, PM of the Learner Experience Squad, for a new upgrade flow that moves AI for HR Academy users to a Team Access license. You check whether the upgrade prompt comes after users have seen enough value, and you propose a few changes to the PRD to ensure the proper UX guardrails are applied throughout the experience. On Wednesday morning, you lead a cross-functional brainstorm with Marion, PM of the Manager Experience Squad, and our Learning Consultants. You first share your prototype for feedback, and together you work out how to help buyers identify their team's skill gaps and build tailored learning journeys themselves. In the afternoon, you join the Learner Experience Squad's refinement to get feedback on the technical feasibility of a new bootcamp design. Based on what you hear, you set up a follow-up with the engineers, including Aliia, Front-End Engineer, to dig into the details. On Friday, you review the pages the team shipped over the past month. You find inconsistencies in some components across pages, create a ticket to fix them in the design system and update the prototyping skill so PMs build with the latest version. Then you join the monthly business update, where the founders share the previous month's results with everyone, and end the week with drinks at our weekly team activity, a chance to unwind and get to know colleagues who recently joined. We offer A key role in shaping the learning experience for tens of thousands of HR professionals worldwide, bridging the gap between user experience and world-class visual execution; Competitive, benchmarked compensation; The opportunity to shape your own day-to-day work; Regular growth talks and support to reach your career goals; Flexible working hours & working from home arrangements A high degree of autonomy in a vibrant, result-driven, inclusive, and international team; A key role in a fast-growing scale-up company; A beautiful office right across Rotterdam Central Station (Milleniumtower) and a brand new office in Amsterdam; 26 paid holidays per year + 1 extra day for the first 5 years you work here Exchange any 2 public holiday days for 2 other days of your choice; Work from anywhere policy, where you can work abroad for 20 days in a calendar year; Pension plan; 5 Mental health days per year; Access to OpenUp mental health platform; Personal development budget, training, and we pay for the books you read; All public transport expenses covered (NS Business Card); MacBook + all other equipment you need to do your work; Daily lunch prepared by a chef, weekly drinks, and fun team activities; Free access to the office gym. Apply for the job Are you excited to become our Senior Product Designer ? Then we'd love to hear from you! We are looking to hire for this role as soon as we find an eligible candidate. P.S. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women tend to apply only when they meet 100% of them. So if you think you have what it takes, but don't necessarily meet every single point above, please still apply. We'd love to consider you and see if you could be a great fit. Who you are You're a senior product designer who thinks in journeys, enjoys wearing multiple hats and gets energy from being the team's go-to, hands-on designer and the team’s go-to for design advice. You could be our ideal candidate if: You have at least 5 years of experience as a product designer in B2B SaaS, preferably in elearning, content platforms, or HR tech. You’ve been the sole or lead designer before, so you know how to hold a high quality bar without a design team around you. You've designed products that work seamlessly for several different personas . You've designed engagement and growth moments that work for users and the business, and you can explain how you decided where to draw the line. You think about the whole journey, not just conversion. You take a pragmatic approach to research and behavioral design. You know when a quick test is enough and when a decision needs deeper evidence. You've owned a design system and have the taste to keep raising its standard. You use Figma as your primary craft tool and AI daily to shape your and the team’s workflow. You enjoy turning ideas into build-ready mockups and helping others do the same. You see feedback as a way to improve the work , hold your ground with data and principles, and change course when the evidence says so. You're fluent in English and able to work from our Rotterdam office at least 2 days a week. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Je zoekt niet-herkende ontvangsten en niet-gematchte betalingen uit en helpt ze oplossen. Je boekt en verwerkt dagelijks bankafschriften in Exact, voor meerdere bankrekeningen en entiteiten (inkomend en uitgaand). Je matcht klantontvangsten en leveranciersbetalingen aan de juiste facturen. Je helpt bij bankreconciliaties en spoort verschillen op tussen bankafschriften en de administratie. Je denkt mee over verbeteringen om het toewijzen en afletteren efficiënter te maken. Je bent nauwkeurig en analytisch ingesteld en werkt makkelijk met Excel en grotere datasets. Je beheerst het Nederlands en Engels goed, in woord en geschrift. Wat kun je van ons verwachten? title: Senior R&D Engineer Trainingssystemen (m/v/x)
description: Ben jij een ervaren bèta-academische professional die klaar is voor een nieuwe uitdaging? Wil je bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van 's werelds meest innovatieve simulatie- en trainingssystemen binnen de militaire (en civiele) luchtvaartwereld? Wil jij je technische kennis en ervaring inzetten voor het initiëren en realiseren van complexe, multidisciplinaire projecten in een high-tech omgeving? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou! Wat ga je doen? Als senior R&D Engineer Trainingssystemen richt je je op het initiëren en realiseren van innovatieve, multidisciplinaire ontwikkelingen en het opzetten, uitvoeren en managen van grote, complexe projecten. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het leiden van projectteams, het adviseren van klanten en het opbouwen en onderhouden van een extern nationaal en internationaal relatienetwerk. Je werkt samen met collega's uit andere teams aan diverse soorten projecten die hoogwaardige technologische simulatie- en trainingsoplossingen leveren aan eindgebruikers in de luchtvaartoperatie. Je hebt frequent contact en interactieve werksessies met hen om tot grensverleggende totaaloplossingen te kunnen komen. Jouw enthousiasme en de wil om je te verdiepen in de operationele wereld van deze gebruikers is daarbij een must. Dat doe je niet enkel vanaf je bureau maar ook bij de operationele gebruikers op locatie, en regelmatig samen met industrie en kennispartners wereldwijd! Wat breng je mee? Een afgeronde WO-opleiding in Informatica, Lucht- en Ruimtevaarttechniek, Technische Natuurkunde, Werktuigbouwkunde of vergelijkbare studierichting; Ruime (>10 jaar) werkervaring in een technische of wetenschappelijke discipline, met een focus op simulatie, training of een verwant gebied, zoals luchtvaart, ruimtevaart, defensie of andere industrieën waarin complexe systemen en processen worden gesimuleerd. Door jou vrijheid en eigen verantwoordelijkheid te geven, ben jij het best in staat om tot baanbrekende innovaties te komen. Wil jij jezelf vakinhoudelijk én op persoonlijk vlak ontwikkelen? Naast dit alles bieden wij jou: Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 5400 en €7100 (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek) , afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring; 45 verlofdagen (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek); 8% vakantiegeld én een vaste eindejaarsuitkering van 8%; De kosten voor reizen met het openbaar vervoer worden volledig vergoed. Een tegemoetkoming in jouw zorgkosten; Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof; De mogelijkheid om jezelf te ontwikkelen met opleidingen en cursussen die passen bij jouw ambities. Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving Bij de afdeling Training & Simulatie werken experts op het gebied van simulatie, informatica, opleiding en training, kunstmatige intelligentie, psychologie, en lucht- en ruimtevaart. Het team waarin je terecht komt is het team Trainingssystemen. We zijn expert op het gebied van de volledige life-cycle van simulatiemiddelen – van verwerving, tot ontwerp en ontwikkeling, tot VV&A en kwalificatie, tot uiteindelijke operatie – gedreven vanuit een diepgaande kennis van M&S-technologie en –gebruik in combinatie met operationele expertise en klantdomeinkennis. Vanuit die drijfveer maken wij de wereld van lucht- en ruimtevaart veiliger, duurzamer, efficiënter en effectiever en staan wij voor baanbrekende innovaties. title: Projektleiter/in Automation 80 - 100 %
description: Im Auftrag unseres Kunden glaus personal suchen wir eine/n Projektleiter/in Automation 80 - 100 % Sie verstehen Technik nicht nur auf dem Papier, sondern möchten Anlagen von der ersten Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Inbetriebnahme begleiten? title: Business Development Manager
description: Grosse Veränderungen beginnen mit Menschen, die mehr erreichen wollen. Wie kommen Mitarbeitende zur Arbeit? Warum stehen Firmenautos ungenutzt herum, während Parkplätze knapp sind? Und wie wird nachhaltige Mobilität zur attraktivsten Wahl? Bei Urban Connect machen wir aus diesen Herausforderungen konkrete Lösungen. Wir verbinden geteilte E-Bikes und Firmenautos, öffentliche Verkehrsmittel, Mobilitätsbudgets und digitales Parkplatzmanagement auf einer Plattform. Damit helfen wir Unternehmen, Kosten zu senken, Ressourcen besser zu nutzen und ihren Mitarbeitenden mehr Freiheit zu geben. Unternehmen wie Roche, Google, SWISS und Lonza setzen bereits auf uns. Unser Anspruch geht weiter: Wir wollen die Art verändern, wie Unternehmen Mobilität organisieren. Und wir bieten das Betriebssystem, das dies möglich macht. Um diese Vision zu verwirklichen, suchen wir eine neugierige, unternehmerisch denkende Persönlichkeit, die Verantwortung übernimmt, Energie und gutes Urteilsvermögen mitbringt und mit uns das Unternehmen und die Mobilitätsbranche voranbringen möchte. Deine Rolle: echte Verantwortung, spürbare Wirkung Du möchtest ein Unternehmen mitgestalten, anspruchsvolle Probleme lösen und sehen, was deine Arbeit bewirkt. Als Business Development Manager arbeitest du eng mit unserem Sales- und Account-Management-Team sowie mit Product, Technology und Operations zusammen. Du entwickelst aus Kundenbedürfnissen, Daten und Marktkenntnissen überzeugende Mobilitätslösungen und konkrete Wachstumschancen. Du verantwortest Projekte, bringst eigene Ideen ein und treibst ihre Umsetzung voran. Wir erwarten, dass du von Anfang an durchdachte Fragen stellst, erkennst, wo du einen Beitrag leisten kannst, und ins Handeln kommst. Dabei unterstützen dich Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die wollen, dass du erfolgreich bist. Was du bei uns bewegst Aus Daten Chancen machen: Du analysierst Nutzungs- und Marktdaten, etwa zur Auslastung von Fahrzeugen und Parkplätzen, und entwickelst daraus umsetzbare Empfehlungen für bessere betriebliche Mobilitätslösungen. Eigene Projekte vorantreiben: Du verantwortest Projekte wie Produktanalysen, die Bewertung von Geschäftschancen und die Entwicklung betrieblicher Mobilitätskonzepte. Du definierst nächste Schritte, bringst die richtigen Menschen zusammen und erzielst Ergebnisse. Das Produkt verstehen: Du entwickelst ein praxisnahes Verständnis unserer Plattform, der Kundeneinrichtung, Buchungen, Abrechnungen und Integrationen. So gestaltest du Lösungen mit, die wirtschaftlich und operativ funktionieren. Mit KI besser arbeiten: Du setzt KI-Tools gezielt ein, testest neue Anwendungen und verbesserst die Qualität und Effizienz unserer Recherchen, Analysen und Prozesse. Wachstum vorantreiben: Du identifizierst potenzielle Kunden, verstehst ihre Herausforderungen und arbeitest mit dem Commercial-Team daran, neue Kunden zu gewinnen und bestehende Partnerschaften auszubauen. Überzeugend argumentieren: Du erstellst klare Präsentationen, fundierte Business Cases, überzeugende Angebote und aussagekräftige Kundenreviews, die den Mehrwert unserer Lösungen sichtbar machen. Für Fortschritt sorgen: Du setzt klare Prioritäten und hältst Kundeninformationen und nächste Schritte in HubSpot aktuell. Du hältst Zusagen ein und gehst Hindernisse frühzeitig an. Teams verbinden: Du klärst technische und kommerzielle Fragen gemeinsam mit Product, Operations und Technology und leitest daraus verständliche Empfehlungen für Kunden und das Team ab. Den Status quo hinterfragen: Du erkennst Verbesserungspotenzial, hinterfragst Annahmen und machst aus kreativen Ideen konkrete Verbesserungen. Was du mitbringst Einen sehr guten akademischen Leistungsausweis, beispielsweise in Betriebswirtschaft, Volkswirtschaft, Data Science oder Ingenieurwissenschaften. Wissbegierde, Kreativität und nachweisbare Leistungen sind uns wichtiger als eine bestimmte Studienrichtung. Relevante praktische Erfahrung im Business Development, in der Beratung, in einem Technologieunternehmen oder im unternehmerischen Umfeld. Du kannst zeigen, welche Projekte du verantwortet und welche Ergebnisse du erzielt hast. Analytisches Denkvermögen, einen sicheren Umgang mit Excel und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Ideen und Zusammenhänge zu verstehen und klar und einfach zu erklären. Grosses Interesse an der Mobilität der nächsten Generation und an den Technologien, Geschäftsmodellen und Verhaltensänderungen, die die Branche prägen. Idealerweise kennst du die betriebliche Mobilitätslandschaft bereits und hast Ideen, wie sie sich verbessern lässt. Gutes Urteilsvermögen: Du kannst Zielkonflikte abwägen, Wesentliches priorisieren und vorankommen, ohne auf vollständige Informationen zu warten. Tatkraft und einen kreativen Zugang zur Problemlösung. Du entwickelst Vorschläge, überprüfst Annahmen und findest Wege, Dinge voranzubringen. Technologieaffinität und praktische Erfahrung mit KI-Tools wie ChatGPT, Claude oder Copilot sowie das Urteilsvermögen, deren Ergebnisse kritisch zu prüfen. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse. Französisch ist ein grosser Vorteil. Besonders wichtig ist uns deine Haltung. Du bringst Begeisterung, Ehrgeiz und eine lösungsorientierte Einstellung mit. Du lernst schnell, stellst durchdachte Fragen und übernimmst Verantwortung für Ergebnisse. Du achtest auf Details und suchst laufend nach Wegen, gute Arbeit noch besser zu machen. Du bist selbstbewusst genug, eine Idee zu hinterfragen, und offen genug, deine Meinung zu ändern. Die beste Lösung und der Erfolg des Teams sind dir wichtiger als persönliche Anerkennung. Du suchst Feedback, teilst dein Wissen und arbeitest gerne mit Menschen zusammen, die das genauso halten. Du probierst Neues aus, gehst bewusst Risiken ein und lernst aus Fehlern. Wenn du auf ein Problem stösst, ergreifst du die Initiative und beziehst andere ein, wenn es sinnvoll ist. Was dich bei uns erwartet Hohe Ansprüche – und kluge, herzliche Menschen, die dich fordern und weiterbringen. Wir arbeiten ambitioniert, geben direktes, konstruktives Feedback und unterstützen uns gegenseitig. Exzellenz zeigt sich bei uns im Alltag: in durchdachten Lösungen, sorgfältiger Umsetzung und dem Willen, kontinuierlich besser zu werden. Eine Rolle, die das ganze Unternehmen verbindet. Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von Vertrieb, Customer Success, Technologie und Operations und hilfst dabei, aus Ideen Lösungen zu machen, die Kunden schätzen. Verantwortung und Raum für Initiative. Gute Ideen finden bei uns schnell Gehör. Du übernimmst Verantwortung dafür, Dinge voranzubringen, kannst auf die Unterstützung des Teams zählen und gestaltest mit, wie wir arbeiten. Die Möglichkeit, mit Urban Connect zu wachsen. Mit deinen Ergebnissen und Fähigkeiten wächst auch dein Verantwortungsbereich. Du hast die Chance, die nächste Entwicklungsphase unseres Unternehmens mitzugestalten. Dazu kommen: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und ein schönes Büro in Zürich. Ein monatliches Mobilitätsbudget sowie Zugang zu unseren E-Bikes und geteilten E-Autos. Ein motiviertes Team, das gerne gemeinsam und überwiegend vor Ort arbeitet, Wissen teilt und Erfolge zusammen feiert. Bereit, etwas zu bewegen? Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar persönliche Zeilen: Warum Urban Connect? Was begeistert dich an der Zukunft der Mobilität? Und was hast du selbst in die Hand genommen und verbessert? Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Assigned Support Engineer-(Designated / Premier Support)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As an Assigned Support Engineer, you’ll be a trusted technical advisor to GitLab’s largest Self-managed, GitLab Dedicated, and GitLab.com customers, helping them avoid operational disruption and get the most from GitLab. You’ll combine deep Linux systems expertise, GitLab and CI/CD knowledge, and a proactive support mindset to understand each customer’s environment, anticipate and prevent issues, and solve complex technical and business challenges. In a typical week, you might be prioritizing strategic blockers with customer stakeholders, partnering with Product, Development, Infrastructure, Customer Success, and Sales to drive defect resolution and influence the roadmap, or diving into code, logs, and tools like strace to troubleshoot performance issues. Your impact in the first year will be measured by customer trust, reduced critical incidents, and clear, reusable support content that empowers customers and GitLab teams alike.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Provide technical support to our largest Self-managed, GitLab Dedicated, and GitLab.com customers, ensuring their GitLab environments remain stable and performant.</li> <li value="2">Troubleshoot and resolve complex, critical, and sensitive support issues using tools like Zendesk, logs, and Linux utilities such as strace, through email and video conferencing.</li> <li value="3">Build strong, proactive relationships with key customer stakeholders, helping them prioritize and address their most important technical blockers.</li> <li value="4">Collaborate with <a class="textLink" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/product/">Product</a>, <a class="textLink" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/development/">Development</a>, <a class="textLink" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/infrastructure/">Infrastructure</a>, <a class="textLink" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/customer-success/">Customer Success</a>, and <a class="textLink" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/sales/">Sales</a> teams to drive bug fixes, influence feature development, and help shape product goals and roadmap.</li> <li value="5">Act as a technical expert on GitLab and CI/CD implementations, advising customers on how incidents and service interruptions impact their workflows and how to mitigate them.</li> <li value="6">Create and improve support content, including documentation and knowledge articles, to help customers and GitLab team members resolve issues more efficiently.</li> <li value="7">Partner closely with Support Engineering team members through <a class="textLink" href="https://gitlab.com/gitlab-com/support/support-pairing/?_gl=1%2a1vj7usl%2a_ga%2aMTYyOTI0OTAxNC4xNjc4NzIwMDg0%2a_ga_ENFH3X7M5Y%2aMTY4NDgzNDU0OC4xMTAuMS4xNjg0ODM2NDM3LjAuMC4w">pairing sessions</a> and <a class="textLink" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/support/#support-stable-counterpart">stable counterpart</a> relationships to share knowledge and solve problems together.</li> <li value="8">Contribute to team growth by participating in hiring processes, including reviewing applications and assessments and joining interviews.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Background managing complex, customer facing support cases end to end, from initial inquiry and triage through reproduction, escalation, and resolution.</li> <li value="2">Advanced troubleshooting skills with the ability to investigate ambiguous, multi-layered technical issues and identify root causes across applications, infrastructure, and integrations.</li> <li value="3">Strong Linux systems administration knowledge (LFCE or RHCE equivalent), including performance analysis and low-level debugging tools.</li> <li value="4">Practical experience with GitLab and continuous integration / continuous delivery (CI/CD), including how different deployment models and outages affect customers.</li> <li value="5">Ability to write and maintain clear, reusable support content such as knowledge articles, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides.</li> <li value="6">Proficiency with scripting languages (such as Ruby or Bash) and familiarity with model-view-controller (MVC) frameworks, preferably Ruby on Rails.</li> <li value="7">Effective communication skills for explaining complex technical topics to audiences with varying technical backgrounds and for building rapport with customer stakeholders.</li> <li value="8">Familiarity with DevOps practices and technologies such as Kubernetes and serverless platforms, with openness to applying transferable skills from related domains.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The Support team is a fully distributed, global group across the AMER, EMEA, and APAC regions, focused on helping customers get the most from GitLab by troubleshooting complex issues and digging into code and logs to understand why something is not working as expected. title: Intern Power Electronics Engineer
description: With over 140 years of Swiss engineering heritage, Sécheron Hasler Group is a global leader in high-power electrical and electronic equipment. Our solutions power railways, renewable energy, DC and AC networks, and industrial systems worldwide trusted for their precision, reliability, and innovation. At the heart of modern rail infrastructure, our Traction Power Systems unit delivers cutting-edge DC and AC traction substations, protection systems, power conversion and digital monitoring solutions. Join us to shape the future of sustainable mobility with technology that keeps cities and countries moving. As an intern within our Traction Power Systems R&D team, you will support the development and validation of power electronic converters and control solutions used in railway and industrial applications. You will work alongside experienced engineers on innovative projects involving power conversion, control algorithms, testing, and system analysis. The internship has the duration of 6 months and is expected to start in January 2027, but if that is not the best for you, let us know your availability. Key responsibilities Support the design and analysis of power electronic converters. Assist in the development and validation of control algorithms. Participate in laboratory testing, measurements, and troubleshooting activities. Analyze simulation and test results and prepare technical reports. Contribute to continuous improvement and innovation projects within the team. Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams. Requirements Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Power Electronics, or a related field. Strong interest in power converters, control systems, and electrical energy conversion. Basic knowledge of power electronics and control theory. Familiarity with simulation tools such as MATLAB/Simulink or similar is an advantage. Curious, autonomous, and eager to learn in a hands-on engineering environment. Good communication skills in English. Benefits A challenging internship in an international engineering environment. Exposure to real-world power electronics and railway technology projects. Mentorship from experienced R&D engineers. Opportunity to develop practical skills in power conversion and control systems. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Erfahrener SAP Personalberater / Headhunter - Schwerpunkt Kandidatengewinnung
description: Die besten SAP-Spezialisten der Schweiz suchen keinen Job, sie wollen angesprochen werden. Für das «Who is Who» der Schweizer Wirtschaft finden, überzeugen und begleiten wir genau diese Menschen. VANGARD ist eine auf SAP spezialisierte Headhunting-Boutique mit dem Anspruch: Headhunting. Nicht Recruiting. Warum VANGARD, gerade jetzt Der Markt für Personaldienstleister ist unter Druck, viele Agenturen kämpfen. Wir stehen auf einem soliden Fundament: Seit 2012 sind wir im Schweizer SAP-Markt aktiv, haben bei über 400 SAP-Arbeitgebern platziert und sind in der SAP-Community bestens etabliert. Jährlich veröffentlichen wir das White Paper «SAP-Arbeitsmarkt Schweiz», mit Interviews von Branchenführern aus SAP-Beratung und Inhouse-Organisationen. Und dank unseres eigenen CRM-Systems vermessen und mappen wir den Schweizer SAP-Markt systematisch, wie kaum jemand sonst. Für dich heisst das: Du musst nicht jeden Monat bei null anfangen. Deine Rolle Du spürst Top-SAP-Spezialisten auf, für die sonst niemand einen Zugang findet. Du gewinnst ihr Vertrauen, verstehst ihre Ziele und begleitest sie bis zur Vertragsunterschrift und darüber hinaus. Unser Kandidatenpool mit tausenden Profilen, unsere gewachsenen Beziehungen und unser erprobtes Headhunting-Konzept geben dir vom ersten Tag an Rückenwind. Deine Aufgaben Kandidatengewinnung Systematisches Mapping des SAP-Markts: Wer arbeitet wo, in welchem Modul, mit welchem Erfahrungsprofil? Gezielte Direktansprache passiver SAP-Spezialisten über Telefon, Netzwerk, Empfehlungen und LinkedIn Aufspüren von Talenten, die auf keiner Jobbörse und oft nicht einmal auf LinkedIn sichtbar sind Kontinuierliche Pflege und Reaktivierung unseres Kandidatenpools Aufbau eines eigenen Netzwerks in der Schweizer SAP-Community, mit Empfehlungen als festem Bestandteil deiner Arbeit Qualifizierung und Präsentation Fundierte Interviews zur fachlichen und persönlichen Qualifizierung, von Modulwissen und Projekterfahrung bis zu Karrieremotivation und Wechselbereitschaft Ehrliche Einschätzung, welche Position wirklich passt, statt Kandidaten in die erstbeste Stelle zu schieben Betreuung durch den gesamten Prozess Persönliche Begleitung jedes Kandidaten als feste Ansprechperson, vom ersten Gespräch bis zum ersten Arbeitstag Individuelle Interviewvorbereitung, Gehaltsbenchmarks und ehrliches Feedback nach jedem Gespräch Begleitung durch Debriefings, Gehalts- und Vertragsverhandlungen Souveräner Umgang mit Gegenangeboten, Zweifeln und kritischen Momenten im Entscheidungsprozess Nachbetreuung nach dem Start, damit Platzierungen langfristig tragen und aus Kandidaten Botschafter werden Zusammenarbeit mit den Key Account Managern Projektarbeit in enger Abstimmung mit unseren Key Account Managern Bei Eignung Einbindung in die Kundengewinnung und -betreuung, etwa durch Teilnahme an Briefings und Kundenterminen Was du mitbringst Mindestens 4 Jahre Erfahrung in der SAP- oder IT-Personalberatung, idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt Direktansprache Einen nachweisbaren Track-Record im Gewinnen und Platzieren von Spezialisten, die nicht aktiv suchen Gutes Verständnis der SAP-Welt: Du weisst, was einen FI/CO-Berater von einem EWM-Spezialisten unterscheidet Die richtige Mischung aus Ausstrahlung und Hartnäckigkeit, am Telefon wie im persönlichen Gespräch Eine Art, die Menschen öffnet: Kandidaten rufen dich zurück, weil sie gerne mit dir sprechen, und hören dir auch nach dem dritten Nein noch zu Humor, Drive und die Gelassenheit, auch in hektischen Phasen den richtigen Ton zu treffen Stilsicheres Deutsch und gutes Englisch Was wir dir bieten Ein stabiles Umfeld in einer gefragten Nische, mit gefülltem Pool und etablierten Beziehungen statt Kaltstart Erfahrene Mentoren mit über 10 Jahren SAP-Headhunting-Erfahrung, die dich mit viel Engagement, Know-how und Freude an deinem Erfolg unterstützen Ein solides Fixum und ein variabler Anteil, der deutlich über dem der grossen Personaldienstleister liegt: Bei gleichem Erfolg verdienst du bei uns unter dem Strich mehr Ein kleines, eingespieltes Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und echtem Teamspirit Ein super modernes Office in Zürich-Greencity mit neuester IT Was du sonst noch wissen solltest Bei uns ist jeder Tag anders, die Pace ist hoch, und Kandidaten wie Unternehmen erwarten eine Beratung auf höchstem Niveau. Dafür brauchst du Fokus, Engagement und Freude an Menschen. Unser Antrieb: SAP-Spezialisten in die Rolle zu bringen, in der sie wirklich wachsen, und dabei selbst jeden Tag besser zu werden. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>Support Engineering at GitLab believes that healthy teams deliver a healthy customer experience, and that command during a crisis shouldn't fall to whoever happens to be senior and available. GitLab's global Incident & Escalation Management (IM/EM) function coordinates critical incidents, complex multi-team engagements, and executive-level escalations for enterprise customers. As Escalation Manager, you'll own complex, executive, and commercial escalations where customer trust and the relationship are at stake, alongside or independently of a technical issue.</p> <p>In this functional role, you'll advocate for customers inside GitLab, coordinate teams toward resolution, and lead relationship repair after the event.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own complex, executive, and commercial escalations end-to-end, as defined in GitLab's IM/EM engagement model.</li> <li>Advocate for customers internally and coordinate Engineering, Support, Product, Customer Success, and Sales toward resolution, tracking commitments and holding owning teams accountable to agreed dates and deliverables.</li> <li>Maintain a written, customer-facing resolution plan from engagement through confirmed resolution, updating it at each communication milestone.</li> <li>Coordinate with Incident Managers during concurrent technical incidents to maintain a single, coherent narrative for the customer.</li> <li>Own external escalation communications using GitLab's approved templates and cadence, and represent GitLab in high-stakes customer conversations where clarity and ownership influence retention.</li> <li>Engage Sales, Customer Success, and executive stakeholders as needed, including executive-to-executive communication for Severity 1 and 2 events. Brief GitLab leadership with concise summaries that distinguish what's known, what's unknown, and next steps.</li> <li>Lead post-escalation reviews and relationship repair plans, contribute corrective actions with named owners and due dates to postmortems, and hand the relationship back to the account's Customer Success Manager at resolution.</li> <li>Partner with the Head of IM/EM to develop playbooks, communication templates, and process improvements based on patterns from escalations.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience in enterprise technical support, customer success, or incident and escalation management at a business-to-business software-as-a-service or enterprise software company.</li> <li>A track record of owning complex, multi-stakeholder escalations end-to-end, including executive customer engagements and structured resolution or account plans.</li> <li>Executive-level written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical detail into plain-language updates for customers and GitLab leadership.</li> <li>The ability to coordinate Engineering, Support, Product, Customer Success, and Sales under pressure without formal authority over those teams.</li> <li>Calm, structured decision-making with incomplete information and the ability to provide a steadying presence in high-stress customer situations.</li> <li>Proficiency with support and coordination tools such as Zendesk, Salesforce, Slack, and PagerDuty, or equivalent platforms.</li> <li>Availability for on-call coverage supporting executive escalations as part of a globally distributed team.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Nice to have:  </strong>Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) Foundation or equivalent certification; customer-facing experience with GitLab, development, security, and operations (DevSecOps), continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), or cloud-native products; experience with formal escalation or incident command frameworks; or AI-assisted support tools for triage, sentiment analysis, or resolution drafting.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Incident & Escalation Management function sits within Support Engineering in GitLab's Enterprise Technology & AI (ETA) division. We operate a follow-the-sun model anchored in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East and Africa, and Asia-Pacific, providing year-round, 24-hour coverage for enterprise customers. Our Escalation Managers work globally rather than within a single region, partnering with Incident Managers, Communications Leads, and regional Support Engineering leadership. title: Ingénieur MES (h/f)
description: Contexte Dans le cadre de projets de transformation digitale au sein d’un groupe international du secteur des sciences de la vie, nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur(e) MES – Qualification & Déploiement pour accompagner l’évolution et le déploiement de solutions informatiques industrielles sur plusieurs sites en Europe. Vous interviendrez sur la qualification d’une solution MES (Manufacturing Execution System), destinée à soutenir et à optimiser les processus de production, tout en garantissant sa conformité aux exigences qualité et réglementaires du secteur. Votre rôle et missions Votre rôle En tant qu’Ingénieur(e) MES – Qualification & Déploiement, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la qualification du système et l’accompagnement de son déploiement sur différents sites européens. Vous veillerez à la fiabilité, à la conformité et à la bonne intégration de la solution dans les environnements industriels concernés. À l’interface entre les équipes IT, les équipes de production, les interlocuteurs qualité et les équipes projet, vous contribuerez à sécuriser les différentes étapes du cycle de vie de la solution, de la préparation des activités de qualification jusqu’à sa mise en service opérationnelle. 🎯 Missions 🔹 Qualification & validation du système MES * Participer à la définition et à l’exécution de la stratégie de qualification et de validation du logiciel MES. * Rédiger, revoir et exécuter les protocoles de tests et la documentation de validation. * Préparer et réaliser les tests fonctionnels, les tests d’intégration et les tests de non-régression. * Identifier, documenter et suivre les anomalies jusqu’à leur résolution. 🔹 Déploiement international * Participer au déploiement de la solution MES sur plusieurs sites en Europe. * Accompagner les équipes locales dans la préparation, l’exécution et la validation des activités de déploiement. * Contribuer à l’adaptation de la solution aux spécificités opérationnelles des différents sites, dans le respect des standards définis. 🔹 Documentation & conformité * Rédiger et maintenir la documentation technique et qualité liée aux activités de qualification. * Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des processus de qualification et de déploiement. 🔹 Collaboration & support * Collaborer avec les équipes IT, qualité, production et métiers afin de garantir une compréhension commune des besoins. Votre profil : Formation supérieure en informatique, systèmes industriels, automatisation, ingénierie ou domaine équivalent. Expérience en qualification logicielle, validation des systèmes informatisés ou validation de solutions MES. Bonne compréhension des environnements industriels réglementés, idéalement dans les secteurs pharmaceutique, biotechnologique ou des sciences de la vie. Connaissance des méthodologies de validation et des bonnes pratiques documentaires. Expérience dans la rédaction et l’exécution de protocoles de tests, ainsi que dans la gestion des anomalies. Une expérience dans le déploiement de solutions sur plusieurs sites constitue un atout important. Capacité à collaborer avec des interlocuteurs techniques, qualité et métiers dans un environnement international. Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit, indispensable pour évoluer dans un contexte international. Disponibilité pour des déplacements ponctuels sur les différents sites européens, selon les besoins du projet. 🏆 Conditions du poste * 📍 Localisation : Suisse romande * 🕒 Taux d’occupation : 100 % * 💼 Type de contrat : Mission de consulting * 📅 Démarrage : Flexible / Janvier 2027 * 🌍 Environnement : International et multisite * ✈️ Déplacements : Possibles en Europe selon les besoins du projet Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Brand Management Stage (vanaf januari 2027)
description: Misschien wel het leukste bedrijf van Nederland is op zoek naar versterking! Dit prachtige familiebedrijf groeit als kool en daarom zijn wij hard op zoek naar marketing talent. Word jij enthousiast van grote brands? Ben je benieuwd hoe deze internationaal worden gepositioneerd en houd jij van design? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou! Op de Global Marketingafdeling houden we ons o.a. bezig met Brand Management, Product Management, Social Media en Influencer Marketing. Binnen het brand management team zijn wij op zoek naar een Brand Management stagiair(e). Als Brand Management stagiair(e) draai je gewoon mee met het team. Dit betekent dat je een lekker veelzijdige baan hebt met veel verantwoordelijkheden. Je helpt ons met het ontwikkelen van diverse brand campagnes, van idee tot shoot en van lancering tot evaluatie. Daarnaast bewaak en versterk je de merk identiteit (in meer dan 85 landen!), dit doe je door veel te schakelen met andere afdelingen binnen KEUNE. Btw, koffie halen en printen kunnen we zelf, daar ben jij niet voor. We vinden het veel belangrijker dat je je stem laat horen en ons omver blaast met je kennis van de beauty-industrie, je goede ideeën en je slimme vragen. We staan open voor zowel meewerkstagiairs als afstudeerders. In overleg formuleren we een passende onderzoeksvraag waarmee jij kunt afstuderen, mits je minimaal 4 dagen in de week meewerkt. YOU Je volgt een relevante opleiding op HBO/WO niveau; Spreekt en schrijft flawless Nederlands en Engels; Begrijpt wat het inhoudt om onderdeel van een team te zijn; Gaat niet zitten wachten tot er dingen gebeuren of iemand iets van je vraagt, maar toont initiatief; Bent flexibel en kunt goed omgaan met last minute veranderingen; Bent grappig (het is ook ok als je dat alleen zelf vindt). OUR OFFER Collega’s die elkaar behandelen als familie; Een B Corp gecertificeerde werkgever; Een inspirerende werkomgeving; Collega’s die investeren in jouw talent; De mogelijkheid om een scriptie te schrijven of onderzoek te doen; De kans om samen te werken met top notch marketeers; Regelmatig (eerlijke!) feedback; Stagevergoeding van €650,- per maand; Personeelskorting op de volledige KEUNE-collectie. KEUNE We zijn een familiebedrijf met een langetermijnvisie, waar wetenschap centraal staat in alles wat we doen. Ons verhaal begint in 1922, in Amsterdam. Vandaag, 104 jaar later en een koninklijk predicaat rijker, hoort KEUNE bij één van de hardst groeiende merken in professionele haarverzorgingsproducten. Vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Soest worden KEUNE-producten ontwikkeld, geproduceerd en wereldwijd gedistribueerd naar meer dan 85 landen. En we zijn niet van plan om gas terug te nemen! Ieder jaar openen we een nieuwe eigen vestiging. We produceren op een duurzame en diervriendelijke manier en zijn B Corp-gecertificeerd. Maar bij KEUNE gaat het niet alleen om het creëren van mooie producten - het gaat om ons verhaal en onze visie. KEUNE staat onder leiding van Philip Berlijn, die zich richt op het bouwen van een sterk merk en het creëren van een bedrijfscultuur die draait om samenwerken, duurzaamheid en het tonen van karakter. title: Stage consultancy in het publieke domein
description: 24-38,75 uur per week | Utrecht | Hybride | Transformatie van Openbaar Bestuur | €600 | WO Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot Berenschot is op zoek naar een masterstudent die stage wil lopen bij de adviesgroep Openbaar Bestuur. Heb jij affiniteit met bestuurlijke vraagstukken en interesse in het adviesvak? Vind jij het leuk om mee te draaien in adviesprojecten en heb je een sterk organisatorisch vermogen? Dan is deze stage iets voor jou! Werken voor Berenschot betekent werken aan maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Wij helpen verschillende organisaties in het publieke domein met allerlei uitdagingen. Ook organiseren we regelmatig bijeenkomsten, kennissessies en meetings met een maatschappelijk tintje. Je leert veel over het dynamische speelveld waarin wij werken, doordat je direct meewerkt aan uitdagende opdrachten en een actieve bijdrage levert aan de genoemde activiteiten. Je komt terecht in een ambitieus en gedreven team met veel ervaring in het publieke domein. Dit team focust zich voornamelijk op strategie, samenwerking en organisatieontwikkeling in het openbaar bestuur. Zie je jezelf na de stage in het adviesvak? Dan zijn er mogelijkheden om te solliciteren op een traineeship. Dit ga je doen Overheden staan voor uiteenlopende uitdagingen, van de energietransitie tot het verbeteren van de woningmarkt. Berenschot helpt ministeries, provincies, gemeenten en waterschappen om deze uitdagingen aan te gaan. Als stagiair(e) draag je bij door: Mee te draaien met de Gideonsbende, waar je helpt bij de organisatie van leergangen en inspiratiesessies. Actief mee te werken aan opdrachten, zodat je het speelveld en de spelers binnen het publieke domein leert kennen. Samen met collega-consultants naar klanten te gaan en te leren van hun vraagstukken. Onderzoek te doen en vraagstukken te analyseren, ter ondersteuning van het advieswerk. Leermodules en events te organiseren, waarbij je contact onderhoudt met sprekers en locaties. Tijdens je stage word je intensief begeleid door een adviseur, zodat je je professionele vaardigheden ontwikkelt en leert hoe concepten en theorieën toegepast worden in de praktijk. Ook het uitvoeren van een afstudeeronderzoek is mogelijk. In dat geval bespreken we graag met elkaar hoe we het afstudeeronderzoek zo goed mogelijk kunnen laten aansluiten op ons advieswerk en vice versa. Quote "De kracht van samenwerking in het publieke domein inspireert mij dagelijks om innovatieve en waardevolle oplossingen te bieden voor maatschappelijke uitdagingen." – Senior consultant publieke sector Hier kom je terecht Berenschot is een onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert. We streven altijd naar verrassende en vernieuwende oplossingen, wat ons uniek maakt. Met een open en informele cultuur, samenwerking tussen verschillende vakgebieden en veel vrijheid vanaf dag één krijg je de kans om te ontdekken waar je kracht ligt en waarin jij je wilt ontwikkelen. Dit zijn je directe collega's Je gaat werken binnen de adviesgroep Openbaar Bestuur, specifiek in het team Strategie, Samenwerking en Organisatieontwikkeling. Dit team bestaat uit twintig gedreven adviseurs met specialisaties in bestuurskunde, rechten, technologie en innovatie. We houden ontwikkelingen in de maatschappij, politiek en economie nauwlettend in de gaten en schakelen direct in bij grote opgaven. We werken in wisselende teams, zodat altijd de juiste expertise beschikbaar is. Naast hard werken, wordt er veel gelachen. Binnen Berenschot hebben we een Gideonsbende: vrije denkers en jonge mensen die evenementen organiseren die normaal niet tot stand komen. Denk aan leergangen voor bestuurders en topambtenaren met de titel ‘Taaie thema’s en duivelse dilemma’s in het openbaar bestuur’. title: Commercial Account Executive, UK
description: Get to Know Us Horizon3.ai is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organisations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organisations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results. Role Description Help shape the next stage of Horizon3.ai’s UK growth. Based in the Netherlands with regular UK travel, you’ll bring autonomous pentesting to new customers and help them reduce real-world security risk. If you thrive on opening doors, building partnerships and turning opportunities into wins, this is a chance to make a visible impact as we expand our UK Commercial team. We currently require our Amsterdam team to come to the office 2 - 3 days per week. What You’ll Do Grow Horizon3.ai’s UK Commercial business by winning new customers, developing productive channel partnerships and helping organisations realise value from our cybersecurity solutions. Win new accounts and expand our customer base by introducing disruptive cybersecurity software solutions to the UK market. Build and convert a qualified pipeline, owning the sales cycle from qualification and proof of value through negotiation and close, with the goal of exceeding quota consistently quarter over quarter. Turn channel partnerships into revenue by proactively engaging regional resellers and developing joint opportunities. Demonstrate Horizon3.ai solutions in virtual and in-person meetings, connecting technical capabilities to customer needs and business outcomes. Drive the post-proof of value ROI process, helping customers understand business value while building relationships that support satisfaction and retention. Maintain accurate customer records, pipeline data and forecasts in Salesforce so opportunities, risks and next steps are clearly understood. Work independently to progress opportunities while collaborating with distributed sales, support and customer success teams to deliver a coordinated customer experience. What You’ll Bring At least 5 years of successful cybersecurity sales experience, with a track record of driving growth, introducing disruptive software solutions and consistently exceeding quarterly quotas. Previous experience selling technical solutions into the UK market. Experience establishing and monetising channel partnerships; existing relationships with key regional resellers are essential. Proficiency across the full sales process, including qualification, proof of value, forecasting, negotiation, deal closure and post-proof of value ROI management. The ability to present and demonstrate cybersecurity solutions effectively, both virtually and in person. Strong CRM discipline and experience maintaining accurate pipeline records and forecasts in Salesforce (SFDC). Familiarity with Challenger Question-Based Selling-type methodologies and sales tools such as Outreach , LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo and Slack. The ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with distributed teams. Fluency in English; additional language skills are welcomed. Travel Required We are a hybrid company, and this job will require you to spend 3 days based at our Amsterdam city centre sales hub. The role may require up to 40% of travel within the assigned territory to be successful. Job-related travel expenses are reviewed and must be approved by your manager. Perks of Horizon3.ai Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive. Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities. Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking. Remote Work: We are a 100% remote company. Enjoy the flexibility to work in the way that supports you and brings out your best. Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave. You Belong Here Horizon3.ai is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law. Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3.ai , every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3.ai , where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. title: Data Scientist Marketing
description: At bunq, we’re on a mission to Make Life Easy for our users by creating the most user-centric banking experience out there. Our paid marketing campaigns run on predictions about which new users will turn out to be valuable. This role makes sure those predictions are right. That’s where you come in. As our Data Scientist, Marketing , you’ll own the machine learning models that predict the value of every newly verified user and feed that value into Google Ads, so our campaigns find more users like them. If the models are off, the spend is off. AI can help you write and debug code, but it can’t build the model or judge whether the output can be trusted. That judgment is yours. Take Ownership 🚀 You’ll own the predictive models that steer our marketing spend. Here’s how you’ll do it: Build, maintain and expand the predictive models for marketing, from first idea to production, starting with the models that predict each new user’s value in their first 90 days. Hit the model quality targets within 9 months: a Spearman rank correlation of 0.50 or higher and a binary model AUC of 0.75 or higher. Keep the models running in production and monitor data and model health to find where to intervene, using Claude Code to move faster and validating everything it produces. You’ve built predictive models with traditional machine learning, such as XGBoost. You’ve written Python and built the data pipelines a model needs, including when none existed. You’ve shipped ML models to production and kept them running. You’ve done deep dives into data and model health to find what needs intervention. You use AI tools like Claude Code in your daily work and know where they stop. You are fluent in English. Curious to see how we make life easy? - try the bunq app , it only takes 5 minutes to sign up. Your space to perform We give you the space and the tools you need to succeed 💪 🤟 Great, international colleagues who share your mindset 👩‍💻 Hybrid setup: after 3 months in-office, work 2 days remote, 3 days in-office weekly. 🧳 Digital Nomad Program: After your first year, enjoy up to 20 days per year to work while traveling, combining flexibility with strong team collaboration 🚀 We reward tenure with a dedicated travel budget: €1.5k after 2 years and €3k after 4 years to visit another core office. 📚 We support growth with bunq Academy and €1500 annual learning budget 🧘 €60 monthly allowance via Alleo by Epassi, rolling over monthly and resetting annually 🚌 Travel expenses are covered whether you come walking or by bike, bus or car (though we prefer green choices 🌳) 💻 A MacBook so you can Get Shit Done with us 🥦 Delicious lunches from our fabulous in-house chefs with vegan and vegetarian options 💰 An optional pension plan with monthly contribution from bunq 💸 Monthly contribution to your phone and internet bills 🍻 Friday drinks and other celebrations - bunq style All new hires are subject to Pre-employment Screening (PES), which includes checks conducted by our third-party partner, Zinc. This is part of our commitment to a secure and trustworthy workplace Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Stage of Afstuderen: Optimalisatie van Machine-inspecties
description: Wat ga je doen? Binnen Customer Service voert Voortman periodieke machine-inspecties uit om de technische staat van machines te beoordelen en klanten te adviseren over onderhoud, reparaties en mogelijke verbeteringen. Deze inspecties vormen een belangrijke basis voor het verhogen van de betrouwbaarheid, prestaties en levensduur van machines. Het huidige inspectieproces is door de jaren heen organisch gegroeid. Hierdoor worden inspectievragen niet altijd op dezelfde manier geïnterpreteerd, verschillen beoordelingen tussen monteurs en worden bevindingen niet overal uniform vastgelegd. Ook de rapportage richting klanten kan op onderdelen duidelijker, consistenter en meer actiegericht worden ingericht. Tijdens deze opdracht analyseer je het volledige machine-inspectieproces en ontwikkel je een vernieuwde werkwijze die aansluit bij de huidige en toekomstige behoeften van onze serviceorganisatie. Daarbij kijk je niet alleen naar de inhoud van inspectievragen, maar ook naar de manier waarop inspecteurs informatie verzamelen, beoordelingen uitvoeren, bevindingen vastleggen en resultaten communiceren naar klanten. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Het analyseren van het huidige machine-inspectieproces en het identificeren van verbeterpunten; Het ontwikkelen van een logische en uniforme structuur voor machine-inspecties; Het herformuleren en standaardiseren van bestaande inspectievragen; Het opstellen van duidelijke beoordelingscriteria voor de technische staat van machineonderdelen; Het ontwikkelen van een uniforme methode voor het vastleggen van metingen, bevindingen, foto's en aanbevolen acties; Het verbeteren van inspectierapportages zodat technische bevindingen overzichtelijk, eenduidig en actiegericht worden gepresenteerd; Het opstellen van een implementatievoorstel voor het vernieuwde inspectieproces binnen Customer Service. Het eindresultaat is een praktisch en onderbouwd verbeterplan waarmee Voortman machine-inspecties wereldwijd op een uniforme manier kan uitvoeren en klanten nog beter kan ondersteunen met duidelijke inspectierapportages en onderhoudsadviezen. Wij vragen HBO studie in de richting van Technische bedrijfskunde, Werktuigbouwkunde, Mechatronica of vergelijkbaar. Wij bieden Een vergoeding: €600,- per maand; Reiskostenvergoeding: zodat jij geen onnodige kosten maakt; Apparatuur en materialen: bijvoorbeeld een laptop, speciaal gereedschap of software; Ervaren coach: goede begeleiding is belangrijk en dus krijg je een vaste coach om je te ondersteunen; Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Over Voortman Wat in 1968 begon in een kippenschuur in Rijssen, is uitgegroeid tot wereldspeler in CNC-staalbewerkingsmachines. Met een team van meer dan 750 collega’s wereldwijd ontwikkelen en bouwen we niet alleen high-end machines, maar ook slimme software en service waarop klanten kunnen vertrouwen. Deze 3 krachtige bouwstenen maken ons Twentse, internationale familiebedrijf uniek. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer, Environment Automation
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p>As a Staff Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) at GitLab, you’ll help keep all user-facing services and production systems reliable, scalable, and efficient. Our SREs combine a pragmatic operations mindset with strong software engineering practices to drive automation, reduce toil, and improve resilience across our platform.</p> <p>In the Environment Automation specialization, your focus is on operating and automating hundreds of GitLab environments—from initial provisioning to day-to-day maintenance tasks. </p> <p>Unlike other SRE roles, this position centers on automating the lifecycle of many tenant environments, ensuring they remain secure, consistent, and reliable at scale.</p> <p>Some examples of the projects you could work on:</p> <ul> <li>Designing infrastructure automation that provisions and operates GitLab environments using Terraform, Ansible, and Kubernetes</li> <li>Creating and maintaining deployment packages for GitLab, such as Helm Charts and omnibus-gitlab</li> <li>Building and operating Dedicated GitLab instances integrated with cloud-native services (e.g., GCP, AWS)</li> <li>Developing tools to orchestrate infrastructure-as-code workflows across multiple tenants</li> <li>Deploying and managing microservices on Kubernetes clusters at scale</li> <li>Enhancing GitLab’s observability stack (e.g., Prometheus, ELK) to support proactive monitoring and incident response</li> <li>Integrating with and operating infrastructure in cloud provider ecosystems (e.g., IAM, networking, storage)</li> <li>Championing and implementing cloud security best practices across automated infrastructure</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Build & Scale Multi-Tenant Infrastructure:</strong> Design and implement automation that provisions and manages hundreds of isolated GitLab environments using Terraform, Ansible, and Kubernetes. Manage complex state strategies and workspace configurations to support scale and maintainability.</li> <li><strong>Debug & Resolve Production Issues: </strong>Troubleshoot issues across Kubernetes clusters, cloud services, and GitLab apps—identifying root causes of failed deployments, crash loops, and scheduling conflicts to ensure service continuity.</li> <li><strong>Automate Operations at Scale: </strong>Replace manual workflows with infrastructure-as-code solutions, including automated version upgrades, configuration rollouts, and provisioning pipelines that operate reliably across all tenants.</li> <li><strong>Monitor & Predict Capacity: </strong>Build observability systems that detect bottlenecks, predict usage trends, and optimize resource consumption using tools like Prometheus, ELK, and Grafana.</li> <li><strong>Respond & Lead During Incidents: </strong>Lead incident response and postmortem efforts, applying technical depth to resolve issues and establish operational standards that reduce future risk.</li> <li><strong>Architect & Collaborate: </strong>Influence architectural decisions around automation, scalability, and operational excellence. Partner with engineering teams to improve automation, platform resilience, and production-readiness.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Bring</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Production-Scale Experience: </strong>Proven ability to operate and troubleshoot production workloads across multiple tenants or environments. Deep understanding of how distributed systems fail at scale and how to build in resilience.<br><strong>Terraform & IaC Mastery:</strong> Strong hands-on experience with Terraform, including workspace strategies, state management, and automation patterns that scale. Comfortable solving state isolation issues and building reliable, reusable infrastructure code. Experience with Ansible and templating tools like Jsonnet is a plus.<br><strong>Kubernetes in Production: </strong>Skilled at diagnosing deployment failures, interpreting pod logs, and debugging scheduling issues and rollback scenarios in live environments. Understands how pods, ReplicaSets, and controllers interact in production.<br><strong>Programming & Code Analysis: </strong>Ability to read and debug code in Go and/or Ruby. Familiar with identifying performance issues, scalability concerns, and contributing to infrastructure tooling through thoughtful code analysis.<br><strong>Large Scale Operations Background: </strong>Experience supporting infrastructure for many customers or environments simultaneously. Comfortable managing isolation, scaling, monitoring, and incident response across diverse workloads.<br><strong>Architecture & Incident Response:</strong> Able to reason through complex systems and operational challenges. Brings on-call experience and can lead technical discussions and incident resolution efforts under pressure.<br><strong>Customer-Focused Collaboration: </strong>Proven ability to work across teams and with internal or external customers to solve technical problems while maintaining service commitments and clear communication.<br><strong>GitLab Platform Proficiency: </strong>Comfortable using GitLab as a daily tool for infrastructure automation, collaboration, and operational workflows.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong><br>GitLab’s Dedicated team, where the SRE Environment Automation role sits, is on a mission to deliver a fully managed, single-tenant GitLab experience through the GitLab Dedicated platform. Our goal is to eliminate manual operations across the entire lifecycle of customer environments, including provisioning, upgrades, security, and monitoring, so customers can focus on unlocking the full potential of The One DevOps Platform without managing the underlying infrastructure. description: Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you. We crawl the web continuously and cannot keep all of it, refresh all of it, or spend a GPU on all of it. Something has to decide which pages are worth indexing, which links are worth following, which pages say the same thing as pages we already have, what has gone stale, and what we should never have picked up. These decisions are worth more than most ranking work. The cheapest way to improve search is to stop indexing pages nobody should ever retrieve, and to start indexing the ones we are missing. Today they run on a mix of learned signals and thresholds someone picked. We are looking for a research engineer to own the signals behind those decisions, and the decisions themselves. Desired Experience You are comfortable owning a problem with no ground truth, where the first job is defining what the right answer means Hands-on ML experience with classifiers, rankers and calibration, plus strong data instincts at web scale You think in end-to-end impact. A signal only counts if a decision changes and search gets better You like working across teams. title: Software Engineer, Knowledge Engine – Query Engine
description: Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z. Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you. The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness. In this role, you'll own the query engine that searches hundreds of billions of claims across a variety of retrieval backends, from a distributed graph database to vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial indexes. This is greenfield work with a massive scope. No off-the-shelf system answers precise questions over hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims at agent speed, so you'll make foundational decisions, from storage layout and indexing across engines to the query language and the planner that routes work between them, that every query depends on. What you'll do Own storage and indexing across backends: data layout, partitioning and indexes for graph, vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial retrieval, with bulk snapshot builds and live ingest that never take the system down. Decide how best to search: cost-based planning from cardinality estimates that chooses, for each question, which backends to use, in what order and how to join their results, executed as traversals, retrievals, filters and aggregations in one plan. Make it fast at scale: serve thousands of queries per second, profiling and cutting p50/p99 latency, memory and cost per query under high concurrent load, from on-disk layout to network fan-out. Keep answers consistent while the data converges: the graph is fed by live updates and bulk snapshots at once and is eventually consistent by design, so you'll own what a query may see while it converges: consistent snapshot promotion, ordered application of live updates and stable pagination across versions. Measure precision and completeness: end-to-end checks every deployment must pass, plus evals and metrics that show when a plan returns wrong results or misses ones it should have found. What we're looking for You've worked deep inside a distributed database, query engine, search engine or storage system. Strong grasp of indexing, query planning and optimization, and storage formats. Solid grasp of distributed systems fundamentals: consensus, replication, sharding and fault tolerance. Strong in a systems language (Go, Rust or C++). You profile before you optimize, and you've shipped measured latency wins in production. You obsess over correctness, reliability and data quality as much as scale. Bonus Graph databases, or combining vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial retrieval Compilers, query language design or cost-based optimizers Example projects Build a system that retrieves and reasons over everything known about any company or person in the world, answering any factual question precisely and completely. Answer precise multi-hop questions over hundreds of billions of claims at thousands of QPS with interactive latency. Build a planner that picks the right mix of graph, vector, full-text and geospatial retrieval for any question, and proves it chose well. Make new knowledge queryable seconds after it's synthesized, without ever serving an inconsistent result. Logistics Location: This is an in-person opportunity in Zurich. Visas: We're happy to sponsor international candidates (e.g., STEM OPT, OPT, H1B, O1, E3).
