title: Senior Backend Engineer
description: About Us Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights. Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi. About the role: We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to help us build powerful, delightful features that empower restaurant teams. You’ll work across the stack to bring new ideas to life, whether it’s building intuitive interfaces, scalable backend services, or the glue in between that makes everything feel seamless. You’ll collaborate closely with design, product, and other engineers to rapidly ship impactful features. As an early team member, you’ll also help shape our engineering culture, tooling, and technical direction. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, loves solving real user problems, and wants to help modernize an underserved industry with thoughtful, elegant software. Responsibilities: Build, test, and ship end-to-end features across the stack—from APIs and data models. Collaborate with designers and PMs to translate user needs into working, intuitive product experiences Own projects from concept to launch and beyond, balancing speed, quality, and scalability Improve system performance and reliability across frontend and backend systems Help evolve our codebase and technical architecture as we scale Contribute to shared tooling, component libraries, and best practices that level up the whole team What you’ll need: 8+ years of professional experience as a fullstack or backend engineer in a product-focused environment Deep expertise in either Kotlin, Java, or Scala. Significant experience with distributed systems. You know how to build and maintain scalable, resilient services that work together. Experience with event-driven architectures (e.g., Kafka). Good experience of relational databases, such as Postgres. Comfortable working with APIs, relational databases, and docker A product mindset, you care about the why behind what you’re building and optimizing for user impact Ability to work collaboratively across functions and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders Strong attention to detail and a sense of pride in crafting great user experiences What is Restaurant Software? Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it. From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy. How we use AI at Tebi We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed. At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. title: Associate Account Executive (Top Talent Sales Program - Lunar) BENELUX
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.</p></div><h3><strong>Lunar Sales:</strong></h3> <p>The Celonis Lunar Sales is a fast-track, 2-year development programme designed for ambitious professionals who want to accelerate their career at the intersection of AI, enterprise technology, and strategic sales.  If you have experience solving complex problems in a client-facing role, in management or strategy consulting or a leading industry strategy function and you are ready to bring that expertise into enterprise sales, this is your launchpad.</p> <p>The Program immerses you in every stage of the customer sales journey, supported by motivating leaders who will help accelerate your growth beyond expectations. If you're an innovative thinker who thrives on overcoming challenges, our Top Talent Sales Program will provide strategic significance, arming you with the knowledge and tools to address complex problems, create meaningful change and excel as an Account Executive. </p> <p>Onboarding Period of 1-3 months with the whole Lunar Cohort one-site at the Celonis Munich Office.<br><strong><br><br>The Role:</strong></p> <p>Fast-track your growth in enterprise sales through our exclusive top talent program. You will gain hands-on experience selling AI-driven business transformation, build relationships with industry leaders across Celonis verticals, including Automotive, Manufacturing, Banking, FSI,  Life Sciences, Consumer Goods, Retail, Energy and Public Sector and develop the leadership skills needed to drive real change for enterprise customers.</p> <h3><strong>The program focuses on three key pillars </strong></h3> <p><strong> </strong><strong> Strategic Business Development & Executive Relationship Building </strong></p> <ul> <li>Take full ownership of generating your own pipeline through cold outreach, persona identification, and first meetings, driving directly towards concrete KPI and revenue targets.</li> <li>Collaborate with C-suite executives (CEO, CFO, COO, CDO/CIO) to address challenges and align with their strategic objectives. </li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong><strong> Tailored Solutions & Strategic Alignment </strong></p> <ul> <li>Position Celonis Context Model and AI capabilities to address critical business needs, delivering measurable impact and expansion.</li> <li>Align strategies with clients' long-term business goals to maximize platform adoption and success.</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong><strong> Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration</strong></p> <ul> <li>Join a highly collaborative cohort of peers featuring a great team who can tackle challenges together, a strong performance culture, and continuous shared learning experiences.</li> <li>Orchestrate cross-functional teams, including Value Engineers, Service Consultants, Marketing, BDRs, and external partners.</li> <li>Partner directly with a senior Account Executive in a dedicated 1:1 mentorship model to accelerate your professional growth.</li> </ul> <h3><strong><br>The work you’ll do:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Understand the strategic and operational business needs of your target accounts and effectively communicate how Celonis and its AI-powered Process Intelligence Platform, will meet those to create real opportunities.</li> <li>Responsible for delivering revenue in your allocated account patch by creating new business opportunities. </li> <li>Identify key stakeholder personas, cultivate strategic relationships, and build an internal network of champions to drive customer success and account expansion.</li> <li>Engage cross Line-of-Business at C-level and below within your target organizations </li> <li>Become proficient in driving the sales process, following a structured, staged, programmatic flow through prospect, initial call, qualify, pitch to close.</li> <li>Collaborate with Value Engineering or personally conduct comprehensive presentations and demonstrations tailored to specific use cases, including Celonis AI, Process Intelligence Graph and industry-specific solutions, showcasing the value of our platform.</li> <li>Forge strong partnerships, particularly with leading consulting firms, tech partners, and the Big4.</li> <li>Work closely with your team, which includes business development representatives, value engineers, partner managers, and marketing specialists, to ensure seamless collaboration and success. </li> <li>Stay current on AI trends, process automation, and digital transformation to position Celonis as the intelligent backbone of enterprise operations.<br><br></li> </ul> <h3><strong>The qualifications you need:</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Proven Track Record in Client-Facing Roles: </strong>You bring 2–3 years of professional experience from a top-tier management consultancy, corporate strategy/transformation function, or leading enterprise technology company. </li> <li><strong>Strong Academic Foundation: </strong>You studied Business Economics, Engineering, Informatics, or a related discipline. A Master's degree is preferred, but exceptional graduates with solid foundational knowledge are encouraged to apply.</li> <li><strong>Sales Drive & Career Acceleration: </strong>You're ready to accelerate your career in sales. You have a genuine interest in applying your professional experience to a dynamic sales environment and are excited to build expertise in enterprise software solutions and client success.</li> <li><strong>Business Acumen & Process Intelligence Expertise: </strong>You have a sharp ability to quickly understand how companies operate, identify inefficiencies, and recognize where Process Intelligence and AI unlock real value and drive transformation.</li> <li><strong>AI-Forward Mindset: </strong>You're genuinely curious about AI and emerging technologies, driven to deepen your business acumen, and passionate about understanding business processes and KPIs—particularly in Finance, Supply Chain, or operations.</li> <li><strong>Industry Edge:</strong> You bring familiarity or hands-on experience in Manufacturing, Automotive, Consumer Goods, Retail, Financial Services, Telecommunications, or Utilities. This foundation helps you quickly grasp client contexts and add immediate value.</li> <li><strong>Communication Excellence</strong>: You communicate complex, strategic ideas with clarity and confidence in Business English. Fluency in Dutch is a strong plus.</li> <li><strong>Analytical & Independent Thinker</strong>: You bring a forward-thinking mindset with analytical capabilities. You think strategically, operate independently, and are comfortable owning challenges and driving solutions.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>What Celonis can offer you:</strong></p> <ul class="p-rich_text_list p-rich_text_list__bullet p-rich_text_list--nested" data-stringify-type="unordered-list" data-list-tree="true" data-indent="0" data-border="0"> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Pioneer Innovation:</span> Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Ownership from Day 1:</span> Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Unrivaled Family Support:</span> Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Work-Life Integration:</span> Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Continuous Growth:</span> Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Holistic Well-being:</span> Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Drive Sustainability:</span> Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Global Inclusion & Belonging:</span> Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Value-Driven Impact:</span> Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About Us:</strong></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="1264">Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="1982">Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this <a class="_ymio1r31 _ypr0glyw _zcxs1o36 _mizu194a _1ah3dkaa _ra3xnqa1 _128mdkaa _1cvmnqa1 _4davt94y _4bfu18uv _1hms8stv _ajmmnqa1 _vchhusvi _kqswh2mm _ect4ttxp _2rkolb4i _syaz13af _1a3b18uv _4fpr8stv _5goinqa1 _f8pj13af _9oik18uv _1bnxglyw _jf4cnqa1 _30l313af _1nrm18uv _c2wa

title: Technical Lead Consultant
description: <ul> <li>Adviseer en begeleid klanten naar optimale bedrijfsprocessen</li> <li>Combineer strategie, technologie en leiderschap in één rol</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>Stap aan boord als Technical Lead Consultant en help onze klanten het maximale uit hun Microsoft-omgeving te halen. Jij bent de strategische sparringpartner die bedrijfsprocessen optimaliseert en vertaalt naar slimme technologische oplossingen. Je wordt een integraal onderdeel van het klantteam en speelt een cruciale rol in het verhogen van klanttevredenheid en zakelijke groei door middel van deskundig advies en strategische technologie-implementatie. Deze rol biedt een unieke mix van business en techniek: jij adviseert én zet jouw technische expertise in om impact te maken.<br>  </p> <p><strong>Jouw reisgezelschap </strong> </p> <p>Bij HSO Managed Services werk je in klantenteams die end-to-end verantwoordelijk zijn. Techniek, business en change komen samen, waardoor je korte lijnen, snelle besluitvorming en nauwe samenwerking met de klant ervaart. Je rol gaat verder dan beheer: je adviseert, innoveert en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor proactieve monitoring, incidentmanagement, roadmap en optimalisatie van kritische processen. Samen met je collega’s creëer je jouw eigen groeipad. </p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Jouw bijdrage aan de reis   </strong> </p> <ul> <li>Ontwikkel en presenteer verbeter-roadmaps en vertaal deze naar concrete opdrachten;</li> <li>Adviseer klanten over toekomstige Microsoft-ontwikkelingen en innovaties;</li> <li>Werk nauw samen met Sales en Accountmanagement om klantwaarde te maximaliseren;</li> <li>Begeleid en coach consultants en developers, bewaak kwaliteit en deel best practices;</li> <li>Stem actief af met de Customer Team Manager en klanten over voortgang en kansen.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Wat neem jij mee?</strong> </p> <ul> <li>HBO/WO-opleiding (bij voorkeur IT & Business, Bedrijfskunde of vergelijkbaar);</li> <li>Ervaring als (Senior of Lead) Technical Consultant met brede kennis van Microsoft Azure en cloudconcepten;</li> <li>Sterke technische basis, bv opgedaan in development, engineering of vergelijkbare technische disciplines;</li> <li>Sterke analytische en probleemoplossende vaardigheden;</li> <li>Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal, zowel in woord als geschrift.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Wat verzorgen wij? </strong> </p> <ul> <li>Bij HSO reis je niet alleen voor een baan maar voor een carrière vol ontdekkingen. Naast een marktconform salaris en een prestatiegerichte bonus, krijg je praktische benodigdheden en beleving: </li> <li>Flexibele werkplek: kies je basis Rotterdam, Veenendaal of thuiswerken, jij bepaalt de route; </li> <li>Mobiliteitsvergoeding waarbij je of een auto kunt leasen of het bedrag toe kunt  <br>voegen aan je salaris. Daar bovenop krijg 100% betaald van de ov-kosten;  </li> <li>Je kunt deelnemen aan het leasefietsplan;  </li> <li>EUR 65,- netto vitaliteitsbudget, we vinden het belangrijk dat we gezond blijven en een veilige werkplek hebben, zowel op kantoor als remote;  </li> <li>Opleidingsbudget, studiedagen en toegang tot onze Academy en GoodHabitz voor jouw leerexpeditie; </li> <li>25 vakantiedagen + optie om 10 extra te kopen; workations mogelijk voor wie écht nieuwe houvast zoekt; </li> <li>Dagelijkse verzorgde lunch, bedrijfsfeesten, sportactiviteiten en wekelijkse borrels om onze gezamenlijke reis te versterken. <br> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Onze wereldwijde route</strong> </p> <p>Als Microsoft Inner Circle-partner en internationaal opererend bedrijf biedt HSO jou toegang tot best practices, certificeringen en een wereldwijd netwerk van experts. Samen met ruim 2200 getalenteerde medewerkers in Europa, Azië en Noord-Amerika verlenen we ondersteuning op lokaal en internationaal niveau aan industriële bedrijven, retailers, financiële en zakelijke dienstverleners en overheidsinstellingen. Je werkt in een dynamische omgeving waarin kennisdeling centraal staat en waarin je jouw expertise direct kunt inzetten om klanten te helpen transformeren.  <br> </p> <p><strong>Ready to join the journey? </strong> <br>Klaar om met ons op pad te gaan of vragen hierover?</p> <p>Neem contact op met Sheling via <a ---------- Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Technical Architect Power Platform CE
description: <section class="styles--3vx-H" data-ui="job-description"> <div class="styles--2Kv6p" data-ui="careers-page-content"> <div lang="en"> <p>Als Technical Architect ben je eindverantwoordelijk voor de technische architectuur op de korte en lange termijn in projecten en salestrajecten. Je beschrijft en ontwikkelt de technische architectuur inclusief bijkomende integraties. Naast het ontwerpen van migratiescenario’s, onderhoud je contact met de technische en inhoudelijke stakeholders bij de klant en HSO.<br><br><strong>Join the journey<br><br>Wat ga je doen?<br></strong><br>Jij zet technische best practices op voor klanten en (interne) collega's. Als Technical Architect ben je de motivator voor de technische collega's van het klantteam. Als digital leader naar de klant ben je in staat om breder te kijken dan de oplossing die wij leveren en zie je deze in het totale end-to-end klantproces.<br><br>Als Technical Architect ben je verantwoordelijk voor het technische deel van de oplossing. Daarnaast:</p> <ul> <li>Ben je betrokken in de designfase en bepaal je welke technologieën kunnen worden gebruikt in welke scenario's;</li> <li>Draag je bij aan de technische best practices van HSO en draag je deze ook uit naar de klant en het team;</li> <li>Fungeer je fungeer als technische vraagbaak voor de technische en functionele consultants;</li> <li>Houd je je bezig met integraties met andere (third-party) applicaties, denk je mee over integration patterns;</li> <li>Zorg je ervoor dat alles in source control terecht komt en dat er automatisch uitgerold wordt d,m,v, Azure DevOps pipelines;</li> <li>Samen met de Product Owner stel je een roadmap op voor technische verbeteringen.</li> </ul> <p><br><strong>Wat vertellen onze huidige technische architecten over deze rol?</strong></p> <p>“Het werk als technische architect is heel erg uitdagend en gevarieerd. Je werkt samen met hele leuke collega’s op projecten. Op het project ben je verantwoordelijk voor de algehele kwaliteit en samenhang van het IT-landschap. Primair binnen de kaders van het project. Echter doordat je implementatie altijd samenhangt met andere systemen ben je ook veel bezig met het landschap buiten het Microsoft project. Je bepaalt samen met de klant waar je naartoe gaat over de jaren heen en ziet jouw plannen dan werkelijkheid worden. <br><br>Als je het leuk vindt is er ook altijd ruimte om op de inhoud in te gaan. Als je dat doet ben je vooral bezig met de complexe onderdelen van het project en dat is erg leuk en uitdagend. Naast de projecten houd je je bezig met de best practices van HSO. Je krijgt daardoor altijd de nieuwe ontwikkelingen mee en krijgt de kans om daar wat mee te doen.”</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Wat breng jij mee?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde HBO- of WO-opleiding;</li> <li>Je hebt minimaal 7 jaar ervaring met Power Platform (Dynamics 365 CE, CRM) implementaties in een technische rol;</li> <li>Aantoonbare werkervaring in programmeertaal C#;</li> <li>Je hebt uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden die je inzet bij het aansturen van de techneuten;</li> <li>Je bent in staat om op basis van de behoeften van de klant een technisch ontwerp te maken en de structuur van de oplossing uit te denken;</li> <li>Je bent in staat om de best practices die wij en Microsoft hebben opgebouwd hierbij leidend te laten zijn. Op basis hiervan ben je voorstellend en adviserend naar je klanten;</li> <li>Je bent in staat de implementatie te begeleiden volgens de overeengekomen architectuur en infrastructuur;</li> <li>Je bent inhoudelijk, analytisch, ondernemend, kwaliteitsbewust en creatief.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Wat bieden we jou?  <br></strong>Werken bij HSO is uitdagend, we willen je daar graag een goede beloning voor teruggeven. Naast goede primaire voordelen bieden wij:  </p> <ul> <li>Een competitief salaris, een jaarlijkse bonus op basis van bedrijfs-, team- en individuele prestaties;  </li> <li>Mobiliteitsvergoeding waarbij je of een auto kunt leasen of het bedrag toe kunt voegen aan je salaris. Daar bovenop krijg 100% betaald van de ov-kosten; </li> <li>25 Vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om er 35 van te maken;  </li> <li>Hybride werken, vanuit huis, op kantoor (Rotterdam, Veenendaal) of zelfs tijdens je Workation;  </li> <li>EUR 65,- netto vitaliteitsbudget – we vinden het belangrijk dat we gezond blijven en een veilige werkplek hebben, zowel op kantoor als remote;  </li> <li>Je kunt deelnemen aan het leasefietsplan; </li> <li>En vooral een leven lang leren. Op dag één start jouw onboardingprogramma, daarnaast krijg je een persoonlijk studiebudget dat je kunt inzetten voor jouw professionele ontwikkeling en ontvang je ook een GoodHabitz account, een online trainingstool voor je persoonlijke ontwikkeling.  </li> </ul> <p><br><strong>Vrijheid, flexibiliteit en fun  <br></strong>Je werkt in een internationale omgeving met professionals met verschillende nationaliteiten. Een flexibele werkweek van 40, 36 of 32 uur behoort tot de mogelijkheden omdat wij van mening zijn dat jouw manier van werken bij jouw levensstijl moet passen. title: Enterprise Account Executive III - Netherlands
description: Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration , enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide , including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences. Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team. Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies , We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading. We are looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to build Camunda’s Dutch Government market. This is a territory-building role for a disciplined, consultative seller who can create demand, shape strategic opportunities, and guide complex buying groups through to executive-level decisions. You will own the full sales cycle across a focused set of government accounts, from account strategy and first conversation through business case, procurement, negotiation, close, and expansion. You will combine commercial ownership with public-sector credibility. The successful candidate will be comfortable engaging senior civil servants, CIO and transformation leaders, procurement, security, architecture, and business stakeholders. You will translate government priorities into a compelling value case for process orchestration, automation, and agentic workflows, while navigating formal procurement processes and the governance expectations of public-sector customers. What you will own Own the Dutch Government territory and create a clear account and coverage strategy across priority national and public-sector organizations. Build and maintain a healthy, self-generated pipeline, targeting at least 2.5x pipeline coverage through focused outbound activity, executive engagement, partner collaboration, and market development. Develop relationships across complex buying groups, including CIOs, CTOs, transformation leaders, enterprise architects, process owners, procurement, security, legal, and executive sponsors. Lead the full enterprise sales cycle: discovery, qualification, value engineering, technical evaluation, business case, procurement, commercial negotiation, and close. Apply MEDDICC consistently to create deal clarity, strengthen qualification, identify gaps early, and improve forecast reliability. Build business cases connected to public-sector outcomes such as service quality, operational efficiency, transparency, resilience, compliance, and cost control. Coordinate account teams across Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Professional Services, Marketing, Product, Legal, Finance, and leadership. Developa partner-first motion with relevant global system integrators, regional partners, and public-sector specialists. Expand successful customer relationships by identifying adjacent processes, departments, agencies, and use cases after the initial land. Maintain accurate account, contact, opportunity, and forecast data in Salesforce as the single source of truth. Share market intelligence on government priorities, procurement dynamics, competitors, partners, and customer needs to improve Camunda’s Dutch public-sector go-to-market strategy. What success looks like First 30 days Build a working understanding of Camunda’s platform, value proposition, sales methodology, customer evidence, pricing approach, and public-sector references. Align with internal stakeholders on territory priorities, account ownership, partner coverage, and available sales resources. Produce an initial account segmentation and stakeholder-mapping plan for the Dutch Government territory. Establish a repeatable operating cadence for pipeline creation, deal inspection, forecasting, and cross-functional account-team collaboration. First 90 days Complete strategic account plans for the highest-priority government accounts, including business priorities, buying groups, whitespace, partners, competition, and next actions. Create qualified pipeline through a balanced mix of net-new opportunities, partner-sourced activity, executive introductions, and expansion plays. Develop a strong network of relevant government and ecosystem stakeholders, with clear relationship and meeting objectives. Demonstrate consistent MEDDICC qualification and accurate Salesforce hygiene across active opportunities. Identify the most relevant public-sector use cases and value narratives for Camunda’s Dutch market development. First 180 days and beyond Establish a credible, repeatable pipeline engine for the Dutch Government market. Progress strategic opportunities through well-defined qualification, value validation, technical evaluation, procurement, and commercial stages. Win new government logos and create expansion paths into additional departments, agencies, or processes. Build trusted relationships with executive sponsors and public-sector ecosystem partners. Contribute actionable market insight that improves Camunda’s positioning, messaging, partner strategy, and investment decisions in the Netherlands. Deliver against quota while protecting long-term customer value, adoption, and expansion potential. What you will bring Must-haves 5+ years of success in a quota-carrying enterprise software or SaaS Account Executive role, owning complex deals end to end. Demonstrated experience selling into the Dutch Government or another highly regulated public-sector environment, with a clear understanding of formal procurement, security, legal, and governance requirements. A track record of creating pipeline through proactive outbound activity and converting multi-stakeholder opportunities into material, preferably multi-year, contracts. Strong command of MEDDICC or a comparable enterprise sales methodology, with the discipline to qualify rigorously, manage mutual action plans, and forecast accurately. Executive presence and communication skills in Dutch and English, with the ability to connect operational problems to strategic, financial, and citizen-impact outcomes. A collaborative, customer-focused, and resilient approach aligned with Camunda’s FAITH values and global-first way of working. Nice-to-haves Experience selling process automation, workflow, orchestration, integration, business transformation, or adjacent enterprise technology. Existing relationships across Dutch ministries, executive agencies, municipalities, provinces, public-service organizations, or government-focused partners. Experience working with global system integrators, regional implementation partners, or public-sector framework agreements. Familiarity with Camunda, BPMN, DMN, process orchestration, cloud platforms, or agentic automation. Experience creating quantified value cases for service modernization, compliance, operational resilience, or cost reduction. Why this role matters now Dutch public-sector organizations are under pressure to modernize services, improve efficiency, operate securely, and coordinate increasingly complex technology and regulatory environments. Process orchestration gives them a way to make that complexity visible and manageable while connecting people, systems, and automation. This role is an opportunity to shape a market rather than inherit a mature patch. You will have the ownership and visibility to define where Camunda can create the greatest public value, build the ecosystem around those opportunities, and establish a durable foundation for growth in the Netherlands. You will join a global, distributed team that values initiative, transparency, customer impact, and practical collaboration. The role offers the chance to work at the intersection of public-sector transformation, enterprise technology, process orchestration, and the next generation of agentic automation. This role is an existing vacancy #LI-AG1 #LI-Remote What We Have to Offer: Compensation We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition. The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. Final offers depend on skills , experience , and location , and we typically hire in the first half of the range to allow room for growth: United States: $281,300.00 to $453,500.00 United Kingdom: £176,600.00 to £290,500.00 Singapore: S$349,400.00 to S$524,000.00 If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview. Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP) . Benefits & Perks We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable. Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it. In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets , including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi. Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and our Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA), a flexible, global benefit that puts you in control of your whole life, not just work, from: staying active, to caring for family, exploring personal passions, meaningful experiences, and investing in your financial wellbeing. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a Business Systems Engineer to own the systems that turn a signed deal into a correct invoice and accurate revenue numbers. You’ll work across our go-to-market and finance stack: CRM, quoting and CPQ, billing, the data warehouse, and the integrations between them. Salesforce is one important part of that stack, not the whole job. This is an engineering role with business ownership: you’ll design how data and money move between Sales, Finance, Billing Ops, and Data teams, build the automation that keeps them in sync, and use AI to remove manual work and surface timely signals to reps and operators. You’ll partner closely with Sales, Deal Desk, Billing Ops, Revenue Accounting, and Data Engineering. This role is based in one of San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE - The big bet: Create a reliable GTM and quote-to-cash foundation across CRM, CPQ, billing and finance systems, marketing automation infrastructure, the data warehouse, and the integrations between them. - By day 90, build a clear understanding of the critical data flows between GTM systems, finance systems, and the warehouse, then ship an initial improvement to a high-value integration or workflow. - By day 90, develop AI-powered and agent-based workflows that reduce manual work for reps, Deal Desk, and Billing Ops while improving the quality of signals available to reps and operators. - By the end of your first year, automate billing-critical workflows such as upgrades and prorated refunds, early renewals, true-ups, and credit deferment, with audit trails Finance can trust. - By the end of your first year, improve data integrity and reporting through clear data models, deduplication, validation rules, reconciliation, and monitoring—including accurate ARR, pipeline, dashboard, and forecasting infrastructure. - Raise the bar for how the team ships and operates: sound access, change management, and release practices; thoughtful documentation and tool decisions; reusable tests, runbooks, code review, and AI-assisted development practices. SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING - Demonstrated experience in business systems engineering, GTM engineering, revenue operations, or a technical sales or marketing operations role, with the ability to own problems end to end and work effectively across functions. - Strong SQL skills and experience working with a data warehouse such as Snowflake or BigQuery; you design for clean, traceable data and understand how to protect its integrity across systems. - Experience building integrations with APIs, webhooks, event-driven services, reverse ETL, or automation platforms such as Zapier, Workato, or Tray.io http://Tray.io. Scripting in Python or JavaScript, or building serverless integrations, is a plus. - Familiarity with finance systems and concepts such as quote-to-cash, billing, invoicing, and revenue recognition, and the ability to work effectively with Finance and Billing Ops. Experience with an ERP such as NetSuite is a plus. - Hands-on Salesforce development experience with Apex, triggers, Lightning Web Components, and Salesforce automation, following the team’s development and release practices: source control, pull requests, code review, automated testing, and the deployment pipeline - is a plus. - Hands-on experience with Salesforce CPQ, Revenue Cloud, or a similar CPQ tool — including product and pricing data models, price books, bundles, and approval rules — is a plus. - Genuine curiosity about AI, with experience applying it to day-to-day work through AI-assisted development, agents, or workflow automation. Familiarity with Salesforce administration and customization—including objects, flows, permissions, and integrations—is a plus, not a requirement. title: Senior AI Engineer
description: About Rivia Rivia is a technology company building a data engine that powers the future of clinical trial intelligence. Rivia was founded on the belief that new drugs can be brought to market more successfully with a fraction of today's capital. Biotechs are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is constantly constrained by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia unifies clinical trial data at scale through a core engine built as a reusable intelligence layer, comprising hundreds of configurations and trial-specific logic, independent of source structure. This vertical stack of data engine, workflows, and agents creates a distinct advantage in how trials are operated. Over the past two years, European and US based biotechs running global clinical trials on Rivia have demonstrated measurable impact, from earlier understanding of therapeutic potential to significantly more efficient trial execution. In March 2026, Rivia raised its $15M Series A led by Earlybird Venture Capital. Rivia’s ambition is to become the standard infrastructure for modern drug development, transforming how trials are executed end-to-end. The team designs and operates agentic, production-grade AI workflows that power critical monitoring, data quality, and insight-generation capabilities for clinical trial stakeholders.​ By building reliable, auditable, and scalable AI systems, AI Engineering helps transform fragmented clinical data into actionable intelligence and positions Rivia as the AI-first platform for clinical trial intelligence. The Role As a Senior AI Engineer at Rivia, you will architect and ship high-impact AI workflows that materially improve how clinical trial teams monitor studies, assess data quality, and make operational decisions.​ You will work as a key technical contributor embedded in product initiatives, owning AI features end-to-end from design and evaluation through to deployment, observability, and continuous improvement.​ The ideal candidate is a product-minded engineer who combines deep LLM and agentic systems expertise with strong software engineering skills, a bias to action, and a passion for turning cutting-edge AI into reliable, commercially impactful products in a complex, regulated domain. What excites you Being part of a collaborative startup where you can make a direct impact on the product, the business, and the team. Working in a fast-paced environment where you can leverage your AI engineering expertise to solve complex, real-world problems in clinical trials. Building AI systems that customers rely on for critical decisions, where trust, traceability, and auditability are essential. Owning outcomes end-to-end, driving clarity, momentum, and quality without heavy oversight, and continuously learning and experimenting in the rapidly evolving LLM landscape. Responsibilities Architect and ship production-grade agentic AI workflows, including tool use, orchestration, planning, memory, and structured outputs, for clinical trial intelligence use cases. Translate user workflows and product requirements into pragmatic, measurable AI solutions that work reliably in production and optimize for user and business value. Design and maintain evaluation pipelines, including gold sets, metrics, and experiments, and use them to drive iteration with rigor. Implement robust LLMOps practices, including tracing, monitoring, cost and latency management, safe deployment, and continuous improvement of AI systems in production. Design high-quality retrieval and context pipelines with strong guarantees on correctness, provenance, and auditability, particularly in regulated environments such as clinical trials. Collaborate closely with Engineering, Product, Design, Sales, and Customer teams to ensure AI features are usable, trusted, and commercially impactful. Stay deeply current with the LLM ecosystem, actively experiment with new models and tools, and translate innovation into practical product advantage. Proven experience building and shipping production-grade AI or agentic systems, ideally in high-stakes or complex domains. title: Procurement & Supply Chain Lead
description: About Hyperscale Power Hyperscale Power is building the power backbone for the AI data center era: a complete power conversion chain from 13.8kV–35kV medium-voltage AC down to 800V DC, combining ultra-compact SiC-based AC/DC and DC/DC power blocks. As we scale from Alpha customer readiness toward Production and Volume Readiness, securing the right components at the right price and lead time – power semiconductors, magnetics, PCBs and mechanical parts – becomes mission-critical. The role As Procurement & Supply Chain Lead, you will own the purchasing and supply chain for the materials, equipment, parts and services that keep our prototype, pilot and volume production on track – from negotiating with suppliers to coordinating with contract manufacturers and logistics partners. You will partner closely with Engineering to translate technical requirements into sourcing decisions, and help build our purchasing processes as we scale. This role is for you if you’ve negotiated with component suppliers yourself, like being hands-on, and enjoy building processes rather than following them – ideally with experience buying electronic components for B2B hardware such as power electronics, industrial equipment or automation systems. It isn’t for you if you prefer managing a team, require an established ERP and approval chain to work well, or a clearly defined, stable scope. It would not be a fit if your procurement background is mainly consumer goods, retail or indirect spend without hands-on exposure to electronic components. What you will do Contract and purchase raw materials, equipment, tools, parts, services and supplies needed for prototype, pilot and volume production. Negotiate pricing, terms and delivery schedules with suppliers for critical components – power semiconductors, magnetics, PCBs, and mechanical/enclosure parts. Issue and manage purchase orders; track order status and expedite as needed to meet production schedules. Source and coordinate with suppliers and contract manufacturers (EMS, PCB vendors, logistics partners) on order status, lead times and quality issues. Work closely with Engineering to understand technical requirements, communicate them clearly to suppliers, and identify alternate sourcing options for critical or long-lead-time components. Support supplier qualification and specification compliance for new and existing vendors. Maintain purchasing records, the Bill of Materials (BOM) and sourcing data; track lead times, inventory levels and supplier performance, and flag supply chain risks. Drive logistics and inbound/outbound shipments together with our logistics partners. Scale the supplier base and purchasing processes as we move from Alpha Customer readiness to Production and Volume Readiness. What you bring BSc in supply chain management, business administration, engineering or comparable education, or equivalent experience. Several years of hands-on experience in procurement, purchasing or supply chain, specifically in electronics or hardware manufacturing. Strong negotiation skills; track record of managing supplier contracts and pricing. Our platform processes billions of API requests per month and supports applications with millions of concurrent users, while delivering highly reliable, low-latency services and a great developer experience. The role We're looking for a Staff Backend Engineer to join Stream on our mission of elevating the quality of apps for billions of users globally. You'll own the technical direction of Stream Video's media plane and the infrastructure it runs on. This is a full-time role, hybrid with 3 days a week in our Amsterdam office, or remote from anywhere in the EU. What you'll work on Stream Video runs on an SFU we built in Go on top of Pion, plus ingest and recording fleets, all on a global edge network we own across more than one cloud. Our central infrastructure team is tuned for request-based services, and video breaks in different ways: live sessions can't be dropped, bandwidth is the biggest cost, and placement is the main lever. That's why this is a Staff role. You'll set the direction for the video backend and its infrastructure with your own roadmap, reporting to our Director of Engineering with a direct line to our CTO. The Video SDK teams own the client side, and you'll work closely with them and with infrastructure. Part of the fleet is mid-move to Kubernetes. title: Head of Solution Consulting R&D / Field CSO
description: We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era. When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done. Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma. More than half of the world's top 50 biopharma companies already use Benchling, and many of the most important are in Europe. Our ambition is 10x faster science, from idea to first dose. With Science Foundries, launched at Benchtalk 2026, agents and scientists run entire R&D workflows together, so a three-person team can have the productive capacity of thirty. In a senior R&D role, you can change how one organisation does science. As our Field CSO, you'll take one question to R&D organisations across EMEA: how do we get from idea to first dose 10x faster? You'll be the scientific counterpart to our General Manager, EMEA, and work alongside our Field CTO. They lead on IT, data science and architecture; you lead on the scientists and how their work changes. RESPONSIBILITIES Be the scientific voice in the room. Brief the GM and account teams before key meetings, then join them as a peer to the CSOs and Heads of R&D across the table. Decide with sales leadership where to focus the team's expertise, and bring patterns from the field back to Product, Marketing and global Solution Consulting. A record of driving change, from adopting new technologies to rethinking how your teams work, and clear views on how AI will change R&D. Readiness for a field role: frequent on-site time with the largest pharma and biotech companies across EMEA, plus US travel three to four times a year for team offsites and our global sales kickoff. title: Senior ML Engineer
description: For this role, we will only consider candidates who are currently based in the Netherlands. About SkinVision Skin cancer is highly treatable when caught early, but limited access to specialist care and long wait times delay diagnosis, increasing the risk of late-stage cases and driving up treatment costs. SkinVision, founded in Amsterdam in 2012, exists to close that gap. Our proprietary AI — certified as a Class IIa medical device under EU regulation, with over 90% sensitivity and 89% specificity — has already helped over 3 million people worldwide. Today, SkinVision has a database of more than 6 million skin cancer images and can reach 20 million people through insurer partnerships. Where needed, cases are reviewed by a team of dermatologists, who support users in taking the right next step — from urgent care to a specialist referral. We are extending this further, connecting users faster to the specialist care they need. We're a focused, international team, active globally, united by one goal: making early detection accessible to everyone, everywhere. If you join us, you're not just building a product — you're helping close the gap between a person noticing something and getting the care they need. Senior Machine Learning Engineer at SkinVision We're on the lookout for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer based in our Amsterdam office with the right skills and experience to ensure the Machine Learning team releases models with exceptional performance making use of state-of-the-art techniques. Not only are ML models vital to our product and hence for our end users, e.g., enabling early detection of skin cancer, they also enable our internal team to perform optimally. The ideal candidate possesses strong expertise in training new and optimizing existing Machine Learning and computer vision models (Python), has hands-on experience in MLOps and deploying models to production (preferably in AWS) and is able to gather requirements and communicate results to the stakeholders directly involved in the model development and deployment. Moreover, in this senior role, it is vital that you can mentor other team members, own the technical processes and actively contribute to the ML roadmap. Knowledge of data orchestration tools (Apache Airflow), data modeling (dbt) and working in a regulated and/or medical environment are a plus! What you will do Drive the full ML model development lifecycle: from understanding and co-defining the problem to providing inputs on data collection, assessing the quality of data, model training, validation, deployment and monitoring. Create requirements for data collection for both new and existing models. This includes data for model training and testing. Develop and improve efficient ML training pipelines in the cloud (AWS or similar). Involve stakeholders appropriately during the entire development, deployment and monitoring lifecycle. Scale the ML environment and processes to multiple models being developed and deployed simultaneously. Ensure ML development aligns with medical device standards if applicable, including ML best practices, experiment tracking, traceability, data lineage and documentation. Support and mentor team members. Showcase ML models and capabilities both internally and externally, by giving presentations, workshops, training, etc. Stay abreast of the latest industry standards, best practices and emerging trends in Machine Learning and AI and share insights with the broader team. Your profile 8-10 years of proven professional experience as a Machine Learning Engineer or similar role, showcasing exceptional proficiency in model training, deployment within a consumer product, data analysis, stakeholder management and teamwork/mentoring. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Econometrics, Statistics, Computer Science or a related field. title: Business Development Intern
description: Big changes start with people who want to achieve more. How do employees get to work? Why do company cars sit idle while parking spaces are scarce? And how can we make sustainable mobility the most attractive choice? At Urban Connect , we turn these challenges into practical solutions. We bring shared e-bikes and company cars, public transport, mobility budgets and digital parking management together on one platform. We help companies reduce costs, make better use of resources and give their employees greater freedom. Companies such as Roche, Google, SWISS and Lonza already rely on us. Our ambition goes further: we want to transform how companies manage mobility. To make that happen, we are looking for curious minds who take ownership and want to make a difference together. Your internship: accelerated learning, real responsibility Want to understand how a technology company grows—and help make it happen? During this six-month internship, you will work closely with our Sales and Account Management team, as well as Product and Operations. You will learn to understand customer needs, develop compelling solutions and turn data into tangible business opportunities. Your initiative matters. You will contribute your own ideas, take on increasing responsibility and see the impact of your work. How you will make a difference Turn data into opportunities: analyse usage and market data, including vehicle and parking utilisation, and translate your findings into recommendations for better corporate mobility solutions. Drive your own projects: Work with the team lead to take ownership of clearly defined projects, such as analysing products, assessing sales opportunities and developing corporate mobility concepts. Understand the product: learn how customers are set up on our platform, how bookings and billing work, and how vehicles and parking barriers are connected. Work smarter with AI: use AI tools thoughtfully, test new applications and help us improve research, analysis and everyday processes. Help drive growth: identify prospective customers, research their challenges and support the team in winning new business and expanding existing partnerships. Make a compelling case: create clear presentations, well-founded proposals and insightful quarterly reviews that demonstrate the value of our solutions. Keep things moving: maintain accurate customer data and activities in HubSpot, ensuring good conversations lead to clear next steps. Connect teams: resolve technical questions with the Product, Operations and Technology teams and communicate the answers clearly to customers and the Commercial team. What you bring An excellent degree, for example in business, economics, data science, engineering or industrial engineering. We are looking for excellence, curiosity, creativity and courage - not to have studied a perfect subject. Some practical experience through an internship, part-time job, personal project or entrepreneurial initiative. An analytical mindset, confidence with Excel and the ability to understand and communicate complex ideas and interdependencies clearly and simply. Ability to think outside of the box and to question conventional ways of doing things. Experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot - and the excellent judgement to critically assess their output. In fact, good judgment is a key criterion for success with us. An interest in technological progress, the curiosity to truly understand how things work, and the confidence to contribute your questions and ideas to a highly motivated team. Excellent German and good English skills. French is a big plus. Above all, we value your mindset: you learn quickly, ask thoughtful questions and think ahead. You take initiative, develop suggestions and seek support when you need it. You care about the details, strive to make good work even better and are willing to take a risk sometimes to try something new - even when that means making a mistake and learning from it. What you can expect High standards - and an environment of smart, kind people to challenge you to grow. We are ambitious, give direct, constructive feedback and support one another. Excellence shows up in our everyday work: in thoughtful solutions, careful execution and the drive to keep improving. A view of the whole business. You will work at the intersection of sales, customer success, technology and operations, learning how an idea becomes a solution that customers value. Direct access and room to take initiative. Good ideas get heard quickly here. Your responsibility grows with your capabilities and commitment. The opportunity to build a future with us. If we are a good fit for each other, there is an opportunity to join Urban Connect beyond the internship and grow with the company. You will also benefit from: Flexible working hours and a beautiful office in Zurich. A monthly mobility budget and access to our e-bikes and shared electric cars. A motivated team that enjoys working together (mostly in person), sharing knowledge, growing together, and celebrating success together! Ready to make a difference? Send us your CV and a few personal lines: Why Urban Connect? And what are you proud of having initiated, solved or improved yourself? We look forward to meeting you. Up to 20 “Work From Anywhere” days annually to explore the world while staying connected. A fully paid four-week sabbatical after five years with Perk. description: Who We Are You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today. As stakeholder expectations and regulations evolve, we’re building the future of sustainability intelligence. We’re looking for someone passionate about the intersection of tech and sustainability, who’s eager to simplify systems and data by developing digital-first tools. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in fast-paced, global teams and wants to shape the next generation of ESG reporting. What you bring Strong interest in sustainability, ESG reporting, and emerging regulations (e.g., CSRD, ESRS, ISSB). Experience in application or through studies is a plus. Passion for technology and AI, with experience or interest in process automation, data integration, or reporting systems. Comfortable with systems such as G-suite, Microsoft Office, etc. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to distill complexity into clarity. Strong communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams and present ideas to technical and non-technical stakeholders. A self-starter mindset: proactive, adaptable, and comfortable navigating ambiguity. Fluent in English; additional languages are a bonus. Bachelor’s degree or higher. Why Prosus? title: Lead Backend Engineer, Service Standards
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Brief info about Vinted </strong></h2> <p data-renderer-start-pos="1"><span data-sheets-root="1">Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. <br>The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:<br><br><strong><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/marketplace" target="_blank">Vinted Marketplace</a></strong> is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedgo" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Go</strong></a> enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedpay" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Pay</strong></a> is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.<br><br>Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. </span></p></div><h2><strong>Information about the position </strong></h2> <p>As a <strong>Lead Backend Engineer </strong>in the <strong>Service Standards</strong> team, you will shape how services are built, deployed, and operated across all of Vinted. You will work closely with a team on the development of our core service framework—providing engineering teams with golden paths, robust service contracts, standardized tooling, and performance benchmarks to ensure high reliability and developer velocity at scale.</p> <p><br>You will sit in the Service Standards team, part of the Service Ecosystem domain, reporting to the Engineering Manager of that team.</p> <p><br>The Service Standards team is responsible for standardizing service startup, consumer APIs, and foundational backend frameworks across Vinted's engineering landscape. Within it, this is a senior individual-contributor role combining technical leadership with high autonomy—you will define architectural directions, establish best practices, and guide engineers across domains without requiring full management overhead.</p> <p><br>You will collaborate closely with platform, observability, and product engineering teams to ensure our service framework and standards seamlessly integrate into daily workflows. Your work will directly impact developer experience, platform reliability, and system performance as Vinted continues to scale.</p> <h2><strong>In this position, you’ll </strong></h2> <ul> <li>Lead the technical direction and design around service standards and golden paths.</li> <li>Define and evolve company-wide service standards, including consumer APIs, service contracts, startup routines, and performance guidelines.</li> <li>Build reusable backend libraries, tools, and scaffolding to streamline new service creation and maintenance.</li> <li>Partner with backend engineers across domains to drive adoption of framework updates and gather continuous feedback.</li> <li>Evaluate pragmatic trade-offs between architectural consistency, delivery speed, and technical debt across the platform.</li> <li>Collaborate with Observability and Infrastructure teams to integrate telemetry, SLOs, and resilience practices into standard service templates.</li> <li>Ensure security, privacy, and compliance guidelines are embedded directly into service contracts and framework templates.</li> <li>Mentor senior backend engineers, participate in architectural design reviews, and foster high description: Wat ga je doen? Als Operations & Events Stagiair(e) help je mee om onze dagelijkse vaarten soepel te laten verlopen. title: Senior contractmanager (domein IT)
description: Wil jij ervoor zorgen dat belangrijke contracten niet alleen goed zijn afgesloten, maar gedurende de hele looptijd ook daadwerkelijk waarde leveren? En krijg jij energie van leveranciers uitdagen, risico’s beheersen en samen met de business sturen op prestaties en verbetering? Kies dan voor Univé! Wie zijn wij? Het mooie van Univé? Dat zijn de mensen, de resultaten, de geschiedenis, de cultuur, het ontstaan en de betrokkenheid. Dat is samenwerken. Een coöperatie zijn zonder winstoogmerk. Dicht bij onze leden staan. En samen bouwen aan een organisatie die betrouwbaar, toekomstbestendig en wendbaar is. Wij richten ons op het voorkomen van risico’s, het beperken van gevolgen en we verzekeren alleen als het echt nodig is. Coöperatie Univé bestaat uit zeven verschillende Regionale Univé’s, zodat we op landelijk én lokaal niveau altijd dichtbij onze leden zijn. Dat is het mooie van Univé. Waar kom je te werken? Je komt te werken binnen de afdeling Inkoop & Facilitaire Zaken, in het team Inkoop & Contractmanagement. Dit team voert binnen Univé de regie op inkoop-, contract- en leveranciersmanagement. Ons doel? Grip op uitgaven en risico’s, professionele en efficiënte processen én optimale ondersteuning van de business. We zijn volop in ontwikkeling. Inkoop & Contractmanagement groeit verder naar een professionele, businessgerichte en datagedreven regiepartner. Dat betekent dat we niet alleen kijken naar wat er contractueel is afgesproken, maar vooral ook naar de waarde die contracten en leveranciers gedurende de looptijd daadwerkelijk voor Univé realiseren. Als contractmanager speel jij daarin een belangrijke rol. Je werkt intensief samen met contracteigenaren, management, inkopers, Risk, Compliance en Juridische Zaken. En natuurlijk met onze leveranciers. Jouw uitdaging Als contractmanager ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het realiseren en bewaken van contractwaarde gedurende de volledige looptijd van onze contracten. Je voert regie op het contract- en leveranciersmanagement van de aan jou toegewezen contracten en leveranciers. Daarbij stuur je op naleving van afspraken, kosten, kwaliteit, risico’s, performance, compliance en duurzaamheid. Je zorgt ervoor dat Univé grip houdt op de ingekochte dienstverlening en dat afspraken niet alleen op papier goed geregeld zijn, maar in de praktijk ook worden nagekomen. Daarbij ben je een stevige gesprekspartner voor zowel de business als leveranciers. Je organiseert en leidt leveranciersoverleggen, maakt prestaties en risico’s inzichtelijk en zorgt dat acties daadwerkelijk worden opgevolgd. Zie je afwijkingen, kansen of risico’s? Dan wacht je niet af, maar kom je in actie. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: regie voeren op complexe, risicovolle en/of strategische contracten; sturen op contractnaleving, kosten, kwaliteit, performance, risico’s, compliance en duurzaamheid; organiseren en leiden van leveranciersoverleggen; bewaken van SLA’s, KPI’s, afspraken en verbetermaatregelen; begeleiden van wijzigingen, indexaties, evaluaties, verlengingen en beëindigingen; signaleren en beheersen van contractuele, leveranciers- en continuïteitsrisico’s; initiëren en begeleiden van verbeterplannen, disputen en escalaties; ondersteunen van contracteigenaren en management bij besluitvorming over contracten en leveranciers; opstellen van analyses en managementrapportages over contractstatus, prestaties, risico’s, acties en besluitpunten; tijdig signaleren wanneer hercontractering of een nieuwe marktbenadering nodig is; bijdragen aan de verdere professionalisering van contract- en leveranciersmanagement binnen Univé. De inhoudelijke beoordeling van de dienstverlening ligt primair bij de business en contracteigenaar. Jij zorgt ervoor dat deze prestaties periodiek worden beoordeeld en voert regie op de contractuele borging, opvolging en eventuele escalatie. Je kijkt daarbij verder dan één overleg of één contractmoment. Wie ben jij? Je bent een contractmanager die regie pakt. Je brengt structuur, houdt overzicht en weet wanneer je moet verbinden, adviseren, onderhandelen of juist escaleren. Je voelt je comfortabel in een omgeving waarin verschillende belangen samenkomen. Je kunt schakelen tussen de dagelijkse praktijk en tactisch-strategische vraagstukken en bent een stevige gesprekspartner voor contracteigenaren, management en leveranciers. Je bent analytisch en risicobewust, maar vooral ook gericht op resultaat. title: Interim Chief Privacy Officer | RVO
description: Omschrijving Wij zijn voor de Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland (RVO) op zoek naar een ervaren Interim Chief Privacy Officer (CPO) . Binnen de afdeling CIP speel je een sleutelrol in het verder ontwikkelen en professionaliseren van de privacyfunctie binnen een grote en complexe overheidsorganisatie. Vanwege het vertrek van de huidige plaatsvervangend CPO is tijdelijke versterking nodig om de continuïteit van de privacyorganisatie te waarborgen. Op termijn wordt de functie structureel ingevuld. In deze opdracht ben je verantwoordelijk voor het verder inrichten en uitbouwen van de CPO-functie, het versterken van de privacy governance en het adviseren van management bij complexe privacyvraagstukken. Je begeleidt en stuurt privacyfunctionarissen functioneel aan, verbindt verschillende stakeholders binnen de organisatie en draagt actief bij aan de verdere professionalisering van privacy, compliance en gegevensbescherming. Taken en verantwoordelijkheden Verder ontwikkelen, inrichten en positioneren van de Chief Privacy Officer-functie. Functioneel aansturen van privacyfunctionarissen en privacyaanspreekpunten binnen de organisatie. Adviseren van hoger management over complexe privacyvraagstukken. Opstellen, uitvoeren en bewaken van het privacyplan. Doorontwikkelen van privacy governance, privacybeleid en bijbehorende processen. Uitvoeren, begeleiden en beoordelen van Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIA's). Deelnemen aan strategische en tactische overleggen op het gebied van privacy en gegevensbescherming. Begeleiden van privacy-audits, onderzoeken en opvolging van verbetermaatregelen. Wat vragen wij? Eisen Afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding op het gebied van gegevensbescherming, privacy of een vergelijkbare richting. Minimaal 2,5 jaar aantoonbare ervaring als Chief Privacy Officer (CPO) of plaatsvervangend CPO binnen de Rijksoverheid. Aantoonbare ervaring met de toepassing van privacywetgeving, waaronder de AVG, binnen grote organisaties met meer dan 1.000 medewerkers. Aantoonbare ervaring met functionele aansturing van privacyfunctionarissen of privacyadviseurs. Aantoonbare ervaring met het ontwikkelen of doorontwikkelen van privacy governance en privacybeleid. Aantoonbare ervaring met het adviseren van hoger management over privacyvraagstukken. Pré Relevante privacycertificering, zoals CIPP/E of CIPM. Ervaring met het uitvoeren of beoordelen van DPIA's. Ervaring met het opzetten, vastleggen, inrichten en vervullen van een CPO-functie. Ervaring met privacygerelateerde audits en onderzoeken. Ervaring met Privacy by Design binnen organisatieprocessen of digitale producten. Kennis van en/of ervaring met de EU AI Act en de relatie tussen AI-governance en privacy. Competenties Overtuigend en verbindend. Bestuurlijk en organisatiesensitief. Analytisch en doortastend. Integer en onafhankelijk in de oordeelsvorming. Informatie Opdrachtduur: 7 maanden met optie verlengen Locatie: Den Haag, met werkzaamheden in Utrecht en Zwolle en deels hybride Inzet: 24 tot 36 uur per week (voorkeur voor 32 uur per week( Contractvorm: ZZP Start: Zo spoedig mogelijk Geïnteresseerd? Wij geven je op korte termijn een inhoudelijke reactie op jouw interesse in de interim opdracht. title: Senior AWS Consultant
description: CloudNation helpt organisaties om het maximale uit de cloud te halen. We combineren diepgaande technische expertise met een pragmatische aanpak en bouwen samen met onze klanten aan schaalbare, veilige en toekomstbestendige oplossingen. We geloven in doen wat werkt: geen dikke rapporten, maar concrete oplossingen met zichtbare impact. Onze consultants staan midden in de uitvoering, werken nauw samen met klanten en zoeken continu naar manieren om te verbeteren en te innoveren met cloud en AI. Wat ga je doen? Als AWS Cloud Consultant sta je midden in de uitvoering: Je ontwikkelt cloudstrategieën en vertaalt businessdoelen naar concrete AWS-oplossingen, op basis van een grondige analyse van de bestaande IT-omgeving en het AWS Well-Architected Framework. Je onderzoekt samen met klanten waar AI echt waarde toevoegt, van slimme automatisering tot generatieve AI met Amazon Bedrock. Je neemt de rol van meewerkend voorman: je stuurt engineers aan en werkt zelf actief mee aan de implementatie van cloudoplossingen. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de delivery binnen scope, stelt een Work Breakdown Structure op en bewaakt samen met de projectmanager de voortgang, kwaliteit en planning. Je coacht en ontwikkelt je team volgens het ‘To do, To participate, To do it yourself’-principe. Je zorgt dat oplossingen schaalbaar, veilig en toekomstbestendig zijn en blijft na oplevering betrokken bij optimalisatie en doorontwikkeling. Over deze rol Dit is een senior rol met een duidelijke Customer Lead-overlay. Naast een sterke basis als AWS Cloud Consultant ben jij het vaste aanspreekpunt voor de klant en verantwoordelijk voor de waarde die we samen realiseren, over de hele lifecycle. Je combineert technische kennis met leiderschap, neemt teams en partners mee en vertaalt cloudmogelijkheden naar concrete impact. Tegelijk bouw je aan sterke, langdurige klantrelaties en help je zowel de klant als het team steeds een stap verder. Als Customer Lead: Ben je het vaste aanspreekpunt en escalatiepunt voor de klant. Neem je eigenaarschap over de klantroadmap en stuur je op bedrijfswaarde. Ben je verantwoordelijk voor de uitkomsten van de delivery en stuur je bij wanneer resultaten afwijken van de verwachtingen. Vorm je tijdens Continuous Delivery samen met de People & Process Officer het governance-model richting de klant. Vertegenwoordig je intern het perspectief van de klant en breng je collega’s en partners op één lijn. Signaleer je kansen om de samenwerking verder uit te bouwen. Onze gedachte We werken volgens ons 6D Delivery Model. Als Customer Lead houd je de rode draad vast over alle fasen. Het zwaartepunt van jouw deliverywerk ligt hier: DISCOVER, DEFINE & DESIGN Je analyseert IT-omgevingen, voert Well-Architected Reviews uit en vertaalt businessdoelen naar concrete AWS-strategieën, migratieplannen, roadmaps en toekomstbestendige oplossingen. DEVELOP & DEPLOY Als meewerkend voorman stuur je engineers aan en werk je zelf mee aan de implementatie en uitrol. Je bewaakt scope, voortgang en kwaliteit, stelt de Work Breakdown Structure op en neemt eigenaarschap over de delivery, in nauwe afstemming met de klant en projectmanager. CONTINUOUS DELIVERY Je zorgt voor een succesvolle oplevering en blijft betrokken bij optimalisatie, innovatie en doorontwikkeling. In deze fase komt de Customer Lead-rol het sterkst naar voren: je bewaakt de klantwaarde en geeft samen met de People & Process Officer richting aan de governance. Wat neem je mee? Ruime ervaring, doorgaans 5+ jaar, met AWS-services, architectuur en cloudoplossingen. Ervaring met AWS-frameworks zoals Well-Architected, AWS CAF en landing zones, inclusief migraties en optimalisatie. Sterke hands-on ervaring met Infrastructure-as-Code, CI/CD en het realiseren van AWS-oplossingen. Ervaring met het aansturen van technische teams en het nemen van eigenaarschap over complexe klantprojecten. Je combineert technische expertise met sterk stakeholdermanagement en stuurt op bedrijfswaarde en resultaat. Ervaring met AI-assisted development en AI in je dagelijkse werk, bij voorkeur met een agentic way of working. Goede beheersing van Nederlands en Engels. Relevante AWS-certificeringen zijn een pré. Wat bieden wij? Een marktconform salaris van 66k-115k per jaar. Een leaseauto of mobiliteitsbudget, laptop, telefoon, pensioenregeling en 26 vakantiedagen. Een persoonlijk opleidings- en certificeringsbudget voor jouw ontwikkeling in AWS en AI. Ondersteuning bij het behalen van certificeringen, waarbij behaalde certificeringen terugkomen in je salaris. Een rol met veel eigenaarschap, waarin je een eigen klantportfolio draagt en stuurt op waarde en groei. Volop ruimte voor innovatie, eigen initiatief en het werken met de nieuwste cloud- en AI-technologie. Hybride werken, met Bunnik als thuisbasis en vrijdag als gezamenlijke kantoordag. Een open en ondernemende cultuur waarin we samenwerken, van elkaar leren en successen vieren. Over CloudNation CloudNation, an IG&H company, helpt organisaties versnellen met cloud en AI. Als AWS Premier Tier Services Partner combineren we diepgaande technische expertise met strategisch inzicht om organisaties niet alleen te moderniseren, maar ook toekomstbestendig te maken. We geloven dat echte impact ontstaat wanneer strategie en uitvoering samenkomen. Daarom adviseren onze consultants niet alleen, maar bouwen en realiseren ze ook: van de eerste strategie tot implementatie, optimalisatie en doorontwikkeling. AI? Wij maken het werkend. We geloven in AI voorbij de hype. We bouwen het, passen het toe bij klanten én gebruiken het iedere dag zelf. Claude op AWS: we bouwen veilige AI-gateways in het AWS-account van de klant, met EU-inference via Amazon Bedrock en een AI Center of Excellence eromheen. Een AI-agentframework: we ontwikkelen agentic AI die onze delivery versnelt, bijvoorbeeld met autonome agents die audit-ready Infrastructure-as-Code opleveren. Productie-AI voor klanten: samen met TOPdesk ontwikkelden we TicketBuddy, een GenAI-servicedeskassistent. AI in ons DNA: van AI Readiness Scans bij klanten tot interne hackathons en AI-literacy, we passen zelf toe wat we adviseren. Interesse? Wil jij AWS-expertise combineren met technisch leiderschap en verantwoordelijkheid voor langdurige klantwaarde? Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. Strong product intuition and user focus have driven adoption across organizations of all sizes. Millions of users now rely on Notion's building blocks to get work done. As Notion scales, there's a unique opportunity to build the data foundations that help our product and company reach their full potential. This role is based in our San Francisco Headquarters. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person.
