title: Principal / Senior Consultant EU Transport & Mobility (Project Delivery & Excellence)
description: Panteia | Transport & Mobility | EU Policy & Research About Panteia Panteia is one of the Netherlands’ leading research and consultancy firms in the fields of transport, mobility and public policy. Headquartered in Zoetermeer, Panteia employs around 70 professionals and works for national governments, the European Commission, EU agencies (CoR, CINEA), international institutions (e.g. EIB, World Bank, etc) and branch organisations. Panteia is part of the PanMuc group, together with Revnext (digitalisation, cybersecurity, technology and innovation). Together, they form a growing European consultancy ecosystem operating at the intersection of transport, sustainability, economics and policy. Panteia also collaborates closely with partner consultancies across all 27 EU Member States. Within the Transport & Mobility (T&M) unit, Panteia has built a strong and trusted position in EU projects, including policy studies, corridor studies, market studies, evaluations and impact assessments. As Panteia’s EU transport and mobility portfolio continues to grow in scale and complexity, this role is created to anchor delivery quality and long-term excellence. The role To further strengthen delivery quality and execution excellence, Panteia is looking for a Principal Consultant EU – Project Delivery & Excellence. This is a senior leadership role focused on the co-ordination, execution and quality assurance of complex EU-funded transport and mobility projects (research and consultancy). The role is designed for an experienced EU consultant who excels in structuring delivery, steering teams, managing risk, and ensuring that projects meet the highest professional standards. A job for a policy-driven expert who wants impact and autonomy. The Principal Consultant EU transport and mobility holds end-responsibility for delivery performance across a portfolio of EU projects and acts as a senior point of contact for clients and consortium partners. Key responsibilities Project delivery & leadership Lead and oversee the execution of EU transport and mobility projects, including corridor studies, evaluations, impact assessments and policy research. Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope and budget, and in line with contractual and quality requirements. Act as senior escalation point for delivery issues, client questions and consortium coordination. Maintain strong working relationships with the European Commission, EU agencies and international partners. Team & quality leadership Steer and coach multidisciplinary project teams (internal consultants and external partners). Safeguard consistency, methodological soundness and professional quality across deliverables. Contribute to the continuous improvement of internal workflows, delivery standards and quality assurance processes. Role in acquisition & transition The Principal Consultant plays a key strategic role in shaping delivery approaches during tenders and proposals: Shaping delivery concepts, work plans and governance structures in EU proposals. Identifying delivery risks and mitigation strategies at proposal stage. Ensuring a smooth and effective handover from acquisition to project execution. Position in the organisation Reports to: Team manager. Team: Works closely with an international EU team of approx. 10–15 consultants, plus external consortium partners. Leadership role: Senior delivery lead across multiple EU-funded projects, with high autonomy and responsibility. Practicalities Location: Zoetermeer (NL), hybrid model – Regular presence at HQ expected (approx. 3 days/week) – Occasional travel to Brussels and other EU locations. Languages: English required; additional EU languages are an asset. Start date: As soon as possible. Package: Competitive salary, aligned with Dutch consultancy benchmarks. Why join Panteia? Work at the forefront of EU transport and mobility policy – from social aspects of transport, to transport infrastructure resilience. Combine analytical depth with real policy impact. Focus on delivery excellence rather than sales targets. Work in a compact, expert-driven team. Enjoy autonomy to shape how EU projects are delivered. Join a respected, collaborative team with strong EU credentials. Be part of a growing European consultancy ecosystem within PanMuc. What Panteia is looking for: 10+ years of experience managing EU-funded projects in transport, sustainability or policy consulting. Proven track record in complex project execution within a multi-stakeholder environment. Experience with policy studies, corridor studies, impact evaluations, stakeholder consultation, and socio-economic analysis. Excellent team leadership and co-ordination skills. Familiarity with DG MOVE, DG CLIMA or similar EU institutions and processes. Strong communicator in English (spoken and written). Dutch or any additional EU language is a plus. MSc or PhD in Transport Economics, Civil Engineering, Spatial Planning, Public Policy or related field. Willingness to travel to Brussels and other EU locations when needed. title: Senior Adviseur Energie En Laadinfrastructuur Goederenvervoer
description: Werken aan de energietransitie in transport. De transportsector staat voor een fundamentele verandering. Elektrificatie en de ontwikkeling van laadinfrastructuur zijn cruciaal voor de toekomst van het goederenvervoer. Panteia ondersteunt overheden, brancheorganisaties en bedrijven met onafhankelijk onderzoek en advies. Voor ons team Transport en Mobiliteit zoeken wij een senior adviseur die dit werkveld verder uitbouwt. Wat ga je doen? Je werkt aan complexe vraagstukken op het snijvlak van energie, logistiek en beleid. Denk aan de ontwikkeling van laadpleinen, depotladen en de integratie van energie in logistieke systemen. Jij: leidt onderzoeks- en adviesprojecten van offerte tot oplevering; stuurt op kwaliteit, planning en budget van projecten; vertaalt beleidsvragen naar concrete onderzoeksopzetten en werkplannen; ontwikkelt nieuwe proposities rond laden en energie in transport; onderhoudt en bouwt relaties met opdrachtgevers zoals ministeries, brancheorganisaties en bedrijven; speelt een actieve rol in acquisitie en het binnenhalen van nieuwe opdrachten; werkt samen met nationale en - waar relevant - Europese partners. Deze vacature daagt jou uit …om op strategisch niveau bij te dragen aan de oplossing van grote maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Je richt je hierbij op een breed spectrum van goederenwegtransport tot energietransitie vraagstukken als gevolg van strengere klimaat- en energiedoelen. Binnen Panteia is Team Transport & Mobiliteit een onafhankelijke intermediair tussen de transportsector en beleidsmakers en richt zich bijvoorbeeld op onderzoek en advisering van de introductie van batterij elektrische voertuigen, laadinfra tot biobrandstoffen en bijbehorende complexe rekendossiers met forse maatschappelijke belangen en grote financiële gevolgen. Projecten van Panteia hebben vaak een omgeving met meerdere stakeholders en grote politieke aandacht. Panteia T&M biedt scherp inzicht op goederenwegvervoerbeleid en de daarbij behorende omgevingsfactoren, zodat opdrachtgevers verantwoorde beslissingen en beleidskeuzes kunnen maken. Wie die opdrachtgevers zijn? Denk aan lokale, regionale, nationale, en internationale overheden, en brancheorganisaties. Zij kunnen rekenen op gedegen en toepasbaar onderzoek en advies van Panteia. Aan afwisseling en uitdaging geen gebrek dus! Als onze nieuwe senior adviseur zit jij boven op de ontwikkelingen in de samenleving en weet je precies wat onze opdrachtgevers drijft en waar zij behoefte aan hebben. Wat breng je mee? Je combineert inhoudelijke kennis met gevoel voor de praktijk en weet hoe beleid, markt en techniek samenkomen. We find a healthy work-life balance important: working flexible hours combined with 30 vacation days a year and the option to buy more; 8% holiday allowance; Travel allowance of € 0,23/km with a daily maximum of 150 kilometers. For your own sustainability Be secured with our pension plan; Feel engaged and join our participation plan; Keep on learning with your personal education possibilities and budget; Be happy and fit by using our healthy cafeteria, our free on-premises fitness where you can participate in CrossFit, Pilates and Spinning classes or play table tennis or table football. Our values Priva's mission is to create an optimal environment where people can work, grow and develop. We offer worldwide solutions for horticulture and building automation. Our ambition is to be known as the leading technology and service provider for sustainable urban deltas. We are proud that our solutions result in lower consumption of natural resources and contribute to some of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Our culture is built around our core values; sustainable, innovation, make it happen and human. In our latest employment survey, our colleagues mainly described our culture as: open, ambitious, innovative, friendly, committed, informal, flexible and down to earth. We aim to be a dynamic, fast-paced, flat and informal organization, where our colleagues have the space to grow and develop. We believe that to be successful, it is important to include people with different perspectives, backgrounds and cultures. Every day, we continue to build our open culture with people who are driven to turn our vision into reality, regardless of who they love, where they are from, or what they believe in. We encourage and celebrate people to voice their opinions and be their authentic selves. Apply Does this make you smile, and do you see yourself as our new Embedded Staff Engineer? title: Senior Backend Engineer – Energy Optimization & Platform
description: At Priva Energy, we build software systems that help customers manage and optimize energy in real-world environments, from greenhouses to buildings. You'll join one of our Energy Solutions teams (spanning Building Automation, Horticulture, and Energy Flexibility Trading), landing wherever the need is greatest at the time, and you'll also carry some responsibility for the cloud infrastructure and scalability that benefits teams beyond your own. You'll work at the intersection of three things: shipping features end-to-end in Priva Digital Services (touching both backend and, where needed, the front end), integrating optimization and forecasting logic into production services , and strengthening the cloud/DevOps foundation the whole department builds on. You don't need to be equally deep in all three, but you do need to be comfortable moving between them, and you should genuinely enjoy the connective, systems-level work of making things run reliably in production. Come Shape the Future of Sustainable Energy with Priva Priva Energy is working to become the leading global lifecycle partner for high-performing, sustainable buildings, horticultural operations, and energy distribution and management companies. Energy systems are transforming fast: grid congestion, dynamic pricing, decentralized production, and tightening sustainability regulation are reshaping what our customers need from us. Our Digital Twin and optimization technologies exist to meet that shift at scale, delivering measurable results such as lower energy intensity, greater flexibility and reliability, reduced operating costs, and structurally lower emissions. As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll help turn that ambition into production reality: building the services, integrations, and cloud foundation that put our optimization and forecasting capabilities to work for customers every day. Your work will directly contribute to: Reducing and optimizing energy costs and emissions across Europe Enabling customers to participate in future energy flexibility and trading markets Optimizing multi-energy systems (heat, cold, electricity, storage, HVAC) Driving the transition toward autonomous, intelligent buildings and greenhouses Helping customers stay compliant with increasing regulatory pressure (e.g., CSRD) What You’ll Do Priva Digital Services & product engineering Design and build backend services that process data and execute optimization logic for products across Neo Heat, Neo Light, Neo Building, and Neo Smart Contribute to user-facing Priva Digital Services features end-to-end, including front-end work where it's the fastest path to shipping value Build and maintain APIs for internal and external integration Optimization & forecasting integration Implement and integrate optimization and forecasting logic into scalable, production-ready systems. You bring these models into production; you don't develop new optimization theory Work on data processing pipelines, scheduling logic, and system orchestration Cloud infrastructure & DevOps Own and improve cloud infrastructure (Azure) that supports scalability across Energy Solutions teams Strengthen CI/CD, monitoring, and deployment practices so systems are reliable, performant, and maintainable in real-world operation Collaborate with product, domain experts, and other engineers across teams to deliver end-to-end solutions Contribute to technical design decisions within your domain, and participate in the full software lifecycle: ideation → design → development → testing → deployment → monitoring What you will NOT do This is not a research or modelling role. You implement and integrate optimization and forecasting models rather than developing new theory You are not expected to be a dedicated front-end specialist or a dedicated DevOps specialist. The role spans these areas by design, so depth in every direction isn't the bar A bachelor's degree in an IT-related field Around 5 years of experience in a software engineering role, with demonstrated range across at least two of the following: backend/production systems, cloud infrastructure, front-end, or optimization integration. Versatility across these areas matters more here than deep tenure in a single one You've taken systems into production and kept them running, and can show or talk us through examples (work projects, open source, side projects) Experience with one or more of the following is a significant advantage: Python, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes/CI-CD tooling, SQL, KQL, Linux, and front-end frameworks (e.g., React/TypeScript) You are based in the Netherlands and are available to be in the office two to three days per week Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to work with complex, unfamiliar systems A passion for creating customer value through high-quality engineering Curiosity, ownership, craftsmanship, and the drive to keep learning Good communication skills, able to explain trade-offs clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders A good vibe: you bring energy to the team and make collaboration genuinely enjoyable, not just effective What We Offer You 💶 Excellent remuneration, competitive and aligned with experience 🌴 30 days holiday per year, with the option to buy 5 extra at half price 🏦 Excellent pension contribution 🎓 €1,000 education budget per year ⏰ Flexible working hours, and location. 🍱 On-site canteen (e.g., poke bowl for €2) 🏋️ Free onsite gym- with personal trainer. 🎉 A vibrant, open culture where you can be yourself 🌿 Human- and values-driven work, not corporate bureaucracy 🍻 Twice-weekly drinks on Thursdays and Fridays Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior HR advisor / Senior HR Adviseur
description: Maak impact op HR, organisatie en medewerkers Wil jij als Senior HR Advisor complexe HR-vraagstukken vertalen naar praktisch en toekomstgericht HR-beleid? En krijg je energie van adviseren, verbeteren én zelf de handen uit de mouwen steken? Bij Priva werk je nauw samen met onze HR Business Partners, HR Director en HR Operations-collega's. Je bent een ervaren sparringpartner voor het HR-team en de business en draagt bij aan complexe HR-casuïstiek, organisatieontwikkeling en strategische HR-projecten. Je combineert een brede HR-expertise met een praktische aanpak. Van arbeidsrecht en verzuim tot HR-processen, beleid, data en systemen: jij weet wat er nodig is om onze HR-dienstverlening continu te verbeteren. Wat ga je doen? Als Senior HR Advisor : adviseer je over complexe HR-vraagstukken, arbeidsrecht, verzuim, arbeidsvoorwaarden en organisatieveranderingen; ondersteun je HR Business Partners en management bij individuele en collectieve HR-casuïstiek; draag je bij aan strategische HR-projecten rondom onder andere cultuur, organisatieontwikkeling, transformatie en HR-beleid; vertaal je HR-strategie en wet- en regelgeving naar duidelijke en werkbare processen en oplossingen; werk je samen met HR Operations aan een professionele en efficiënte HR-dienstverlening; analyseer en verbeter je HR-processen en systemen; zet je HR-data en technologie in om betere beslissingen en procesverbeteringen mogelijk te maken; werk je actief met HR-systemen zoals AFAS en kijk je verder dan alleen de gebruikerskant om processen slimmer in te richten. Wie ben jij? Je bent een ervaren HR-professional die gemakkelijk schakelt tussen strategie, advies en uitvoering. Je hebt een stevige inhoudelijke HR-basis, maar kijkt tegelijkertijd verder: waar kunnen processen beter, welke impact heeft een verandering op de organisatie en wat hebben managers en medewerkers nodig? title: Consultant senior / Manager - Conseil en transformation, organisation et gestion de projet
description: Pourquoi ce poste existe maintenant Ad Valoris change de modèle. Depuis vingt ans, nous aidons des directions générales de Suisse romande, publiques et privées, à voir clair, à décider et à embarquer leurs équipes. Depuis 2025, nous pratiquons le conseil augmenté : l'IA nous sert à comprendre mieux, à aller plus loin, pas seulement à produire plus vite. Le cabinet est en pleine croissance : de nouvelles directions nous confient leurs enjeux et un deuxième bureau ouvre à Lausanne. Nous cherchons deux personnalités prêtes à rejoindre cette aventure humaine : une équipe dynamique et engagée, au sein de laquelle vous pourrez contribuer au développement du cabinet et tracer votre propre parcours. Ce que vous ferez Vous rejoignez le cabinet comme consultant-e senior ou manager, selon votre expérience. Sur un mandat, vous pouvez assumer plusieurs responsabilités ; en particulier, vous concevez la démarche de chaque mandat, vous vous assurez qu'elle répond au vrai problème du client et vous gérez la relation avec lui tout au long de la mission. Comprendre avant de proposer. Lire la situation du client, ses acteurs et ses non-dits, avant d'arriver en séance. Résoudre le bon problème. Remettre en cause la commande quand elle ne vise pas le vrai sujet, et défendre une recommandation engagée. Co-construire et faire avancer. Apporter tôt une première version, la faire travailler par le client jusqu'à ce qu'il en soit co-auteur, et animer seul-e des séances, y compris sur des sujets complexes, dans des environnements exigeants et avec des parties prenantes aux sensibilités diverses. Créer de la valeur pour le client. Mieux comprendre, aller plus loin dans l'analyse et concrétiser : ce qui compte, ce sont les progrès durables que le client constate dans son organisation. Faire grandir le cabinet. Transmettre, challenger et accepter de l'être. Deux points d'entrée, selon votre expérience : Manager (dès 10 ans d'expérience). Architecte de mission dès votre arrivée : vous cadrez et pilotez des mandats de bout en bout, et vous encadrez un ou deux consultants en continuant à produire. Vous prenez part à la conduite du cabinet : méthodes, recrutement, capitalisation. Trajectoire explicite vers un rôle où vous portez le résultat et la croissance de plusieurs comptes. Consultant-e senior (dès 5 ans d'expérience). Autonome sur un périmètre cadré, vous menez vos entretiens et ateliers seul-e ou en équipe, et vous êtes une référence en conseil augmenté. Trajectoire explicite vers le rôle d'architecte de mission. Le conseil augmenté, tel que nous le pratiquons Le conseil augmenté, ce n'est pas utiliser l'IA pour produire plus vite. C'est l'utiliser pour comprendre mieux, sans jamais laisser la production avancer plus vite que la compréhension. Le test est simple : qu'avez-vous fait du temps que l'IA a libéré ? Plus de livrables, c'est de la sous-traitance à une machine. Plus de présence chez le client et plus de profondeur d'analyse, c'est du conseil augmenté. Ce que nous cherchons Un master ou un diplôme d'ingénieur, et cinq à quinze ans d'expérience en conseil en organisation, stratégie, conduite du changement ou pilotage de programmes. Une pratique réelle du conseil augmenté : vous savez dire ce que vous avez écarté dans une réponse de l'IA et pourquoi, et vous refusez de produire ce que vous n’assumez pas. La capacité à trancher avec une information incomplète, et à ajuster ce choix en avançant, à mesure que la situation se précise. De la fiabilité et de la droiture : vous parlez franchement et vous tenez parole. Pour le point d'entrée Manager : des mandats menés de bout en bout, des consultants que vous avez fait grandir, et des relations de confiance avec vos clients. Maîtrise parfaite du français ou équivalent, excellente plume, anglais courant, allemand un atout. Le tissu romand vous est familier. Ce que nous ne cherchons pas, pour vous éviter de perdre du temps Un-e senior qui veut encadrer sans plus produire. Ici, tout le monde est en séance, les associés compris. Un-e consultant-e qui vit l'IA comme un outil de productivité, ou qui s'en méfie par principe. Un-e spécialiste d'une seule méthode qui veut la plaquer sur chaque client. Ce que vous trouverez chez nous Des terrains variés : État et collectivités publiques, santé et services à la personne, assurances sociales, formation et recherche, organisations internationales et ONG, énergie et mobilité, services financiers et bancaires, horlogerie et luxe, arômes et parfums, grande distribution, et le tissu industriel romand, des grands groupes aux PME. Une trajectoire lisible : un référentiel de compétences partagé, un parcours collaborateur suivi, et un budget de formation continue renouvelé chaque année. Un environnement augmenté réellement outillé : centre d'excellence IA interne, outils maison, base de connaissances du cabinet. Deux bureaux, Genève et Lausanne, et une vraie souplesse : télétravail et horaires flexibles, présence au bureau pour le travail en commun, équilibre entre vie privée et vie professionnelle pris au sérieux. Comment nous recrutons Trois rencontres, une réponse motivée à chaque étape. 1. Trente minutes en visio pour comprendre pourquoi Ad Valoris, et répondre à vos questions. 2. Une heure avec deux de nos collaborateurs : un échange ouvert sur vos motivations et votre projet professionnel, et sur ce que le cabinet peut vous apporter. 3. Une étude de cas avec la direction, tirée d'une situation réelle : avec l'IA, en temps limité, puis en restitution devant les associés. Nous nous engageons à vous répondre sous dix jours ouvrés après chaque étape. Candidature Envoyez votre CV et, à la place de la lettre de motivation, une note d'une page qui répond à cette question : que devient le métier de consultant quand le client a accès à la même IA que nous ? Dites-nous sur quoi vous êtes d'accord avec notre approche, sur quoi vous ne l'êtes pas, et ce que vous apporteriez au cabinet. Appuyez-vous sur au moins une situation que vous avez vécue. Avec ou sans IA, peu importe : ce qui compte, c'est votre avis. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

emerging agentic and AI tooling, with a clear view of cost, risk, and durability.</li> <li>Stand up prototypes and review architecture directly to test whether a proposed fix moves a target metric and represents a durable solution before GitLab makes broader engineering investment.</li> <li>Hire and manage a small, high-caliber team, or operate as a hands-on working manager, with a focus on talent density over headcount.</li> <li>Drive validated fixes from prototype to internal adoption by partnering with affected teams so solutions are relied on, used, and maintained.</li> <li>Build the technical and business case for productizing internal fixes that prove durable, in partnership with product.</li> <li>Document reusable learnings so successful internal fixes don’t remain tribal knowledge.</li> <li>Report impact through changes in key metrics and progress on turning internal fixes into products, including a clear account of what didn’t work.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Ability to use GitLab.</li> <li>A track record of identifying and shipping technical fixes for developer productivity, continuous integration and continuous delivery, or platform friction, including problems you found before they were assigned.</li> <li>Comfort operating with high ambiguity and no existing backlog, building the roadmap rather than executing one handed down.</li> <li>People management experience, including in a small-team or working-manager capacity.</li> <li>Technical depth to evaluate and prototype solutions directly, not only direct others toward them.</li> <li>Product judgment to assess whether an internal tool could hold up for paying customers.</li> <li>Familiarity with agentic or AI-assisted development tooling.</li> <li>Experience moving supply-chain problem.</li> <li><strong>Own What You Build in Production:</strong> Take part in on-call and incident response for the systems your teams own, act as a technical escalation point during complex incidents, and turn what you learn into architectural and operational improvements that prevent recurrence.</li> <li><strong>Influence and Partner:</strong> Shape technical direction across course-correct agent output.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Cross-Team Technical Leadership:</strong> A sustained record of technical leadership across more than one team or a broad product area.</li> <li><strong>Deep Architecture Experience:</strong> Deep backend architecture and production experience in complex applications, services, or platforms, including scaling or governing APIs, service platforms, data systems, modular monoliths, or shared backend components.</li> <li><strong>Modularization in Production:</strong> Experience modernizing a monolith or legacy backend architecture in production, and with modular architecture such as bounded contexts, package encapsulation, ports and adapters, service extraction, event-driven boundaries, or an equivalent approach.</li> <li><strong>Influence Without Authority:</strong> A strong ability to create alignment through clear written proposals and decision records, so decisions are documented, understood, and adopted without constant escalation.</li> <li><strong>Product Judgment:</strong> The ability to balance customer outcomes, delivery speed, technical health, reliability, and long-term platform investment.</li> <li><strong>Mentorship:</strong> Experience mentoring engineers and shaping standards through code review, documentation, and example.</li> <li><strong>Agentic AI Leadership:</strong> Production experience with AI-assisted or agentic engineering workflows, including the ability to evaluate and improve how a team adopts them.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Helpful readiness.</li> <li>Rust adoption or production ownership for systems, security, performance, or platform components.</li> <li>Ruby/Rails modularization and large-monolith modernization.</li> title: Senior AML/CFT Compliance Officer
description: RULEMATCH has built a digital assets trading and clearing venue with world-class partners to meet the specific needs of regulated financial institutions. By offering significantly more capital-efficient and lower latency trading, RULEMATCH is helping increase institutional adoption and enable the next evolution of the crypto and digital asset market. To strengthen our compliance function, RULEMATCH AG, based in Zürich, Switzerland, is looking for a Senior AML/CFT Compliance Officer . In this role, you will play a key part in ensuring the effectiveness and ongoing development of RULEMATCH’s AML/CFT framework. You will combine hands-on compliance expertise with sound regulatory judgement, taking ownership of key compliance processes and contributing to a robust control environment in a dynamic and evolving regulatory landscape. Tasks Take ownership of the ongoing monitoring, maintenance and enhancement of the AML/CFT framework to ensure compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements. Develop, draft, review and maintain internal AML/CFT policies, procedures and controls. Oversee and perform AML/CFT compliance operations, including participant onboarding, KYC and due diligence. Ensure appropriate documentation and lifecycle management of participant relationships. Review and investigate transaction monitoring and screening alerts, assess potentially suspicious activities and ensure appropriate escalation and documentation. Assess the effectiveness of existing AML/CFT controls and drive continuous improvement of processes, systems and risk mitigation measures. Support regulatory matters, including the preparation of documentation, responses and information required by supervisory authorities. Collaborate with internal stakeholders to embed a strong compliance culture and deliver AML/CFT training across the organisation. Requirements Several years of relevant professional experience in AML/CFT compliance, ideally within financial services, banking, digital assets or fintech. Strong knowledge of AML/CFT regulatory requirements and their practical application within a regulated financial institution. Experience in developing and maintaining compliance frameworks, assessing regulatory risks and implementing effective controls. Experience in engaging with supervisory authorities or supporting regulatory examinations and enquiries is a strong advantage. Experience with digital assets, digital securities and related technologies is a plus. Excellent written and spoken German and English are mandatory. Strong professional judgement, integrity and the ability to take ownership of complex compliance matters and make sound, risk-based decisions. A pragmatic, business-oriented and detail-conscious approach, combined with an entrepreneurial mindset. The ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment, manage competing priorities and work flexibly when required. An open-minded, solution-oriented attitude, strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset. A genuine interest in technology and in optimising compliance systems, processes and technical implementations. Benefits Annual salary of CHF 150’000 and additional stock appreciation rights to participate in the increase in value of the company. Be part of a venture in a fast-growing market with the ambition to compete with the world's best. Inspiring environment with a focus on excellence, teamwork, and transparency. Competitive pension plan benefits. Please note that only direct applications will be considered for this position. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

description: About Benetics AI People who build lose nearly a quarter of their working time to things that have nothing to do with building. Ferdinand, an electrician and engineer who had founded companies before, started Benetics AI in 2022 to give that time back. Our first product is a voice assistant for the construction site. It works in over 100 languages and every dialect, and nobody has to type. More than 500 companies in 10+ countries use Benetics AI: electricians, HVAC installers, timber builders, roofers and solar installers. We are bootstrapped, cash-flow positive and growing in triple digits. About the role We are looking for a growth marketer who likes making things and getting them in front of the right people. You will work closely with marketing, product and sales, using customer feedback and campaign results to decide what to make next. What we're looking for Campaign-oriented: Build campaigns around a real customer need, connecting audience, message and channels. High quality bar: Strong judgment and a track record of shipping work that stands out, from ad copy to short-form video. Audience & account-driven: Deeply understand the trades we serve and use what customers and sales tell you to shape every campaign. Multi-channel experience: Hands-on depth across several channels, today mostly Meta Ads, Google Ads and organic social. Content creation & repurposing: Create posts and short-form video, and turn customer stories and product demos into formats that fit each channel. Test and scale: Test clear hypotheses on audiences, messages and creative, and feed what you learn into the next round. Marketing analytics: Track spend and lead quality across channels with input from sales, and keep reporting simple and useful. AI builder: Build AI workflows and agents that turn customer insights and performance data into new copy, images and video, share them with the team, and keep human review where it matters. Sets & hits goals: Own the goals for your channels, measured on cost per lead and lead quality, and decide what to cut and what to scale. Velocity: Move quickly from idea to launch and adapt as channels and tools change. Language & location: Excellent German and English, spoken and written, and based in Zurich, working from our office on site Experience 3 to 5 years in growth or performance marketing, with campaigns you ran hands-on and can talk through. Experience at a B2B tech company; small businesses or the construction trades as an audience are a plus. Experience with HubSpot and with connecting creative or marketing tools through automation is helpful. Why Benetics AI A profitable, bootstrapped company with no investor setting the plan. Ownership of your channels and the workflows behind them, with room to test and improve how we work. Close work with marketing, product and sales, with customer feedback and product knowledge feeding into your content and campaigns. Freedom to pick your tools and automate routine work. How we hire Introduction with hiring manager, 15-minute video call A practical case with the team. Conversation with Ferdinand, our founder, 30 minutes, about the company, growth and the role Final decision. We decide quickly and tell you why. You don't meet every requirement? Apply anyway. title: Solutions Consultant, Mid-Market, UKI
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: Notion is shaping the future of Go-To-Market, and as a Solutions Consultant (SC), you’ll bring that future to life by building alongside customers and turning their biggest challenges into measurable outcomes. As a customer-facing, quota-carrying SC, you’ll bring together technical fluency and commercial ownership to grow your book of business. You’ll build pipeline with BDRs, engage key stakeholders, lead discovery, co-build workflow solutions live with customers, and guide opportunities through close. You’ll connect each solution to a clear business case and stay engaged through adoption, expansion, and renewal so customers realize the value of what they buy. You’ll partner with BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists while maintaining clear ownership of customer relationships, opportunity momentum, and next steps. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role. This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Create pipeline across your book of business. Build target-account plans with BDRs and initiate outreach to priority stakeholders to generate qualified opportunities, alongside BDR-sourced pipeline. - Own opportunities from first conversation through close. Lead discovery, qualify business needs and urgency, align stakeholders, shape the solution and business case, and drive the evaluation and commercial decision. Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path. - Design and validate workflow solutions that deliver measurable value. Map current- and future-state workflows, co-build solutions live in Notion, and define realistic scope, success criteria, and an implementation path. Translate customer needs and validated outcomes into a clear business case, commercial recommendation, and decision path. Treat discovery as an opportunity to build and validate. - Orchestrate the right partners while maintaining ownership. Engage BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists at the right moments, with clear context and asks, while owning opportunity momentum, customer communication, and next steps. - Drive customer value and commercial growth after signature. Partner with Outcomes Architects, guide the initial path to value with a clear adoption plan, on onboarding and ongoing multi-workflow adoption, and own expansion strategy and renewal planning. Stay accountable for translating credits sold into credits consumed, and surface risks or expansion opportunities as customer workflows mature. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - Commercial ownership and pipeline generation. You can demonstrate how you created or advanced business, influenced customer decisions, and owned measurable outcomes. Relevant experience may come from quota-carrying sales or adjacent customer-facing roles. - Technical fluency and builder mindset. You are comfortable building live in software and can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot with a customer without needing a specialist in the room. - AI fluency. You are excited about AI, build with new tools, and continually learn new ways of working. - Discovery, qualification, and value articulation. You can uncover customer needs, map workflows, qualify business impact and urgency, and translate what you learn into commercial outcomes, adoption plans, and clear success criteria. - Agency, urgency, and learning velocity. You set clear goals, take initiative, learn from customer interactions, and apply those learnings to improve outcomes. You bring new ideas and workflows to customers and make complex problems easier to solve. - Complex customer engagement. You can lead multi-stakeholder interactions and navigate procurement, legal, and security review cycles. NICE TO HAVES: - Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience, with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new-logo acquisition and expansion motions. - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals. - Prior experience selling to mid-market and enterprise accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software. - Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or Customer Success team as part of an integrated customer motion. title: Solutions Consultant, Commercial, UKI
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: Notion is shaping the future of Go-To-Market, and as a Solutions Consultant (SC), you’ll bring that future to life by building alongside customers and turning their biggest challenges into measurable outcomes. As a customer-facing, quota-carrying SC, you’ll bring together technical fluency and commercial ownership to grow your book of business. You’ll build pipeline with BDRs, engage key stakeholders, lead discovery, co-build workflow solutions live with customers, and guide opportunities through close. You’ll connect each solution to a clear business case and stay engaged through adoption, expansion, and renewal so customers realize the value of what they buy. You’ll partner with BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists while maintaining clear ownership of customer relationships, opportunity momentum, and next steps. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role. This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Create pipeline across your book of business. Build target-account plans with BDRs and initiate outreach to priority stakeholders to generate qualified opportunities, alongside BDR-sourced pipeline. - Own opportunities from first conversation through close. Lead discovery, qualify business needs and urgency, align stakeholders, shape the solution and business case, and drive the evaluation and commercial decision. Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path. - Design and validate workflow solutions that deliver measurable value. Map current- and future-state workflows, co-build solutions live in Notion, and define realistic scope, success criteria, and an implementation path. Translate customer needs and validated outcomes into a clear business case, commercial recommendation, and decision path. Treat discovery as an opportunity to build and validate. - Orchestrate the right partners while maintaining ownership. Engage BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists at the right moments, with clear context and asks, while owning opportunity momentum, customer communication, and next steps. - Drive customer value and commercial growth after signature. Partner with Outcomes Architects, guide the initial path to value with a clear adoption plan, on onboarding and ongoing multi-workflow adoption, and own expansion strategy and renewal planning. Stay accountable for translating credits sold into credits consumed, and surface risks or expansion opportunities as customer workflows mature. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - Commercial ownership and pipeline generation. You can demonstrate how you created or advanced business, influenced customer decisions, and owned measurable outcomes. Relevant experience may come from quota-carrying sales or adjacent customer-facing roles. - Technical fluency and builder mindset. You are comfortable building live in software and can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot with a customer without needing a specialist in the room. - AI fluency. You are excited about AI, build with new tools, and continually learn new ways of working. - Discovery, qualification, and value articulation. You can uncover customer needs, map workflows, qualify business impact and urgency, and translate what you learn into commercial outcomes, adoption plans, and clear success criteria. - Agency, urgency, and learning velocity. You set clear goals, take initiative, learn from customer interactions, and apply those learnings to improve outcomes. You bring new ideas and workflows to customers and make complex problems easier to solve. - Complex customer engagement. You can lead multi-stakeholder interactions and navigate procurement, legal, and security review cycles. NICE TO HAVES: - Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience, with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new-logo acquisition and expansion motions. - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals. - Prior experience selling to mid-market and enterprise accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software. - Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or Customer Success team as part of an integrated customer motion. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €174,000 per year. By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21 #LI-Onsite A NOTE ON AI You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know. Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

title: Customer Service & Scheduling – German & English
description: Neuchâtel Region | 100% | Temporary 12 months | Start January 2027 Fluent in German and English? Great with customers and strong in coordination? For an international biopharmaceutical company in the Neuchâtel region, we are looking for a German-speaking Site Account Specialist to join an international team supporting treatment centers across Europe. This role is all about communication, coordination and excellent customer service. You will be the key contact for assigned treatment centers, help them manage schedules and processes, solve day-to-day issues and make sure information reaches the right people at the right time. You don't need to be a Cell Therapy expert – you will receive comprehensive training. What matters most is your ability to communicate, organize, take ownership and find solutions. The original BMS profile specifically requires strong customer orientation, scheduling coordination and direct interaction with treatment sites. Site Account Specialist (SAS) -… What you will do Be the main contact for your assigned treatment centers Coordinate patient schedules and ensure information is accurate and up to date Support customers with an online scheduling platform Handle questions and resolve day-to-day issues by phone and email Coordinate with internal teams when changes or problems occur Follow up on open topics and escalate critical issues when needed Maintain customer and scheduling data in internal systems Build strong and trusted relationships with your customers Contribute to a smooth and positive customer experience What you bring We are looking for people with experience in areas such as Customer Service, Customer Care, Account Coordination, Patient Services, Order Management, Logistics or Supply Chain. Around 3 years of relevant professional experience or a Bachelor's degree A genuine customer-service mindset Strong organizational skills and attention to detail Confidence communicating by phone and email The ability to stay calm and solution-oriented when priorities change Good IT skills and the ability to work with several systems and tasks at the same time A proactive attitude and strong sense of ownership Experience in Pharma, Biotech, MedTech or Healthcare is welcome, but not mandatory. Languages – important Fluent German and fluent English are essential. Additional fluent language skills in French, Spanish or Italian are a strong advantage. Contract Start: January 2027 Duration: 12 months, with potential extension up to 24 months Salary: approx. CHF 80'000/year Existing Swiss work permit is mandatory Interested? If you enjoy working with people, coordinating complex processes and finding solutions in an international environment, this could be a great next step. You don't need to know Cell Therapy yet – bring your customer focus, fluent German and English, and organizational talent. We'll take it from there. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Customer Support Specialist 100%
description: Du hast Freude am Kundenkontakt und ein gutes technisches Verständnis? Dann bist du bei Soobr genau richtig! Wir sind ein innovatives Softwareunternehmen mit Sitz in Bern, das mit datengetriebener Technologie das Facility Management neu denkt. Durch die Kombination von Algorithmen und menschlicher Expertise revolutionieren wir die Reinigungsprozesse, fördern Transparenz und Fairness und setzen neue Massstäbe. Unser geografischer Schwerpunkt liegt auf Zentraleuropa, mit der Soobr AG in Bern (Schweiz) und der Soobr GmbH in Hamburg (Deutschland). Das erwartet dich: Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für unsere Kunden per E-Mail, Telefon und Chat bei technischen oder anwendungsbezogenen Fragen. Du analysierst Anfragen, findest Lösungen, dokumentierst sie und trägst dazu bei, dass sich unsere Kunden gut betreut fühlen und unsere Wissensdatenbank laufend besser wird. Du arbeitest eng mit dem Customer Success-, Produkt- und Entwicklungsteam zusammen und gibst wertvolles Feedback aus dem Support-Alltag weiter. Du führst individuelle Schulungen durch und unterstützt unsere Kunden im laufenden Betrieb. Du bringst dein Interesse ein, um bei Tests oder Verbesserungen neuer Produktfeatures mitzuwirken. Das bringst du mit: Eine selbstständige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise. Erfahrung im Customer Support, idealerweise im SaaS-, IT- or Softwareumfeld, oder du kennst die Reinigungs- oder Facility-Branche und möchtest in den digitalen Bereich wechseln. Freude an der Kundenkommunikation und ein sicheres, professionelles Auftreten, auch in anspruchsvollen Situationen. Technisches Verständnis und Interesse, Neues zu lernen. Ausgezeichnete Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, Englisch fliessend, Französisch von Vorteil. Das bieten wir dir: Umfassende Einarbeitung, damit du schnell zum Experten für unser Produkt wirst. Abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben und die Möglichkeit, dich fachlich weiterzuentwickeln Spannende Kundenprojekte im In- und Ausland. Ein motiviertes, offenes Team mit offener Unternehmenskultur und der Vision, das Facility Management zu revolutionieren. Moderne Arbeitsbedingungen am Standort Bern mit der Möglichkeit, 1–2 Tage pro Woche im Homeoffice zu arbeiten Let’s talk! Klingt spannend? title: Senior Regulatory Compliance Officer
description: Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe. Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow – with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable. With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions. We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of. Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together. Your impact Compliance at Mollie is a competitive advantage — and you'll be the one building it. As a Senior Regulatory Compliance Officer, you'll be at the heart of how we scale responsibly across Europe, turning complex regulatory requirements into practical, automated solutions that actually work for the business. You'll own the frameworks, lead the conversations, and make sure compliance moves at the same pace we do. You'll also lead and develop a team of junior and mid-level compliance officers — coaching them, reviewing their work, and helping them grow. Your expertise across AML/CFT, sanctions, and regulatory advisory will set the standard for how the team operates and how compliance is embedded across Mollie. This is a role where your work has real reach. The frameworks you build, the policies you shape, and the culture you foster will directly support over 350,000 businesses growing with less friction and more freedom. What you'll ship A robust, scalable compliance framework across AML/CFT, sanctions, and governance — designed to support Mollie's rapid European expansion Clear, actionable policies and controls that translate PSD2/3, AMLD6 and EBA Guidelines into practical business requirements Proactive risk assessments and thematic reviews that identify and close compliance gaps before they become problems Compliance embedded into product development lifecycles — working closely with Product, Engineering, Legal, Risk, and Operations to make it happen by design, not as an afterthought High-quality regulatory reporting and senior management deliverables, prepared with precision and delivered on time A stronger, more capable compliance team — through structured mentorship, coaching, and quality oversight that raises the bar across the board What you'll bring 7+ years of compliance experience within a regulated financial institution — Fintech, PSP, EMI, or (neo)bank Strong, hands-on knowledge of European regulatory frameworks, including PSD2, AMLD, EBA Guidelines and MiCAR Solid experience across both financial crime (AML/CFT, sanctions) and broader regulatory compliance advisory The ability to translate complex regulations into clear, practical solutions — without overcomplicating it Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge and influence senior leadership when it matters A proven track record of mentoring or managing junior compliance professionals and elevating team performance Grow your way At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms. You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step. No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way. Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy. If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below. a trusted partner in the skeletal dysplasia advocacy community through presentations and participation in relevant external forums</li> </ul> <h3><strong><u>Where You Will Work</u></strong></h3> <ul> preferred.</li> <li>Fluency in both Spanish and Portuguese is required to engage effectively with patient communities and partners in both languages. title: Werk Student Recruitment
description: Werkstudent Recruitment (Nederlandstalig) — Den Haag of Berlijn, hybride (v/m/x) Wil je weten hoe recruitment echt werkt? Bij Eye ga je niet alleen cv's archiveren. Je helpt een groeiend recruitmentteam bouwen aan de manier waarop we mensen aannemen. En als het klikt, willen we je graag laten doorgroeien tot recruiter. Over Eye Eye Security maakt cybersecurity van topniveau, met een ingebouwde cyberverzekering, bereikbaar voor elk bedrijf in Europa, niet alleen voor de grote spelers. We zijn met ruim 190 collega's, met ons hoofdkantoor in Den Haag en een kantoor in Berlijn. Ons team komt uit de inlichtingenwereld, defensie, tech en consultancy. We groeien hard, dus er is veel te bouwen en veel te leren. Wat ga je doen? Je helpt onze recruiters kandidaten te vinden voor lastig in te vullen functies Je screent sollicitaties voor onze junior functies, waarvan veel in het Nederlands Je maakt van recruitmentdata heldere rapportages waar het team en managers echt iets aan hebben Je verbetert hoe we ons ATS gebruiken en houdt de data op orde Je brengt structuur in onze recruitmentkennis, te beginnen met alle vacatureteksten op één plek Je zorgt dat sollicitatiegesprekken soepel verlopen: plannen, afstemmen en contact met kandidaten Je helpt onze contacten met hogescholen en universiteiten op te bouwen De functie is nieuw en groeit mee met jou en met wat het team het hardst nodig heeft. Wie ben jij? Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en redt je goed in het Engels Je zit in het derde of vierde jaar van je hbo- of wo-opleiding en kunt 20 uur per week werken, waarvan 2 à 3 dagen op ons kantoor in Den Haag of Berlijn Je hebt minstens een half jaar administratieve of kantoorervaring (een bestuursjaar telt ook mee) en je bent handig met Excel Je wilt een carrière in recruitment opbouwen en bent benieuwd hoe het vak in elkaar zit Je pakt dingen zelf op: je ziet wat er moet gebeuren, zoekt hulp als je die nodig hebt en stelt goede vragen Mooi meegenomen Je vindt het leuk om met data te werken, of wilt daar beter in worden Je hebt al wat ervaring met recruitment, HR of een ATS Wat krijg je? Vanaf de eerste week echte verantwoordelijkheid, met een recruiter naast je van wie je het vak leert Een duidelijke kans om door te groeien naar junior recruiter Flexibele uren die passen bij je studie, en hybride werken Een team dat successen samen viert, van maandelijkse teamactiviteiten tot onze jaarlijkse "Eye-cation" Over Eye Security Eye Security biedt cybersecurity met een ingebouwde cyberverzekering aan organisaties in heel Europa. Ons hoofdkantoor staat in Nederland en we zijn gegroeid naar ruim 170 medewerkers. We blijven internationaal uitbreiden. We combineren geavanceerde technologie met praktische expertise om cyberdreigingen in realtime te detecteren, erop te reageren en de schade te herstellen. Ons team bestaat uit professionals met een achtergrond in de inlichtingenwereld, defensie, tech en consultancy. We werken allemaal aan dezelfde missie: cybersecurity van topniveau bereikbaar maken voor elk bedrijf, niet alleen voor de grote spelers. Bij Eye werk je aan internationale projecten, los je echte vraagstukken op en help je onze klanten aan een veiligere digitale toekomst. Kleine noot: in de Engelse en Nederlandse vacature in het document staat “ruim 190 collega’s”, wat recentere vacatures van Eye ook noemen. Kijk even welk getal je wilt aanhouden, zodat beide versies hetzelfde zeggen. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Group Fitness Instructor (m/w/d)
description: Als Mitglied der internationalen PureGym Gruppe mit mehr als 2 Millionen Mitgliedern gehören wir zu den drei größten Fitnessketten in Europa und sind damit bestens aufgestellt, um unsere ehrgeizigen Ziele weiter zu verfolgen und zu realisieren. So können wir in Zukunft einen noch grösseren und wichtigeren Beitrag zur Fitness und Gesundheit der Schweizer Bevölkerung leisten. Für unser motiviertes Group Fitness Team in Lenzburg suchen wir ab sofort eine leidenschaftliche und sportbegeisterte Person als Group Fitness Instructor (m/w/d) unter anderem für die folgenden Kurse zu folgenden Zeiten: BODYPUMP und ZUMBA. Du möchtest lieber flexibel als Selbstständige/r arbeiten? Kein Problem – alternativ zur Festanstellung bieten wir dir auch eine freiberufliche Zusammenarbeit zu einem attraktiven höheren Stundenlohn an. Sprich uns gerne direkt darauf an. Für weitere Informationen hierzu wenden dich bitte direkt an die Studioleitung. Deine Aufgaben: Du leitest die Group Fitness Kurse und vermittelst dein Fachwissen mit grosser Begeisterung Du bist für unsere Mitglieder da und betreust sie vor, während und nach deinen Kursen Du bereitest deine Kurse vor, hältst die Gruppendynamik aufrecht und motivierst deine Teilnehmer:innen während des Kurses Du bist verantwortlich für die Einhaltung der Sauberkeit und Hygieneregeln im Kursraum Du kennst unsere Angebote und unsere Philosophie und kannst diese den Mitgliedern vermitteln Du sorgst idealerweise selbstständig für deine Stellvertretungen und bist auch bereit bei Bedarf selbst als Stellvertretung einzuspringen Was du mitbringst: Du hast bereits fundierte Erfahrung als Groupfitness Instructor für die aufgeführten Kursarten und kannst Group Fitness Diplome oder nachweisbare Diplome im Bereich Zumba und Bodypump vorweisen Du hast das Talent andere Menschen zu motivieren und sie mit jedem Training bei dir auf das nächste Level zu bringen Du begeisterst unsere Mitglieder mit der Vielfalt deiner Trainingspalette und bringst in deinen Kursen sowohl Anfänger:innen als auch Fortgeschrittenen mit Spass an Bewegung zu ihren persönlichen Höchstleistungen Du hast das Interesse und die Möglichkeit zukünftig mehrere Lektionen pro Woche an verschiedenen Wochentagen und/oder in verschiedenen Studios zu übernehmen Du verfügst über gute Deutschkenntnisse Was wir dir bieten: Wir sind ein junges, dynamisches und internationales Team Wir bezahlen ein branchengerechtes Salär Wir bieten dir gratis Training in all unseren Studios Bewirb dich jetzt und werde Teil der PureGym-Familie . Lass uns gemeinsam noch mehr Menschen die Möglichkeit geben, ein gesünderes Leben zu leben! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Let op: deze procedure bevindt zich al in een gevorderd stadium: Marketing director @ Snelstart
description: Vacature: Marketing director (B2B SaaS/fintech) @ Snelstart Voor onze opdrachtgever Snelstart ( www.snelstart.nl ) in Amersfoort zoekt Sound People een marketing director die marketingstrategie, executie en teamontwikkeling verbindt. Met 180.000 gebruikers is het een van de grootste boekhoud en accountancy software platforms van Nederland Snelstart maakt ondernemen al 40+ jaar eenvoudiger met slimme software en wil uitgroeien tot de meest vooruitstrevende fintech‑partner van Nederland. Jij krijgt mandaat om die ambitie te versnellen. De rol van marketing director bij Snelstart. · Co-creëer de marketingstrategie met de Sales Director en directie en bewaak de realisatie. · Leid en coach het team (growth & automation, campagnes, product marketing, design, content). · Bouw een AI‑gedreven leadfunnel in HubSpot (Breeze AI), gekoppeld aan Dynamics, voor een constante stroom kwalitatieve MQL’s richting sales. · Vergroot het eigen leadkanaal (‘base’) en verminder afhankelijkheid van externe platformen. · Zet een schaalbare B2B‑contentmachine op op basis van ICP’s, persona’s en doelgroepdata. · Stuur campagnes op ROI; elke euro meetbaar en aantoonbaar resultaat. · Verhoog interne marketingkennis en verminder bureau‑afhankelijkheid; zet AI slim in. · Manage budget en martech‑stack; rapporteer KPI’s (leadvolume, conversie, CPL/CAC, CLV). Wat biedt Snelstart jou? · Brutosalaris €7.500 – €8.500 (40 u/pw), afhankelijk van ervaring. · 30 vakantiedagen (op basis van 40 uur) · Een werkplek in de fijne kantoorruimte van SnelStart in het midden van Nederland. · Maandelijks vakantiegeld en pensioenbijdrage. · Laptop, ergonomische werkplek (zit‑sta), goede koffie/thee, fruit en noten. · Veel ruimte voor ontwikkeling, zingeving, veiligheid en vrijheid. · Een betrokken en dynamisch team. Wat is de procedure? Na een succesvolle telefonische kennismaking volgt een face to face gesprek met Sven Fremeijer. Als we beiden voldoende aanleiding zien om verder te gaan stelt Sound je voor bij SnelStart. Daar volgen 2 gesprekrondes. De eerste gespreksronde wordt gezamenlijk gevoerd door de CCO en HR De tweede ronde zal plaatsvinden met de CCO en een externe adviseur. Als laatste een finale selectie en arbeidsvoorwaarden worden vastgesteld in afstemming met de CEO en het MT. Slotopmerking Deze functie is bedoeld voor een daadkrachtige verbinder die marketing discipline met pragmatisme combineert. Als jij de marketing van SnelStart wilt professionaliseren en de organisatie wilt helpen naar een voorspelbare, succesvolle ‘marketingmachine’, dan horen we graag van je! Neem contact op met Sound People via Sven Fremeijer ( Jouw profiel · Aantoonbare resultaten in digitale marketing op strategisch niveau (focus op wat je hebt neergezet). · Ervaring met het leiden/opbouwen van een marketingteam, bij voorkeur in B2B SaaS/tech. · Bewezen succes met leadfunnel‑bouw en marketingautomatisering. · Aantoonbare resultaten met product‑led growth. · Sterk in performance marketing (paid search/social, SEO/SEA, e‑mailautomatisering, retargeting). · Datagedreven, ROI‑gedreven, vertaalt inzichten naar actie. · Pré: HubSpot, Dynamics, Userpilot, AI in marketing (o.a. Breeze AI), B2B‑contentstrategie. Qua motivatie en ambitie zoeken we iemand om marketingkennis intern op te bouwen en afhankelijkheid van bureaus te verkleinen. Die het team neerzet, begeleid en ontwikkeld. Die het ruime marketingbudget inzet en optimaliseert. Daar zit de change en de uitdaging. Qua persoonlijkheid zoeken we iemand die verbinding maakt met de rest van de organisatie, die kwaliteit, energie en humor brengt; cultuur omarmt en ownership heeft. De cultuur is professioneel en no nonsens, dus we zoeken iemand die daar goed bij past. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Technical Architect & Developer – Marketing Automation
description: Who is Sonar? Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com , Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development. Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. Position Description We are seeking a deeply technical Marketing Technology Architect / Developer to lead the data architecture, custom code development, system integrations, and infrastructure scalability of our marketing engine. Our day-to-day stack currently relies on Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) as our primary engine, and we are actively considering next-generation architecture like Marketing Cloud Next. However, for us, specific tool proficiency takes a backseat to a genuine passion for marketing technology, AI-driven marketing innovations, robust data architecture, and technical problem-solving. We value your ability to analyze complex data models, integrate APIs, write clean code, and optimize high-throughput automation pipelines over specific certifications. If you are a platform-agnostic technologist passionate about marketing tech stack mechanics and AI marketing tools, this role provides the scope and autonomy to build world-class system infrastructure. What you will do Data Architecture & Engineering Operations Enablement: Prepare, clean, structure, and model marketing data for Marketing Operations teams to run campaigns, segment audiences, and manage daily operations friction-free. Data Modeling: Build and optimize scalable relational database structures, data extensions, custom models, and subscriber key lifecycles for operational needs. ETL & Data Pipelines: Partner with the Data Team to create automated SQL queries and ETL pipelines ingesting and transforming data warehouse datasets (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery) into production-ready data extensions. Governance & Hygiene: Maintain data hygiene, identity resolution, deduplication, and real-time ecosystem syncs to ensure efficiency. Technical Customization & Custom Development Write maintainable custom platform code (e.g., AMPscript, SSJS, WSProxy) for personalization engines. Develop dynamic rendering logic, interactive web forms, and secure landing pages. Troubleshoot automation failures, script exceptions, and data bottlenecks. API & Ecosystem Integrations Architect and maintain API integrations (REST, SOAP, Webhooks) connecting product apps, mobile backends, and third-party systems to the marketing platform. Configure native CRM and database connectors for low-latency, real-time bidirectional sync. Manage rate limits, payload efficiency, OAuth, and retry handlers. Platform Operations & System Health Monitor runtimes, script performance, and query execution to ensure 99.9% uptime. Lead security governance, permissions, business unit structuring, and privacy compliance (GDPR, CCPA, CAN-SPAM). Partner with DevOps and IT Security on domain authentication and deliverability infrastructure. Experience and qualifications Core Technical Competencies Advanced SQL & Database Design: Extensive experience with relational data modeling, complex joins, aggregation, and query tuning. Integrations & Protocols: Strong knowledge of REST/SOAP APIs, JSON/XML, OAuth 2.0, webhooks, and Postman. Scripting & Code: Skilled in AMPscript, SSJS, or general languages (JavaScript, Node.js, Python) applied to MarTech. MarTech & AI Curiosity: Passionate about marketing architecture, event triggers, relational mapping, agentic AI, CDPs, and automated personalization. Experience 3+ years in technical architecture, administration, or development in Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) (Automation Studio, Journey Builder, Contact Builder, CloudPages, APIs, or Data Cloud/AI frameworks). Practical understanding of how Predictive, Generative, and Agentic AI transform technical marketing. Proven track record of evaluating and mastering new marketing platforms and technical tools. Key Personality Traits Tech & AI Enthusiast: Actively follows MarTech, CDPs, AI automation, and data engineering trends. Platform Agnostic: Uses tools and AI models adaptively to solve data and communication challenges. Problem Solver: Enjoys debugging complex data issues, race conditions, integrations, and AI logic edge cases. In-office culture We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having. Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date. Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Reliability Engineer
description: Make Your Mark as a Reliability Engineer at Storio group About the role. We are looking for a Reliability Engineer to join our production team and help optimize our machinery operations. In this role, you will analyze the lifecycle of our equipment, evaluate how we manage asset maintenance, and prevent potential downtime before it happens. You will work closely with operational teams to keep our production running safely and smoothly across our plant. When failures do occur, you will advise the team on how to respond quickly and effectively. You will use data and engineering risk methodologies to develop preventive maintenance strategies, establish inspection criteria, and protect our business from performance losses. Your work directly impacts our operational efficiency and the continuous delivery of personalized products to our customers. How you embrace curiosity daily. Analyze statistical data, performance losses, and cost drivers to predict equipment failures and uncover improvement opportunities. Facilitate root cause analysis using techniques like FMEA, Fault Tree Analysis, and PHA for complex machinery issues. Test new ideas and support machine trials to optimize process performance and material changes. Review preventive maintenance programs and recommend technical updates to increase machinery availability. Assess the technical feasibility of proposed changes from procurement and operational teams. Explore innovative ways to streamline maintenance approaches while cutting overall operational costs. How you make your mark. Maximize equipment availability and reliability while lowering maintenance costs across the plant. Develop effective maintenance strategies and clear standard operating procedures for autonomous maintenance. Lead cross-functional improvement teams to solve persistent technical problems and boost site productivity. Support capital investment projects to ensure new equipment meets strict maintainability standards and spare part requirements. Conduct risk assessments to maintain full compliance with statutory inspection requirements, safety guidelines, and product quality standards. What you bring to the team. Strong experience as a reliability engineer or production specialist in a manufacturing environment. Deep knowledge of reliability engineering techniques including FMEA, FTA, PHA, and criticality analysis. Proven ability to facilitate root cause analysis and resolve complex technical equipment failures. Practical background in developing preventive maintenance strategies, SOPs, and machine inspection criteria. Hands-on experience supporting new machine installations, engineering trials, and capital projects. Strong communication skills to guide production teams and collaborate on safety and quality standards. What sets you apart. Experience applying maintainability analysis within high-volume automated production settings. Degree or formal qualification in Mechanical, Electrical, or Reliability Engineering.
